māṃsalairṛjubhirvṛttaiḥ pārśvairnṛpatayaḥ smṛtāḥ |
īśvaro vyāghrapṛṣṭhastu senāyāścaiva nāyakaḥ | | 27
kūrmapṛṣṭhāstu rājāno dhanasaubhāgyabhāginaḥ | | 28
vistīrṇaṃ hadayaṃ yeṣāṃ māṃsalomacitaṃ samam |
śatāyuṣo vijānīyādbhogabhājo mahādhanān | | 29
viralāḥ śuṣkāstathā rūkṣā dṛśyante.aṅgulayaḥ kare |
tasya sidhyati vāṇijyaṃ puruṣasya na saṃśayaḥ | | 32
yajñayājī bhavennityaṃ bahuvittaśca mānavaḥ | | 33
śailaṃ vāpyatha vā vṛkṣaḥ karamadhye tu dṛśyate |
acalāṃ śriyamāpnoti bahubhṛtyasamanvitaḥ | | 34
śaktitomarabāṇāsirekhā 1 cāpopamā tathā |
dhvajabhrāpyatha vā śaṃkhaḥ karamadhye tu dṛśyate |
śrīvatsamatha vā padmaṃ vajraṃ vā cakameva ca |
rājānaṃ taṃ vijānīyātparasainyavidāraṇam | | 37
dakṣiṇe tu karāṅguṣṭhe yavo yasya tu dṛśyate |

gatā madhyaṃ pradeśinyāḥ sa jīveccharadaḥ śatam | | 39
puruṣalakṣaṇavarṇanam
māyāvī viṣamā 1 kukṣistathā kuhakakṛtsadā | | 1
rājā syānnimnakukṣistu sārvabhaumo mahābalaḥ |
vistīrṇābhirmaṇḍalābhirunnatābhiśca nābhibhiḥ |
valirmadhyaṅgatā vīrā viṣamā ca viśeṣataḥ | |
dhanahāniṃ tathā śūlaṃ nityaṃ janayate vibho | | 4
vāmāvārtā sadā śāntiṃ karotīti vidurbudhāḥ |
karoti medhāṃ dakṣiṇena saṃpravṛttā divaspate | | 5
pārśvāyatā dīrghamāyuraiśvaryamūrdhvataḥ smṛtam |
gavāḍhyatāmadhastāttu karotīti vidurbudhāḥ | | 6

bhūpatvaṃ kurute sā tu puruṣasya na saṃśayaḥ | | 7
māṃsalairmṛdubhiḥ pārśvai rājā syānnātra saṃśayaḥ | | 11
rājānaḥ sukhinaścāpi bhavantīha na saṃśayaḥ | | 13
avepanaṃ māṃsalaṃ ca pārthivānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ | | 14
khararomacitaṃ vīraśirālaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
adhanānāṃ bhavedeva hṛdayaṃ ṛbhavottama | |
samavakṣaso.arthayutāḥ pīnaiḥ śūrāḥ smṛtā budhaiḥ | | 15

vadhyante cāpi śastreṇa nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | | 16
nirmāṃsairviṣamairvīra niḥsvo nimnaiḥ pracakṣyate |

śūraḥ syānmahiṣagrīvo mṛgagrīvo bhayāturaḥ | | 19
kambugrīvo bhavedrājā lambakaṇṭho.agralakṣaṇaḥ |
nimāṃsau romaśau bhagnāvalpau vāpi viśeṣataḥ |
bhavedaromaśaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ dhanināṃ bhīmasambhava |
salomaśaṃ tathā vakraṃ nirdhanānāṃ balādhipa | | 22
asvedanāvunnatau ca tathā pīnau ṣaḍānana |
śūrāṇāmīdṛśāvaṃsau nagajānandavardhana | | 24
dīrghabāhurbhavedrājā samudravacanaṃ yathā | | 25
pralambabāhurvijñeyo naraḥ sarvaguṇānvitaḥ |
vāmāvartabhujā ye tu dīrghāyatabhujāśca ye |
sampūrṇabāhū rājā syādityāha sa payonidhiḥ | | 27
grīvā ca vartulākārā kamburekhāsamāvṛtā |
dīrghagrīvā bakagrīvā śukagrīvāśca ye narāḥ |
uṣṭragrīvāḥ karigrīvāḥ sarve te nirdhanāḥ smṛtāḥ | | 29
ibhāṅgasadṛśau vṛttau samau pīnau ca suvrata |
ājānulambinau bāhū pārthivānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ | | 1.26.30
daridrāṇāṃ lomaśau hrasvau bāhū jñeyau surottama |
taskarāṇāṃ ca viṣamau sthūlau sūkṣmau ca suvrata | | 31
bhavedārbhavaśārdūla tathā bhīruśca mānavaḥ | | 32
uttānakaratalo dātā bhavatīti na saṃśayaḥ | | 33
viṣamā bhavanti viṣamairnimnāścāpi viśeṣataḥ |
karatalairdevaśārdūla lākṣābhairīśvarāḥ smṛtāḥ | | 34
agamyāgamanaṃ pītai rūkṣairnirdhanatā smṛtā |
apeyapānaṃ kurvanti nīlakṛṣṇaiḥ sadaiva hi | | 35
nimnāḥ snigdhā bhavennṛṇāṃ rekhā karatale guha |
dhanināṃ na daridrāṇāmityāha sa payonidhiḥ | | 36
dhaninastu mahābāho ye ghanāṅgulayo narāḥ | | 37
vadanaṃ maṇḍalaṃ yasya dharmaśīlaṃ tamādiśet |
śuṇḍavaktrā narā ye tu durbhagāste na saṃśayaḥ | | 38
harivaktrā jihmavaktrā vikṛtāsyāstathā narāḥ |
bhagnavatrāḥ karālāsyā sarve te taskarāḥ smṛtāḥ | | 39
sampūrṇavaktrā rājāno gajasiṃhānanāstathā |
chāgavānaravaktrāśca dhaninaḥ parikīrtitāḥ | | 1.26.40
kṛṣibhāgī bhavennityaṃ bahuvittaśca mānavaḥ | | 41
siṃhavyāghragajendrāṇāṃ kapolaḥ sadṛśo yadi |
mahābhogī sa vijñeyaḥ senāyāścaiva nāyakaḥ | | 42

sthūloṣṭhā hanumūlāśca śuṣkaistīkṣṇaiśca duḥkhitāḥ | |47
asphoṭitāgraṃ snigdhaṃ ca nataṃ mṛdu tathā guha |
sampūrṇaṃ ca sadā śastaṃ śmaśru bhūmipaterguha | | 48
raktaiścālpaistathā rūkṣaiḥ śmaśrubhirbhīmanandana |
narāścaurā bhavantyeva paradāraratāstathā | |49
nirmāṃsau yasya vai karṇau saṃgrāmānnāśamṛcchati 1 |
cipiṭābhyāṃ bhavedrogī hrasvau ca kṛpaṇasya ca | | 1.26.50
śaṅkukarṇaśca bhūnāthaḥ sarvaśatrubhayaṅkaraḥ |
dīrghāyū romaśābhyāṃ tu vipulābhyāṃ narādhipaḥ | |
bhogī ca sa bhavennityaṃ devabrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ | | 51
śirāvabaddhau krūrasya vyālambau ca viśeṣataḥ |
bhogī syānnigaṇḍo vai mantrī sampūrṇagaṇḍakaḥ |
śubhabhākchukanāsastu cirajīvī śuṣkanāsikaḥ | | 53
kundakuṇḍalasaṅkāśaiḥ prakāśairdaśanairnṛpaḥ |
ṛkṣavānaradantāśca nityaṃ kṣutparipīḍitāḥ | | 54
hastidantāḥ kharadantāḥ snigdhadantā guṇānvitāḥ |
karālairviralai rūkṣairdaśanairduḥkhajīvinaḥ | | 55
dvātriṃśaddantā rājāna ekatriṃśacca bhogavān |
triṃśaddantā narā nityaṃ sukhaduḥkhitvabhāgina | |
ūnatriṃśacya daśanaiḥ puruṣāḥ duḥkhabhāginaḥ | | 56
kṛṣṇajihvo bhavetpreṣyaḥ savalayā tu jihvayā |
śvetajihvā narā jñeyāḥ śaucācārasamanvitāḥ |
padmapatrasamā jihvā sūkṣmā dīrghā suśobhanā | |
sthūlā ca na ca vistīrṇā yeṣāṃ te manujādhipāḥ | | 58
nimnā snigdhā ca hrasvā ca raktāgrā rasanā yadi |
kṛṣṇatālurnaro yastu sa bhavetkulanāśanaḥ |
sukhabhāgī duḥkhabhāgī pītatālurnarādhipaḥ | | 1.26.60
vikṛtaṃ sphuṭitaṃ rūkṣaṃ tālukaṃ na praśasyate |
padmatālurbhavedrājā śvetatālurdhaneśvaraḥ | | 61
haṃsasvarā narā dhanyā meghagambhīraniḥsvanāḥ |
krauṃcasvanāśca rājāno bhogavanto mahādhanāḥ | | 62
cakravākasvanā dhanyā rājāno dharmavatsalāḥ |
rūkṣadīrghasvarāḥ krūrāḥ paśūnāṃ sadṛśā na tu | | 63
gurgurasvarasaṃyuktāḥ puruṣāḥ kleśabhāginaḥ |
cāṣasvanā bhāgyayutā bhinnakāṃsyasvarāśca ye | |
kṣīṇabhinnasvarā ye syuradhamāste prakīrtitāḥ | | 64
pārthivāstanunāsāśca dīrghanāsāśca bhoginaḥ |
hrasvanāsā narā ye tu dharmaśīlāstu te matāḥ | | 65
hastyaśvasiṃhanāsāśca sūcīnāsāśca ye narāḥ |
teṣāṃ sidhyati vāṇijyaṃ hayānāṃ caiva vikrayaḥ | | 66
vikṛtā nāsikā yasya sthūlāgrā rūpavarjitā |
pāpakarmā sa vijñeyaḥ sāmudravacanaṃ yathā | | 67
dāḍimīpuṣpasaṃkāśe bhavetāṃ yasya locane |
bhūpatiḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ saptadvīpādhipo guha | | 68
vyāghrākṣāḥ kopanā jñeyāḥ karkaṭākṣāḥ kalipriyāḥ |
biḍālahaṃsanetrāśca bhavanti puruṣādhamāḥ | | 69
mapūranakulākṣāśca narāste madhyamāḥ smṛtāḥ |
āpiṅgalākṣā rājānaḥ sarvabhogasamanvitāḥ |
rocanā haritālākṣā guñjāpiṅgā dhaneśvarāḥ | |
balasattvaguṇopetāḥ pṛthivīcakravartinaḥ | | 71
dvimātrāvīkṣaṇā nityaṃ jīvanti paramāśritāḥ |
trimātrāsyandino jñeyāḥ puruṣāḥ sukhabhāginaḥ | | 72
caturmātrānimeṣaiśca nayanairīśvarāḥ smṛtāḥ |
dīrghāyuṣo dharmaratāḥ pañcamātrānimeṣiṇaḥ | | 73
hrasvakarṇā mahābhāgā mahākarṇāśca ye narāḥ |
dīrghāyuṣaḥ śuktikarṇāḥ śaṅkhakarṇā mahādhanāḥ |
dīrghāyuṣo dīrghakarṇā lambakarṇāstapasvinaḥ | | 75
lalāṭenārdhacandreṇa bhavanti pṛthivīśvarāḥ |
vipulena lalāṭena mahādhanapatiḥ smṛtaḥ | |
rekhā pañca lalāṭe tu striyā vā puruṣasya vā |
śataṃ jīvati varṣāṇāmaiśvaryaṃ cādhigacchati | | 77
catūrekhāmaśītiṃ tu tribhiḥ saptatimeva ca |
dvābhyāṃ ṣaṣṭiṃ tu rekhābhyāṃ catvāriṃśattathaikayā | |
arekhena lalāṭena vijñeyā pañcaviṃśatiḥ | | 78
rekhācchedaistu vijñeyā hīnamadhyottamā narāḥ |
alpāyuṣastathālpābhirvyādhibhiḥ paripīḍitāḥ | | 79
triśūlaṃ paṭṭiśaṃ vāpi lalāṭe yasya dṛśyate |
īśvaraṃ taṃ vijānīyādbhoginaṃ kīrtimāśritam | | 1.26.80
candrākāraṃ narendrāṇāṃ gavāḍhyaṃ maṅgalaṃ smṛtam | | 81
viṣamaṃ tu daridrāṇāṃ śiro dīrghaṃ tu duḥkhinām |
nāgakumbhanibhaṃ rājñaḥ samaṃ sarvatra bhoginaḥ | | 82
kapilaḥ sphuṭitai rūkṣaiḥ sthūlaiśva śikhareśayaiḥ |
duḥkhitā puruṣā jñeyā romaśmaśrubhireva ca | | 83

nātistokā na bahuśo mūrdhajā duḥkhabhāginaḥ | | 84

kacā yasya tu dṛśyante sa bhavetpṛthivīpatiḥ | | 85
puruṣalakṣaṇa-varṇanam
saṃkṣepato mama vibho lakṣaṇāni nṛpasya tu |
śubhāni cāṅgajātāni brūhi me vadatāṃ vara | | 1
śṛṇu vakṣyeṅgajātāni pārthivasya śubhāni ca |
pārthivo jñāyate yaistu narāṇāṃ madhyabhāgataḥ | | 2
udyatāni tathā ṣaḍ vai gambhīrāṇi ca trīṇi vai | | 3
dīrghāṇi cāpi sūkṣmāṇi bhavanti yasya pañca vā | | 4
nābhiḥ saṃdhiḥ svanaśceti gambhīrāṇi ca trīṇi vai |
sa rājā nātra sandehaḥ śṛṇuṣvevonnatāni ca | | 6
kṛkāṭikā tadhā cāsyaṃ nakhā vakṣo.atha nāsikā |
kakṣe cāpi mahābāho ṣaḍetāni vidurbudhāḥ | | 7
liṅgaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ tathā grīvā jaṅghā hrasvāni suvrata |
jihvā raktā nakhāścaiva saptaitāni mahāmate | | 8
tvacaḥ kararuhāḥ keśā daśanā ṛbhavottama |
sūkṣmāṇyetāni ca guha pañca cāpi vidurbudhāḥ | | 9
nāsikālocane bāhū stanayorantaraṃ hanuḥ |
iti dīrghamidaṃ proktaṃ pañcakaṃ bhūbhujāṃ nṛpa | | 1.27.10
kṣutaṃ rājñāṃ sakṛddvistrirnāditaṃ hrāditaṃ tathā |
dīrghāyuṣāṃ prayuktaṃ te hasitaṃ ca vidurbudhāḥ | | 11
madhupiṅgairmahātmāno narā jñeyāḥ surādhipa |
bhīravo hi kṛśākṣāstu caurā maṇḍalacakrakaiḥ | | 13
nīlotpalābhairvedavido bhṛśaṃ kṛṣṇaistathārthitā | |
śyāmākṣāḥ subhagā jñeyā dīnākṣaibhra daridratā |
abhyunnatābhirhrasvāyurviśālābhiḥ sukhī bhavet |
bhruvo bālendusadṛśā dhanināmārbhavottama |
kṣīṇābhirarthahīnāḥ syurnarā jñeyāḥ surottama |
viralairunnataiḥ śaṃkhairdhanyāḥ syurnātra saṃśayaḥ |
nimnaiḥ stutyarthasaṃsaktā unnataiśca janādhipāḥ | | 19
viṣamalalāṭā vidhanāḥ sadā syurdevasattama |
ācāryāḥ śuktisadṛśairnarāḥ syurnātra saṃśayaḥ | | 1.27.20
unnataśirobhirāḍhyā narā jñeyāḥ sadā guha |
vadhabandhabhāgino vīrā narā ninnalalāṭinaḥ | |
bhṛśamunnataiśca mūrkhāśca kṛpaṇāśca tathā nataiḥ | | 21
śubhāvahaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ vadanaṃ syādyathā śṛṇu |
adīnamānanaṃ snigdhaṃ sasmitaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | | 22
sāśrudīnaṃ tathā rūkṣamasnigdhaṃ ninditaṃ guha |
asambhāvyaṃ mukhaṃ jñeyaṃ narāṇāṃ nagadāraṇa | | 23
akampaṃ gubhadaṃ jñeyaṃ narāṇāṃ hasitaṃ guha |
nimīlitākṣaṃ pāpasya hasitaṃ cārbhavottama | | 24
āmaṇḍalaṃ śiro yasya sa gavāḍhyo naro bhavet |
cipiṭākāritaśirā hanyādvai pitarau naraḥ |
ghaṇṭākṛti śirodhvānamasakṛtsevate naraḥ | |
nimnaṃ śironarthadaṃ syānnarāṇāmarbhavottama | | 26
bahulāḥ kapilāḥ sthūlā viṣamāḥ sphuṭitāstathā |
paruṣā hrasvātikuṭilā daridrāṇāṃ kacāḥ ghanāḥ | | 28

yoṣitāṃ tadidānīṃ te lakṣaṇaṃ vacmi bhīmaja | | 29
strīlakṣaṇavarṇanam
śṛṇvidānīṃ mahābāho strīlakṣaṇamanuttamam |
yanmayoktaṃ purā vīra nāradasya mahātmanaḥ | | 1
ninditaṃ ca praśastaṃ ca strīṇāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam | | 2
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva bhrātaraṃ mātulaṃ tathā |
dvijaistu saha vāgamya kanyāṃ vīkṣeta śāstravit | | 4
pāṇimeva ca jaṅghe ca kaṭināsoru eva ca | | 5
jihvāṃ coṣṭhau ca dantāśca kapolaṃ galakaṃ tathā | | 6

romarājiṃ svaraṃ varṇamāvartāni tu vā punaḥ | | 7
yasyāstu rekhāgrīvāyāṃ yā ca raktāntalocanā |
lalāṭe dṛśyate yasyāstriśūlaṃ devanirmitam |
bahūnāṃ strīsahasrāṇāṃ svāminīṃ tāṃ vinirdiśet | | 9
rājahaṃsagatiryasyā mṛgākṣī mṛgavarṇikā |
samaśuklāgradantā ca kanyāṃ tāmuttamāṃ viduḥ | | 1.28.10
maṇḍūkakukṣī yā kanyā nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalā |
haṃsasvarā mṛduvacā yā kanyā madhupiṅgalā |
āyatau śravaṇau yasyāḥ surūpā cāpi nāsikā |
bhruvau cendrāyudhākārau sātyantaṃ sukhabhāginī | | 13
tanvī śyāmā tathā kṛṣṇā snigdhāṅgī mṛdubhāṣiṇī |
śaṅkhakundendudaśanā bhavedaiśvaryabhāginī | | 14
vistīrṇaṃ jaghanaṃ yasyā vedimadhyā tu yā bhavet |
maśakaṃ tilakaṃ vāpi sā pūrvaṃ janayetsutam | | 16
gūḍhagulphāṅguliśirā alpapārṣṇiḥ sumadhyamā |
raktākṣī raktacaraṇā sātyantaṃ sukhabhāginī | | 17
vakrāṅgulitalau pādau kanyāṃ tāṃ parivarjayet | | 18
yena kenacidaṃśena māṃsaṃ yasyā vivardhate |
rāsabhīṃ tādṛśīṃ vidyānna sā kalyāṇamarhati | | 19
pāde pradeśinī yasyā aṅguṣṭhaṃ samatikramet |
duḥśīlā durbhagā jñeyā kanyāṃ tāṃ parivarjayet | | 1.28.20
pāde madhyamikā yasyāḥ kṣitiṃ na spṛśate yadi |
ramate sā na kaumāre svacchandā kāmacāriṇī | | 21
pāde anāmikā yasyāḥ kṣitiṃ na spṛśate yadi |
dvitīyaṃ puruṣaṃ hatvā tṛtīye sā pratiṣṭhitā | | 22
pāde kaniṣṭhā yasyāstu kṣitiṃ na spṛśate yadi |
dvitīyaṃ puruṣaṃ hatvā tṛtīye sā pratiṣṭhitā | | 23
gulmavṛkṣasanāmnī ca kanyāṃ tāṃ parivarjayet | | 24
naitāḥ patiṣu rajyante yāśca nakṣatranāmikāḥ | | 25
āvartaḥ pṛṣṭhato yasyā nābhiṃ samanuvindati |
pṛṣṭhāvartā patiṃ hanti nābhyāvartā pativratā |
yasyāstu hasamānāyā gaṇḍe jāyet kūpakam |
ramate sā na kaumāre svacchandā kāryakāriṇī | | 28
sthūlahastā ca yā syādvai dāsīṃ tāṃ nirdiśedbudhaḥ | | 1.28.30
yasyāścotkaṭakau pādau mukhaṃ ca vikṛtaṃ bhavet |
uttaroṣṭhe ca romāṇi sā kṣipraṃ bhakṣayetpatim | | 31
trīṇi yasyāḥ pralambante lalāṭamudaraṃ sphicau |
trīṇi bhakṣayate sā tu devaraṃ śvasuraṃ patim | | 32
samudbhūṣitacāritrā gurubhaktā pativratā |
devabrāhmaṇabhaktā ca mānuṣīṃ tāṃ vinirdiśet ||3 3

āstīkastatra bhavitā teṣāṃ naurvahnisāgare | | 1.32.30
śrutvā sa cāgniṃ rājānamṛtvijastadanantaram |
nivartayiṣyate yāgaṃ nāgānāṃ mohanaṃ param | | 31
pañcamyāṃ tatra bhavitā brahmā provāca lelihān |
tasmādiyaṃ mahābāho pañcamī dayitā sadā | |
nāgānāmānandakarī dattā vai brahmaṇā purā | | 32
kṛtvā tu bhojanaṃ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu kāmataḥ |
visṛjya nāgāḥ prīyantāṃ ye kecitpṛthivītale | | 33
ye nadīṣu mahānāgā ye sarasvatigāminaḥ | |
ye ca vāpītaḍāgeṣu teṣu sarveṣu vai namaḥ | | 34
nāgānviprāṃśca sampūjya visṛjya ca yathārthataḥ |
tataḥ paścāttu bhuñjīta saha bhṛtyairnarādhipa | | 35
pūrvaṃ madhuramaśnīyāttato bhuñjīta kāmataḥ |
mṛto nāgapuraṃ yāti pūjyamāno.apsarogaṇaiḥ |
vimānavaramārūḍho ramate kālamīpsitam | | 37
iha cāgatya rājāsāvayutānāṃ varo bhavet |
sarvaratnasamṛddhaḥ syādvāhanāḍhyaśca jāyate | | 38
daśanti ye naraṃ vipra nāgāḥ krodhasamanvitāḥ |
nāgadaṣṭo naro rājanprāpya mṛtyuṃ vrajatyadhaḥ |
adho gatyā bhavetsarpo nirviṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ | |4 1
upoṣyā pañcamī rājannāgānāṃ puṣṭivardhinī |
tvamevamekaṃ rājendra vidhānaṃ śṛṇu bhārata | | 44
māsi bhādrapade yā tu kṛṣṇapakṣe mahīpate |
mahāpuṇyā tu sā proktā grāhyāpi ca mahīpate | |45
jñeyā dvādaśa ṣañcamyo hāyane bharatarṣabha |
kṛtvā dārumayānvāpi atha vā mṛnmayānnṛpa | |47
pañcamyāmarcayedbhaktyā nāgānāṃ pañcakaṃ nṛpa |
karavīraiḥ śatapatrairjātīpuṣpaiśca suvrata | | 48
brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayetpaścād ghṛtapāyasamodakaiḥ | |4 9
ananto vāsukiḥ śaṅkhaḥ padmaḥ kambala eva ca |
tathā karkoṭako nāgo nāgo hyaśvataro nṛpa | | 1.32.50
dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ śaṅkhapālaḥ kāliyastakṣakastathā |
piṅgalaśca tathā nāgo māsi māsi prakīrtitāḥ | | 51
vatsarānte pāraṇaṃ syādbrāhmaṇānbhojayedbahūn |
itihāsavide nāgaṃ gairikeṇa kṛtaṃ nṛpa | |
tathārcanā pradātavyā vācakāya mahīpate | | 52
eṣa vai nāgapañcamyā vidhiḥ proktā budhairnṛpa |
tava pitrā kṛtaścaiva piturmokṣāya bhārata | | 53
suvarṇabhāraniṣpannaṃ nāgaṃ dattvā tathā ca gām | | 54
vyāsāya kuruśārdūla piturānṛṇyamāpnuyāḥ |
tava pitrā kṛtā hyevaṃ pañcamyupāsanā nṛpa | | 55
utsṛjya nāgatāṃ vīra tava pūrvapitāmahaḥ |
puṣpottaraṃ sado gatvā tathā puṣpasado nṛpa | | 56
daṣṭako mokṣyate teṣāṃ śubhaṃ sthānamavāpsyati | | 58
yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ naraḥ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
sarpāṇāṃ kati rūpāṇi ke varṇāḥ kiṃ ca lakṣaṇam |
kā jātistu bhavetteṣāṃ keṣu yonikuleṣu vā | | 1
sarpāṇāṃ kati rūpāṇi kiṃ cihnaṃ kiṃ ca lakṣaṇam |
jātiṃ kulaṃ tadhā varṇānbrūhi sarvaṃ prajāpate | | 3
kathaṃ vā jāyate sarpaḥ kadhaṃ muñcedviṣaṃ prabho |
viṣavegāḥ kati proktāḥ katyeva viṣanāḍikāḥ | |4
daṃṣṭrāḥ katividhāḥ proktāḥ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ viṣāgame |
gṛhṇīte tu kadā garbhaṃ kathaṃ ceha prasūyate | | 5
kīdṛśī strī pumāṃścaiva kīdṛśaśca napuṃsakaḥ |
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kaśyapaḥ pratyabhāṣata |
śṛṇu gautama tattvena sarpāṇāmiha lakṣaṇam | |7
māsyāṣāḍhe tathā jyeṣṭhe pramādyanti bhujaṅgamāḥ |
caturo vārṣikānmāsānnāgī garbhamadhārayat |
tataḥ kārttikamāse tu aṇḍakāni prasūyate | | 9
aṇḍakānāṃ tu vijñeye dveśate dve ca viṃśatī |
tānyeva bhakṣayetsā tu bhogaikaṃ ghṛṇayā tyajet | | 1.33.10
svarṇārkavarṇādvai tasmātpumānsañjāyate.aṇḍakāt |
tānyeva khādate sarpa ahorātrāṇi viṃśatim | | 11
svarṇaketakavarṇābhāddīrgharājīvasannibhāt |
tasmādutpadyate strī vai aṇḍādbrāhmaṇasattama | | 12
śirīṣapuṣpavarṇābhādaṇḍakātsyānnapuṃsakaḥ |
tato bhinatti cāṇḍāni ṣaṇmāsena tu gautama | | 13
tato.asau saptarātreṇa kṛṣṇo bhavati pannagaḥ | | 14
āyuḥpramāṇaṃ sarpāṇāṃ śataṃ viṃśottaraṃ smṛtam |
mṛtyuścāṣṭavidho jñeyaḥ śṛṇuṣvātra yathākramam | | 15
mayūrānmānuṣādvāpi cakorādgokhurāttathā |
biḍālānnakulāccaiva varāhādvṛścikāttathā | |
eteṣāṃ yadi mucyeta jīvedviṃśottaraṃ śatam | | 16
saptāhe tu tataḥ pūrṇe daṃṣṭrāṇāṃ cādhirohaṇam |
viṣasyāgamanaṃ tatra nikṣipecca punaḥ punaḥ | | 17
evaṃ jñātvā tu tattvena viṣakarmmārabheta vai |
ekaviṃśatirātreṇa viṣadaṃṣṭrā sujāyate | |
nāgīpārśvasamāvartī bālasarpaḥ sa ucyate | | 18
pañcaviṃśatirātrastu sadyaḥ prāṇaharo bhavet |
ṣaṇmāsājjātamātrastu kañcukaṃ vai pramuñcati | | 19
pādānāṃ cāpi vijñeye dve śate dve ca viṃśatī |
golomasadṛśāḥ pādāḥ praviśanti kramanti ca | | 1.33.20
sandhīnāṃ cāsya vijñeye dveśate viṃśatī tathā |
aṃgulyaścāpi vijñeyā dve śate viṃśatī tathā | | 21
akālajātā ye sarpā nirviṣāste prakīrtitāḥ |
pañcasaptativarṣāṇi āyusteṣāṃ prakīrtitam | | 22
raktapītaśukladantā anīlā mandaveginaḥ |
ete alpāyuṣo jñeyo anye ca bhīravaḥ smṛtā | | 23
dvātriṃśaddaśanāḥ proktāḥ pannāgānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ | | 24
teṣāṃ madhye catasrastu daṃṣṭrā yāḥ suviṣāvahāḥ |
makarī karālī kālarātrī yamadūtī tathaiva ca | | 25
sarvāsāṃ caiva daṃṣṭrāṇāṃ devatāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
prathamā brahmadevatyā dvitīyā viṣṇudevatā | |
tṛtīyā rudradevatyā caturthī yamadevatā | | 26
hīnā pramāṇataḥ sā tu vāmanetraṃ samāśritā |
nāsyāṃ mantrāḥ prayoktavyā nauṣadhaṃ naiva bheṣajam | | 27
vaidyaḥ parāṅmukho yāti mṛtyustasyā vilekhanāt |
makarīṃ māsikāṃ vidyātkarālī ca dvimāsikā |
kālarātrī bhavettrīṇi caturo yamadūtikā | | 29
makarīṃ guḍaudanaṃ dadyātkaṣāyānnaṃ karālikām |
kālarātrīṃ kaṭuyutaṃ dūtīṃ vai sānnipātikam | | 1.33.30
makarī śastrakaṃ vidyātkarālī kākapādikā |
karākṛtiḥ kālarātriryāmyā kūrmākṛtiḥ smṛtā | | 31
makarī vātulā jñeyā karālī paittikī smṛtā |
kaphātmikā kālarātrī yamadūtī sānnipātakī | | 32
śuklā tu makarī jñeyā karālī raktasannibhā |
kālarātrī bhavetpītā kṛṣṇā ca yamadūtikā | | 33
vāmā śuklā ca kṛṣṇā ca raktā pītā ca dakṣiṇā |
samāsena tu vakṣyāmi yathaitā varṇataḥ smṛtāḥ | | 34
śuklā tu brāhmaṇī jñeyā raktā tu kṣatriyā smṛtā |
vaiśyā tu pītikā jñeyā kṛṣṇā śūdrā tu kathyate | |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi daṃṣṭrāṇāṃ viṣalakṣaṇam | | 35
daṃṣṭrāṇāṃ tu viṣaṃ nāsti nityameva bhujaṅgame |
dakṣiṇaṃ netramāsādya viṣaṃ sarpasya tiṣṭhati | | 36
mastakāddhamanīṃ yāti tato nāḍīṣu gacchati | | 37
nāḍībhyaḥ padyate daṃṣṭrāṃ viṣaṃ tatra pravartate |
tatsarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ | | 38
aṣṭabhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ sarpo daśate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
ākrānto daśate pūrvaṃ dvitīyaṃ pūrvavairiṇam | | 39
tṛtīyaṃ daśate bhītaścaturthaṃ madadarpitaḥ |
pañcamaṃ tu kṣudhāviṣṭaḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ ceha viṣolbaṇaḥ | |
saptamaṃ purarakṣārthamaṣṭamaṃ kālacoditaḥ | | 1.33.40
balabhugnākṛtiṃ daṃṣṭrāmākrāntaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet | |4 1
yasya sarpeṇa daṣṭasya gabhīraṃ dṛśyate vraṇam |
vairadaṣṭaṃ vijānīyātkaśyapasya vaco yathā | |4 2
ekaṃ daṃṣṭrāpadaṃ yasya avyaktaṃ na ca kalpitam |
bhītadaṣṭaṃ vijānīyādyathovāca prajāpatiḥ | | 43
madadaṣṭaṃ vijānīyātkaśyapasya vaco yathā | | 44
dve ca daṃṣṭrāpade yasya dṛśyante ca mahākṣatam |
kṣudhāviṣṭaṃ vijānīyādyathovāca prajāpatiḥ | | 45
trividhaṃ daṣṭajātaistu lakṣaṇaṃ samudāhṛtam | |48
daṣṭānupītaṃ vijñeyaṃ kaśyapasya vaco yathā |
asādhyaścāpi vijñeyaścaturdaṃṣṭrābhipīḍitaḥ |
grīvābhaṅgo bhavetkiñcitsandaṣṭo viṣayogataḥ | |
ito daṃśastataḥ śuddho vyantaraḥ parikīrtitaḥ | | 51
kālalakṣaṇam
kaśyapa uvāca
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kāladaṣṭasya lakṣaṇam |
śṛṇu gautama tattvena yādṛśo bhavate naraḥ | | 1
jihrābhaṅgo.atha hṛcchūlaṃ cakṣurbhyāṃ ca na paśyati |
daṃśaṃ ca dagdhasaṃkāśaṃ pakvajambūphalopamam | | 2
vaivarṇyaṃ caiva dantānāṃ śyāvo bhavati varṇataḥ |
sarveṣvaṅgeṣu śaithilyaṃ purīṣasya ca bhedanam | | 3
bhagnaskandhakaṭigrīva ūrdhvadṛṣṭiradhomukhaḥ |
daṇḍena tāḍyamānasya daṇḍarājī na jāyate | | 5
daṃśe kākapadaṃ sunīlamasakṛjjambūphalābhaṃ ghanamucchūnaṃ rudhirārdrasekabahulaṃ kṛcchrānnirodho bhavet |
hikkāśvāsagalagrahaśca sumahānpāṇḍustvacā dṛśyate śuṣkāṅgaḥ pravadanti śāstranipuṇāstatkāladaṣṭaṃ viduḥ | | 6
daṃśe yasyātha śothaḥ pracalitavalitaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vā sunīlaṃ prasvedo gātra bhedaḥ sravati ca rudhiraṃ sānunāsaṃ ca jalpet |
dantoṣṭhābhyāṃ viyogo bhramati ca hṛdayaṃ sannirodhaśca tīvro divyānāmeṣa daṃśaḥ sthalavipulamayo viddhi taṃ kāladaṣṭam | | 7
dantairdantānspṛśati bahuśo dṛṣṭirāyāsakhinnā sthūlo daṃśaḥ sravati rudhiraṃ kekaraṃ cakṣurekam | |
pratyādiṣṭaḥ śvasiti satataṃ sānunāsaṃ ca bhāṣetpāpaṃ brūte sakalagaditaṃ kāladaṇḍaṃ tamāhuḥ | | 8
grīvābhaṅgaścalā nābhiḥ kāladaṣṭaṃ vinirdiśet | | 9
darpaṇe salile vāpi ātmacchāyāṃ na paśyati |
mandaraśmiṃ tathā tīvraṃ tejohīnaṃ divākaram | | 1.34.10
sa yāti nidhanaṃ jantuḥ kāladaṇḍaṃ vinirdiśet | | 11
aṣṭamyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm |
nāgapañcamīdaṣṭānāṃ jīvitasya ca saṃśayaḥ | | 12
ārdrāśleṣāmaghābharaṇīkṛttikāsu viśeṣataḥ |
viśākhāṃ triṣu pūrvāsu mūlasvātīśatātmake | |
sarpadaṣṭā na jīvanti viṣaṃ pītaṃ ca yaistathā | | 13
śūnyāgāre śmaśāne ca śuṣkavṛkṣe tathaiva ca |
na jīvanti narā daṣṭā nakṣatre tithisaṃyute | | 14
aṣṭottaraṃ marma śataṃ prāṇināṃ samudāhṛtam |
teṣāṃ madhye tu marmāṇi daśa dve cāpi kīrtite | | 15
śaṅkhe netre bhruvormadhye bastibhyāṃ vṛṣaṇottare |
eṣu dvādaśamarmeṣu daṃśaiḥ śastreṇa vā hataḥ |
na jīvati naro loke kāladaṇḍaṃ vinirdiśet | | 17
dūto vā daṇḍahasto bhavati ca yugalaṃ pāśahastastathā vā raktavastraṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ mukhaśirasi gatamekavastraśca dūtaḥ | |
nāgodayaṃ pravakṣyāmi īśānena tu bhāṣitam |
brahmaṇā tu purā sṛṣṭā grahā nāgāstvanekaśaḥ | | 21
kulikaḥ śaṃkhapālaśca dvāvetau tu śanaiścaraḥ | | 23
pūrvapādaḥ śaṃkhapālo dvitīyaḥ kulikastathā |
śaniḥ prāgaṣṭame bhāge divārātre tvihocyate | | 25
grahāśca bhuñjate caiva śeṣaṃ bhāgasya lakṣaṇam |
ravivāre sadā jñeyau pādau daśa caturdaśa | | 26
aṣṭa dvādaśa vai candre daśa ṣaṣṭhe kuje tathā |
gurordvitīyaḥ ṣaṣṭhaśca ṣoḍaśasya tu varjayet |
śanaiścaradine pādaṃ tyajeccaiva sudāruṇam |
dvitīyaṃ dvādaśaṃ caiva ṣoḍaśasya tu varjayet | | 29
muhūrtaghaṭikādūrddhvaṃ ghaṭikā caturthaṃ bhāgaṃ viṃśatiśca |
kuhūsutaṃ budbudaṃ nimeṣametatkālasya lakṣaṇam | | 1.34.30
yamadūtīlakṣaṇam
kaśyapa uvāca
saviṣā daṃṣṭrayormadhye yamadūtī tu vai bhavet |
na cikitsā budhaiḥ kāryā taṃ gatāsuṃ virnidaśet | | 1
praharārdhaṃ divārātrāvekaikaṃ bhuñjate bahiḥ |
ekasya ca samānaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ tathā | | 2
kāladaṣṭaṃ vijānīyātkaśyapasya vaco yathā | | 3
tanmātraṃ sravate daṃṣṭrā viṣaṃ sarpasya dāruṇam | | 4
nāḍīśate tu sampūrṇe dehe saṅkramate viṣam |
yāvatsaṅkrāmayedbāhuṃ kuñcitaṃ vā prasārayet | | 5
anena kṣaṇamātreṇa viṣaṃ gacchati mastake |
vardhate raktamāsādya tato vātaiḥ śikhī yathā |
śikhaṇḍī āśrayaṃ prāpya mārutena samīritaḥ |
tataḥ sthānaśataṃ prāpya tvacāsthānaṃ viceṣṭitam | | 8
tvacāsu dviguṇaṃ vidyācchoṇiteṣu caturguṇam |
pitte tu triguṇaṃ yāti śleṣme vai ṣoḍaśaṃ bhavet | | 9
vāyau triṃśadguṇaṃ caiva majjāṣaṣṭiguṇaṃ tathā |
prāṇe caikārṇavībhūte sarvagātrāṇi sandhayet | | 1.35.10
śrotre nirudhyamāne ca yāti daṣṭastvasādhyatām |
niṣkrānte tu tato jīve bhūte pañcatvamāgate |
pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca |
ityeṣāmeva saṅghātaḥ śarīramabhidhīyate | | 13
pṛthivī pṛthivīṃ yāti toyaṃ toyeṣu līyate |
ākāśaṃ caivamākāśe saha tenaiva gacchati |
tṛtīye viṣavege tu kampo gātreṣu jāyate |
pañcame viṣavege tu hikkā gātreṣu jāyate |
ṣaṣṭhe ca viṣavege tu prāṇebhyo.api pramucyate | |
saptadhātuvahā hyete vainateyena bhāṣitāḥ | | 1.35.20
tvacaḥ sthāne viṣe prāpte tasya rūpāṇi me śṛṇu |
arkamūlamapāmārgaṃ priyaṅguṃ tagaraṃ tathā |
tvacaḥ sthānaṃ tato bhittvā raktasthānaṃ pradhāvati | | 24
viṣe ca raktaṃ saṃprāpte tasya rūpāṇi me śṛṇu |
etāni yasya rūpāṇi tasya raktagataṃ viṣam |
uśīraṃ candanaṃ kuṣṭhamutpalaṃ tagaraṃ tathā |
bṛhatī vṛścikā kālī indra vāruṇimūlakam |
sinduvāraṃ tathā hiṅguṃ tṛtīye kārayedbudhaḥ |
tasya pānaṃ ca kurvīta añjanaṃ lepanaṃ tathā | | 29
pittasthānagate vipra viṣarūpāṇi me śṛṇu |
gātrataḥ pītakaḥ syādvai diśaḥ paśyati pītikā |
prabalā ca bhavanmūrcchā na cātmānaṃ vijānate | |
pippalyo madhukaṃ caiva madhu khaṇḍaṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā |
madhusāramalābūṃ ca jātiṃ śaṅkaravālukām | |
indravāruṇikāmūlaṃ gavāṃ mūtreṇa peṣayet | | 34
nasyaṃ tasya prayuñjīta pānamālepanāñjanam |
śleṣmasthānaṃ tataḥ prāpte tasya rūpāṇi me śṛṇu |
gātrāṇi tasya rudhyante niḥśvāsaśca na jāyate | |
etāni yasya rūpāṇi tasya śleṣmagataṃ viṣam |
trikuṭakī śleṣmātako lodhrañca madhusārakam |
etāni samabhāgāni gavāṃ mūtreṇa peṣayet | | 38
tasya pānaṃ ca kurvīta añjanaṃ lepanaṃ tathā |
tatra rūpāṇi vakṣyāmi vāyusthānagate viṣe | | 1.35.40
ādhmāyate ca jaṭharaṃ bāndhavāṃśca na paśyati |
īdṛśaṃ kurute rūpaṃ vṛṣṭibhaṅgaśca jāyate | | 41
etāni yasya rūpāṇi tasya vāyugataṃ viṣam |
śoṇāmūlaṃ priyālaṃ ca raktaṃ ca gajapippalīm |
bhārṅgīṃ vacāṃ pippalīṃ ca devadāruṃ madhūkakam | | 43
madhūkasāraṃ sahasinduvāraṃ hiṅguṃ ca piṣṭā guṭikāṃ ca kuryāt |
dadyācca tasyāñjanalepanādi eṣo.agadaḥ sarpaviṣāṇi hanyāt | | 44
añjanaṃ caiva nasyaṃ ca kṣipraṃ dadyādviṣānvite |
vāyusthānaṃ tato muktvā majjāsthānaṃ pradhāvati | |45
viṣe majjāgate vipra tasya rūpāṇi me śṛṇu |
dṛṣṭiśca hīyate tasya bhṛśamaṅgāni muñcati | |4 6

ratha-yātrāvarṇanam
yātrāṃ bhagavato bhaktyā bhāskarasyāmitaujasaḥ | | 1
sa parārdhaṃ tu varṣāṇāṃ sūryaloke mahīyate |
tīrthodakaṃ tu yo bhaktyā gaṃgāyāśca tathodakam |
bhaktyā varṇatrayaṃ dadyādbhāskarasya trilocana | samāpyehākhilānkāmānprāpnuyādvaruṇālayam | | 5
raktavarṇaṃ tu yo dadyāddhaviṣyānnaṃ guḍaudanam |
snāpayedyastu vā bhaktyā bhāskaraṃ pūjayettathā | | 7
sa gaccheddīptimānrudra sūryalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
sa yāti vātasālokyaṃ vātatulyaparākramaḥ |
sa lokaṃ prāpnuyātpuṇyaṃ mārutaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
sa lokaṃ prāpnuyātpuṇyaṃ yaḥ kuryānmārgamādarāt |
puṣpaprakaraśobhāḍhyaṃ śubhatoraṇamaṇḍitam | | 11
śaṃkhatūryaninādāḍhyaṃ tathā prekṣaṇakānvitam |
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo vibhāvasuḥ | | 12
sa sukhī puṇyavānnityaṃ modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ | | 14
bhaktadāsādikaṃ 1 sarvaṃ yo dadāti ravernaraḥ | samprāpyehākhilānkāmānsūryalokamavāpnuyāt | | 15
durlabhaṃ devaśārdūla viśeṣātpurato vrajan | | 16
uttarābhimukhaṃ yāntaṃ tathā vai dakṣiṇāmukham |
tato vai dvādaśe varṣe kartavyaṃ nāntarā punaḥ |
yātrāyāścāpi ye bhaṅgaṃ kurvanti vṛṣabhadhvaja | | 1.58.20
mandehā nāma te jñeyā rākṣasā nātra saṃśayaḥ |
indrādidevāste jñeyā gatāśca paramaṃ padam |
punaryātrāvidhiṃ cemaṃ samāsātkathayāmi te | | 22

etābhyāmapi devībhyāṃ yathaiva savitustathā | | 25

manasā cintayedanyāṃ yathāsthāneṣu devatām | | 26
dikpālāṃllokapālāṃśca kalpayetmanasaiva tu |

gāyatrī caiva triṣṭupca jagatyanuṣṭubeva ca | | 28
paṃktiśca bṛhatī caiva uṣṇigeva ca saptamī |
yathoktakaraṇādrudra sadā śāntirbhavennṛṇām | | 32

digdevānucarāṃścaiva pūjayetpūjyate śriyā | | 34
tattadbhūtakṛtaṃ pādyaṃ na pragṛhṇanti devatāḥ | | 35
yātrākāle tu samprāpte saviturdīkṣitāṃ tanum |
ye drakṣyaṃti narā bhaktyā te bhaviṣyantyakalmaṣāḥ | | 36
paurṇamāsyāmamāyāṃ ca darśanaṃ puṇyadaṃ smṛtam |
saptamyāṃ ca tathā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ dine tasya ravestathā | | 37

gautamyā saha kauśalyā sumanāyāṃ surālaye | | 1

śataśaḥ santi kauśalye devāḥ svarganivāsinaḥ |
devapatnyastathaivaitāḥ siddhāḥ siddhāṅganāstathā | | 3
na teṣāmīdṛśo gandho na kāntirna surūpatā |
naivābharaṇajātāni teṣāṃ bhrājanti vai tathā |
lekhādyānāmapīśānāṃ kṣayātiśayavarjitaḥ | | 6

kauśalyovāca

ratnāni yānyabhīṣṭāni yatpriyaṃ cānulepanam | | 12

dukūlapaṭṭakauśeyavārkṣakārpāsakādibhiḥ |

satrājiditi vikhyātaścakravartī mahābalaḥ | | 1
prabhāvaistejasā kāntyā kṣāntyā balasamanvitaḥ |
buddhyā vikramadakṣaśca sampanno brāhmaṇāyataḥ |
kṛtī kavistathā śūraḥ ṣaṭpadākhyairna nirjitaḥ | | 3
ambujāyāstathā kṛṣṇa vāryapātraṃ sa vai vibho | | 5

gāṅgeyasya tathā kṛṣṇa dhiṣaṇasya hareryathā | | 6
vyāsasya devaśārdūla jāmadagnyasya vā vibhoḥ | | 7

brāhmaṇo vai khagaśreṣṭha sampūjyaḥ prītaye mama | | 125
pūjite.asminsadā vipre pūjitohaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
bhavāmi khagaśārdūla yatastviṣṭaḥ sa me sadā | | 126
vedavīṇāmṛdaṅgaiśca nātigandhavilepanaiḥ |
tathā me jāyate prītiryathā śrutvā khagottama | | 127
itihāsapurāṇāni vācyamānāni vācakaiḥ |
ataḥ priyo vācako me pūjākartā ca bhojakaḥ | | 128
aruṇa uvāca
sādhu pṛṣṭo.asmi bhadraṃ te vainateya mahāmate |
śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ sarvaṃ gadato mama khecara | | 3
te pūjayanti māṃ nityaṃ bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitāḥ | |4
devālayeṣu ye viprāḥ prītyā māṃ pūjayanti hi |
anyāśca devatāvṛttyā te syurdevalakāḥ khaga | |
etasmātkāraṇānmahyaṃ bhojako dayitaḥ sadā | | 5
varṇato brāhmaṇaścāyaṃ svānuṣṭhānaparo yadi |
anuṣṭhānavihīno hi narakaṃ yātyasaṃśayam | | 6
pūjārthamātmano nūnaṃ karma cāsya prakīrtitam |
priyavratasuto rājā śākadvīpe mahāmatiḥ | | 8
tena me kāritaṃ divyaṃ vimānapratimaṃ gṛham |
tasmindvīpe tadātmīye divyaṃ śilāmayaṃ mahat | | 9
sa madarcāṃ kārayitvā kāñcanīṃ lakṣaṇānvitām |
pratiṣṭhāpanāya vai tasyāścintayāmāsa suvrataḥ | | 1.117.10
kṛtamāyatanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ teneyaṃ pratimā kṛtā |
ko vai pratiṣṭhāpayitā devamarkaṃ śubhālaye | | 11
evaṃ sañcintayitvā tu jagāma śaraṇaṃ mama |
gato.ahaṃ darśanaṃ tasya uktañcāpi mayā khaga |
kiṃ cintayasi rājendra kutaściṃtā samāgatā | | 13
brūhi yatte hṛdi prauḍhaṃ cintākāraṇamāgatam |
saṃpādayiṣye tatsarvaṃ vimanā bhava mā nṛpa | | 14
atyarthaṃ duṣkaramapi kariṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ |
ityuktaḥ sa mayā rājā idaṃ vacanamabravīt | | 15
mayā bhaktyā jagannātha tatheyaṃ pratimā kṛtā | | 16
pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayedyastu tava devālaye khaga |
te mayoktā na kurvanti pratiṣṭhāṃ tava kṛtsnaśaḥ |
na cāpyarcāṃ jagannātha brāhmaṇaścātra vidyate | | 18
teneyamāgatā cintā hṛdi śalyaṃ tayārpitam |
kṣatriyāditrayo varṇā dvīpe.asminnātra saṃśayaḥ | | 1.117.20
te ca nārhanti me pūjāṃ na pratiṣṭhāṃ kadācana |
tasmātte śreyase rājanpratiṣṭhāmātmanastathā | | 21
sṛjāmi prathamaṃ varṇaṃ bhagasaṃjñamanaupamam |
ityuktvā tamahaṃ vīra rājānaṃ khagasattama | | 22
jagāma paramāṃ cintāṃ tasya kāryasya siddhaye |
atha me cintayānasya svaśarīrādviniḥsṛtāḥ | | 23
śaśikundendusaṃkāśāḥ saṃkhyayāṣṭau mahābalāḥ |
paṭhanti caturo vedānsāṃgopaniṣadaḥ khaga | | 24
kāṣāyavāsasaḥ sarve karaṇḍāmbujadhāriṇaḥ |
caraṇābhyāṃ tathā dvau tu pādābhyāṃ dvau tathā khaga |
atha te ca mahātmānaḥ sarve praṇatakandharāḥ | | 26
kimarthaṃ bhavatā sṛṣṭā vayaṃ devasya dehataḥ |
ya ete matsutā rājannarghyā brāhmaṇasattamāḥ |
kārayitvā pratiṣṭhāṃ tu mamārcāyāṃ narādhipa |
paścādāyatanaṃ sarvameṣāmarpaya pūjane | | 32
ete matpūjane yogyāḥ pratiṣṭhāsu ca sarvaśaḥ |
sarvamāyatanārthaṃ tu gṛhakṣetrādikaṃ ca yat |
tatsarvaṃ bhojakebhyastu dātavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
dhanadhānyasuvarṇādi gṛhakṣetrādikaṃ ca yat | |
adhipā bhojakāḥ sarve nānye viprādayo nṛpa | | 36
tathā madīyavittasya bhojakāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ | | 37
ityuktena mayā rājñā tathā sarvaṃ pravartitam |
kārayitvā pratiṣṭhāṃ tu dattvā sarvasvameva hi | |
bhojakebhyaḥ khagaśreṣṭha tato harṣamavāptavān | | 38
evamete mayā sṛṣṭā bhojakā garuḍāgraja |
mamājñāṃ pāleyadyastu svānuṣṭhānaparaḥ sadā | | 43
vedādhigamanaṃ pūrvaṃ dārasaṃgrahaṇaṃ tathā |
abhyaṅgadhāraṇaṃ nityaṃ tathā triṣavaṇaṃ smṛtam | | 44
pañcakṛtvaḥ sadā pūjyo hyahaṃ rātrau dine tathā |
devabrāhmaṇavedānāṃ nindā kāryā na vai kvacit | | 45
nānyādevapratiṣṭhā tu kāryā vai bhojakena tu |
sarvameva nivedyānnaṃ nāśnīyādbhojakaḥ sadā |
na bhuñjīta gṛhaṃ gatvā śūdrasya garuḍāgraja | | 47
śūdrocchiṣṭaṃ prayatnena sadā tyājyaṃ hi bhojakaiḥ |
ye.aśnanti bhojakā nityaṃ śūdrānnaṃ śūdraveśmani | | 48
gatvā gṛhaṃ tu śūdrasya na bhoktavyaṃ kadācana | | 49
gṛhāgataṃ ca śūdrānnaṃ tacca tyājyaṃ tathaiva ca |
sakṛtpravādite śaṃkhe mama prītirhi jāyate |
ṣaṇmāsānnātra sandehaḥ purāṇaśravaṇaṃ tathā | | 51
nābhojyaṃ bhuñjate yasmāttenaite bhojakā matāḥ |
magaṃ dhyāyanti te yasmāttena te magadhāḥ smṛtāḥ | | 53
bhojayanti ca māṃ nityaṃ tena te bhojakā smṛtāḥ |
abhyaṅgahīno hyaśucirbhojakaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ |
yastu māṃ pūjayedvīra abhyaṅgena vinā khaga | | 55
muṇḍanaṃ śirasā kāryaṃ śikhā dhāryā prayatnataḥ | | 56
naktaṃ cādityadivase tathā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pravartayet |
trikālaṃ cāpi gāyatrīṃ japedvācā puro mama | | 58
mukhamāvṛtya yatnena pūjanīyo.ahamādarāt |
sa jñeyo me paraḥ śatruḥ sa māmarho na cārcitum |
nirmālyaṃ mama deyaṃ syādbrāhmaṇādiṣu vai nṛṣu | | 62
naivedyaṃ yanmadīyaṃ tu tadaśnīyātsadaiva hi |
tenāsau śuddhyate nityaṃ haviṣyānnasamaṃ tathā | | 63
tatkṣaṇādutkṣipedyastu mamāṃgātpuṣpameva hi |
pañcagavyasamaṃ tasya manmataṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
mamāṅgalagnaṃ yatkiñcidgandhaṃ puṣpamathāpi vā | | 65
dātavyaṃ na ca vaiśyāya na śūdrāya kadācana |
ātmanā tadgrahītavyaṃ na vikreyaṃ kathañcana | | 66
yastu nāropya puṣpāṇi avyaṅgāni mamopari |
yathā na laṅghayetkaścidyathā śvā nāpi bhakṣayet | | 69
sa yāti narakaṃ raudraṃ tāmiśraṃ nāma nāmataḥ |
ekabhaktaṃ sadā kāryaṃ snānaṃ traikālameva hi | | 71
pūjākāle.arghakāle ca krodhastyājyaḥ prayatnataḥ | | 72
amāṃgalyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ vaktavyaṃ ca śubhaṃ tadā |
īdṛgbhūto bhojako me preyān pūjākaraḥ sadā | | 73
sanmānyaḥ pūjanīyaśca viprādīnāṃ yathāsmyaham |
yaḥ karotyavamānaṃ tu vṛttirūpaṃ tu bhojake | | 74
tasyāhaṃ roṣametyāśu kulaṃ hanmi samantataḥ |
aruṇo.api tathā śrutvā mudayā parayā nṛpaḥ |
tasmāddevaṃ vācakāya dvitīyamaśanaṃ naraiḥ | | 78
itthaṃ śrutvā sa rājā tu karmaṇaḥ phalamātmanaḥ |
purātanaṃ mahābāhurmudamāpa mahīpatiḥ | |79
yadyadāyatanaṃ bhānoḥ pṛthivyāṃ paśyate nṛpaḥ |
bhāryā tasyāpi suśroṇi puṇyaśravaṇamādarāt |
itthaṃ rājā sapatnīkaḥ pūjya bhaktyā divākaram |
prāptāvubhau parāṃ prītiṃ gatiṃ cānuttamāṃ tathā | | 82
tejasā ravisaṃkāśaḥ sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet | | 1
kārttike tu viśeṣeṇa kaumāre māsi dīpakam |
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇātra te vacmi saṃvādaṃ pāpanāśanam |
bhrātṛbhiḥ saha bhadrasya brāhmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ | | 3
jagatyasminpurī ramyā nāmnā māhiṣmatī purā |
tasya dīptyā parābhūtāstasya lāvaṇyadharṣitāḥ |
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhadro vacanamabravīt |
nāhaṃ matsarayukto vai na ca rāgādidūṣitaḥ |
bhrātara ūcuḥ
na tathā puṣpadhūpeṣu na tathā dvijapūjane |
yathāhani tathā rātrau yathā rātrau tathāhani |
tattvaṃ tatkathayāsmākaṃ haṃta kautūhalaṃ param |
tadetatkathayāsmākaṃ saviśeṣaṃ mahābala |
vyājahāra sa bhrātṛrṇāṃ na kiñcidapi suvrata |
dākṣiṇyasāro bhadrastu kathayāmāsa kṛtsnaśaḥ |
ikṣvākurājñastu purā vaśiṣṭho.abhūtpurohitaḥ | | 19
tena cāyatanaṃ bhānoḥ kāritaṃ sarayūtaṭe |
ahanyahani śuśrūṣāṃ puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ | | 1.118.20
āsīnnirvāṇa evāsau devārcāpurato niśi |
pūyaśoṇitaniṣpandaṃ prāvahankāyataḥ sadā |
śīrṇa ghrāṇo hyarvaravo durgaṃdhapatitastathā | | 23
duṣṭabuddhyā sadā yuktaḥ saptāśvaṃ prati suvrata |
yadṛcchyā dīpadānaṃ vartyādīnāṃ vibhāvasau | |24
tattadbhuktvā sadā tuṣṭiṃ vrajāmi dvijasattamāḥ |
rātrau dṛṣṭā mayā tatra bhaktā jāgaraṇāgatāḥ |
pratiśrayaṃ prārthitāśca taiśca datto dayānvitaḥ | | 26

tato.ahamagnimāśritya sthitasteṣāṃ samīpataḥ | | 27
duṣṭāṃ buddhiṃ samāśritya hartukāmo vivasvataḥ |
divyamābharaṇaṃ bhānośchidrānveṣī dvijottamāḥ | | 28

nirvāṇāścāpi dīpāstu tato.ahamutthitastvaran | | 1.118.30
puraḥ sthito dvijaśreṣṭhā gṛhītaścāpi tairiha |
tato.ahaṃ tejasā mūḍho bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ | | 34
vilapankaruṇaṃ teṣāṃ pādayoravaniṃ gataḥ |
taiścāpi karuṇāṃ kṛtvā mukto.ahaṃ bhojakaistadā | | 35
gṛhīto rājapuruṣaiḥ pṛṣṭaścāpi samantataḥ |
dīpaṃ prajvālya duṣṭātmankathyatāṃ mā ciraṃ kuru |
tato.ahaṃ vyādhinā kliṣṭo bhayena ca dvijottamāḥ |
hitvā prāṇāngato yatra svayaṃ devo vibhāvasuḥ | | 38
sthitvā kalpaṃ tatastatra yuṣmākaṃ bhrātṛtāṃ gataḥ |
eṣa prabhāvo dīpasya kārtike māsi suvratāḥ | | 39
duṣṭabuddhyā kṛtaṃ yattu mayā dīpapravartanam | | 1.118.40
kṣudhābhibhūtena mayā devadevasya bhūṣaṇam | | 41
tato jātismṛtirjanma prāntaṃ brāhmaṇaveśmani | | 42
kuṣṭhinā cāpi śūdreṇa prāptaṃ brāhmaṇyamuttamam |
nānāvidhāni śāstrāṇi sāṃgaṃ vedaṃ samāptavān | | 43
duṣṭabuddhyā dhṛtāddīpātphalametanmahādbhutam |
prāptaṃ mayā dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kiṃ punardīpadāyinām | | 44
etasmātkāraṇāddīpānahamevamaharniśam |
yuṣmākamidamuktaṃ vai snehātsatyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
eṣa prabhāvo dīpasya kārtike māsi suvratāḥ | |4 6
jātismaratvaṃ prajñāṃ ca prākāśyaṃ sarvajantuṣu | | 48
avyāhatendriyatvaṃ ca samāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ |
sarvakālaṃ ca cakṣuṣmānmedhāvī dīpado naraḥ | |4 9

ṣaṣṭhīṃ vā saptamīṃ vāpi pratipakṣaṃ ca yo naraḥ | | 1.118.50
kāñcanaṃ maṇiyuktaṃ ca manojñamatiśobhanam | | 51

tasmādāyatane bhānordīpāndadyātsadācyuta | | 52

kurvīta dīpahartā tu mūṣakondhaśca jāyate | | 53

dīpadānavarṇanam
saṃkrośamānānsaṃkṣubdhānuvāca yamakiṅkaraḥ | | 1
yatpramādādibhiḥ pūrvamātmāyaṃ samupekṣitaḥ | | 2
idānīṃ yātanāṃ bhuṅdhvaṃ kiṃ vilāpaṃ kariṣyatha | | 3
deho dināni svalpāni viṣayāścātidurbalāḥ |
etatko na vijānāti yena yūyaṃ pramādinaḥ | | 4
na vetti sūryacandrādīnkālamātmānameva ca |
evamākṛṣṭacittānāṃ viṣayaiḥ svādutarpaṇaiḥ |
nṛṇāṃ na jāyate buddhiḥ paramārthavilokinī | | 11
tathā ca viṣayāsaṅge karotyavirataṃ manaḥ |
ko hi bhāro ravernāmni jihvāyāḥ parikīrtane | | 12
ato vai kataro lābhaḥ kā taścintā bhavettadā | | 13
yenāyateṣu hasteṣu svātaṃtrye sati dīpakaḥ |
mahāphalo bhānugṛhe na datto narakāpahāḥ | | 14
naro vilapate kiñcididānīṃ dṛśyate phalam |
asvātaṃtrye vilapatāṃ svātaṃtrye sati māninām | | 15
avaśyaṃ pātinaḥ prāṇā bhoktā jīvo.apyaharniśam |
etatsthānaṃ duṣkṛtairvā yuktaṃ cādya mayekṣitam |
idānīṃ kiṃ vilāpena sahadhvaṃ yadupāgatam | | 17

ādityapūjāvarṇanam
duṣṭagrahopaghātaiśca sarvakālamupadrutāḥ | | 1

devaṃ manuṣyamanyaṃ vā paśupakṣipipīlikam |

sūryaprasādavarṇanam
kathamārādhitaḥ sūryaḥ sāmbenāmitatejasā |
sādhu pṛṣṭo.asmi rājendra śṛṇu sāmbakathāṃ purā |
vistārādvacmi te sarvāṃ kathāṃ pāpavimocinīm | | 2
purā saṃśrutya māhātmyaṃ bhāskarasya sa nāradāt |
vanaṃ gacchāmi bhagavannanujñāṃ dātumarhasi |
śivena puṇḍarīkākṣa dhyāya māṃ puruṣottama | | 5

gatvā santārayāmāsa candrabhāgāṃ mahānadīm | | 6

trailokyacakṣurevātra paramātmā prajāpatiḥ | | 1.127.10
eṣa vai maṇḍale hyasminpuruṣo dīpyate mahān |

vāyuḥ śaśāṅkaḥ parjanyo dhanādhyakṣo vibhāvasuḥ | | 12
yaṣa eṣa maṇḍale hyasmin puruṣo dīpyate mahān |
ekaḥ sākṣānmahādevo vṛtramaṇḍanibhaḥ sadā | | 13

ya eṣa maṇḍale hyasmiṃstejobhiḥ pūrayanmahīm | | 14

ārtiṃ bhaktiṃ ca vijñāya tatsarvaṃ jñātumarhasi | | 23

śrīsūrya uvāca
malaḥ śarīrasaṃstho me tvatprasādātpraṇaśyatu |
tāṃ mumoca rujaṃ sāmbo dehāttvacamivoragaḥ | | 28
śrīsūrya uvāca
bhūyaśca śṛṇu me sāmbaṃ tuṣṭo.ahaṃ yadbravīmi te |
kṣitau ye sthāpayiṣyanti teṣāṃ lokāḥ sanātanāḥ | | 1.127.30
sthāpayasvaiva māmasmiṃścandrabhāgātaṭe śubhe |

prasādalakṣaṇavarṇanam
kathaṃ sāmbena viprendra pratiṣṭhā kāritā raveḥ |
kasya vā vacanāttena prāsādaḥ kārito raveḥ | | 1
pratiṣṭhā kāritā bhānoḥ prasādaśca mahīpate | | 2

sa cāpi cintitaścāgādyatra jāmbavatīsutaḥ | | 3

sa yāti naraśārdūla sūryalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | | 6
iṣṭāpūrtena labhate lokāṃstāṃśca vibhūṣitān |

haṃsasaṃkṣiptakahlāravīthīvimalavāriṣu | | 11
haṃsakāraṇḍavakrauñcacakravākavirāviṣu |
paryantavimalacchāyāviśrāntajanacāriṣu | | 14

nadyastoyāṃśukā yatra śapharīkṛtamekhalāḥ | | 13
phulladrumottamāvāsāḥ saṅgamaśroṇimaṇḍalāḥ |
pulinādyunnatoraskā rasahāsāśca nimnagāḥ | | 14
vanopāntanadīśailasaṃskaropāntabhūmiṣu |
bhūmayo brāhmaṇādīnāṃ yāḥ proktā vāstukarmaṇi |
tā evaṃ teṣāṃ śasyante devatāyataneṣvapi | | 16

nīlāñjanasamaprakhyāṃ nairṛtyāṃ ca pradāpayet |

pratiṣṭhāsnānavidhivarṇanam
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi snānakarmavidhiṃ tava |
snāpakastu mahāprājño brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ | | 1
abhijñaḥ sauraśāstrāṇāmaruṇo yadusattama 1 |
bhojako bhojakaiścānyairbrāhmaṇaiśca tathā vṛtaḥ | | 2
diśābhāge maṇḍalasya īśāne vai yathākramam |
hastamātrapramāṇaṃ tu bhadrapīṭhaṃ tu vinyaset | | 3
maṃgalairbrahmaghoṣaiśca devaṃ prāsādamānayet | | 4
bhadrapīṭhaṃ samādāya bhadraṃ karṇeti mantrataḥ |
sūtradhārastathā proktaḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuciḥ | | 5
snāpayetkalaśaṃ gṛhya devadevaṃ vibhāvasum |
sāmudraṃ toyamāhṛtya jāhnavaṃ yāmunaṃ tathā | | 6
sārasvataṃ jalaṃ puṇyaṃ cāndrabhāgaṃ sasaindhavam |
puṣkarasya jalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ giriprasravaṇodakam | | 7
anyadvāpi śuci toyaṃ nadīnadataḍāgajam |
yathāśaktyā upāhṛtya kalaśaiḥ kāñcanādibhiḥ | | 8
bhojakāścāṣṭabhiḥ sūryaṃ kalaśaiḥ snāpayanti vai |
tatastu maṇiratnāni sarvabījauṣadhīstathā | | 9
brāhmī suvarcalā mustā viṣṇukrāntā śatāvarī |
dūrvā ca śibipuṣpī ca priyaṅgū rajanī vacā | | 11
sambhṛtyaitāṃstu sambhārānsnānakarmavibhāgavit |
balāśvatthaśirīṣāṇāṃ pallavaiḥ kuśasaṃyutaiḥ | | 12
kāñcanai rājataistāmrairmṛṇmayaiḥ kalaśaistathā | | 13
sākṣataiḥ sahiraṇyaiśca sarvauṣadhisamanvitaiḥ |
gāyatryā paripūtaistu ṣoḍaśaiḥ snāpayedravim | | 14
kuśottarāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vediṃ pakveṣṭakāmayīm |
tasyāṃ vedyāṃ samāropya paridhāpya ca vāsasī | 15
pratimāmabhiṣiñcecca sopavāsaḥ prayatnataḥ |
mūrdhni sarvauṣadhīḥ kṛtvā tathaivāmalakāni ca | | 16
mantreṇa mṛttikāṃ cāpi mantrataśca jalaṃ tathā |
ādistvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ devatānāṃ ca sarvathā | | 18
rasānāṃ pataye tubhyamāhvānaṃ ca kṛtaṃ mayā |
itthaṃ paurāṇikairmaṃtraivaidikaiśca viśeṣataḥ | | 19
kāryaṃ hi vāruṇaṃ snānaṃ devasya yadunaṃdana |
itthamuccārayedvācaṃ kuryātsnānaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | | 1.135.20
devāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ |
vyomagaṅgā ca pūrṇena dvitīyakalaśena tu | | 21
śakrādayobhiṣiṃcantu lokapālāḥ surottamāḥ | | 22
vāriṇā paripūrṇena padmapatrasugandhinā | | 23
pañcamenābhiṣiñcantu nāgāśca kalaśena tu |
himavaddhemakūṭādyāścābhiṣiñcantu vāriṇā | | 24
nairṛtodakapūrṇena ṣaṣṭhena kalaśena tu |
sarvatīrthāmbupūrṇena padmareṇusuvāsinā | | 25
saptamenābhiṣiñcantu ṛṣayaḥ sapta ye varāḥ |
vasavaścābhiṣiñcantu kalaśenāṣṭamena vai | | 26
samudrajyeṣṭheti mantreṇa kṣālayenmṛttikānvitam |
sinīvālīti mantreṇa dadyādvalmīkamṛttikām | | 29
yajñaṃ yajñeti mantreṇa dadyātpañcakaṣāyikam | | 1.135.30
pañcagavyaṃ pavitraṃ ca āharettāmrabhājane |
āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi |
yā oṣadhīti maṃtreṇa snānamoṣadhibhiḥ kramāt | | 33
śiraḥ snānaṃ tato dadyānmānastokābhimantritam | | 34

jātavedasamuccārya vastrapūtena vāriṇā |
tata āvāhayeddevaṃ raktamālyāmbaraṃ śubham | | 36
yajñabhāgaṃ gṛhāṇārghyamarkadeva namo.astu te | | 37
hiraṇyena tu pātreṇa devāyārghyaṃ pradāpayet |
pārthivaiḥ prathamaṃ kalaśaiḥ snāpayedbhāskaraṃ budhaḥ |
śaṅkhamādāya devasya tato mūrdhani śaṅkara |
dattvā puṣpāṇi devasya mūrdhni yatnādvicakṣaṇaḥ | |4 1
prathamaṃ snāpayeddevaṃ vāriṇā yadunandana | | 42
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ ghṛtādyairlabhate phalam |
ya ete kathitā yajñā eteṣāṃ kramaśaḥ phalam |
arcāṃ ca kuruśārdūla dṛṣṭvā vai labhate phalam | | 46
na prāśnanti yathā kākāstīrthaṃ lokavigarhitāḥ |
bhūmau gataṃ yathā caiva prāśnāti yadunaṃdana |
rogaṃ prāpnoti kartā vai duḥkhaṃ kārayitā tathā | | 49
tato vardhanikāṃ gṛhya vāridhārāṃ samutsṛjet | | 51
yatnakramaṃ prakurvāṇaḥ puṣpamālāṃ pradāpayet | | 53
yuñjānīti ca mantreṇa rocanāṃ tasya dāpayet |
ārārtikaṃ ca vai kuryāddīrghāyuṣṭvāya varcase | | 55
bhojakā brāhmaṇāścaiva kriyāṃ kuryuḥ prayatnataḥ | | 56
teṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi vibho śṛṇu caikamanāḥ kila |
sampūrṇagātro matimāñchāstrajñaḥ priyadarśanaḥ | | 58
kulīnaḥ śraddadhānaśca āryadeśasamudbhavaḥ |
na sthūlo na kṛśo dīrghaḥ sauraśāstraviśāradaḥ | | 59
pañcaviṃśatitattvajñaḥ sthāpakaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ | | 1.135.60
varjanīyāṃśca vakṣyāmi yaistu karma na kārayet |
hīnāṅgaścādhikāṅgaśca vāmano vikaṭastathā | | 61
nātigauro na kṛṣṇaśca snāpanāya prayojayet |
aśucivratasaṃyuktaḥ śyāmadanto.atha matsarī |
kopano duṣṭaśīlaśca yuvā vā vṛddha eva ca | | 63
śvitrī kuṣṭhī ca rogī ca kāṇo durmatireva ca |
saṃkīrṇo jātihīnaśca tathā na vṛṣalīpatiḥ | | 64
kubjaścādhastathā vyaṃgaḥ khalvāṭo vikalendriyaḥ |
tithinakṣatrayogānāṃ vārāṇāṃ ca tathā vibho |
sūcako jīvikārthaṃ hi yaśca mūlyena pāṭhayet | | 66
īdṛśānsnāpakānsarvānvarjayeta prayatnataḥ |
tasmātsarvaprayatnena parīkṣyāḥ snāpakā budhaiḥ | | 67
sūryapratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣo maṇḍapaṃ yatnato viśet | | 1
tato.anye ca śucau deśe asaṃspṛṣṭopalepane |
maṇḍalaṃ pañcavarṇaistu ālikheccaturasrakam | | 2 patākātoraṇacchatradhvajamālyādyalaṃkṛtam |
vicitrasuvitānāḍhyaṃ prakīrṇakusumotkaraiḥ | | 3
tasya madhye kuśāstīrṇe mūrtiḥ sthāpyā vivasvataḥ |
tatrāsyāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā dadyādarghyaṃ vivasvate | | 4
suvarṇamadhuparkādi kṛtvā tatra vidhānataḥ |
devasya darśayedgāṃ ca savatsāṃ rohiṇīṃ śubhām | | 5
yajñopavītamātithyaṃ tathābhyaṅgaṃ tathaiva ca |
avyaṅgaṃ yaduśārdūla śrāvaṇe māsi bhāskaram |
mālābhiśca vicitrābhirābaddhābhiranekaśaḥ | | 1.136.10
tato dhūpaṃ nivedyāśu pratimāgre prayatnataḥ |
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣo maṇḍapaṃ ca praveśayet | | 11
namaḥ śambhaveti mantreṇa śayyāyāṃ viniveśayet |
punareva ca vakṣyāmi saṅkalīkaraṇaṃ śubham |
snāpane tu yathākāryaḥ svadehe nyāsa uttamaḥ | | 13
pratimāyāṃ tathā kāryo yathā cālambhanaṃ budhaḥ |
oṃ huṃ khaṣolkāya namo mūlamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ | | 14
ādityo.ayaṃ svayaṃ devo hyakṣareṇopabṛṃhitaḥ |
oṃkāraṃ vinyasenmūrdhni huṃkāraṃ nāsikopari | | 15
khakāraṃ ca lalāṭe tu ṣakāraṃ vadane nyaset |
lakāraṃ caiva kaṃṭhe tu kakāraṃ hṛdaye nyaset | | 16
yakāraṃ tu bhuje vāme nakāraṃ dakṣiṇe bhuje |
makāraṃ vāmakukṣau ca visargaṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset || 17
oṃkāraṃ tu sadā dhyāyejjvālāmālāsamākulam |
huṅkāraṃ śuddhavarṇābhaṃ prasuvantamalaṃ śubham || 18
taruṇādityavarṇābhaṃ khakāraṃ cintayedbudhaḥ || 19
ṣokāraṃ tu mahābāho hemavarṇaṃ vicintayet |
śuklapadmanibhākāramakāraṃ ciṃtayedbudhaḥ ||1.136.20
jātīkusumasaṃkāśaṃ hrīṃkāraṃ sarvavarṇakam |
kṣīravarṇaṃ sakāraṃ tu cintayetsatataṃ budhaḥ ||2 1
nakāraṃ himakundābhaṃ makāramamṛtākṣaram |
hrīṃkāraṃ vidyutsaṃkāśaṃ hrīṃkāraṃ sarvavarṇakam ||221
kṣīravarṇaṃ sakāraṃ tu cintayetsatataṃ budhaḥ |
nakāraṃ svarṇavarṇābhaṃ makāraṃ kanakaprabham ||23
tato devaṃ mahātmānaṃ sahasrakiraṇaṃ ravim |
prasādābhimukhaṃ devaṃ śayanīye niveśayet ||24
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kuryuragnikuṇḍeṣu vai dvijāḥ |
tato.araṇyāṃ samutthāpya agniṃ laukikameva vā ||25
prajvālyāgniṃ vidhānena kuryāddhomaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
bahvṛcaḥ pūrvakāṇḍeṣu yāmyāṃ madhyandinastathā ||26
śamīpālāśodumbarāṇi hyapāmārgastathaiva ca |
dvādaśa tu sahasrāṇi aṣṭau catvāri eva ca ||28
ullikhyābhyukṣya tenaiva agniṃ dūtamiti smṛtāḥ |
jātakarma tathā proktaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ vidurbudhāḥ | | 31
annaprāśanamantreṇa annaprāśanamādiśet | | 32
jyeṣṭhamagreti mantreṇa tena cūḍopakarmaṇi |
agnihotrādikaṃ karma yajñakarmāṇi yāni ca |
mahāvyāhṛtimantreṇa hotavyāni samantataḥ | | 35
mātṛrṇāṃ yajñabhūtānāṃ balikarma pradāpayet |
trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ ca ahorātramathāpi vā |
tataḥ tvalaṅkṛtāṃ snātāṃ maṇiratnairvibhūṣitām | | 37
kṛtarakṣāṃ prayatnena pratimāmadhivāsayet |
devāgārādathaiśāne digbhāge divyamandiram | | 38
kṛtvā kuśaparistīrṇe varāstaraṇasaṃvṛte |
pūrvaśīrṣāṃ tathā śayyāṃ śuklāṃ śuklāmbarottarām | | 39 tasyāmāveśayetsamyaṅmahāśvetamupāharet |
nikṣubhā dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme rājñī ca kīrtitā | | 1.136.40
tasyāṃ saṃveśitāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ pratimāṃ raveḥ | | 41
vasettāṃ rajanīṃ tatra stūyamānaścatudiśam |
brāhmaṇairbandibhiścāpi gītajñaiścāraṇaistathā | | 42
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ bodhayedṛgvidhānataḥ | | 43
haviṣyaṃ bhoktukāmāṃstu brāhmaṇānbhojakāṃstathā |
dakṣiṇābhiśca sampūjya taiḥ kṛtasvastivācanaḥ | |44
tato garbhagṛhasthāya madhye kṛtvā tu piṇḍikām |
dattvārghyaṃ sthāpayettatra yajamānaḥ sahāyavān | | 46 śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣairjaladhārāsahākṣataiḥ |
kṛtyā puṇyāhaśabdaṃ tu ālayasya pradakṣiṇām | |47
śubhalagne dine ṛkṣe pūrvāhṇe bhānave kṣaṇe |
muhūrte ca śubhe bhānoḥ pratimāṃ sthāpayedbudhaḥ | |48
nādhomukhīṃ nordhvamukhīṃ na pārśvāvanatāṃ tathā |
samāmabhimukhīṃ cemāṃ pratimāṃ tu niveśayet | |49
nikṣubhā dakṣiṇe pārśve rave rājñī tu vāmataḥ | | 1.136.50
tatastadupahārārthaṃ sambhāraṃ prāktamāhṛtaiḥ |
modakāyūṣikāpūpaśaṣkulībhūtaśīrṣakaiḥ | | 51
kṛśaraiḥ pāyasonmiśraiḥ sarvadikṣu kṣipedbalim |
agnaye raktanetrāya jvālāmālārcitāya vai |
śaktihastāya tīvrāya tathā caivājavāhine | |
āgreyyāmagrimantreṇa vahnerāvāhanaṃ smṛtam | | 54
vāruṇyāṃ pāśahastāya varuṇāyeti kalpayet |
mantreṇāvāhanaṃ vidyātpañcanadyaḥ sarasvatīm ||58
prāṇātmakāya dhūpāya avyaṅgāyānilāya ca |
tasyāpyāvāhanaṃ vidyādyaddevādevaheḍanam |
gadāhastāya somāya śuṣmiṇe nṛgatāya ca ||1.136.6 0
gadāpaṭṭiśahastāya somarājāya vai namaḥ |
īśāvāsyaṃ ca guhyā vai somamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||6 1
kṛṣṇājinaniṣaṇṇāya namo lambodarāya ca ||62
gaṇādhipataye deva nīlakaṇṭhāya śūline |
virūpākṣāya rudrāya trailokyādhipate namaḥ ||
abhi tvā śūra no mantra īśānāya prakalpayet ||6 3
sarvanāgādhirājāya śvetavarṇāya bhogine |
pañcarātrādibhirnyāso hyaṃganyāsaḥ prayujyate ||65
sūryakratuṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ naiva kuryādadakṣiṇam |
sā tu vṛddhikarā nityaṃ sānnidhyācca sadā bhavet |
upāsate trirātraṃ ye bhānoryātrābhivāsane |
ātmīyaṃ parakīyaṃ vā pratimāsthāpanaṃ raveḥ |
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ vājapeyaśatasya ca |
phalaṃ prāpnoti puruṣaḥ pratiṣṭhāpya divākaram | | 71
yāvatkīrtiḥ puṇyakṛtā bhānoḥ sthāne niveśite |
tāvatsa tu yaduśreṣṭha sūryaloke mahīyate | | 72
dhruvā dyauśca dhruvā pṛthvī dhruvaṃ viśvamidaṃ jagat | |
sthāpayitvā raviṃ bhaktyā vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā |
māse māse ṛtuphalaṃ labhante nātra saṃśayaḥ | | 74
ekāhenāpi yadbhānoḥ pūjayā prāpyate phalam |
kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpaṃ yaḥ paścātsevate ravim |
na bhavediṣṭakānāṃ ca dravaṇaṃ bhūmisaṃmiti |
khaṇḍasphuṭitasaṃskāraṃ kṛtvā yatphalamāpyate |
sikatāyāmapi gṛhaṃ yastu kuryādvibhāvasoḥ |
śrībhāgī bhavati naro niketakārī kalpānāṃ vasati śataṃ sa sūryaloke | | 1.136.80
pratiṣṭhāpanavidhivarṇanam
yaḥ prāsādaṃ racayati pumāndevatānāṃ prayatnāttatra prītyā sapadi kurute sthāpanāṃ bhānubhaktaḥ |
ye mānavāstridaśamūrtiniketanāni kurvanti sādhujanadṛṣṭimanoharāṇi |
teṣāṃ mṛte.apyaparamārthamaye śarīre loke paribhramati kīrtimayaṃ śarīram | | 2
sādhāraṇaṃ vidhānaṃ śṛṇu devānāṃ pratiṣṭhāpane vīra | | 3
snāto bhukto vastrālaṅkṛtakusumairgandhaiḥ pratimāyā āstīrṇāyāṃ śayyāyāṃ sthāpanaṃ kuryāt |
suptāyāṃ tu sa nṛtyagītairjāgaraṇaiḥ samyagevādhivāsya daivajñena pratidiṣṭakāle saṃsthāpanaṃ kuryāt |
abhyarcya kusumagandhānulepanaiḥ śaṅkhatūryanirghoṣaiḥ prādakṣiṇyena nayedāyatanasya prayatnena kṛtvā baliṃ pratimāmabhyarcya brāhmaṇāṃśca sādhūndattvā hiraṇyakalaśaṃ vidhinā nikṣipetpiṃṇḍikāmadhye suśvabhre sthāpakadaivajñadvijānsamyagviśeṣato.abhyarcyākalpāntaṃ bhogī bhavatīha paratra sukhī | |4
viṣṇorbhāgavatā matāśca savituḥ śambhoḥ sabhasmadvijā mātṛrṇāmapi mātṛmaṇḍalavido viprā vidurbrāhmaṇāḥ |
sāmānyamidaṃ devānāmadhivāsanaṃ bhavati mayā kathitam |
kriyamāṇamidaṃ dṛṣṭvā devānāṃ pratiṣṭhāpanam | |
idaṃ te kathitaṃ rājanpratiṣṭhāpanamāditaḥ |
yatkṛtvā savituḥ snānaṃ naro yāti manogatim | | 7
itthaṃ kuryānnaro bhaktyā savituḥ sthāpanaṃ budhaḥ |
itihāsapurāṇasya śravaṇaṃ pāpanāśanam |
tābhyāṃ hi śravaṇādvīra sānnidhyaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ | | 9
kṛte tvāyatane tasminye cānye cāpi devatāḥ |
tasmātkāryaṃ budhairnityaṃ dharmaśravaṇamāditaḥ | | 1.137.10
vācakaṃ pūjayitvā tu brāhmaṇānupapūjya ca |
kārayedvācanaṃ vīra pustakasyāgrato raveḥ | | 11
ityeṣa kathito vīra pratiṣṭhākalpa āditaḥ |
kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā ca śrutvā ca yaṃ naro.arkamavāpnuyāt | | 13
yaduktaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvamṛṣabhādhipate puraḥ | | 1
kṛtānyupari cihnāni vāhanāni dhvajāni tu | | 2
atha vā tatpramāṇastu dhvajadaṇḍaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | | 5
prāsādavyāsa iti te proktaśceha na saṃśayaḥ | | 7
caturhastā bhavantyete praśastāḥ kṛṣṇanandana |
aṣṭahastapramāṇastu viṃśārdhasya pramāṇataḥ | | 9
sāmānyo dhvajadaṇḍastu sarvasādhāraṇo mataḥ |
daṇḍapāṇidhvajo yastu smṛtaḥ ṣoḍaśahastavān | | 1.138.10
viṃśaddhastātparo daṇḍo na kāryaḥ sarvathā raveḥ |
caturaṅgulavistīrṇaḥ suvṛtto dvyaṅgulopari |
nātisūkṣmo na ca sthūlo na kāryo nataparvakaḥ | | 12
dvādaśahastastu jaitreyaḥ śatruhantā kalānvitaḥ | | 17
jayāvahastu viṃśārdho nanda ādityasannibhaḥ |
upendro.aṣṭādaśaḥ proktastathendro viṃśatiḥ smṛtaḥ |
dhvajadaṇḍo mahābāho atha vā vāstumānataḥ | | 1.138.20

sapatnīkaṃ sasainyaṃ ca pṛthivyāṃ sāravatsthitam | | 12

ādityaṃ yaduśārdūla tathā ca vidhinā vibho | | 13
jātakarmādayo yasya na saṃskārāḥ kṛtā vibho |
āruṇeyaiśca mantraiśca sāvitrīṃ na ca vai paṭhet | |
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ bhāskarasya tu |
akṛtvā vidhivatpūjāṃ yastu bhuṅkte sa dharmahā | | 16
abhyaṅgena vihīno yaḥ śaṃkhahīnastathaiva ca |
śirasā dhārayetkeśānsa jñeyo bhojakādhamaḥ | | 17
devārcanaṃ tathā homaṃ snānaṃ tarpaṇameva ca |
dānaṃ brāhmaṇapūjāṃ ca kurvato bhojakasya tu | |
abhyaṅgo yaduśārdūla pavitraḥ paramaḥ smṛtaḥ | | 19
bhojakānāṃ yaduśreṣṭha tasya mūle sthito hariḥ |
madhye brahmā mahātejā agre gośrutibhūṣaṇaḥ | | 1.146.20
ṛgvedo yasya mūlastho madhye sāmāni kṛtsnaśaḥ |
yajurvedastathā śreṣṭhaścātharvasahitaḥ sthitaḥ | | 21
trayo.agnayastathā rājaṃstrayo lokāḥ sthitāḥ kramāt |
abhojyaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ so.aśucirnātra saṃśayaḥ | | 23
ye prayacchanti śūdrāṇāṃ vikrīṇanti ca bhojakāḥ | |

na te deva priyāstāta vijñeyā bhojakādhamāḥ | | 25
brāhmaṇānāṃ puroḍāśo yathā kāyaviśodhanaḥ |

vāsudeva uvāca
atra pṛṣṭo yathā devo bhāskaro devapūjitaḥ |
aruṇena mahābāho ke priyā bhojakāstathā | | 1
pūjāyāṃ tava ke yogyāḥ ke na yogyā bhavanti ca |
iti pṛṣṭaḥ sa bhagavānaruṇena divākaraḥ | |
yaduvāca mahābāho tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu | | 2
bhāskara uvāca
paradārānparadravyaṃ ye na hiṃsanti bhojakāḥ |
vāṇijyaṃ kṛṣisevāṃ tu vedānāṃ nindanaṃ ca ye |
kurvanti bhojakā jñeyāḥ sarve te mama vairiṇaḥ | | 4
yeṣāṃ bhāryāsaṅgrahaṇaṃ karṣaṇaṃ ye prakurvate |
nṛpasevāṃ khagaśreṣṭha vijñeyāḥ patitāstu te | |
bhuñjate ye ca śūdrānnaṃ jñeyāste śatravo mama | | 5
pūjā kṛtā tu yā taistu tathārghyaṃ ca khagottama |
pūjāṃ tāmatha cāpyarghyaṃ nāhaṃ gṛhṇāmi khecara | | 6
ya ete kathitā vīra ye ca śaṅkhavivarjitāḥ |
nirmālyaṃ ye madīyaṃ tu naivedyaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tathā | | 7
yajante ye ca sāvitrīṃ mahāśvetāṃ ca gopateḥ |
ye na jānanti me mudrāṃ kiṅkarāṇāṃ ca nāmataḥ | | 9
naite pūjayituṃ śaktā ye priyā mama bhojakāḥ | |
tāñchṛṇuṣva khagaśreṣṭha bhūtvā caikāgramānasaḥ | | 1.147.10
devadvijamanuṣyāṇāṃ pitṛrṇāṃ cāpi pūjakāḥ |
te priyā mama vai nityaṃ śaktāḥ pūjayituṃ ravim | | 11
yeṣāṃ muṇḍaṃ śiro nityaṃ ye cābhyaṅgasamanvitāḥ |
vādayanti ca ye śaṅkhaṃ divyāste bhojakā matāḥ | | 12
trikālaṃ ye ca māṃ nityaṃ susnātāḥ krodhavarjitāḥ |
pūjayanti khagaśreṣṭha te priyā mama bhojakāḥ | | 13
vāre madīye naktaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ye ca prakurvate |
saptamyāmupavāsaṃ tu tathā saṅkramaṇe mama | | 14
divyāste brāhmaṇā jñeyā bhojakā mama pūjakāḥ |
pūjayanti ca ye viprānmadbhaktā matparāyaṇāḥ | |
te priyāḥ satataṃ mahyaṃ bhojakā garuḍāgraja | | 15
na te pūjyā na vandyāśca ye dviṣanti ca māṃ sadā | | 16
ye kurvanti mahāyajñānbhojakā garuḍāgraja |
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ pūjārthaṃ santataṃ khaga | | 17

mama vāre ca ye vīra tathā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca keśava |
na rātrau bhuñjate prājñā matpriyāste magāḥ khaga | | 1.147.20
itthaṃ bhūtā bhojakā yā māghamāse ca saptamī |
puṣpāṇāṃ karavīrāṇi tathā raktaṃ ca candanam | | 22
vācako brāhmaṇānāṃ tu naivedyaṃ modakāstathā |
ghṛtāhutyo guggulaśca kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ tathā | | 23
vādyānāṃ śaṅkhaśabdaśca nṛtyaṃ nāṭyaṃ mataṃ mama |
pañcavarṇā patākāstu śvetaṃ chatraṃ ca me priyam | | 24
nānyavarṇaiḥ kṛtā pūjā tathā prīṇāti māṃ khaga |
yathā kṛtā bhojakena pūjā prīṇāti māṃ sadā | |
vāsudeva uvāca
ityuktvā bhagavāndevaścāruṇāya purānagha |
lakṣaṇaṃ bhojakānāṃ tu tato merumathākramat | | 26
evaṃ bhojyā bhojakāstu na cābhojyāḥ kadācana |
anuṣṭhānavihīnā ye na te bhojyāstu bhojakāḥ | | 27
bhaumāstu brāhmaṇā ye tu anuṣṭhānavivarjitāḥ |
nāsti pūjyatamaṃ kiñcinmāṅgalyaṃ pāvanaṃ tathā |
caturṇāmiha varṇānāṃ muktvā bhojakamuttamam | |
tasya bhuṅkte svayaṃ bhānurbrahmā viṣṇustathā śivaḥ | | 1.147.30
tatheha sarvabhūtānāṃ bhojakaḥ pūjya ucyate | | 31

tathā pūjyatamo jñeyaḥ pūjyānāṃ bhojako vibho | | 32
viśeṣeṇa ca saurāṇāṃ bhojakaḥ pūjya ucyate |

bhojakastu tathā pūjyaḥ saurāṇāṃ hṛdikātmaja | | 33
evaṃ pūjyāstathā bhojyā bhojakā hṛdikātmaja |
atha kiṃ bahunoktena śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama | | 36
nāsti vedātparaṃ śāstraṃ nāsti gaṅgāsamā sarit |

jvālāmālākarālaṃ tu mahatā tejasānvitam | | 1

vāsudeva uvāca
prāptaṃ cakraṃ mayā tasmādbhāskarāllokapūjitāt | |5

grahāḥ somādayo yasya saṃsthitā nābhimaṇḍale | | 6

saṃkṣepātte mayākhyātaṃ dattaṃ cakramivāparam | | 8

vāsudeva uvāca
kamalaṃ hyṛtubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaṭdalaṃ cākṣayāśritam |
puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ taddhi tatra sāṅgo raviḥ sthitaḥ | | 1.148.10
māsā arā mahābāho pakṣāśca pradhayaḥ smṛtāḥ | | 11
pathinābhiṣu yoge ca yogākhyāstapanādibhiḥ | | 12
nakṣatrāṇi grahāścaiva sadā cātra sthitāḥ smṛtāḥ |
etairvyāptamidaṃ cakraṃ sthūlasūkṣmaprabhedataḥ | | 13
atroddiṣṭeṣu kāleṣu ye noddiṣṭā mayā tava |
yatte kālātmakaṃ cakramidaṃ saṃkṣepato mayā |
kathitaṃ tadviniṣkrāntaṃ pradīptātsūryamaṇḍalāt | | 15
asurāṇāṃ vadhāyedaṃ mayā labdhaṃ divākarāt |
ārādhya tapasā sūryaṃ purā kalpe jagadgurum | |
ataḥ sampūjyayāmyenaṃ grahaistattvairvṛtaṃ sadā | | 16
tejasā ravisaṃkāśaḥ puṣpottarapuraṃ vrajet | | 17
tasmāttaṃ matkulānandaṃ mitraṃ sampūjayāmyaham |
piṣṭagandhādibhirvāpi raktavarṇakamiśrakaiḥ |
phalaiḥ pakvairoṣadhibhistathā dūrvāṅkuraiḥ kuśaiḥ |
dhūpaiśca vividhairgandhaistathā vastraiśca bhūṣaṇaiḥ | | 22
vitānaśobhāsikataiḥ palāśairupaśobhitaiḥ | | 23
chatracāmaraghaṇṭābhirbhūṣaṇairdarpaṇādibhiḥ |
nṛtyavāditragītaiśca vedaiḥ puṇyakathāsvanaiḥ | | 24
sarvatra jayaghoṣaiśca sampūrṇe pūjayanti ye | sampūrṇānvividhānkāmānnirvighnānprāpnuvanti te | | 25
bhavanti niyatāḥ sāmba tasya sānugrahā grahāḥ | | 27
arkasya sarvayajñānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ siddhiprado bhṛśam | | 29
puṇyo dharmastathā puṣṭyaḥ śatrughnaśca viśeṣataḥ |
śveto rakto.atha pītaśca kṛṣṇaścāpi vibhāgaśaḥ | | 1.148.30
sūryadīkṣāvarṇanam
kiṃ pramāṇaṃ likheccakraṃ tatra padmaṃ ca kiṃ bhavet |

vāsudeva uvāca
catuḥṣaṣṭyaṅgulaṃ cakraṃ kṛtvā vṛttaṃ pramāṇataḥ |
aṣṭāṅgulā bhavennemiḥ seyaṃ vibhavataḥ sadā | | 2
arakṣetraṃ ca padmasya kaṇikākesarāṇi ca | | 3

ākīrṇāḥ saṃvibhaktāśca kartavyāḥ pradhayaḥ kramāt | |5

bhūmiḥ pītā bahirjñeyā karṇikākesarāṇi ca | | 6

nābhinemyantare lekhāḥ sitāścāṅgulamānataḥ | | 8
aparāhṇe.atha pūrvāhṇe varuṇamāvāhayetsadā | | 1.149.10

itthaṃ me bhānunā pūrvamidamuktaṃ varānana | | 12

vāsudeva uvāca
karṇikāyāṃ daleṣvevamaṅgāni hṛdayādi ca | | 14

namaskāraśca sarvatra eṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ | | 15
svāhāntā homakāle ca karmasvanyeṣu te punaḥ |
yathā karmāvasānāśca prayoktavyāḥ samāsataḥ | | 16
oṃ khaṣolkāya vidmahe divākarāya dhīmahi |
tannaḥ sūryaḥ pracodayāt | | 17
sāvitrī ca mahābāho caturviṃśākṣarā matā |
evaṃ mantrāḥ prayoktavyāḥ sarvakarmasvataṃdritaiḥ |
tasmātsarvaprayatnena mantrāñjñātvā vidhiṃ tathā |
ādityamaṇḍale dīkṣā kasya kāryā kathaṃ ca sā |
vāsudeva uvāca
brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyaṃ kulīnaṃ śūdrameva ca |
puruṣaṃ vā striyaṃ vāpi dīkṣayetsūryamaṇḍale | | 22
gurustaṃ dīkṣayedvipraḥ kalpajñaḥ satyavākchuciḥ | | 23

sampūjyārkaṃ tathā vahnau hutvā vai haviṣā ravim | | 24
śiṣyaṃ snātamathācāntaṃ khaṣolkākṛtivigraham |
svāṅgairālabhya cāṅgeṣu darbhavadbhistathākṣataiḥ | | 25

bhaved ghṛtaguḍakṣīraistandulaiśca pramāṇataḥ |
dattvā śiṣṭāya muktvaivaṃ dattvānte dantadhāvanam |

yāṃ diśaṃ dantakāṣṭhasya mukhaṃ paśyati tatpatim |
arcayettena śāṃtiḥ syādityuktaṃ bhānunā svayam | | 31

ācamya kṛtarakṣastu kṛtadravyādhivāsanaḥ |

hadayenāśubhe dṛṣṭe śatahomaṃ samācaret | | 35
svapne paśyati harmyāṇi devatānāṃ hutāśanam |
nadīyānāni ramyāṇi udyānopavanāni ca | | 36

rājānaṃ śauryasampannaṃ dhanāḍhyaṃ kṣatriyottamam |
śuśrūṣaṇaparaṃ śūdraṃ yadi tattvārthamādiśet | | 38
praśastaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ caiva yathāsambhavato matam |
etaiḥ sparśanameteṣāṃ śreṣṭhamārohaṇaṃ tataḥ | | 39

parvataṃ ca samāruhya vipulāṃ bhārgavīṃ bhajet | | 1.149.40
pītvā surāṃ samudraṃ ca dadhyājyaṃ kṣīrameva ca |
somaṃ māṃsaṃ havirbhuktvā kāśyapīṃ labhate naraḥ | | 41
labdhvā vastrāṇi ratnāni vividhābharaṇāni ca |
vāhanāni mahīṃ gāśca dhānyopakaraṇāni ca | | 42
samṛddhimāpnuyātkiñcitsvapnānāṃ darśanaṃ śubham |

vāsudeva uvāca

sthaṇḍile yaduśārdūla nibodhaikāgramānasaḥ | | 1

śriyamṛddhiṃ vibhūtiṃ ca dhṛtiṃ caivonnatiṃ tathā | | 17

kīrtitaṃ bhavatā mahyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam | | 2

śṛṇvato nāsti me tṛptiramṛtasyaivameva ca | | 1.151.10

sarve ca yaṃ yataprāṇā dhyāyanti brahmarūpiṇam || 19 ||
sa uvāca mahātejāḥ kaśyapaṃ carṣisatta mam ||
dattvā varaṃ purā vipra viraṃcasya mahātmanaḥ ||
tasmāttvamṛṣiśārdūla kuru sṛṣṭimanaupamām || || 24 ||
evamārādhya deveśaṃ brahmā sṛṣṭimavāptavān ||
ārādhya kaśyapaścāpi bhāskaraṃ sutamāptavān || 25 ||
sūryāvatāravarṇanam
brahmādayo.api yaṃ nityaṃ pūjayaṃti vidhānataḥ || 1 ||
brahmā viṣṇuḥ surā brahmaṃstamārādhya divākaram ||
dadṛśustasya kiṃbhūtaṃ rūpaṃ yattanmahādbhutam || 2 ||
|| sumaṃturuvāca || ||
ārādhya devamīśānaṃ bhāskaraṃ sūtivācakam ||
kaviṣṇū kuruśārdūla jagmatustau himācalam ||3||
gopateraṃtikaṃ vīra prahṛṣṭau vibhudarśane ||
kuṃdeṃdusaṃnibhaṃ draṣṭuṃ kaṃjajaścācyutaśca tau ||4||
dadṛśaturmahātmānaṃ caṃdrārdhakṛtaśekharam ||
pūjayaṃtaṃ vivasvaṃtaṃ bhāskaraṃ vīravannṛpa || 5 ||
ārcyocaturmahātmānaṃ kaviṣṇū taṃ trilocanam ||
bhobho bhīma suraśreṣṭha paśyāvāmiha cāgatau || 6 ||
praṇamya śirasā bhūmau kṛtvā pūjāṃ vidhānataḥ ||7||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ śikṣākṣarasamanvitam ||
harṣa gadgadayā vācā diśaḥ sannādayanniva || 8 ||
dṛṣṭavaṃtau paraṃ kiṃcidrūpaṃ devasya śaṃkaram ||
niśamya vacanaṃ vīra śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ ||
ūcatustau mahātmānau kaviṣṇū devasattamau ||11||
ārādhayitumevāpi hyāgatau teṃtikaṃ ca tam ||12||
tasmādārādhayāmo hi ekībhūya vibhāvasum||
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ vīra kaṃjajācyutayorharaḥ||
tathetyāha mahābāho harṣādutphullalocanaḥ|| ||14||
atha te rājaśārdūla vivigogatayo nṛpa ||
jagmustaṃ parvataśreṣṭhamudayācalamāśu vai ||15||
tamāsādya nagaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṃgaistribhiralaṃkṛtam ||
nānā dhātupinaddhāṅgaṃ nānādhātuvibhūṣitam || 16 ||
ārādhanāya vidhivadyatnaṃ cakrurvibhāvasoḥ ||
divyavarṣasahasrāṃte tapaṃtaḥ saṃsthitā nage ||
sthāṇuvatsaṃsthito bhūmāvūrdhvabāhustrilocanaḥ ||
paṃcāgniṃ bhajamānastu sthito viṣṇuravākchirāḥ || 19 ||
evaṃ varṣasahasrāṃte tapaścakruḥ sudāruṇam ||
atha brahmeśaviṣṇūnāṃ kurvatāṃ tapa uttamam ||
tuṣṭohaṃ bhavatāṃ dātu mihāyāto varaṃ svayam || 22 ||
|| sumaṃturuvāca || ||
niśamya vacanaṃ bhānoḥ śāṃtaṃ hṛdyaṃ manoramam ||
praṇamya śirasā keśā idaṃ vacamabruvan|| || 23 ||
kṛtakṛtyā vayaṃ sarve prasādāttava gopate ||
tvāmārādhya purā deva tvattaḥ prāpya varaṃ śubham || 24 ||
utpattisthitināśānāṃ vayaṃ sarve divākara ||
saṃbhūyeha samarthā vai tvatprasādānna saṃśayaḥ || 25 ||
yatte paramakaṃ rūpaṃ durlabhaṃ durdṛśaṃ tathā || 26 ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaviṣṇvīśabhāṣitam||
darśayāmāsa tadrūpamadbhutaṃ lokapūjitam || 28 ||
bhūḥ pādau dyauḥ śiraścāpi tatrāgnī locane mate ||
pādāṃgulyaḥ piśācāśca hastāṃgulyaśca guhyakāḥ || 1.160.30 ||
viśve devāḥ smṛtāstasya jaṃghāsaṃghāḥ surottamāḥ ||
yakṣāḥ kukṣiṣu saṃlīnāḥ keśāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ||31||
dṛṣṭidhṛṣṭyaśca vipulāḥ keśā vīrāṃśavaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
tārakā romarūpāṇi romāṇi ca maharṣayaḥ ||32||
bāhavo vidiśastasya diśaḥ śrotre narādhipa||
aśvinau śravaṇe cāsya nāsā vāyurmahābalaḥ ||33||
satyamasyābhavadvāṇī jihvā devī sarasvatī || 34 ||
grīvāditirmahādevī tālū rudraśca vīryavān ||
dvāraṃ svargasya nābhirvai mitrastvaṣṭā picaṃḍakaḥ || 35 ||
mukhaṃ vaiśvānaraścāsya vṛṣaṇau ca bhagastadā ||
hṛdayaṃ bhagavānbrahmā hyudaraṃ kaśyapo muniḥ || 36 ||
pṛṣṭhe.asya vasavo devā marutaḥ sarvasaṃdhiṣu ||
sarvacchaṃdāṃsi daśanā jyotīṃṣi vimalā prabhā || 37 ||
prāṇo rudro mahādevaḥ kukṣau cāsya mahārṇavāḥ ||
udare cāsya gaṃdharvā bhujagāśca mahābalāḥ || 38 ||
lakṣmīrmedhā dhṛtiḥ kāṃtiḥ sarvā vidyāśca vai kaṭau ||
lalāṭamasya paramaṃ vayaḥsthānaṃ parātmanaḥ || 39 ||
sarvajyotīṃṣi jānīhi tapaścakraśca deva rāṭ||
stanau kukṣau ca vedāśca teṣṭau cāsya makhāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
yaṣṭavyapaśubaṃdhāśca dvijānāṃ veṣṭi tāni ca || 41 ||
sarvadevamayaṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpamarkasya te nṛpa ||
brahmā haro harirdevāḥ paraṃ vismayamāgatāḥ || 42 ||
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ vepamānā dharāṃ gatāḥ ||
samīkṣya rūpaṃ te deva bhīmaṃ jvālāsamākulam ||
digjñānaṃ hṛtamasmākaṃ tatprasīda jagatpate ||
upasaṃhara viśvātmandraṣṭuṃ śaktā na te vayam || 45 ||
iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā devadevo divākaraḥ ||
etanmayā prasannena yuṣmākaṃ śreyase.anaghāḥ ||
darśitaṃ pūjiteneha yogināṃ yanmahālayam || 48 ||
|| brahmeśācyutā ucuḥ || ||
gatāste paramāṃ siddhiṃ gaṃdharvā ṛṣayastathā || 52 || ||
sūryapūjāphalapraśnavarṇanam
nāstyādityasamo devo nāstyādityasamā gatiḥ || 1 ||
ādityamūlamakhilaṃ trailokyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
rudreṃdropeṃdrakeṃdrāṇāṃ vipreṃdra tridivaukasām ||
sarvātmā sarvalokeśo mahādevaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
bhāvābhāvau hi lokanāmādityānniḥsṛtau purā || 5 ||

māsāḥ saṃvatsarāścaiva ṛtavaśca yugāni ca || 7 ||
sa eṣa kālaścāgniśca dvādaśātmā prajāpatiḥ ||
|| sumaṃturuvāca || ||
bhānuṃ pratiṣṭhāpya naraḥ sarvadevamayaṃ vibhum ||
prāpnotyamaratāṃ vīra tejasā ravisannibhaḥ || 1 ||
yo bhānuṃ dveṣṭi saṃmohātsarvadevanama skṛtam ||
naro narakagāmī syāttasyasaṃbhāṣaṇādapi || 2 ||

yatpuṇyaphalamāpnoti tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu || || 3 ||

yo bhānuṃ sthāpayedbhaktyā vidhipūrvaṃ narādhipa ||
sarvāṃgamuditaṃ puṇyaṃ labhetkoṭiguṇaṃ naraḥ || 5 ||

ihaiva dhanavāñcchrīmā nsoṃte.arkatvamavāpnuyāt ||

varāṃbaradharā kanyā nānālaṃkārabhūṣitā ||
tridaśānāṃ ca jananī puṇyā lokanamaskṛtā || 1.178.10 ||
śāṃtiṃ karotu te mātā bhuvanasya khagādhipa || 11 ||
snigdhaśyāmena varṇena mahāmahiṣamardanī ||
dhanuścakrapraharaṇā khaṅgapaṭṭiśadhāriṇī || 12 ||
ātarjanyāyatakarā sarvopadravanāśinī ||

atisūkṣmo hyatikrodhastryakṣo bhṛṃgiriṭirmahān ||
sūryātmako mahāvīraḥ sūryaikagatamānasaḥ ||
pracaṃḍagaṇasainyeśo mahāghaṃṭākṣadhārakaḥ ||
akṣamālārpitakaraścākṣacaṃḍeśvaro varaḥ || 15 ||
caṃḍapāpaharo nityaṃ brahmahatyā vināśanaḥ ||
śāṃtiṃ karotu te nityamādityārādhane rataḥ ||
karoti ca mahāyogī kalyāṇānāṃ paraṃparām || 16 ||
ākāśamātaro divyāstathānyā devamātaraḥ ||
sūryāyaṇaparā devyo jagadvyāpya vyavasthitāḥ ||
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu me nityaṃ mātaraḥ surapūjitāḥ || 17 ||

aiṃdrādayo gaṇā ye tu vajrahastā mahābalāḥ ||
himakundeṃdusadṛśā nīlakṛṣṇāṃgalohitāḥ || 1.178.20 ||
divyāṃtarikṣā bhaumāśca pātālatalavāsinaḥ ||
aiṃdrāḥ śāṃtiṃ prakurvaṃtu bhadrāṇi ca punaḥ punaḥ || 21 ||
āgneyyāṃ ye bhṛtāḥ sarve dhruvahatyānuṣaṃgiṇaḥ ||
sūryānuraktā raktābhā japāsumanibhāstathā || 22 ||
viraktalohitā divyā āgneyyāṃ bhāskarādayaḥ ||
ādityārādhanaparā ādityagatamānasāḥ || 23 ||

bhayā.a.adityasamā ye tu satataṃ daṇḍapāṇayaḥ ||
ādityārādhanaparāḥ kaṃ prayacchaṃtu te sadā || 24 ||
aiśānyāṃ saṃsthitā ye tu praśāṃtāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ ||
bhasmoddhūlitadehāśca nīlakaṇṭhā vilohitāḥ || 25 ||
divyāṃtarikṣā bhaumāśca pātālatalavāsinaḥ ||
sūryapūjākarā nityaṃ pūjayitvāṃśumālinam || 26 ||
tataḥ suprītamanaso lokapālaiḥ sama nvitāḥ ||
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu me nityaṃ kaṃ prayacchaṃtu pūjitāḥ ||27||
amarāvatī purī nāma pūrvabhāge vyavasthitā ||
vidyādharagaṇākīrṇā siddhagandharvase vitā ||28||
ratnaprākārarucirā mahāratnopaśobhitā ||
tatra devapatiḥ śrīmānvajrapāṇirmahābalaḥ ||
airāvatagajārūḍho gairikābho mahādyutiḥ||
deveṃdraḥ satataṃ hṛṣṭa ādityārādhane rataḥ || 1.178.30 ||
sūryapraṇāmaḥ paramāṃ śāṃtiṃ te.adya prayacchatu || 31 ||
āgneyadigvibhāge tu purī tejasvatī śubhā ||
nānādevagaṇākīrṇā nānāratnopaśobhitā || 32 ||
tatra jvālā samākīrṇo dīptāṃgārasamadyutiḥ ||
ādityārādhanarata ādityagatamānasaḥ ||
śāṃtiṃ karotu te devastathā pāpaparikṣayam || 34 ||
vaivasvatī purī ramyā dakṣiṇena mahātmanaḥ ||
surāsuraśatākīrṇā nānāratnopaśobhitā ||35||
tatra kundeṃdusaṃkāśo haripiṃgalalocanaḥ ||
mahāmahiṣamārūḍhaḥ kṛṣṇasragvastrabhūṣaṇaḥ || 36 ||
antako.atha mahātejāḥ sūryadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ||
ādityārādhanaparaḥ kṣemārogye dadātu te || 37 ||
nairṛte digvibhāge tu purī kṛṣṇeti viśrutā ||
moharakṣogaṇāśaucapiśācapretasaṃkulā || 38 ||
khaḍgapāṇirmahātejāḥ karālavadanojjvalaḥ || 39 ||
rakṣeṃdro vasate nityamādityārādhane rataḥ ||
karotu me sadā śāṃtiṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ praya cchatu || 1.178.40 ||
paścime tu diśo bhāge purī śuddhavatī sadā ||
nānābhogisamākīrṇā nānākinnarasevitā || 41 ||

yaśovatī purī ramyā aiśānīṃ diśamāśritā ||
nānāgaṇasamākīrṇā nānākṛta śubhālayā ||
tejaḥprākāraparyaṃtā anaupamyā sadojvalā || 43 ||

trinetraḥ śāṃtarūpātmā akṣamālā dharādharaḥ ||
īśānaḥ paramo devaḥ sadā śāṃtiṃ prayacchatu || 44 ||

sarasvatī sūryabhaktā śāṃtidā vidadhātu me ||
cārucāmīkarasthā yā sarojakarapallavā ||

kṛttikā paramā devī rohiṇī ca varānanā ||
śrīmanmṛgaśiro bhadrā ārdrā cāpyaparojjvalā || 1 ||

nakṣatramātaro hyetāḥ prabhāmālāvibhūṣitāḥ || 3 ||

śyāmena dehabhāreṇa śrīmatkamalalocanaḥ || 37 ||

śaṃkhapālaśriyā dīptaḥ sūryapādābjapūjakaḥ || 38.||

tenāpi kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpaham || 62 || ||
paṃcaprakāraṃ dharmaṃ me vada smārtaṃ yathākramam ||
paṃcadhā varṇitaṃ dharmaṃ śṛṇu rājansamāsataḥ ||
yathoktaṃ bhāskareṇeha aruṇasya mahātmanaḥ || 2 ||
praṇamya śirasā devamuvāca garuḍāgrajaḥ || 3 ||
evaṃ pṛṣṭastu bhagavānaruṇena khagādhipaḥ ||
uvāca parayā prītyā pūjayitvā mahīpate || 5 ||
|| || bhāskara uvāca || ||
smṛtidharmaṃ vedamūlaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ garuḍāgraja ||
pūrvānubhūtaṃ yaddhyānamatha tatsmaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ || 6 ||
dharmaḥ kriyātmā nirdiṣṭaḥ śreyobhyudayalakṣaṇaḥ ||
sa ca pañcavidhaḥ prokto vedamūlaḥ sanātanaḥ || 7 ||
asya śabdasyānuṣṭhānātsvargo mokṣaśca jāyate ||
|| anūruruvāca || ||
|| bhāskara uvāca || ||
vedadharmaḥ smṛtastveka āśramāṇāṃ sa tatparaḥ ||
varṇāśramastṛtīyastu guṇanaimittiko yathā || 1.181.10 ||

yathā mūrdhābhiṣiktasya prajānāṃ pālanaṃ param ||13||
naimittikaḥ sa vijñeyo jātidravyaguṇāśrayaḥ ||14||

evaṃ śakyavidhānaṃ tu nyāyo hyevaṃ vyavasthitaḥ || 1.181.20 ||
niṣedhavidhirūpaṃ tu dvidhā śāstraṃ khagādhipa ||

anuvādasmṛtistvanyā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭā tu paṃcamī ||
sarvā etā vedamūlāḥ smṛtā vai ṛṣibhiḥ svayam || 23 || ||
|| aruṇa uvāca || ||
yā etā bhavatā proktāḥ smṛtayaḥ parvagopane ||
etāsāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi samāsādeva sattama || 24 ||
dṛṣṭārthā kā matā deva adṛṣṭārthā ca kā bhavet ||
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭasvarūpā kā nyāyamūlā ca kā bhavet ||
anuvādasmṛtiḥ kā syādṛṣṭādṛṣṭā tu kā bhavet || 25 ||
uvāca taṃ khagaṃ vīraṃ praṇataṃ vinayānvitam || 26 ||
ṣaḍguṇasya svarūpaṃ tu prayogā tkāryagauravāt ||
samayānāmupāyānāṃ yogo vyāsasamāsataḥ || 27 ||
adhyakṣāṇāṃ ca nikṣepaḥ karaṇānāṃ nirūpaṇam ||
dṛṣṭārtheyaṃ smṛtiḥ proktā ṛṣibhirgaruḍāgraja || 28 ||
saṃdhyopāstistathā kāryā śuno māṃsaṃ na bhakṣayet ||
adṛṣṭārthā smṛtiḥ proktā manunā vinatātmaja || 29 ||
pālāśaṃ dhārayeddaṃḍamubhayārthā vidurbudhāḥ ||
śrutau dṛṣṭaṃ yathā kāryaṃ smṛto tattādṛśaṃ yadi ||
uktānuvādinī sā tu pārivrājyaṃ tathā gṛhāt || 31 ||
ukto dharmaśca saṃkṣepātparibhāṣā ca tadgatā ||
tatsādhanaṃ ca deśādi itthamityabravīdraviḥ || 32 ||

yajñiyaḥ sa tu deśaḥ syānmlecchadeśastataḥ paraḥ || 34 ||
brahmādīnāṃ ca devānāṃ brāhmaṇādestathaiva ca ||
sādhanatvaṃ manuḥ prāha vedamūlaṃ sanātanam ||
upalabhya yathātattvaṃ sa ca darśitavānṛṣiḥ ||

ācārayuktaḥ śraddhālurvedajño.adhyātmaciṃtakaḥ ||

|| aruṇa uvāca || ||
brahmāvartādideśānāṃ samastānāṃ vibhāvaso ||

etānvijñāya saddeśāntsaṃśrayeta prayatnataḥ || 42 ||

eṣā dharmasya vai jyotiḥ samāsātkathitā tava || 43 || ||
uktaṃ dharmasya rūpaṃ tu sādhikāraṃ sanātanam ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmamāśramiṇāṃ khaga || 1 ||
catvāra āśramāḥ proktā eka eva caturvidhaḥ || 2 ||
gāyatro brahmacārī tu prājāpatyo dvitīyakaḥ ||

ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃskāraṃ dharmasiddhaye || 4 ||

vidyānte.abhīṣṭadānaṃ ca anujñāto gṛhī bhavet || 17 ||
niṣkāsanaṃ gurugṛhādgṛhasthasya yathābhavet ||

aṣṭau vivāhā varṇānāṃ saṃskārākhyā iti śrutiḥ || 22 ||

|| anūruruvāca || ||

|| bhāskara uvāca || ||

|| aruṇa uvāca || ||
nodvahetkapilāṃ kanyāṃ nādhikāṃgīṃ na rogiṇīm ||

ṛkṣavṛkṣanadīnāmnīṃ nānyaparvatanāmikām ||

|| anūruruvāca || ||
ete.aṣṭau prabhavāḥ proktā vivāhā ye jagatpate ||

caturṣveteṣu dattāyāmutpanno yaḥ sutaḥ striyām ||

prītihetuḥ sa gāṃdharvo vivāhaḥ paṃcamo mataḥ ||58||

śulkaṃ pradāya kanyāyā haraṇaṃ vyasanādapi||
suptāṃ mattāṃ pramattāṃ vā raho yatropagacchati ||

etānsaśulkānsāmānyānvivāhāṃścaturo viduḥ ||
kevalaṃ kṣatriyasyaiva vīryaṃ chittvā hi rākṣasaḥ || 62 ||

doṣavatyāḥ pradāne tu dātuḥ ṣaṇṇavatirdamaḥ ||
syāttu śulkapradāne ca kanyāyāścāpavarjane ||64||

brāhmo daivastathārṣaśca prājāpatyaḥ khagā dhipa ||

kuryātpaṃcamahāyajñānadhikāro dvijasya saḥ||
bhūtapitramarabrahmamanuṣyāṇāṃ yathāvidhi||1||

nityānitya miti prāhuranuṣaṃgātphalaṃ pare ||2||

|| anūruruvāca || ||

anūruruvāca || ||

upanikṣepadharmeṇa śūdrānnaṃ ca paceddvijaḥ ||

śūdrānnopahatā viprā vihvalā ratilālasāḥ ||
kupitāḥ kiṃ kariṣyaṃti nirviṣā iva pannagāḥ || 22 ||
hastadattāstu ye snehāllavaṇavyaṃjanādayaḥ ||
dātāraṃ nādhitiṣṭhaṃti bhoktā bhuṃkte tu kilbiṣam || 23 ||
bhoktā viṣṭhāśanaṃ bhuṃkte dātā tu narakaṃ vrajet || 24 ||
aṃgulyā daṃtakāṣṭhaṃ yatpratyakṣalavaṇaṃ ca yat ||
mṛttikābhakṣaṇaṃ caiva tulyaṃ gomāṃsabhakṣaṇaiḥ || 25 ||
tasmācchuṣkamathārdraṃ vā bhakṣayeddaṃtadhāvanam || 26 ||
puṣpālaṃkāravastrāṇi gaṃdha mālyānulepanam||
upavāse na duṣyaṃti daṃtadhāvanamaṃjanam ||27||
gṛhāṃte vasate mūrkho dūre cāsya guṇānvitaḥ ||
sannikṛṣṭamadhīyānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ yo vyatikramet||
|| anūruruvāca || ||
kiṃ tu yatte purā deva śrutaṃ vākyaṃ mahātmanaḥ || 31 ||
gadato nāradasyaiva śṛṇu tvaṃ vibudhādhipa ||
satyaniṣṭhaṃ dvijaṃ yastu śuklajātiṃ priyaṃvadam ||
mūrkhaṃ pākhaṃḍinaṃ vāpi vṛttihīnamathāpi vā || 33 ||
sapta parānsapta pūrvānpuruṣānātmanā saha || 34 ||
tasmānnātikramedrājā brāhmaṇaṃ prātiveśikam ||
bhāgineyaṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā baṃdhuṃ grahādhipa ||
mamāpyavagataṃ vīra brāhmaṇaṃ na parīkṣayet || 37 ||
tasmātsaṃpūjayedenaṃ na guṇāṃstasya ciṃtayet || 38 ||
kevalaṃ ciṃtayejjātiṃ na guṇānvinatātmaja ||
tasmādāmaṃtrayetpūrvamāsannaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ budhaḥ || 39 ||
yastvāsannamatikramya brāhmaṇaṃ patitādṛte ||
dūrasthānpūjayenmūḍho guṇāḍhyānnarakaṃ vrajet || 1.184.40 ||
devadravyaṃ dvijānnaṃ ca brahmasvaṃ brāhmaṇārjitam ||
mā dadasveti yo brūyādgavāgnibrāhmaṇeṣu vai ||
tiryagyoniśataṃ gatvā cāṃḍā leṣvabhijāyate || 42 ||
yattu vācā pratijñātaṃ karmaṇā nopapāditam ||
krīḍaṃtyoṣadhayaḥ sarvā yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim || 44 ||
madhu māṃsaṃ surāṃ somaṃ lākṣādyaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā ||
vikrīyānyatamaṃ teṣāṃ dvijaścāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret || 45 ||
guḍaṃ tilaṃ tathā nīlaṃ keśāngodhūmakānyavān ||
vikrīya brāhmaṇo gāṃ ca kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ caret || 46 ||
auṣṭramāvikadugdhaṃ ca annaṃ mṛtakasūtake ||
caurasyānnaṃ mṛtaśrāddhe bhuktvā cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret || 47 ||
gavāṃ śṛṃgodake snāto mahānadyāśca saṃgame ||
samudradarśanādvāpi śunā daṣṭaḥ śucirbhavet || 48 ||
vedavidyāvratasnātaḥ śunā daṣṭo dvijaḥ khaga ||
hiraṇyodakamiśraṃ tu ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśuddhyati || 49 ||
tiṣṭhanvāpyatha vā gacchañchunā daṣṭo dvijaḥ khaga ||
vajraṃ prāśya śuciḥ syādvai yathāha bhagavānmanuḥ || 1.184.50 ||
vratinaścāpi daṣṭasya trirātraṃ kṣapaṇaṃ smṛtam ||
saghṛtaṃ ca tato bhuktvā vrataśeṣaṃ samācaret || 51 ||
brāhmaṇī tu śunā daṣṭā some dṛṣṭaṃ samācaret ||
yadā na dṛśyate somaḥ prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet || 52 ||
yāṃ diśaṃ vrajate somastāṃ diśaṃ cāvalokayet ||
somamārgeṇa sā pūrvā pañcapūtena śudhyati || 53| ||
brāhmaṇasya brahmadvāre pūya śoṇitasaṃbhave ||
gavāṃ tatra purīṣeṇa trikālaṃ snānamācaret ||
dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ pītvā kṛmidaṣṭo viśudhyati || 55 ||
atha nābhyāḥ pradaṣṭasya āpādādvinatātmaja ||
etadvinirdiśetprājñaḥ prāyaścittaṃ khagādhipa || 56 ||
nābhikaṇṭhāṃtare vīra yadā cotpadyate kṛmiḥ ||
ṣaḍrātraṃ tu tadā proktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ manīṣibhiḥ || 57 ||
yadā daśaṃti śirasi kṛmayo vinatātmaja ||
kṛcchraṃ tadā caretprājñaḥ śuddhaye kaśyapātmaja || 58 ||
mṛtānnaṃ madhu māṃsaṃ ca yastu bhuñjīta brāhmaṇaḥ ||
mātṛśrāddhavidhivarṇanam
rātrau śrāddhaṃ na kurvīta rākṣasī kīrtitā hi sā ||
akṛtvā mātṛyajñaṃ tu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ pariveṣayet ||
tātasya krodhasaṃyuktāṃ hiṃsāmicchaṃti dāruṇām ||2||
|| anūruruvāca || ||
mātṛśrāddhaṃ kathaṃ kāryaṃ kāśca tā mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ||
nāṃdīmukhāśca pitaraḥ kathaṃ pūjāmavāpnuyuḥ || 3 ||
hanta te sampravakṣyāmi mātṛśrāddhavidhiṃ khaga ||
śṛṇu tvaṃ khagaśārdūla gadato mama kṛtsnaśaḥ ||4||
pūrvāhṇe bhojayedviprānaṣṭau sarvānpradakṣiṇān ||
kṛtvā yavaistilārthaṃ tu dadhimiśraṃ krameṇa ca ||6||
gandhapuṣpādikaṃ sarvaṃ kuryādviprapradakṣiṇam ||
guḍamiśraṃ khagaśreṣṭha savastramodanaṃ param ||
rasānāṃ modakāṃścaiva na ca tānkaṭukāṃstathā || 8 ||
evaṃ bhukteṣu vipreṣu dadyātpiṃḍā nsamāhitaḥ ||
kṛtvā tu maṃḍapaṃ vīra caturasraṃ pradakṣiṇam ||
pūrvāgrāṃśca kuśāndattvā puṣpāṇāṃ prakaraṃ tathā || 1.185.10 ||
evamuddiśya vai mātṛrḥ ṣaṭ piṃḍānnirvapetkhaga ||
aṣṭāśayeddvijānvīra mātṛśrāddhe khagā dhipa ||
nāṃdīmukhāṃstānuddiśya pitṛrnpaṃca dvijottamān ||
itthaṃ śrāddhadvayaṃ kuyādvṛddhau kaśyapanaṃdana ||
anyathā tatra luṃpaṃti sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ ||16||
pitrye trīnudagāsyāṃśca vṛddhau cādhvaryusaṃgamān || 19 ||
trīṇi śrāddhe pavitrāṇi dauhitraḥ kutupāstilāḥ ||
trīṇi cātra praśaṃsaṃti śaucamakrodhamatva ram || 1.185.20 ||
dauhitraṃ khaṃḍamityuktaṃ lalāṭāya prajāpate ||
savyādaṃsātparibhraṣṭaṃ nābhideśe vyava sthitam ||
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ tathā ||
nottarīyaṃ vinā kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ syānniṣphalaṃ yataḥ || 23 ||
na sa tatphalamāpnoti yathā yogapaṭāvṛtaḥ || 24 ||
vanasthānāṃ khagaśreṣṭha yatīnāṃ ca mahāmate ||
siddhaye karmaṇāṃ vīra yogapaṭṭakamucyate || 25 ||
hastau prakṣālya gaṃḍūṣaṃ yaḥ pibedavicakṣaṇaḥ ||
sa tu daivaṃ ca pitryaṃ ca ātmānaṃ copaghā tayet || 26 ||
bhojaneṣveva tiṣṭhaṃti svasti kurvaṃti ye dvijāḥ ||
āsuraṃ tadbhavecchrāddhaṃ pitṛrṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhate || 27 ||
dātāro nobhivardhaṃtā vedāḥ saṃta tireva ca||
bhāskara uvāca || ||
śrāvaṇyāṃ tu baliḥ kāryaḥ sarpāṇāṃ maṃtrapūrvakaḥ ||
śayanārohaṇe caiva kārye sukhamabhīpsatā || 1 ||
kāryaḥ pratyavarohastu mārgaśīrṣyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
phalaṃ vinā tvanuṣṭhānaṃ nityānāmiṣyate sphuṭam || 2 ||
kāmyānāṃ saphalārthaṃ tu doṣaprāptyarthameva ca ||
naimittikānāṃ karaṇaṃ trividhaṃ karmaṇāṃ phalam || 3 ||
nityakriyaṃ tathā cānye anuṣaṃgātphalaṃ śrutiḥ ||
agnyādheyaṃ tathā darśaṃ paurṇamāsaṃ dvitīyakam||5||
cāturmāsyamagnihotraṃ paśubaṃdho nirūḍhakāḥ ||
sautrāmaṇī saṃsthāḥ syurhaviṣaḥ śrutinoditāḥ || 6 ||
agniṣṭomo.atyagniṣṭoma ukthyaḥ saṃṣoḍaśī tathā ||
vājapeyātirātraśca āpyoryāmaḥ śrutau śrutaḥ ||7||
dayā syātsarvabhūteṣu anasūyātha maṃgalam ||
kṣāṃtirdayā tvanāyāsaḥ śaucamaspṛhatā vratam || 8 ||
samyaguktāstu saṃskārā brahmaprāptinimittakāḥ ||
anaṃtaraṃ pravakṣyāmi viprāṇāṃ vṛttayaḥ śubhāḥ || 9 ||
ṛtāmṛte ca viprāṇāmṛtaṃ pramṛtameva ca ||
ājīvikāvṛttayastu ityādyāḥ saṃpravartitāḥ ||
tāsāṃ kayāpi jīvettu anutiṣṭhedyathāvidhi || 11 ||
nityaṃ śuciḥ sugaṃdhaśca snānaśīlaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ ||
pūjyaśca pūjayeddevānkāryāṇi svayamācaret || 12 ||
nekṣetārkaṃ na nagnāṃ strīṃ na ca saṃspṛṣṭa maithunam ||
nāpsu mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā nāśucī rātritārakāḥ || 13 ||
śāstroktā yaṃtraṇā yā tu nānuktāni vratāni ca ||
svargārthaṃ sādhayettaiśca śaktimānmanasā tathā ||14||
kāmyāpravṛttau saṃge ca prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate ||15||
vratāni manasā tviṣṭasaṃkalpa iti mānasaḥ ||
aṃtarānuphalaṃ yattadṛṣivādāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||16||
ātmā śuddhastathā deśo hyasuhāraḥ prajāpadaḥ || 17 ||
aśubhāni nimittāni utpāto vikṛtaṃ tathā ||
parvāṇi manaso.aśuddhiranadhyāya iti smṛtaḥ ||18||
anadhyāyāśca dṛṣṭārthā adṛṣṭārthāstathāpare ||
abhakṣyaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ śāvāśaucaṃ khagādhipa ||
jātiduṣṭaṃ kriyāduṣṭaṃ kāladuṣṭaṃ vibhūṣitam||
saṃsargāśrayaduṣṭaṃ ca sahṛllekhaṃ svabhāvataḥ ||21||
laśunaṃ gṛṃjanaṃ caiva palāṃḍuṃ kavakāni ca ||
vārtākaṃ nālikeraṃ tu mūlakaṃ jātiduṣṭakam||22||
no bhuñjīta kriyāduṣṭaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca patitaiḥ pṛthak||
kāladuṣṭaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ hānidaṃ cirasaṃsthitam ||23||
surālaśunasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ peyūṣādisamanvitam ||
saṃsargaduṣṭametaddhi śunocchiṣṭaṃ khageśvara||25||
śūdrasaktaṃ khaṃḍasaktaṃ jñeyamāśrayadūṣitam||
sahṛllekhaṃ tu tajjñeyaṃ purīṣaṃ tu svabhāvataḥ ||
pāyasaṃ kṣīrapākādi tasminneva dine tathā||
yathāśāstraṃ khagaśreṣṭha bhakṣyābhakṣye nirūpayet||28||
prāṇātyaye prokṣitaṃ ca śrāddhe ca dvijakāmyayā ||
pitṛrndevāṃścārpayitvā bhuṃjanmāṃsaṃ na doṣabhāk||29||
pretāśuddhiḥ sapiṃḍānāṃ tasminneva mṛte sati||
daśāhaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vā pakṣaṃ māsaṃ tvaśuddhatā || 1.186.30 ||
daśāhāditrike bhāge varṇaśo na bhavaṃti hi ||
daśāhena tu bhojyāḥ syuḥ sūtakāśaucayostathā || 31||
ūrdhvaṃ daśāhādekāhaśravaṇe sati jāyate ||
sapiṃḍāḥ saptapuruṣāḥ śrutāvetannidarśanam || 33 ||
ā daṃtajanmanaḥ sadya ācūḍānnaiṣṭhikī smṛtā ||
trirātramāvratādeśātsapiṃḍeṣu mṛteṣu ca || 34 ||
teṣāmapi tadekaṃ syādvayovasthāpyapekṣyate ||
samānodakāttrirātreṇa śudhyedvai mṛtyujanmanoḥ || 35 ||
garbhasrāve trirātreṇa udakyā śudhyate tathā ||
dvijānāṃ tvevameva syātpitrarthaṃ mātureva vā ||
agnihotrārthaṃ vijñeyaṃ sadyaḥ śaucamiti sthitiḥ ||37||
asapiṃḍe tu nirhārāttrirātramapi mānavaḥ ||
tasyaivānugatau jñeyaṃ sadyaḥ śaucaṃ khagādhipa || 38 ||
ṣaṅbhistribhirahai kena kṣatraviṭśūdrayoniṣu || 39 ||
uktaśaucaṃ yathānyāyaṃ śārīraṃ tattvadarśibhiḥ ||
taijasī mārtikī vīra vāriśuddhiḥ smṛtā tathā ||
snānaṃ śaucaṃ ca kartavyaṃ dravyaśaucādanaṃtaram ||
prātaḥsnānaṃ tu nityaṃ syādgrahaṇe kāmyameva ca || 43 ||
naimittikaṃ kṣurāśaucaṃ tena pāpādviśudhyati ||
uktaṃ tu śaucaṃ vijñeyaṃ doṣakṣayakaraṃ khaga || 44 ||
karmāṃgaṃ ceti vijñeyaṃ ṣaṭprakārā samāsataḥ ||
evamācamanaṃ vidyādviśiṣṭaṃ tu dvijanmanām ||45||
śuśrūṣeta patiṃ bhāryā paritoṣaṃ yathā vrajet ||
etāṃ dharma samāṃ niṣṭhāṃ bhartṛlokamavāpnuyāt ||1.186.50||
strī dharmacāriṇī sādhvī mṛtā dāhyā tathāgnibhiḥ ||
viparītādadāhyā tu punardārakriyā tathā ||51||
strīṇāṃ niyogo vihito maraṇādbrahmacārakam ||
prāptavyaśca yathādharmo dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradaḥ || 52 ||
tasmāddharmaṃ sadā kuryātkurvatī svargamāpnuyāt || 53 ||
|| anūruruvāca || ||
kāni puṇyāni kṛtveha svargaṃ gacchaṃti mānavāḥ ||
manuṣyaloke saṃbhūtāḥ svarloke gāminaḥ param ||1||
karmayajñastapoyajñaḥ svādhyāyo dhyānanirmitaḥ ||
jñānayajñaśca paṃcaite mahāyajñāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 2 ||
eteṣāmeva yajñānāmuttamaḥ katamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
etadyajñaphalānāṃ ca kiṃ phalaṃ kā gatirbhavet ||3||
dharmādharmaprabhedāśca kiyantaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
khaga nārakiṇāṃ puṃsāmāgatānāṃ punaḥ kṣitau ||

garbhādiduḥkhaphenāḍhyānmucyaṃte dehinaḥ katham || || 6 ||
ityukto bhagavānbhānuḥ sarvapraśnārthamādarāt || 7 ||
pratyuvāca mahātejāḥ samāsavyāsayogataḥ || 7 ||
svargāpavargaphaladaṃ narakārṇavatāraṇam ||
dharmaṃ pāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇu śūra prabhāṣataḥ || 8 ||
śraddhāpūrvaḥ sadā dharmaḥ śraddhāmadhyāṃtasaṃsthitaḥ ||
