śrutimaṃtrarasāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ ||
śraddhāmātreṇa gṛhyaṃte na pareṇa ca cakṣuṣā || 1.187.10 ||
dharmaḥ saṃprāpyate sūkṣmaḥ śraddhāhīnaiḥ surairapi || 11 ||
śraddhā dharmaḥ paraḥ sūkṣmaḥ śraddhā yajñāhutaṃ tapaḥ||
śraddhā mokṣaśca svargaśca śraddhā sarvamidaṃ jagat || 12 ||
sarvasvaṃ jīvitaṃ vāpi dadyādaśraddhayā ca yaḥ ||
evaṃ śraddhāmayāḥ sarve mama dharmāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
pūjyastu śraddhayā puṃsā dhyeyaḥ pūjyaśca śraddhayā || 14 ||
ajñāduktaṃ sasaṃdigdhaṃ vākyametanmamādbhutam || 15 ||
nānāsiddhikaraṃ divyaṃ lokacittānuraṃjanam ||
suniścitārthagaṃbhīraṃ vākyaṃ mama manoramam || 16 ||
sa khaṣolketi vikhyātaḥ saśivaṃ maṃḍalaṃ khaga || 17 ||
devatrayaguṇātītaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvavitprabhuḥ ||
yathānādipravṛttoyaṃ ghoraḥ saṃsārasāgaraḥ ||
khaṣolkopi tathānādiḥ saṃsārārṇavaśodhanaḥ ||19||
vyādhīnāṃ bheṣajaṃ yadvatpra tipakṣasvabhāvataḥ ||
mokṣiṇāṃ muktihetuśca siddhaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ || 1.187.20 ||
vedo manogame cātra ṣaḍakṣaramaṃtrasthitaḥ ||
yadvā mukto.akṣaraikena loke pañcākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 22 ||
yasyoṃ namaḥ khaṣolketi mantro.ayaṃ hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ || 23 ||
tenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam ||
yenoṃ namaḥ khaṣolketi mama vākyaṃ ṣaḍakṣaram || 24 ||
vidhivākyamidaṃ sarvaṃ nārthavādaṃ vaco mama ||
pṛcchasvemaṃ praṇamyāśu vainateya mahāmate || 25 ||
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ bhānorvainateyo mahābalaḥ ||
saptāśvatilakaṃ bhaktyā praṇamyovāca bhārata || 26 ||
|| anūruruvāca || ||
brūhi māṃ devaśārdūla yatpṛcchāmi mahāmate ||
kīdṛgvākyamidaṃ bhānorvākyārthaṃ brūhi ca prabho || 27|| ||
|| saptāśvatilaka uvāca || ||
vimuktāśeṣadoṣeṇa sarvajñena bhagena yat ||

saṃskṛtenāpi kiṃ tena mṛdulālāpasaṃginā ||
avidyārāmavākyena saṃsārakleśahetunā || 35 ||

idaṃ śreṣṭhamidaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvaṃ tvaṃ jñātumicchasi ||
api varṣasahasrāyuḥ śāstrāntaṃ nādhigacchati || 39 ||
vijñāyākṣaratanmātraṃ jīvitaṃ cātivaṃcanam ||
vihāya sarvaśāstrāṇi paralokaṃ samācaret || 1.187.40 ||
yaḥ puṇyabhāramudvoḍhumaśaktaḥ pāralaukikam || 41 ||
paṇḍito.api sa mūrkhaḥ syācchaktiyukto.apyaśaktikaḥ ||
yaḥ saurajñānamāhātmyamuccārayitumakṣamaḥ || 42 ||
tasmātsa paṃḍitaḥ śaktaḥ sa tapasvī jitendriyaḥ ||
yaḥ saurajñānasadbhāvamālocayitumudyataḥ || 43 ||
yaḥ pradadyānnṛpaḥ kṛtsnāṃ kṣmāṃ dhanaṃ kāṃcanaṃ tathā ||

sarve biṃduyutā bhīṣma śikhā biṃduvibhūṣitāḥ || 1.206.30 ||
somādyāḥ ketuparyaṃtā grahā hyevaṃ prakīrtitāḥ ||
etā mudrāḥ pravakṣyāmi sarvasiddhipradāyikāḥ || 31 ||
iyaṃ mudrā namaskāre grahasānnidhyakārikā || || 32 ||

hṛdayaṃ cottamāṃgaṃ ca śikhā vai vaktrameva ca ||

varadā.abhayahastāśca dhyātavyā sādhakena tu ||

dīptā dīptaśikhākārā dhyātavyā mama śaktayaḥ || 1.206.40 ||

||vyāsa uvāca || ||

sakṛtprapūjya saptamyāṃ bhaktyā devaṃ divākaram || 26 ||

tasya viṣṇustathā brahmā tuṣyate śaṃkarastathā || 44 ||
pratyūṣe bhagavānbrahmā dināṃte tuṣyate hariḥ ||
mahādevastathā rātrau śṛṇvatāṃ tuṣyate vibhuḥ ||
pāraṇāni daśāheṣu eke kurvaṃti tāni bhoḥ || 45 ||
bhavedvai rājaśārdūla śṛṇu teṣāṃ ca yatphalam ||
vidhānaṃ vācakasyeha śṛṇvatāṃ ca viśāṃpate||46||
śuddhavāsā gṛhādetya sthānaṃ yatsamayānvitam ||
nātyuccaṃ nātinīcaṃ ca hyāsanaṃ bhajate tataḥ ||
vandanīyaṃ prapūjya ca śrotṛbhiḥ kurunandana ||
vyāsapīṭhaṃ tu tatproktaṃ gurorāsanamādiśet || 49 ||
devārcāmagrataḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇārcāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 51 ||
upa viśya tataḥ paścācchrāvakaḥ śṛṇuyānnṛpa ||
samastānāgatānkṛtvā tataḥ pustakamādadet || 52 ||
praṇamya śirasā tasya pustakasya viśāṃpate ||
graṃthiṃ ca śithilāṃ kuryādvācakaḥ kurunandana ||
patrāṇi bhagavānbrahmā akṣarāṇi janārdanaḥ ||54||
śaṃkaraśca tathā sūtraṃ paṃktayaḥ sarvadevatāḥ ||
pāvakaśca tathā sūtre madhye bhānuḥ samāśritaḥ ||55||
agre sthitā grahāḥ sarve diśo vāpi tathā vibho ||
smṛto meruḥ sadā śaṃkuśchidramākāśamucyate ||56||
yaṃtradvayaṃ kāṣṭhamayamadhordhvaṃ yadudāhṛtam ||
dyāvāpṛthivyośca śaṃkhastathā caṃdra udāhṛtaḥ ||57||
namasyaṃ pūjanīyañca gṛhe sthāpyaṃ vibhūtaye|| 58 ||
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ||59||
nirūpya pātraṃ rājendra karābhyāṃ gṛhya vācakaḥ ||
praṇamya śirasā sarvānbrahmādīnvyāsameva ca ||
vālmīkiṃ ca tathā rājanvidhiṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ ravim||1.216.60||
namaskāramathaiṣāṃ tu paṭhitvā kurunaṃdana||
tatosau vyāharedviprānvācakaḥ śradayānvitaḥ|| |
saptasvarasamāyuktaṃ kālekāle viśāṃpate ||
īdṛśādvācakādviprācchrutvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
itihāsapurāṇāni rāmasya caritaṃ tathā|| 64||
niyamasthaḥ śuciḥ śrotā śṛṇuyātphalamaśnute ||
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraścāpi viśeṣataḥ || 65 ||
aśvamedhamavāpnoti sarvānkāmānavāpnute ||
snātairgṛhaṃ samāgamya śrotṛbhirvācakasya tu ||
praṇamya śirasā vipraṃ vācakaṃ śraddhayā nṛpa||67||
āsanaṃ ca samāśritya sthātavyaṃ vācakasya tu||
saṃmukhaṃ rājaśārdūla vāgyataiḥ susamāhitaiḥ||68||
na vaktavyaṃ mahābāho śrāvakaiḥ saṃśayādṛte ||69||
saṃśaye sati praṣṭavyo vācakaḥ saṃprasādya tu ||
vācakenāpi vaktavyaṃ yatsyātteṣāṃ nibodhanam ||
anugrahāya sarveṣāmaśeṣā guravo nṛpa || 71 ||
namaskārādayaḥ śrāvyā śivamastviti vodyate ||
vāgyatairnṛpaśārdla varṇaiḥ sarvairmahīpate||72||
śūdrāṇāṃ purato vaiśyā vaiśyānāṃ kṣatriṇastathā ||
ye ca saṃkarajā rājannarāste śūdrapṛṣṭhataḥ || 73 ||
brāhmaṇaṃ vācakaṃ vidyānnānyavarṇajamādaret ||
śrutvānyavarṇajādvācaṃ vācakānnarakaṃ vrajet || 74 ||
itthaṃ hi śṛṇvatāṃ teṣāṃ varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ ||
māsimāsi bhavedrājanpāraṇaṃ kurunandana || 75 ||
śreyo.arthamātmano rājanpūjayedvācakaṃ budhaḥ ||
māsi pūrṇe dvija śreṣṭhe dātavyaṃ svarṇamāṣakam || 76 ||
vācakāya dvijaśreṣṭha vaiśyenāpi trayaṃ tathā || 77 ||
śūdreṇaiva ca catvāro dātavyāḥ svarṇamāṣakāḥ ||
māsimāsi dvijaśreṣṭha śraddhayā vācakāya tu || 78 ||
prathame pāraṇe rājanvācakaṃ pūjya śaktitaḥ ||
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ viṃdati mānavaḥ || 79 ||
kārtikādīnsamārabhya yāvatkārttikamacyuta ||
agniṣṭomaṃ gosavaṃ ca jyotiṣṭomaṃ tathā nṛpa || 1.216.80 ||
sautrāmaṇiṃ vājapeyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca tathā vibho ||
māheśvaraṃ tathā brāhmaṃ puṃḍarīkaṃ yajeta yaḥ || 81 ||
ādityayajñasya tathā rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ ||
phalaṃ prāpnoti rājeṃdra māsairdvādaśabhiḥ kramāt ||
itthaṃ yajñaphalaṃ prāpya yāti lokāṃstathottamān || 82 ||
śociṣkeśagṛhe gatvā gaccheccailavile gṛhe || 84 ||
dhiṣaṇasya gṛhaṃ gatvā tataścitraśikhaṃḍinaḥ ||
evameva nṛpaśreṣṭha nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 85 ||
phalametatsamuddiṣṭaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ satataṃ nṛṇām ||
etatphalaṃ vatsareṇa śṛṇvato vidhito nṛpa || 86 ||
etāni parimāṇāni vatsareṇa bhavaṃti vai ||
śṛṇvatāṃ nṛpaśārdūla dadatāṃ vācakāya vai || 87 ||
ekaṃ ca dve tathā trīṇi catvāri ca viśāṃpate ||
deyāni vācakāyeha māsimāsi narādhipa || 88 ||
brāhmaṇādyairnṛpa śreṣṭha sarvavarṇavibhāgaśaḥ ||
samāpte parvaṇi tathā vācakaṃ pūjayetpunaḥ ||89||
vācakaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ caiva sarvakāmaiḥ prapūjayet ||
hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ rukmaṃ gāśca kāṃsyopadohanāḥ ||91||
yathā sadakṣiṇaṃ cānnaṃ śrāddhakāle prakīrtitam ||
tathā śrutaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha sadakṣiṇamudāhṛtam || 92 ||
vācakaṃ pūjayedyasmā tpaścāllekhakapūjanam ||
samāpte parvaṇi vibho viśeṣeṇaiva cārcayet || 93 ||
vācakaḥ pūjito yena pūjitāstena devatāḥ ||
iti vedhāḥ sadā prāha devānāṃ purataḥ purā ||
tasmiṃstuṣṭe jagatsarvaṃ tuṣṭaṃ bhavati nityaśaḥ||||
tiṣṭhaṃti yasya śāstrāṇi jihvāgre pṛthivīpate||
dṛṣṭaśca gocarastāta kastena sadṛśo dvijaḥ||97||
tasmādannaṃ sadā pūrvaṃ tasmai deyaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ||
śrāddhe yasya dvijo bhuṃkte vācakaḥ śradayānvitaḥ ||
bhavaṃti pitarastasya tṛptā varṣaśataṃ nṛpa ||98||
yatheha sarvadevānāṃ bhāskaraḥ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||
vispaṣṭamadbhutaṃ śāṃtaṃ spaṣṭākṣarapadaṃ tathā ||
budhyamānaḥ sadātyarthaṃ graṃthāthaṃ kṛtsnaśo nṛpa ||
brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu graṃthārthaṃ vācayennṛpa || 1.216.100 ||
ato.anyathā kathayitā jñeyo.asau vaktṛnāmakaḥ || 101 ||
deśe.atha pattane rājansa deśaḥ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 102 ||
te dhanyāste mahātmānaste kṛtārthā na saṃśayaḥ ||
na śobhate puraṃ vīra vyāsahīnaṃ kadācana ||
yathārkahīnaṃ hi dinaṃ caṃdrahīnā yathā niśā || 104 ||
tathā vyāsavihīnaṃ tu rājate na puraṃ kvacit || 105 ||
praṇamya vācakaṃ bhaktyā yatphalaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ ||
tathā vyāsasamo nāsti brāhmaṇo bhuvi kaścana || 108 ||
kurukṣetrasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na dvitīyaṃ pracakṣate ||
na nadī gaṃgayā tulyā na devo bhāskarādvaraḥ ||109||
nāśvamedhasamaṃ puṇyaṃ na pāpaṃ brahmahatyayā ||
daive karmaṇi pitrye ca pāvanaḥ paramo nṛṇām || 111 ||
nāsti vyāsasamaḥ śreṣṭha itīyaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ ||
atha viprasahasrāṇāṃ vipro.ayaṃ śreṣṭha īritaḥ ||
upaviṣṭo yadā bhuṃkte vyāso vai vipramaṇḍale ||112||
śrāddhe tāta pavitrāṇi kathitāni purā mama||
brahmaṇā rājaśārdūla śṛṇu tāni yathāvidhi ||113||
madhu pāyasaṃ kālaśākastilāśca kutapastathā ||
rājataṃ cāpi pātreṣu brāhmaṇeṣvatha vācakaḥ ||114||
vācakaśca yatiścaiva tathā yaśca ṣaḍaṃgavit || 115 ||
ete sarve nṛpaśreṣṭha vijñeyāḥ paṃktipāvanāḥ ||
nāmanī vācakasyaite śṛṅgavārthamathaitayoḥ || 116 ||
itihāsapurāṇāni jayeti viditāni vai ||
jayopajīvī tenāsau gataḥ khyātiṃ tu vācakaḥ || 117 ||
vispaṣṭamadbhutaṃ śāṃtaṃ spaṣṭākṣaramidaṃ tathā ||
yudhyamānotha vātyarthaṃ graṃthārthaṃ kṛtsnaśo nṛpa ||
brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu graṃthārthaṃ cārpayettathā || 119 ||
trividhaṃ vācakaṃ vidyātsadā guṇavibhedataḥ ||
śrāvakaṃ ca mahābāho trividhaṃ guṇabhedataḥ || 121 ||
abudhyamāno graṃthārthamabhīṣṭotsāhavarjitaḥ || 123 ||
īdṛśaṃ vācayedyastu vācakaḥ kṣmādhipeśvara ||
krodhano.apriyavādī ca ajñānādgraṃthadūṣakaḥ || 124 ||
budhyate na ca kaṣṭācca sa jñeyo vācakādhamaḥ ||
vispaṣṭamadbhutaṃ śāṃtaṃ rasabhāvasamanvitam|| 125 ||
abudhyamāno graṃthārthaṃ vācayedyastu vācakaḥ ||
sa jñeyo rājaso rājannidānīṃ sāttvikaṃ śṛṇu || 126 ||
vispaṣṭamadbhutaṃ śāṃtaṃ spaṣṭākṣarapadaṃ tathā ||
attyarthaṃ budhyamānastu graṃthārthaṃ kṛtsnaśo nṛpa ||
brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu ācāryo vidhivannṛpa || 128 ||
ya evaṃ vācayedrājansa jñeyaḥ sāttviko budhaiḥ ||
śraddhā bhaktivihīno yo lobhiṣṭhaḥ kaṭuko yathā || 129 ||
hetuvādaparo rājaṃstathāsūyāsamanvitaḥ ||
nityāṃ naimittikāṃ kāmyāmādadaddakṣiṇāṃ nṛpa || || 1.216.130 ||
vācako yo mahābāho śṛṇuyādyastu mānavaḥ ||
sa jñeyastāmaso rājañchrāvako mānavo.api saḥ || 131 ||
prasaṃgācchṛṇuyādyastu śraddhābhaktivivarjitaḥ || 132||
saṃtyajya sarvakāryāṇi bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 133 ||
satataṃ pūjayedyastu vācakaṃ śraddhayā mudā ||
ya evaṃ śṛṇuyādvīra sa jñeyaḥ sāttviko budhaiḥ ||
vyāsaḥ pūjyaḥ śrāvakāṇāṃ yathā vyāsavaco nṛpa|| 135 ||
tasmātpūjyatamo nānyaḥ śrāvakāṇāṃ nṛpottama ||
yataḥ sa vai gurusteṣāṃ jñānadātā sadā nṛpa ||136||
caturṇāmiha varṇānāṃ nānyo bandhuḥ pracakṣyate ||
vyāsādṛte nṛpaśreṣṭha itīyaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ ||137||
sa guruḥ sa pitā mātā sa baṃdhuḥ sa suhṛttathā || 138 ||
vācako nṛpaśārdūla viprādīnāmaśeṣataḥ ||
itthaṃ vyāso gururjñeyaḥ pūjyo mānyo dvijātibhiḥ || 139 ||
śṛṇvaṃti ye narā rājansa teṣāṃ gururucyate ||
pūjārthaṃ tasya samayaḥ śrāvakāṇāmudāhṛtaḥ || | 1.216.140 ||
ye śṛṇvaṃti nṛpaśreṣṭha māsi māsi dadaṃti te ||
svarṇamāṣakamekasmai vācakāya pṛthakpṛthak ||141||
dvādaśyāṃ cāmāvāsyāyāmatha vā ravisaṃkrame ||
sā nityā dakṣiṇā tasyāṃ yā ca śreyo.arthamātmanaḥ||142||
prāpte vāparapakṣe ca dānaṃ tasyai svaśaktitaḥ || 143 ||
deyaṃ syācchrāvakaistāta taṃ muktvā nānyato nṛpa ||
prathamaṃ tasya dātavyaṃ śreyo.arthaṃ śrāvakaiḥ sadā ||144||
adattvā tasya yenyasmai saṃprayacchaṃti śrāvakāḥ ||
kṛtvāvamānamatha taiḥ prāpyate yatphalaṃ nṛpa ||
brāhmaṇādyaiḥ samastaiśca tacchṛṇuṣva varānana ||146||
śūdratvaṃ brāhmaṇo yāti kṣatriyo yāti kākatām ||
jāyate ca tathā vaiśyaḥ śūdraścāṇḍālatāṃ vrajet ||147||
tasmātpūjyo nṛpaśreṣṭha prathamaṃ vācako budhaiḥ ||
āpatkāle ca vṛddhau ca yataścāsau guruḥ smṛtaḥ || 148 ||
vaiśākhyāmayane vīra tṛtīyāyāṃ ca suvrata ||
kārttikyāmatha mārgyāṃ ca saṃpūjyaḥ prathamaṃ bhavet || 149 ||
hiraṇyaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ ca dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathaiva ca || 1.216.150 ||
annaṃ cāpi tathā pakvaṃ māṃsaṃ ca kurunaṃdana ||
na pīḍyate yathā dvaṃdvaistathā kāryaṃ varānana || 152 ||
hemaṃte lomaśā deyāśchatraṃ prāvṛṣi sattama ||
upānahau kālayogye kāle caivānulomaśaḥ ||153||
itthaṃ dvaṃdvavinirmuktaḥ sa yeṣāṃ vācako nṛpa ||
te dhanyāḥ śrāvakā loke te gatāḥ paramaṃ padam || 154 ||
ātmanā tu kathaṃ vīra sukhamicchedvicakṣaṇaḥ ||
viṣamasthe gurau rājanyataśca sa guruḥ smṛtaḥ || 155 ||
vācakaśrāvakāṇāṃ ca tasmāddvaṃdvaṃ vighātayet ||
yatnaḥ kāryaḥ śrāvakaiśca vācakasya janādhipa || 156 ||
itthaṃ pūjyaḥ sadā vyāsaḥ śreyo.arthaṃ prathamaṃ nṛpa ||
bhartā pūjyo yathā strīṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ vai mahī pate || 157 ||
śrāvakāṇāṃ tathā rājanvācakaḥ pūjya ucyate ||
upādhyāyastu śiṣyāṇāṃ yathā bhāgavato hariḥ || 158 ||
saurāṇāṃ ca yathā bhānuḥ śaivānāṃ śaṃkaro yathā ||
vācakastu tathā pūjyaḥ śrāvakāṇāṃ narādhipa || 159 ||
dakṣiṇāṃ dadatā nityaṃ śrotavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ||
pūrvoktamāṣakaṃ tasmai vācakāya janādhipa || 1.216.160 ||
yadā dātuṃ na śaknoti māṣakaṃ kāṃcanasya tu ||
rajatasya tadā deyaṃ māṣakaṃ śreyase nṛpa || 161 ||
tadabhāve hiraṇyaṃ ca vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
mṛttikāpi hi dātavyā prāpnoti satphalaṃ śubham || 162 ||
ityeṣā dakṣiṇā nityā māsimāsi bhavennṛpa ||
amale vāsasī rājangaṃdhamālyavibhūṣaṇe ||
jñātvā sarvasamāptiṃ tu pūjayecchrāvako dhuvam ||
naimittikāṃ ca nityāṃ ca dakṣi ṇāmapradāya ca ||
śṛṇoti ca sadā yastu tasya tanniṣphalaṃ śrutam || 166 ||
yathā ca dakṣiṇāhīnādyajñānna phalamaśnute ||
tathā śrutaṃ ca rājeṃdra dakṣi ṇārahitaṃ smṛtam || 167 ||
caturguṇā bhavedrājanyā nityā dakṣiṇā vibho ||
samāpte parvaṇi vibho ityāha bhagavāñchivaḥ || 168 ||
ityeṣa kathito rājanpurāṇaśravaṇe vidhiḥ ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṛdevābhipūjanam ||
vidhipūrvaṃ smṛtaṃ jñeyaṃ yatheha kurunadana||1.216.170 ||
phaladaṃ nṛpaśārdūla purāṇaśravaṇaṃ tathā ||
yathāyaṃ kathitaṃ tubhyaṃ vidhinā śravaṇaṃ mayā ||171||
yathoktaṃ tu yathā jīvaṃ yathoktaṃ brahmavādinā ||
sa brāhmaṇo mahārāja sarvalokeṣu pūjitaḥ || 172 ||
yathāśrutaṃ mahābāho tathedaṃ kathitaṃ tava ||
bhāskarasya tu māhātmyaṃ māhātmyaṃ vācakasya tu || 173 ||
tathā ca saptamīkalpaḥ sarvapāpabhayāpahaḥ ||
bhagalokaṃ samāsādya triṣu lokeṣu gīyate ||
daśānāṃ rājasūyānāmagniṣṭomaśatasya ca || 177 ||
śravaṇātphalamāpnoti pitāmahavaco yathā || 178 ||

uccāvacāvadhānaṃ ca prāyaścittādikaṃ ca yat || ṣaṣṭyādhikāṣṭasāhasranavaślokaśatodbhavam || 13 ||
paṃcataṃtrasamāyuktaṃ pratitaṃtre ca viṃśatiḥ ||
paṃcottaraṃ tathādhyāyāḥ purāṇe.asmindvijottamāḥ || 14 ||
trayāṇāmāśramāṇāṃ ca gṛhastho yonirucyate ||
anye.api sūpajīvanti tasmācchreṣṭho gṛhāśramī || 15||

taḍāgasya ca sānnidhye taḍāgaṃ parivarjayet ||
prapāsthāne prapā varjyā maṭhasthāne maṭhaṃ tyajet ||18||
dharmādevāpavargo.ayaṃ tasmāddharmaṃ samāśrayet || 19 ||

jīveddevalavṛttiryaḥ bhāryāvipaṇajīvakaḥ ||
kanyāśulkena jīvedvā strīdhanena ca vā kvacit || 51 ||
ṣaḍeva naṣṭāḥ śāstre ca na svargamokṣabhāginaḥ ||
sadā kruddhaṃ mano yasya hīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā prakopavān || 52 ||
bhrukuṭīkuṭilaḥ kruddho ruṣṭaḥ paṃcavidhoditaḥ ||
duṣṭaiḥ saha sadālāpaḥ sa duṣṭaḥ saptadhā smṛtaḥ ||54 ||
ekākī miṣṭamaśnāti vaṃcakaḥ sādhuniṃdakaḥ ||
yathā sūkaraḥ puṣṭaḥ syāttathā puṣṭaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 95 ||
nigamāgamataṃtrāṇi nādhyāpayati yo dvijaḥ||
na śṛṇoti ca pāpātmā sa duṣṭa iti cocyate || 56 ||
śrutiḥ smṛtiśca viprāṇāṃ nayane dve vinirmite ||
ekena vikalaḥ kāṇo dvābhyāmaṃdhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 57 ||
dvijādhamaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sa caṃḍaḥ śāstraniṃditaḥ ||58||
piśuno rājagāmī ca śūdrasevaka eva ca ||
śūdrāṃganāgamo vipraḥ sa caṃḍaśca dvijādhamaḥ ||59||
pakvānnaṃ śūdragehe ca yo bhuṃkte sakṛdeva vā ||
paṃcarātraṃ śūdragehe nivāsī caṃḍa ucyate || || 2.1.5.60 ||
aṣṭakuṣṭhānvitaḥ kuṣṭhī trikuṣṭhī śāstraninditaḥ ||
kīṭavadbhramaṇaṃ yasya kuvyāpārī kupaṃḍitaḥ ||
sa dvidhā śūkarapaśurniṃditaḥ siddhasaṃmataḥ|| || 63 ||
kapolena hi saṃyukto bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanaḥ ||
nṛpavaddaṃḍayedyastu sa daṃḍaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ || 64 ||
dhanena tena itaraṃ devaṃ vā brāhmaṇānapi || 65 ||
sa kharaśca paśuśreṣṭhaḥ sarvavedeṣu niṃditaḥ || 66 ||
sa nīca iti vijñeyo hyanācārastathāparaḥ || 68 ||
ṣaḍguṇālaṃkṛteḥ sādhordoṣānmṛgayate khalaḥ ||
vane puṣpaphalākīrṇe śalabhaḥ kaṃṭakāniva || 69 ||
daivena ca vihīno yaḥ kusaṃbhāṣāṃ vadettu yaḥ ||
cāṃḍālaiḥ saha ālāpaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ poṣaṇe rataḥ ||
mārjāraiścāpi saṃbhuṃkte yatkṛtyaṃ makarṭoditam || 71 ||
tṛṇacchedī loṣṭamadī vṛthā māṃsāśanaśca yaḥ ||
capalaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ parabhāryāratastathā|| 72 |||
nityakriyā akurvāṇo nityaṃ sa ca malīmasaḥ || 73 ||
anyāyena gṛhaṃ viṃdedanyāyena gṛhāndhanam |||
śāstrādanyadgṛha maṃtraṃ sa steyī brahmaghātakaḥ || 74 ||
devo.api bhāvayetpaścānmānuṣo.api na saṃśayaḥ ||
anyonyabhāvanā kāryā sa steyī yo na bhāvayet|| 76 ||
guroḥ prasādājjayati pitroścāpi prasādataḥ ||
na poṣayati duṣṭātmā sa steyī cāparaḥ smṛtaḥ || 78 ||
sarveṣāṃ ca savarṇānāṃ dharmato brāhmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||
pṛthivīpālako rājā dharmacakṣurudāhṛtaḥ || 2.1.5.80 ||
tadvido gaṇanābhijñā anyaviprāḥ pracakṣate || 81 ||
gaṃgāhīno hato deśo viprahīnā yathā kriyā ||
apradīpā yathā rātriranādityaṃ yathā nabhaḥ ||
tathā.asāṃvatsaro rājā bhramatyaṃdha ivādhvani || 83 ||
śmaśruyukto dvijaḥ pūjyaḥ sūryo viprastu śmaśrulaḥ || 84 ||
pratyakpradarśanātpuṇyaṃ tridinaṃ kalmaṣāpaham ||
darśane vrātyaviprasya sūryaṃ dṛṣṭvā viśudhyati || 85 ||
jātibhedāśca catvāro bhojakaḥ kathakastathā ||
deśacakravidaḥ pūjyā horācakravidaḥ parāḥ || 2.1.5.90 ||
sūryacakravidaḥ pūjyā nāvamanyetkathaṃcana ||
gaṇaviprasamaḥ pūjyo daivajñaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ || 91 ||
saṃsthānaṃ sūryavipro yaḥ sūryaviprasya sattamāḥ ||
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ nānyo baṃdhuḥ pracakṣate ||
ṛte piturdvijaśreṣṭhā itīyaṃ naigamī smṛtiḥ || 1 ||
trayo.api guravaḥ śreṣṭhāstābhyāṃ mātā paro guruḥ ||
ye sodarā jyeṣṭhaśreṣṭhā uttarottarato guruḥ || 2 ||
dvādaśyāṃ tu āmavāsyāmatha vā ravisaṃkrame ||
vāsāṃsi dakṣiṇā deyā maṇimuktā yathāruci || 3 ||
prāpte cāparapakṣe tu bhojayeccāpi śaktitaḥ || 4 ||
paścātpravaṃdayetpādau maṃtreṇānena sattamāḥ ||
yā kukṣivivare kṛtvā svayaṃ rakṣati sarvataḥ ||
namāmi jananīṃ devīṃ parāṃ prakṛtirūpiṇīm ||9|||
kṛcchreṇa mahatā devyā dhārito.ahaṃ yathodare ||
tvatprasādājjagaddṛṣṭaṃ mātarnityaṃ namo.astu te || 2.1.6.10 ||
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni sāgarādīni sarvaśaḥ ||
vasaṃti yatra tāṃ naumi mātaraṃ bhūtihetave || 11 ||
śivarūpa namastasmai saṃsārārṇavasetave || 12 ||
veda vedāṃgaśāstrāṇāṃ tattvaṃ yatra pratiṣṭhitam ||
ādhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāmagrajanmannamo.astu te || 13 ||
brāhmaṇo jagatāṃ tīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ paramaṃ yataḥ ||
bhūdeva hara me pāpaṃ viṣṇurūpinnamo.astu te || 14 ||
pitāmahaṃ ca praṇametsarvādau mātaraṃ gurum ||
mātāmahaṃ ca tadanu ācāryamatha ṛtvijam || 15 ||
mātṛmaṃtraiśca prathamaṃ praṇamedbhaktibhāvataḥ ||
yathāgrajastathā jyeṣṭhaḥ pitṛvyo.api dvijottamāḥ || 16 ||
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭe ca sa gururgururmātā tathā guruḥ ||
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭastṛtīyaḥ syātsūryo.agniścaṃdra eva ca ||17||
maṃtradātā guruḥ khyātassaptamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
kabhojanaguruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ svargāpavargahetukaḥ ||18||
dṛṣṭadevaṃ ca yo hitvā adṛṣṭaṃ ca niṣevate ||
yathā pitā jyeṣṭhapitā kanīyāṃśca tathā dvijāḥ ||
jyeṣṭho bhrātā pitṛtulyo mānyaḥ satkārabhāgyataḥ ||2.1.6.20||
ācāryo brahmaṇo mūrtiḥ pitā mūrtiḥ prajāpateḥ ||
mātā syānpṛthivīmūrtirbhrātaro mūrtirātmanaḥ || 21 ||
pitā merurva śiṣṭhaḥ syāddharmamūrtiḥ sanātanaḥ ||
sa cāpi dṛṣṭadevaḥ syāttadājñāṃ paripālayet || 22 ||
sa yāti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ yasmānnāvartate punaḥ || 23 ||
tasya pādodakasnānādgaṃgā nārhati kevalam ||
dvātriṃ śatkuṃḍakaśilāsparśane yādṛśaṃ phalam ||
tādṛśaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ pitāmahapradakṣiṇe || 25 ||
śatamātṛvariṣṭhāśca pitāmahyāśca poṣaṇe ||
guṇāstaddarśane viprāḥ saṃsāre na punarviśet || 26 ||
samākhyāmīha vipreṃdrā itihāsaṃ purātanam ||
śravaṇepi ca dharmātmañchrūyatāṃ yanmayā purā || 1 ||
pṛṣṭovocanmahātejā viriṃco bhagavānprabhuḥ ||
haṃta te kathayāmyeṣa purāṇaśravaṇe vidhim || 2 ||
itihāsapurāṇāni śrutvā bhaktyā dvijottamāḥ ||
sāyaṃ prātastathā rātrau śucirbhūtvā śṛṇoti yaḥ ||
tasya viṣṇustathā brahmā tuṣyate śaṃkarastathā || 4 ||
pratyūṣe bhagavānbrahmā dināṃte tuṣyate hariḥ ||
mahādevastathā rātrau śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ nṛṇām||5||
nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ svāsanaṃ bhajate tataḥ ||
dikpatibhyo namaskṛtya ū~mkārādhiṣṭhitānapi || 7 ||
pustakaṃ dharmaśāstrasya dharmādhiṣṭhānaśāśvatam ||
āgamānāṃ śivo devastaṃtrādīnāṃ ca śāradā || 8 ||
jāmalānāṃ gaṇapatirḍāmarāṇāṃ śatakratuḥ ||
nārāyaṇo bhāratasya tathā rāmāyaṇasya ca || 9 |||
vāsudevo bhaveddevaḥ saptānāṃ śṛṇu sattama ||
ādityo vāsudevaśca mādhavo rāmakeśavau || 2.1.7.10 ||
vanamālī mahādevaḥ saptānāṃ saptaparvasu ||
viṣṇudharmādikānāṃ ca śivo jñeyaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
atha cādipurāṇasya viriṃciḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 11 ||
śuddhaudanaṃ yavakṣīraṃ pāyasaṃ kṛśaraṃ tathā ||
kṛśarānnaṃ ca vā dadyātkramādbaligaṇaṃ viduḥ || 12 ||
śālibhaktaṃ sagodhūmaṃ tilākṣatavimiśritam ||
paṭheccāpi vidhānena sa yāgaḥ ṣaṇmayaḥ paraḥ ||14||
śītodakaṃ madhu kṣīraṃ sitekṣvośca raso guḍaḥ||
sagarbhaśca paro jñeyaḥ ṣaṇmayaścāparo baliḥ || 15 ||
śālitaṃḍulaprasthaṃ tu tadardhaṃ vā tadardhakam ||
kṣīreṇāpi ca saṃbhaktaṃ yavakṣīramidaṃ smṛtam || 16 ||
kṣīraṃ bhāgāṣṭakaṃ grāhyaṃ saptabhāgena saṃsthitam||
haimaṃtikaṃ sitākhyaṃ ca tāṃḍulaṃ prapaceccarum || 17 ||
aśītipalamānena siddhamāsādayettataḥ ||
bhāgārdhena dadetpaścānmākṣikaṃ vā sitāmapi || 18 ||
guḍamiśreṇa yo dadyātsaṃparko jāyate kvacit ||
saṃpṛktaṃ mākṣikeṇāpi dadyādikṣurasaṃ budhaḥ ||
gṛhītvā yācakaḥ śuddhaḥ śṛṇuta dvijasattamāḥ || 19 ||
śṛṇute vādhīyāno yo dadyāddhaste ca pustakam ||
samutthāya ca gṛhṇīyātpraṇamya vinivedayet || 2.1.7.20 ||
pūrvasthaḥ śrāvako vipro vikhyātastasyadakṣiṇe ||
paścimāśāmukhenaiva tarjanyāṃguṣṭhayā saha ||21||
prastareṇāpi hastena vinyāsaḥ paṃḍitaiḥ sadā ||
itonyathā na kartavyaḥ kṛtvā nyāsamathāpnuyāt ||22||
asakṛdvinyasedviprāḥ pāvamānīṃ jale japet ||
vedāṃtāgamavedāṃtavidhireṣa smṛto budhaiḥ ||23||
yamadiksaṃmukhe śrotā vācakaścottarāmukhaḥ ||
tasmādvidhividhānena śṛṇuyādatha vā paṭhet || 26 ||
śrutvā prati puṇyavidyāṃ yo.aśnīyānmāṃsameva tu ||
yadi devālaye tīrthe vācayecchṛṇuyādatha ||
durgāgre śivasūryasya vaiṣṇavākhyānameva ca ||
yaḥ karoti vimūḍhātmā gārdabhīṃ yonimāviśet || 31 ||
anujñayā tathā pitrorhareḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇam || 32 ||
na viṣṇurna ca brahmā ca na ca rudraḥ śacīpatiḥ ||
jīvanna tarpayenmukhyaṃ gaṃgāyāṃ maraṇepi ca ||
purāṇaśravaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ śūnyaṃ bhāgavataṃ yadi ||
vyarthaṃ bhāgavataṃ viprā nārasiṃhavihīnakam || || 36 ||
ādiparvaṇi hīne tu bhāratākhyaṃ na dhārayet ||
vināśvamedhikaṃ viprā vinā yajñānanaṃ vinā || 37 ||
bhārataṃ ca divārohadhāraṇādau varaṃ vrajet || 38 ||
vāyupurāṇamaśrutvā śāstraṃ ca yaugikaṃ vinā ||
vāyuhīnaṃ dehikulaṃ vṛthā tasya na dhārakam || 39 ||
tathā vāyupurāṇaṃ yadvihīnaṃ śravyamanyakam ||
yathā sundarakāṃḍena āraṇyaṃ ca na dhārayeta || 2.1.7.40 ||
laṃkāṃ vinā cādikāṃḍaṃ tallikhitvā na dhārayet ||
pārāśaraṃ vinā vyāsaṃ yājñavaktyaṃ vinā makham || 41 ||
dakṣaṃ vinā na śaṃkhaṃ ca śaṃkhahīnaṃ bṛhaspatim ||
vahnīyaṃ śravaṇādyena na ca yuktimathāpayet || 42 ||
saṃsthāpanādeva vinā na ca kimapi rākṣasaiḥ ||
na haretpustakaṃ cāpi na haredakṣarāṇi ṣaṭ ||
ādyākṣarasya haraṇāttāmrakuṣṭhī bhavediha ||
mukhavṛttasya haraṇādyāvadācaṃdratārakam|| ||45||
svākṣarasya haraṇe svamātṛharaṇe.api yat ||46||
yadbhārataṃ yatpurāṇaṃ stotrarūpāṇi tāni ca || 47 ||
tāni vedāgamādīni pustakeṣvapi vācayet ||
vedānāṃ pustakaṃ yatra likhitvā tanna vācayet || || 48 ||
pustakaṃ nigamānāṃ ca mantravyākhyānasaṃgraham || 49 ||
sphuṭaṃ kṛtvā puraḥ sthāpya yāvatkālaṃ pravartate ||
na vācayecca vyākhyātā vācako.api pravācayet ||
pauṣkare ca śloka pādamāśvamedhaṃ padepade || 51 ||
vedārthaṃ vācayedyasmādviparīto.apavācakaḥ ||
tāvubhau patitau jñeyau pāvamānīśataṃ japet|| 52 ||
ādimadhyāvasāne ca mantre ca praṇavaṃ diśet ||
patrāṇi bhagavānbrahmā ūrdhvadīrghāṇi yāni ca ||
janārdanaścākṣarāṇi mātrā prakṛtiravyayā || 55 ||
lipī bhaṃgī maheśaḥ syāttasyā mātrā sarasvatī ||
ekarekhā ca ekātmā pādācca pādavicyutiḥ || 56 ||
catuṣpādāṃtare yugmaṃ madhyamoṃ.ate yugaṃ yugam ||
bhārate cetihāse ca purāṇe dvijasattamāḥ ||
vaktṛnāmākṣarairyuktaṃ paṃktibhedena sattamāḥ ||
ātmasaṃśuddhisaṃśuddhyā dhārayeddharma saṃhitām ||
ripuḥ sūryastayārāmo yakṣo.anaṃtaḥ sarasvatī ||
brāhmī ca yakṣiṇī caiva gāyatrī navamī smṛtā || 61 ||
viṣṇvante ca bhavenmuktiḥ sūryāṃ.ate pādavicyutiḥ ||
anaṃte vipulā kīrtiḥ sarasvatyāṃ dhanāgamaḥ ||
brāhmyā brahmatvamāpnoti yakṣiṇyā yakṣamandiram || 63 ||
brahmendravaiṣṇavaṃ śaivaṃ śāktikaṃ ca maheśvarī ||
brahmarūpaṃ cetihāsamaiṃdraṃ rāmāyaṇātmakam||65||
vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ daivaṃ yacchaivaṃ tallalāṭakam ||
pāvako.asya tathā mūle madhye bhāge śatakratuḥ || 66 ||
agre sthitā grahāḥ sarve diśāmīśāstathā dvijāḥ ||
meruḥ sumeruruddiṣṭaḥ saṃgavānkāma ucyate || 67 ||
dvāvāpṛthivyau pātālaṃ tasyāṃtaḥ samudāhṛtam ||
na śasyaḥ pūjanīyaśca gṛhe sthāpyeta mānavaḥ ||
yo yasmai śūdro viprāya vṛttiṃ dadyācca mānavaḥ || 69 ||
sa yāti brahmasadanaṃ maṇivartmādikuṭṭimam ||
na śasyaḥ pūjanīyaśca gṛhe sthāpyeta mānavaḥ ||2.1.7.70||
madhyaṃ tasya haredāyuḥ pārśvavedhaḥ śivaṃ haret ||
aśakto bilvakāṣṭhasya tathā śrīparṇikasya ca ||
na kāṣṭhasya navaṃ śasyaṃ na lauhaṃ yojayetkvacit || 75 ||
prāgāraṃbhaślokaśataṃ dharmaśāstrasya vai likhet ||
saṃhitāyāṃ purāṇāyāṃ yugmakalpaṃ tadardhakam|| 76 ||
tathāpi cākhilavyāsa lekhanātsaṃtatikṣayaḥ || 77 ||
anāmātve hemayutāṃ balākaṃ cittameva ca ||
lekhane pārijātasya matsya māṃsāśinaṃ likhet || 2.1.7.80 ||
vālmīkisaṃhitāyāśca lekhane ca tathā kvacit ||
abrāhmaṇena likhitaṃ niṣphalaṃ parikīrtitam|| 82 ||
durvicāro duṣṭabhāryo durmatiścāpi lekhakaḥ ||
na likheddharmaśāstraṃ ca purāṇaṃ stotrasaṃhitam || 83 ||
vaṃgunyānmukhyāyutairvāpi pītayogairathāpi vā || 85 ||
kṛṣṇe vāyupradaṃ vidyātpīte vāyukṣayo bhavet ||
rakte puṣṭimavāpnoti kṛṣṇe ca saṃpadāgamaḥ ||86||
itihāsapurāṇānāṃ vilikhedyanmukhācchṛṇu ||
vāyavyādimukhenaiva kāṣṭhavedaṃ ca saṃlikhet || 87||
pūrvāmukhe cārthahāniruttare ca mukhe śriyaḥ ||
maraṇaṃ dakṣiṇāsye tu paścimāsye dhanakṣayaḥ ||88||
aśauce mṛtake sūtāvamāyāṃ ravisaṃkrame || 89 ||
aśoce.api daridraḥ syājjanmāhe cāyuṣaḥ kṣayaḥ ||
lipicchaṃdaḥ padajñaśca yuvā dhīmāñjitāsanaḥ ||92||
nāṃdīnāgarakairvarṇaiḥ śuddhanāgarakairapi || 94 ||
kāmarūpākṣarairvāpi yāvacca saṃhitāgaṇaḥ ||
yāvadakṣarasaṃsthānaṃ tāvatsvarge mahīyate ||
likhitvā yastu pāpātmā yāvadakṣara saṃkhyayā ||
tāvatkālaṃ tu narake pacyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 97 ||
kuṭuṃbabharaṇārthaṃ tu gṛhṇīyādvāpi vetanam ||
na jīvati sa duṣṭātmā dhanavastraphalānvitaḥ || 98 ||
patitairaṃtyajairmlecchai rogī kuṣṭhī kṣayī tathā ||
rogī śilīpadaiścaiva mūko.api dharmasaṃhataḥ || 99 ||
etairvilikhitaṃ yacca dhārayenna gṛhāśramī ||
hīnāṃgā pratimā caiva pustakaṃ mānahīnakam ||
sa vai nārāyaṇaḥ khyāto dhāraṇācca kuto.apyalam || 102 ||
śaṃkaraḥ sa tu vijñeyo dharmakāmaphalapradaḥ || 103 ||
aṣṭāṃgulaṃ bhavedyacca tatkaniṣṭhamihocyate ||
etyāḥ patrakṛte mānaṃ bhūrje mānaṃ na vidyate || 105 ||
dvādaśāṃgulakaṃ yacca bhūrjataiḍādinirmitam ||
praṇamya śirasā sarvānvyāsādīnsaṃhitāśrutān || 109 ||
jaiminiṃ ca tato vyāsaṃ śaṃkaraṃ ca tathā harim |||
namaskāramathaiṣāṃ tu ādimadhyāvasānake || 2.1.7.110 ||
asaṃyuktākṣarapadaṃ spaṣṭabhāgasamanvitam ||
sāmagāthāḥ samāśritya rāgayuktāṃtaraṃ paṭhet||
maṇivāro dhanaṃ yatsyādgaurāṃdhāṃ saṃtikastathā || 113 ||
śrīrāgaścaiva hillolarāgo vājāvikastathā ||
evaṃ prakramamāṇena śṛṇuyāddharmasaṃhitāḥ || 114 ||
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraścāpi viśeṣataḥ ||
aśvamedhamavāpnoti sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||
śūdrāṇāṃ purato vaiśyo vaiśyānāṃ kṣatriyaḥ paraḥ ||
kṣatriyāṃte tathā viprāḥ śṛṇuyuścāgrataḥ sadā || 116 ||
na śūdraḥ kathayeddharmāṃstapādhyāpane tathā ||
śūdreṇādhigataṃ nāsti viśeṣācchabdalakṣaṇam ||
śvaśṛgālakharīkṣīramapeyaṃ hi yathā bhavet ||
evaṃ śūdramukhāddharmā na grāhyāḥ śabdasaṃskṛtāḥ ||119||
amedhyaṃ śudhyate toyaiḥ śūdraḥ śrotā hi śudhyati ||
evaṃ śūdro.apyaśuciḥ syādyadi vyākaraṇārthavit ||2.1.7.120||
yaḥ śūdra uddiśeddharmaṃ tathā cāgamavaidikam ||
budhyamānaḥ sadā hyarthaṃ graṃthārthaṃ kṛtsnameva ca ||
te dhanyāste kṛtātmānaste kṛtārthā na saṃśayaḥ ||
yathārkahīnaṃ divasaścaṃdrahīnā yathā niśā ||
na rarāja sabhā tadvadvyāsena rahitā dvijāḥ||124||
yadgṛhe naiva śiśavo na rarāja gṛhaṃ kvacit ||
tathaiva sodara gehe dṛṣṭvā puṣkaradarśanam || 125 ||
aṅkamāhātmyavarṇanam
śṛṇudhvaṃ viprasaṃghātāḥ purāṇaṃ devasaṃmatam||
tṛtīyaṃ śaivamākhyātaṃ tato bhāgavataṃ param||
paṃcamaṃ ca tathā mātsyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ṣaṣṭhamucyate ||2||
asāmarthye ca mātsyoktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca bhaviṣyakam ||
bhārate cāpi parvaṃ ca śāṃtibhaiṣmīyakaṃ tathā || 3 ||
parāśaramataṃ gṛhyaṃ gobhiloktāni yāni ca ||
aṃtareṇāgate martye śāstraṃ nādhyāpayetkvacit ||
maṃḍūke paṃcarātraṃ tu sarpe rātricatuṣṭayam ||
māsamekaṃ khare kāke sthānatyāgānna kutracit ||
adhyātmādhyāpayedebhyaḥ śaṭhaṃ pāpaharaṃ dviṣam ||
nirarthakaṃ maṃtharaṃ ca viśuśrūṣumayājakam ||
ṣaṇḍaṃ caivānṛjuṃ kruddhaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ vyasanārthinam|| 11 ||
niṃdakaṃ cāvidhijñaṃ ca dūrataḥ parivarjayet ||
ato vidyā vadatyevaṃ pāṭhayaṃtaṃ dvijottamam ||13||
mā dadyādbhaktihīnāya durjanāya durātmane ||
apramādāya viprāya śucaye brahmacāriṇe || || 14||
anyāyena grahaṃ vidyāmanyaṃ pāṭhayate sukhāt || 16 ||
ādhyātmikaṃ vaidikaṃ cālaukikaṃ vātha yo vadet||17||
mānamādau praṇamyātha tato.adhīyīta suvrataḥ ||
cūtabhogasamabhyāsāddaridraścābhijāyate ||
vādabhāgasamabhyāsāddhananāśāya jāyate ||19||
yānyanuktāni śāstrāṇi mānanīyāni yāni ca ||2.1.8.20||
lokānāṃ jñānavṛddhyarthaṃ yaḥ kuryāddharmasaṃgraham || 21 ||
jñānadātā ca lokānāṃ teṣu dharmaḥ pravartate||22||
nigamānāṃ jyotiṣāṇāṃ vedānāṃ nāṭakasya ca ||
vyākhyānasaṃgrahaṃ kṛtvā kalau nāśamavāpnuyāt ||23||
vedānāṃ dharbhaśāstrāṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ tathaiva ca ||
mīmāṃsājyotiṣāṃ caiva nāṭakānāṃ viraṃcinī||24||
bhāgāvasāne kathitaḥ purāṇādhyāya eva ca ||
puṣpakaśca paricchedaḥ khaṃḍaśca pratikhaṃḍakaḥ ||25||
vyavahāraścārthaśāstramaśvaśāstrasya caiva hi ||
mohātkṛtvā homadhenuṃ dattvā śuddhirbhaviṣyati ||
kṛtvā cākhyāyikāgraṃthasvarūpānsa divaṃ vrajet || 29 |||
prātaḥkāle na kurvīt tathā madhyaṃdine dvijāḥ ||
pakṣāṃte bhūbhidāhe ca bhuvaḥ kaṃpe dinakṣaye || 32 ||
pūtaṃ syāttatkṣaṇādviprāścatuḥ paṃcākṣareṇa vā||
nārasiṃhasya vinyāse pūto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 34 ||
muhūrtārdhena pūtatvaṃ prabhoryāṃti parāṃ gatim || 35 ||
striyo vā niṃdito vāpi mleccho yāti parāṃ gatim ||
yo mūḍho manyate doṣaṃ tasya śaucaṃ samācaret ||
sa gardabhīṃ kharīṃ yoniṃ praviśennātra saṃśayaḥ|| || 36 ||
navātmako bhairavaśca daśamaśca janārdanaḥ || 37 ||
rudra ekādaśaścaiva arkārkaścāpi dvādaśaḥ ||
trayoviṃśe ca bhūtātmā ṣaḍviṃśe manurīritaḥ || 38 ||
tithyātmakaṃ paṃcadaśe ṣoḍaśākhyā kalāparā ||
aṣṭādaśākṣaro maṃtraḥ purāṇātmaka eva ca ||
ūnaviṃśaścaṃdramāḥ syādviṃśo nārāyaṇo vapuḥ ||2.1.8.40||
jyotirmayaścaikaviṃśo dvāviṃśe keśavārcanam ||
nakṣatrāṇi trayoviṃśe caturviṃśe ca tānakam || 41 ||
paṃcaviṃśe ca tīrthāni ṣaḍviṃśe ca triyaṃbakaḥ ||
aṣṭāviṃśe dhaneśaśca ūnatriṃśe sarasvatī || 42 ||
triṃśadyoge śivaḥ proktaḥ pātālamekatriṃśake ||
ahorātraśca dvātriṃśe catustriṃśe ca jāhnavī || 43 ||
paṃcatriṃśe tadaṃtaḥ syācchate pūrṇe divākaraḥ ||
lakṣe brahmā tathā koṭyāṃ devo nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ ||
puṃprakṛtyātmakaṃ cānyacchāradālipimātṛkā ||45||
śuddhabrahmamayaṃ nityaṃ jñānarūpaṃ paraṃ mahat ||
kṣaṇe brahmamayaṃ yāti ityāha bhagavānmanuḥ || 46 ||
pūrtanirṇayavarṇanam
aṃtarvediṃ pravakṣyāmi brahmaṇoktaṃ yugāṃtare ||
devatāsthāpanaṃ pūjā bahiveṃdirudāhṛtā || 2 ||
prapāpūrtādikaṃ caiva brāhmaṇānāṃ ca toṣaṇam ||
dharmasya kāraṇaṃ rājā dharmametadbhavennṛpaḥ ||
tasmānnṛpaṃ samāśritya bahirvedī tato bhavet || 5 ||
saptāśītirbahirvedī sārameṣāṃ tṛtīyakam ||
devatāsthāpanaṃ caiva prāsādakaraṇaṃ tathā || 6 ||

paṃcamaṃ pitṛpūjā ca gurupūjāpuraḥsarā || 7 ||
adhivāsaḥ pratiṣṭhā ca devatānāmavikriyā ||

pratyahaṃ pūjayettatra jāpakāstatra ṣoḍaśa ||
catvāro yājakāstatra trayoviṃśatidevatāḥ ||

gaṇeśagrahadikpālānvaruṇaṃ ca śivaṃ tathā || 14 ||
saṃpūjya pūjyate yatra kaniṣṭho.asau vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||

nalinīdīrghikāgartavāpīmalaprapādikam ||

gaṇeśagrahadikpālānpūjayedupacārataḥ || 17 ||
vāpyādeḥ puṣkariṇyāśca kṣipedgaṃgājalaṃ tataḥ ||
ulūkhaladvayenāpi jīrṇānāṃ tu kadācana || 18 ||
setuprāsādavāpīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ naiva kārayet ||
prāsādaḥ setavaścaiva taḍāgādyāstathaiva ca || 19 ||
tribhirvarṇaiḥ pratiṣṭhārhā jīrṇānāṃ tu samudgatāḥ ||
munayo mānamicchaṃti amānaṃ na hi dṛśyate || 2.1.9.20 ||
tasmānmānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yanmānaṃ yādṛśaṃ phalam ||
ṣaṣṭihastapramāṇena taduktaṃ vāraṇoditam || 21 ||
ekaṣaṣṭihastamitaṃ prāsādaṃ cottamaṃ viduḥ ||
madhyaṃ tadardhaṃ vijñeyaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ tatparaṃ smṛtam || 22 ||
yastaḍāgaṃ navaṃ kṛtvā jīrṇaṃ vā navatāṃ nayet || || 23 ||
vāpīkūpataḍāgāśca udyānapravahāstathā || 24 ||
guṇānāṃ ca pramāṇena pratimānaṃ vibhāgataḥ || 25 ||
dviśatena śatenāpi prāsādasyaiṣa niścayaḥ ||
sahasrahastavistāraṃ dairghyeṇāṣṭādhikaṃ bhavet || 26 ||

madhyaṃ catuḥśatenāpi prastāve daśahīnakam || 27 ||
kaniṣṭhaṃ triśataṃ caiva prasthe syādviṃśahīnakam ||
taḍāgamānaṃ vijñeyaṃ trivargaphaladāyakam ||
atha puṣkariṇīpakṣe dve śate mānamuttamam || 29 ||
taḍāge dviguṇā nemī mānārdhe gartamīritam ||

caturthaṃ caiva gāṃdharvaṃ paiśācaṃ paṃcamaṃ viduḥ ||
yakṣasthānamitā bhāge evaṃ sarvakramāṇi hi || 31 ||
pañcahīnaṃ ca prastāve evaṃ mānavido viduḥ || 32 ||
ṣaṣṭihastena nalinī prastāve turyahīnakam ||
catuḥṣaṣṭihastamitā dīrghikā ca prakīrtitā || 33 ||

viprādīnāṃ devatānāṃ samāje merusthāne yatra tatraiva kuryāt ||

yadā tu dīrghāsarasītaḍāgaprāsādakūpādiṣu nirmitāni ||
yadapratiṣṭheṣu nipānakeṣu prāsādakūpeṣu vanādikeṣu ||

prasāde mṛnmayaṃ puṇyaṃ mayaitatkathitaṃ dvijāḥ ||
tasmāccaturguṇaṃ proktaṃ tṛṇakāṣṭhamaye tathā || 41 ||

tataśca śatasāhasraṃ sauvarṇe dvijasattamāḥ ||
yadatītaṃ bhaviṣyacca kulānāmayutaṃ naraḥ ||

sarvottamaṃ ca dvātriṃśaccatuṣkoṇe mahāphalam || 48 ||

suraveśmani yāvaṃto dvijendrāḥ paramāṇavaḥ ||
karturdaśaguṇaṃ proktamāpānaparipālakaḥ ||
patitaṃ patamānaṃ ca tathārddhasphuṭitaṃ tathā ||
yaḥ kuryādviṣṇuprāsādaṃ jyotirliṃgasya vā kvacit ||
sūryasyāpi viriṃceśca durgāyāḥ śrīdharasya ca || 54 ||
svargādbhraṣṭo bhavedrājā dhanī pūjyatamopi vā || 55 ||

prāvṛṭkāle sthitaṃ toyamagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ||
śaratkālasthitaṃ toyaṃ yajñatoyādviśiṣyate || 57 ||
nidāghakāle pānīyaṃ yasya tiṣṭhati vāpinaḥ ||
ekāhaṃ tu sthitaṃ toyaṃ pṛthivyāṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
pūrvaṃ pitṛkule sapta tadvanmātṛkule dvijāḥ ||
caturdaśamidaṃ jñeyaṃ śatalekhaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu || 2.1.9.60 ||
piturūrdhvaṃ kulaṃ viṃśaṃ māturūrdhva kulaṃ tathā ||
tadvatparaṃ vijānīyādbhāryāyāḥ paṃca eva ca || 61 ||
paṃca vai mātṛtaścāsya piturmātāmahe kule ||
paṃca paṃca vijānīyānmāturmātāmahasya ca || 62 ||
guroḥ pitṛkule paṃca tasya mātṛkule tathā ||
ācāryasya kule dvaṃdvaṃ daśarājakulasya ca || 63 ||
rājño mātāmahakule paṃca caiva prakīrtitāḥ ||
ātmanā saha vipreṃdrā uddhāraḥ saṃmataḥ smṛtaḥ ||
kuryāddevārcanaṃ tīrthe svavimukte daśārṇave ||65||
samuddharetkulaśataṃ śṛṇu viṃśakulaṃ dvija ||
māturmātāmahasyaiva jātiṃ dvaṃdvamudāhṛtam||
guroḥ saṃtānake dvaṃdvaṃ tadvadyādavasāttvatau ||67||
parapakṣasya caikaṃ syādekaviṃśaṃ kulaṃ kramāt||
pānīyena vinā vṛttirloke nāstīti karhicit||
vārasvasthaṃ puṣpakhaṃḍaṃ toye patati yāvati ||69||
caṃdraraśmivihīnaṃ yannāmṛtatvāya kalpate ||71||
tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ kuṃḍe tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ hrade||
devānāṃ sthāpanaṃ kuryādavimuktaphalaṃ śubham ||72||
susthitaṃ duḥsthitaṃ vāpi śivaliṃgaṃ na cālayet ||
punaḥ saṃsāradharmeṇa sthāpayedavicārayan||74||
bāhudaṃtādipratimā viṣṇoścānyasya sattamāḥ||
na cālayetsthāpite ca vipravṛkṣaṃ na cālayet ||4||
keśavaṃ harivṛkṣaṃ ca madhūkaṃ kiṃśukaṃ tathā||
nākāle sthāpayejjātu cālanādbrahmahā bhaveta||76||
devālayasya purataḥ kuryātpuṣkariṇī dvijāḥ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ samāje ca rājadvāre catuṣpathe||77||
devātheṃ brāhmaṇārthe ca mukhaṃ kuryācca sarvataḥ ||

tṛpye hastaṃ nalinyādāvato hīnaṃ na kārayet ||
gartatṛṇaṃ kalāhastaṃ taḍāge.atra pracakṣyate || 81 ||

pūrtanirṇayavarṇanam
śodhayetprathamaṃ bhūmiṃ mitāṃ kṛtvā tato dvijāḥ ||

somaṃ ca nāgarājānaṃ tato bījaṃ suśodhayet ||
ānayeddhārayetpaścādraudratāpena tāpayet|| ||24||

ityagṛhītamanunā pañcadhā parimaṃtritam ||

kurvaṃti sahakārādiropaṇaṃ ye narādhamāḥ ||

patrapuṣpaphalānāṃ ca rajoreṇusamāgamāḥ ||
yastu vṛkṣaṃ prakurute chāyāpuṣpaphalopagam ||
pathi devālaye cāpi pāpāttārayate pitṛrn||
atītānāgatāścātaḥ pitṛrnsa svargato dvijāḥ||
tārayedvṛkṣaropī ca tasmādvṛkṣaṃ praropayeta ||36||
dhanī cāśvatthavṛkṣe ca aśokaḥ śokanāśanaḥ ||39||
plakṣo bhāryāpradaścaiva bilva āyuṣyadaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
dhanaprado jaṃbu vṛkṣo brahmadaḥ plakṣavṛkṣakaḥ || 2.1.10.40 ||
tiṃdukātkulavṛddhiḥ syāddāḍimī kāminīpradaḥ ||
svargapradā dhātakī syādvaṭo mokṣapradāyakaḥ ||
sahakāraḥ kāmaprado guvākaḥ siddhimādiśet || 42 ||
kadaṃbe vipulā kīrtistiṃtiḍī dharmadūṣikaḥ || 43 ||
jīvaṃtyā rogaśāṃtiḥ syātkeśaraḥ śatrumardanaḥ ||
dhanapradaścaiva vaṭo vaṭaḥ śvetavaṭastathā || 44 ||
panase maṃdabuddhiḥ syātkali vṛkṣaḥ śriyaṃ haret ||
kalivṛkṣaṃ ca śākhoṭa udarāvartakaṃ tathā || 45 ||
tathā ca markaṭīnīparopaṇātsaṃtatikṣayaḥ ||
śiṃśapāṃ cārjunaṃ caiva jayaṃtī haya mārakān ||
śrīvṛkṣaṃ kiṃśukaṃ caiva ropaṇātsvargamādiśet || 46 ||
na pūrvāṃ ropayejjātu samidhaṃ kaṃṭakīdrumam ||
kuśaṃ padmaṃ jalajānāṃ ropaṇāddurgatiṃ vrajet || 45 ||
maṃdāre kulahāniḥ syācchālmale śukabuddhimān ||
niṃbe paśuvināśaḥ syācchatrāke kulapāṃsalaḥ || 48 ||
śatruvṛddhiḥ kākanāde balapūge hataśriyaḥ || 49 ||
sahakārasahasrāttu variṣṭhaṃ dhātakīdvayam ||
tasmāccaiva sahasrāddhi pāṭalaikā viśiṣyate || 51 ||
pāṭalānāṃ śatātpaścādekaraktavaṭo bhavet ||
vaṭānāṃ dvisahasrācca paṃcakaṃ nāgakeśaram || 52 ||
tasmādvariṣṭhaḥ śrīvṛkṣo jaṃbūvṛkṣaḥ praśasyate ||
tasmāddhimavato jñeyaḥ śrīparṇīvṛkṣa uttamaḥ || 53 ||
tiṃdukasya trayaścaiva jaṃbūvṛkṣasya paṃcakam ||
evamuktvā sa dharmātmā kārayetkīdṛśaṃ balam || 54 ||
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca ||
janmatrayādikaṃ pāpaṃ vināśya svargamādiśet ||
śataropī ca brahmatvaṃ viṣṇutvaṃ ca sahasrake || 56 ||
vaiśākhe kīrtimāpnoti jyeṣṭhe tu maraṇaṃ vrajet || 57 ||
āṣāḍhe kīrtimāpnoti śrāvaṇe paramāṃ gatim ||
bhādre dhanāgamaścaiva āśvine kārtike kṣayaḥ ||
tulasī trividhā loke kṛte śvetā praśasyate || 58 ||
śrīvṛkṣasya ca vipreṃdrāḥ sa bhavedbrahmaghātakaḥ || 59 ||
vṛkṣacchedī bhavenmūka ādhivyādhiśataṃ bhajet ||
sāyaṃ prātaśca gharmāṃte śītakāle dināṃtare || 2.1.10.60 ||
phalamāmakulatthaśca māṣo mudgāstilā yavāḥ ||
avikākasakṛccūrṇaṃ yavacūrṇāni yāni ca ||
gomāṃsamudakaṃ caiva saptarātraṃ nidhāpayet || 62 ||
tamekaṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ phalapuṣpādivṛddhidam ||
tenodakādisekaśca kṛto vai vṛddhimādiśet ||
tittiḍībījamādāya ikṣudaṃḍena mardayet ||64||
tenāśoke prasekaḥ syātsahakārasya vṛddhimān ||
dohadaṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ pūgādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
daśaśirābījayutādabhiṣekācca jīvati || 66 ||
prākprasūtirgavādīnāṃ chāgādimahiṣasya ca ||
jarāsu toyaṃ vṛkṣāgre sthāpayedavicārayan || 67 ||
parasya sahakārasya phalaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||
meṣasya ca vitālasya yavāgūṃ ca samāharet || 68 ||
mṛto.api jīvayecchīghraṃ mriyamāṇo.api jīvati ||
niṃbapatraṃ yogapatraṃ śatāvaripunarnavām || 2.1.10.70 ||
kṣīrikātāmrakaiḥ patrairdhūmaṃ dadyāddinatrayam ||
tataḥ prādhānyato vakṣye drumāṇāṃ dohado.anyathā ||
matsyodakena siktena āmrāṇāṃ vṛddhiriṣyate || 72 ||
pakvāmraṃ rudhiraṃ caiva dāḍimānāṃ praśasyate ||
yavodakaṃ sagomāṃsaṃ ketakīnāṃ praśasyate || 73 ||
kṣīrake balavṛddhiḥ syāttiṃdukaḥ karamardakaḥ ||
māṃsapūti rasāmajjā śokatāle guvākake || 74 ||
sapūtimāṃsaṃ saghṛtaṃ nālikerasya rohitam ||
madhuyaṣṭyudakaiḥ sekātsāmānyaṃ nihitaṃ bhavet || 75 ||
jātīnāṃ mallikānāṃ ca kuṃdānāṃ raṃtikasya ca || 76 ||
kūrmamāṃsamannarasaṃ viḍaṃgasya ca puṣpakam || 77 ||
rathyāvṛkṣe pratiṣṭhāpya phalavāñjāyate tataḥ ||
dadyāddhūpaṃ dhānyamadhye dhānyavṛddhiśca jāyate ||
mayūrapatramādāyacchāgaromāṇi sapta vai || 79 ||
eraṃḍatailayogena dadyāddhūpaṃ niśāgame ||
hiṃgukusumasaṃyogānmūṣikāṇāṃ parinyaset || 2.1.10.80 ||
kariviṣṭhāmṛcchaviṣṭhāṃ kṛttikāyāṃ samāharet ||
niśātoye prasekaḥ syāttatkṣātramūlakaṃ haret || 81 ||
aśvatthamūle daśahastamātraṃ kṣetraṃ pavitraṃ puruṣottamasya ||
bāhuviṃśāṃtare ropetsahakāraṃ sa dharmavit ||
kalāhastāṃtaraṃ dhātrī bakulaṃ vaṃjulaṃ tathā || 83 ||
śraiparṇikaṃ ca punnāgaṃ śrīvṛkṣaṃ dviguṇaṃ tarau ||
vāpyādīnāṃ tu kūpānāmekavṛkṣādikasya ca || 85 ||
śrīviṣṇorvṛkṣapakṣe ca varuṇeṣṭaṃ ca kūpake ||
gaṇeśaṃ pūjayetkumbhaṃ dikpālāṃśca viśeṣataḥ || 86 ||
agnikāryaṃ vinā kuryātprakuryācca satāṃ gatim ||
śrutvā kṛtiṃ vidhānena anyeṣāṃ vā tathodbhavam || 87 ||
anyeṣāṃ caiva vṛkṣe ca tathā ca tulasīvane ||
vṛkṣānvānena saṃskṛtya vāsobhirabhiveṣṭayet ||
śucyamānamidaṃ jñeyamanyeṣāṃ vā tathodbhavam || 89 ||
tantrātmakapratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
atha taṃtravidhiṃ vakṣye purāṇeṣvapi gīyate ||
śatavṛkṣakṣudravṛkṣe daśadvādaśa vṛkṣake ||
dṛṣṭimātrāṃtare setau kūpayāge samutsṛjet ||2||
na kūpamutsṛjejjātu vṛkṣayāge kathaṃcana ||
tulasīvanayāge tu na cānyaṃ yāgamācaret || 3 |||
taḍāgayāge setvādīnna cārāme kadācana ||
na setuṃ devayāge tu taḍāgaṃ na samutsṛjet ||4||
taṃtre śrāddhaṃ pṛthaṅnāsti karturbhede pṛthagbhavet ||
śivaliṃgasthāpanāyāṃ na cānyaddevasthāpanam ||5||
viparīte kṛte cāpi āyuḥkṣaya iti smṛtiḥ ||6||
taḍāge puṣkariṇyā vā ārāme.api dvijottamāḥ ||
mānahīne mānapūrṇe daśahaste na dūṣaṇam||7||
dvisahasrādhikaṃ yatra tatpratiṣṭhāṃ samācaret||
daśa dvādaśavṛkṣe ca ārāme pūrvavaddvijāḥ ||8||
pratiṣṭhāṃ bilvavṛkṣe ca anyathā karṇavedhanam ||
anaṃtaraṃ pradātavyā lājā mūrdhnyakṣatādikam || 2.1.11.10 || ||
pratimālakṣaṇavarṇanam
pratimālakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye yathāśāstramataṃ dvijāḥ ||
pratimāṃ lakṣaṇairhīnāṃ gṛhītāṃ naiva pūjayet || 1 ||
śailajā dārujā tāmrī mṛdbhavā sarvakāmadā ||
ekahastā dvihastā vā sārdhahastā tathāpi vā || 2 ||
prāsādamānamathavā athavā sarvalakṣaṇam ||
aṣṭāṃgulotsedhakaṃ ca na gehe.arcayetkṛtī || 3 ||
devāgārasya yaddvāraṃ tasmādaṣṭāṃgulena tu ||
tribhāgapiṃḍikā kāryā dvau bhāgau pratimā bhavet || 4 ||
aṃgulaṃ vai bhavedvṛddhiraśītiścaturuttarā||
vistāramānataḥ kāryaṃ vadanaṃ dvādaśāṃgulam || 5 ||
mukhatribhāge cibukaṃ lalāṭaṃ nāsikāṃ tathā ||
karṇau nāsikayā grīvātulyau vā niyatau tu yau || 6 ||
nayane dvyaṃgule syātāṃ tribhāgā tārakā bhavet ||
tṛtīyatārakābhāge śubhadṛṣṭiṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 7 ||
pariṇāhastu śiraso bhaveddvātriṃśadaṃgulaḥ || 8 ||
tulyau nāsikayā grīvā mukhena hṛdayāṃtaram ||
bāhū ca bāhutulyau ca ūrū jaṃghe ca jāghanam ||
gulphāvasthnastu pādaḥ syāddhāṭitaścaturaṃgulaḥ ||
ṣaḍaṃgulastu vistārastulyāṃguṣṭhoṃ.agulatrayam || 2.1.12.10 ||
pradeśinī ca tattulyā hīnā śeṣānnakhānakham ||
caturdaśāṃgulaḥ pādasyāyāmaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 11 ||
evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktā sā pūjyā pratimā śubhā ||
adharoṣṭhastathaivorubhrūlalāṭamanīṣikam || 12 ||
gaṃḍaṃ ca niyataṃ mūrtau kuryādaṃgasamunnateḥ ||
vatsaprokto.atimukuṭaḥ kaṭakāṃgadahāravān || 14 ||
suprabhāmaṃḍalā cāru vicitramaṇikuṇḍalā || 15 ||
karābhyāṃ kāṃcanīṃ mālāṃ prodvahaṃtīṃ śiroruhān||
evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ kārayedvihitapradām || 16 ||
susnigdhāṃ varadāṃ saumyāṃ dvitīyāśramiṇāmimām ||
navatālo bhavedviṣṇurvāsudevastritālakaḥ || 17 ||
nṛsiṃhaḥ pañcatālaḥ syāddhayagrīvastu paṃcamaḥ ||
nārāyaṇaścāṣṭatālo maheśaḥ pañcatālakaḥ || 18 ||
navatālā bhaveddurgā lakṣmīścaiva tritālikā ||
vāṇīṃ tritālikāṃ vidyātsavitā saptatālakaḥ || 19 ||
dakṣiṇe vāsudevasya kare cakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||
pārśve nalinasiṃhau dvau subhadrāṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset ||
rukmiṇī vāmabhāge ca tadadhastāddivīṃdrakam || 22 ||
kṛtāṃjalipuṭasthaśca nāradaḥ kapilastathā ||
yadugraṃ vāsudevasya tathā nārāyaṇasya ca ||
vaiparītyaṃ vijānīyānmādhavānāṃ tathaiva ca || 24 ||
tīrthe girau taḍāge ca samīpe sthāpayetsudhīḥ ||
nagaragrāmamadhye vā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca saṃsadi || 25 ||
avimukte viśeṣaṇa siddhakṣetre daśārṇake ||
trīṇyuttarasahasrāṇi paṃcapaṃcottarāṇi ṣaṭ || 26 ||
kulāni pūrvaṃ vipreṃdrāḥ samuddharati nānyathā ||
kalau dārumayaḥ kāryo hyaśakto mṛnmayotha vā || 27 ||
caṃdanāgurubhiḥ kuryādbilvaśrīparṇikasya ca ||
kuṇḍanirmāṇavidhivarṇanam
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kuṃḍānāmatha nirṇayam ||
tasyoddhāraṃ ca saṃskāraṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 1 ||
caturasraṃ ca vṛttaṃ ca pādārdhaṃ cārdhacaṃdrakam ||
yonyākāraṃ caṃdrakaṃ ca aṣṭārdhamatha paṃcamam || 2 ||
saptārdhaṃ ca navārdhaṃ ca kuṃḍaṃ daśakamīritam ||
bhūmiṃ saṃśodhya vidhivattuṣakeśādivarjitām || 3 ||
bhrāmayeccordhvatastasyā bhasmāṃgārāṇi yatnataḥ ||
aṃkurārpaṇakaṃ kuryātsaptāhādeva buddhimān || 4 ||
aṣṭādaśāṃgake kṣetre nyasedekaṃ bahistataḥ || 6 ||
māpayettena mānena trivṛttaṃ kuṃḍamujjvalam ||
vṛttāni kālikādīni bahistrīṇi vivarjayet ||
saṃparipātayetsūtraṃ pāṭayettatpramāṇataḥ || 9 ||
paṃcadhā bhedite kṣetre kāmaṃ vā vibhajetsudhīḥ ||
nyasetpurastādevāṃgaṃ koṇārdhārdhapramāṇataḥ || 2.1.13.10 ||
yonisthānaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya aśvatthasya dalākṛtiḥ ||
sūtradvayaṃ tato dadyātkuṃḍaṃ parimitaṃ bhavet || 11 ||
diśaṃ prati yathānyāyaṃ pātayecca dvijottamāḥ || 12 ||
śṛṃgāṭakaṃ yugmapuṭaṃ ṣaḍasraṃ kuṃḍatrayaṃ budhāḥ ||
jalāśayārāmakūpe nitye gṛhamaye yathā || 13 ||
catusraṃ bhavetkuṃḍaṃ dvijasaṃskārakarmaṇi ||
devapratiṣṭhāyāge ca gṛhavāstau caturthakam || 14 ||
some.aṣṭau paṃkajaṃ proktaṃ naramedhāśvamedhayoḥ || || 15 ||
aṃkurārpaṇayāge ca vaiṣṇave yāgakarmaṇi ||
śivadevyośca janmādāvaṣṭamyāṃ cārdhacaṃdrakam || 16 ||
mārjārapauṣṭike vairaṃ ramye ca śāṃtike tathā ||
śāṃtipratiṣṭhāyāge tu śāktānāṃ kāmyakarmaṇi || 17 ||
puraścaraṇakāmyeṣu jvarādīnāṃ vimokṣaṇe ||
evaṃvidheṣu kāryeṣu yonikuṃḍaṃ praśasyate || || 18 ||
devatātīrthayātrādau mahāyuddhapraveśane ||
saure śāṃte pauṣṭike ca ṣaṭpuraṃ kuṃḍamuttamam|| 19||
māraṇoccāṭane caiva tathā rogopaśāṃtaye ||
vaiṣṇavānāṃ koṭihome nṛpāṇāmatiśocane || 2.1.13.20 ||
aṣṭāsramabjakuṃḍaṃ ca saptāsraṃ nidhisādhane ||
rājñā sādhye ca paṃcāsraṃ kanyāprāptau trirasrakam ||21||
kuṃḍānurūpataḥ kāryā mekhalā sarvato budhaiḥ || 22 ||
ayutādiṣu homeṣu mekhalāṃ yojayetsudhīḥ ||
nimna pramāṇe cātrāpi mūle sārdhāṃgulaṃ tyajet || 23 ||
muṣṭihaste samutsedho sārdhāṃgulapariṣkṛtaḥ || 24 ||
aratnimātre kuṃḍe tu triścaikāṃgulataḥ kramāt ||
ekahastamite kuṃḍe vedāgninayanāṃgulāḥ || 25 ||
paṃcamekhalakaṃ vātha lakṣakoṭyāṃ ca yojayet || 26 ||
ekāṃgulādimānena nemiṃ saṃvardhayetsudhīḥ ||
caturhastamite kuṃḍe tāvadeva guṇāṃgulāḥ || 27 ||
sārdhāṃgulādimānena nemiṃ saṃvardhayetsudhīḥ || 29 ||
kuṃḍasya rūpaṃ jānīyātparamaṃ prakṛtervapuḥ ||
ṣaṭacaturdhā guṇāyāmavistāronnatiśālinī ||
ekāṃgulaṃ tu yonyagraṃ kuryādīṣadadhomukham || 32 ||
ekaikāṃgulato yoniṃ kuṃḍaśūnyeṣu vardhayet ||
samamadhye mekhalāyāḥ saparyā yā sulakṣaṇā || 33 ||
sthāpayetkuṃḍakoṇeṣu yoniṃ tāṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
kuṃḍānāṃ kalpayennābhiṃ sphuṭamaṃbujasannibhām || 34 ||
tattu kuṃḍānurūpaṃ vā suvyaktaṃ sumanoharam ||
yonikuṃḍe yonimabjaṃ kuṃḍe nābhiṃ ca varjayet || 35 ||
yāvaddvayapramāṇena ardhāṃgulakramādbahiḥ ||
nābhiṃ pravardhayedekaṃ kuṃḍānāṃ rūpato yathā || 36 ||
tatra tatra bhavetkuṃḍaṃ biṃbaśūnyaṃ na homayet ||
śivaśaktisamāyogātkāma utpadyate yataḥ || 37 ||
avaṭopi umādevī biṃbaḥ khyātaḥ sadāśivaḥ ||

arkahastāṃtare kuryācchatordhvāṃte śatena vā || 41 ||
yajñamānavidhānavarṇanam
amānena hato yajñastasmānmānaṃ na hāpayet || 1 ||
śatārdhaṃ prathamaṃ mānaṃ śatasāhasrameva ca ||
ayutaṃ ca tathā lakṣaṃ koṭihomamataḥ param ||2||
ataḥ paraṃ tu vibhave rājā vānyo ddhijottamāḥ ||
vipākaṃ karmaṇāṃ sarvaṃ naraḥ prāpnoti sarvadā ||
śubhāśubhaṃ tato nityaṃ prāpnoti manujaḥ kila || 4 ||
yuktāścāpi grahāstatra nityaṃ śāṃtikapauṣṭike ||
adbhute ca tathā śāṃtiṃ kuryādbhaktisamanvitaḥ ||
tasmādgrahābhijanitaṃ śubhāśubhaphalaṃ khalu || || 6 ||
homaṃ yathābhirucitaṃ pauṣṭike kāmyakarmaṇi || 7 ||
lakṣahomaṃ koṭihomaṃ rājā kuryādyathāvidhi ||
anyaḥ śatādikaṃ kuryādayutaṃ vibhave sati || 8 ||
grahāṇāṃ lakṣahomastu koṭihomastathā kalau ||
nidhihomaṃ cābhicāraṃ tanna kuryādgṛhāśramī || 9 ||
mānaṃ naiva ca kartavyaṃ mānādau cāṣṭakaṃ nyaset || 2.1.14.10 ||
lakṣe saptatālasaṃkhyā koṭihome ca viṃśatiḥ || 11 ||
āraṃbhastrisahasraḥ syāddvitīye.aṣṭasahasrakaḥ || 12 ||
tṛtīye tu sahasraṃ syādgrahasādhyaḥ smṛto vidhiḥ ||
pañcāhe ca samāraṃbhe sahasraṃ juhuyādbudhaḥ || 13 ||
guṇasāhasrakaṃ turye pañcāhe śeṣamīritam || 14 ||
paṃcame ca tathā ṣaṣṭhe kule bhāgadvayādhikam || 15 ||
na nyūnaṃ nādhikaṃ kāryametanmānamudāhṛtam || 16 ||
sa samāje japennityaṃ pañcatāreṇa sviṣṭakṛt || 17 ||
tryahasādhye trirātre ca pūrṇaṃ kṛtvā visarjayet || 19 ||
pañcāhe tu tṛtīye.ahni balidānaṃ praśasyate ||
saptāhe cāṣṭadivase navāhe paṃcame.ahani || 2.1.14.20 ||
pañcāhe dvādaśāhe tu dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśe.ahani ||
kuṇḍasaṃskāravarṇanam
kuṇḍānāmatha saṃskāre vakṣye śāstramataṃ yathā ||
asaṃskṛte cārthahānistasmātsaṃskṛtya homayet || 1 ||
aṣṭādaśa syuḥ saṃskārāḥ kuṇḍānāṃ tatra darśitāḥ||
tāreṇāvekṣayetsthānaṃ kuśatoyaiḥ prasecayet ||2||
trisūtrīkaraṇaṃ paścādvṛttasūtraṃ nipātayet||
vāreṇa kīlakaṃ dadyānnārasiṃhena kuḍmalam ||3||
jihvāṃ prakalpayetpaścāttasmādagniṃ samāharet ||
nadīparvataśālābhyaḥ strīhastātparivarjayet ||
saṃskṛtya parigṛhṇīyāttridhā kṛtvā samuddharet || 5 ||

parasvodārabuddhīnāṃ sā sā hi dakṣiṇā bhavet || 18 ||

dāsīdāsagavādīni manasā yāni karhi cit || 19 ||
ekasyānekadānaṃ ca dadetkaścitpṛthakpṛthak || 2.2.3.20 ||
varaṇaṃ ca kadā kuryāttantre kuryācca dakṣiṇām ||
ratnasya dakṣiṇā deyā kāṃcanaṃ samudāhṛtam || 21 ||
bhūmerbhūmirdakṣiṇā syādvastrasya vastradakṣiṇā || 22 ||
pānīyasya tu pānīyaṃ vrīhīṇāṃ vrīhidakṣiṇā ||
gajasya dakṣiṇā chāgo hyaśvasya meṣa īritaḥ || ||23||
paśūnāṃ ca catuṣpādā devasya devadakṣiṇā ||
yajño mānasya ṣaḍbhāgo dviguṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 24 ||
ācāryasyaiva bhāgaikaṃ yajamānaḥ pradāsyati ||
pāpakaistu kalatrāṇāṃ bhāgaikaṃ tadanaṃtaram || 25 ||
pātrāṇāmṛtvigādīnāṃ bhāgatrayamudāhṛtam ||
ācāryādyaṃśataḥ kaścitkṣīṇavittaṃ samāharet ||
amūlyaṃ vargamūlyaṃ yadbhavedvai dakṣiṇottamā || 27 ||
mānāśaktau tu yajñānāṃ yaddeyaṃ yajñasiddhaye ||
devatā pustakaṃ ratnaṃ gāvo dhānyaṃ tilāstathā ||28||
nameruphalapuṣpāṇi deyānyetāni sarvataḥ ||
catuścakrāṃkito yastu sāṃdro vṛtto janārdanaḥ ||29||
amūlyānyāhuretāni dattvānantaphalāni ca ||
svarṇapādo bhavenmūlyaṃ śālagrāmasya dakṣiṇā || 32 ||
kṣudraliṃge svarṇamūlyaṃ pādārdhaṃ śrīdharepi ca ||
anantonantamityuktaṃ pādārdhaṃ bāṇaliṅgake || 33 ||
yathā pustakamātreṇa svarṇa pādārdhamiṣyate ||
prāyaścittavidhau jñeyaṃ dhenumātraṃ purāṇakam || 36 ||
purāṇatritayaṃ cānye vīryahīne dvayaṃ bhavet ||
kṛṣṇe vṛṣe ṣaṭpurāṇaṃ śvete navapurāṇakam ||37||
dvātriṃśacca purāṇaṃ syādvṛṣe nīle tathaiva ca ||
nameroḥ praticakre ca dvādaśa svarṇarattikāḥ || || 38 ||
mūlyaṃ śrīphalamātre.api purāṇatritayaṃ bhavet ||
etānyāhuḥ praśastāni mūlayoge paraṃ viduḥ || 2.2.3.40 || ||
mūlyadānavarṇanam
pūrṇapātramatho vakṣye yajñe sādhāraṇe.api ca ||
kāmahome bhavenmuṣṭirmuṣṭayoṣṭau tu kuñcikā || 1 ||
ekaika kuñcimānena kuryātpātrāṇi vai sadā ||
pātrāṇi ca pṛthakkṛtvā sthāpayeddvāradeśataḥ || 2 ||
siddhānāṃ khaḍgadhārāṇāṃ pratyekasya dinakramāt ||
kuṇḍānāṃ kuḍmalānāṃ ca vedanaṃ yādṛśaṃ śṛṇu ||
mahāsiṃhāsane pañca daśapātre tadardhakam || 5 ||
sahasrāre merupṛṣṭhe turyaraupyavṛṣādhikam ||
vṛṣe gale ca vṛṣabhaṃ śeṣe raupyasahasrakam || 6 ||
mahākuṇḍe tu dviguṇaṃ vṛtte raupyaṃ nivedayet || 7 ||
yonikuṇḍe dadeddhenumaṣṭārdhasvarṇamāṣakam || 8 ||
ṣaḍasre tu tadardhaṃ syādyāge māṣadvayaṃ bhavet ||
dāraṇe hastamātraṃ syātsvarṇakṛṣṇakalaṃ bhavet ||
iṣṭikākaraṇe caiva pratyahnā syātpaṇadvayam || 2.2.4.10 ||
khaṇḍe daśavarāṭaṃ syādbṛ hanmāne tu kākiṇī ||
taḍāge puṣkariṇyāṃ ca khanane prathamāṃgake || 11 ||
saptahastamite kuṇḍe niṣṭhe ābaddhamātrakam ||
purāṇasya ca ekāṃśaṃ vetanaṃ parikīrtitam || 12 ||
bṛhatkūpasya nirmāṇe pratyahaṃ ca paṇadvayam || 13 ||
śaile jñeyaṃ kāñcanasya rattikā gṛhakarmaṇi||
koṣṭhe jñeyaṃ sārddhapaṇaṃ raṃgādiracite paṇam||14||
vṛkṣāṇāṃ ropaṇe dadyātpratyahnā sārdhamāṣakam ||
setubaṃdhe ca paṃkile ca paṇadvayaṃ ca kākiṇī || 15 ||
paṇepaṇe tu tāmrasya dadyātpaṇacatuṣṭayam ||
ghaṭane kāṃsyasīsānāṃ paṇatrayamudāhṛtam || 16 ||
atha vā dinasaṃkhyānaṃ paṇaikaṃ ca sakākiṇi ||
suvarṇasya paṇaike tu purāṇaṃ ratnakuṭṭime || 17 ||
dinasaṃkhyāpaṇadvaṃdvaṃ ratnānāmatha kuḍmalam|| 18 ||
maṇivedhe maṇau jñeyaṃ kākiṇī parikīrtitā ||
caturvarāṭamadhikaṃ sphāṭike maṇivedhane || 19 ||
kāṃsyatālasya nirmāṇe dhamane tu paṇatrayam ||
lākṣānirmāṇake kārye tadardhamapi kīrtitam||2.2.4.20||
avivastrasya nirmāṇe syaṃdanaṃ daśakākiṇī ||
pidhānavastranirmāṇe tripaṇaṃ parikīrtitam || 22 ||
saśmaśrunakhamāne tu pradadyātkākiṇīdvayam ||
nārīṇāmatha saṃskāre nakhacitrādirañjane || 25 ||
paṇānāṃ turyakaṃ dadyātsīmaṃtasyālake tathā || 26 ||
padacitre tu sārddhaṃ syādgrīvāṇāṃ guhyadhāraṇe ||
dhānyānāṃ ropaṇe caiva dinaike paṇa vetanam || 27 ||
lavaṇe tu tathā deyā guvākānāṃ ca ropaṇe ||
daṇḍapatrasya saṃskāre maricānāṃ tathaiva ca || 28 ||
paṇadvayaṃ varāṭānāmadhikaṃ daśameva tu ||
paṇatrayaṃ cakrapaṇe mahiṣāṇāṃ paṇādhikam ||
narāṇāṃ vāhane caiva paṇaikaṃ daśa kākiṇī || 2.2.4.30 ||
dāsīnāṃ gardabhānāṃ ca adhikaṃ kākiṇīdvayāt ||
sadyaḥ prakṣālane.apyardhaṃ dinādāvadhikaṃ bhaved || 32 ||
mṛttikānāṃ samuddhāraṃ kuddāle cekṣupīḍane || 33 ||
vetanaṃ puṣpasaṃskāre sahasraṃ daśakākiṇī ||
kākiṇī sraṅnibaddhe ca dviguṇaṃ kaṇṭhamālikā || 34 ||
abaddhe dvyaṃgulaṃ yāvanmuṇḍamālā prakīrtitā ||
hastatraye kaṇṭhamālā ānābhi kamalāvadhi || 35 ||
kākiṇīkatrayaṃ caiva nirmāṇe dvijasattamāḥ ||
mālatyāśca tulasyāśca jātiyūthyośca sattamāḥ || 36 ||
yāmeyāme raupyamāṣaṃ snehe caiva tu kākiṇī ||
sārdhāṃgulapramāṇena vastravartiṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 38 ||
ṣaḍaṃgulena dairghyaṃ ca na nyūnaṃ nādhikaṃ bhavet ||
pañcaviṃśatibhiḥ saṃkhyā taṃtubhirdvijasattamāḥ || 39 ||
pañcāṅgulena mānena kartavyaḥ susamāhitaḥ ||
svarṇadhāre hato rājā rajate sarvakāmadaḥ || 41 ||
tāmre cāyuḥkṣayakaramāyase durgatipradaḥ ||
dīpādhāraṃ kāṃsyamayaṃ tathārītimayasya ca ||
daśāṅgadhūpake mūlyaṃ viṃśake tu paṇatrayam ||
dvādaśakāṃgule.apyardhavartiṃ dhūpāya vartayet || 44 ||
haste paṃcapramāṇaṃ ca vastraiḥ kuryācca vartikām ||
pañcaviṃśatibhirvā yaḥ sa mahāvartirucyate ||45|| ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kalaśānāṃ vinirṇayam ||
yasyārpite ca māṃgalye yātrāsiddhiśca jāyate ||1||
vaṭasyāśvatthavṛkṣasya dhātakībilvakasya ca ||
sauvarṇā rājatā vāpi tāmrādyā mṛnmayāstathā ||
kalaśāḥ kramaśaḥ proktā yathāvittānusārataḥ || 5 ||
abhedyāḥ suṣamāḥ plakṣāḥ sarve ādyāḥ supūritāḥ ||
niśchidrā ṛjavaścaiva secanānyekakarṣakaḥ || 6 ||
eka triṃśāṅgulaṃ kuryātkālāhe dviguṇaṃ śatam ||
mukhaṃ cāṣṭāṃgulaṃ tasya dvyaṃgule ca varārthite ||7||
taijasaiḥ kārayenmānaṃ mṛnmaye mānamucyate ||
kalaśasthāpanaṃ vakṣye yatra sannihitāḥ surāḥ ||
yajñe sādhāraṇaṃ vakṣye yadvidhānaṃ yathāmatam ||
svastikopari vinyāse saṃpūrṇasyārdhamānake || 2.2.5.10 ||
turyasūtrāṇi matimānpañca pūrvāyatanāni ca || 11 ||
mārjayetsvastikākāraṃ turyamātraṃ yathā bhavet ||
svastikaṃ jāyate tatra kalaśānāṃ tathāsanam || 12 ||
syonā pṛthivīti maṃtreṇa kuryādbhūbhiparigraham ||
madhyamānānikābhyāṃ ca nyasyetpātālasaṃmukham ||
ṛṣirnārāyaṇo.asya syādgāyatrī devatā raviḥ || 13 ||
ājighraṃ kalaśaṃ mahyāṃ sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tataḥ ||
kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhakaṃ tyaktvā kumbhāgre udare.api ca || 16 ||
ājighrasya ca mantrasya ṛṣirbharga udāhṛtaḥ ||
paṃktiśchandaśca uddiṣṭo devatā viṣṇuravyayaḥ || 17 ||
paṃcanadyetimantreṇa kṣipedgaṅgājalaṃ tataḥ || 18 ||
devatā paramā triṣṭubdevatā somabhāvitaḥ ||
yāḥ phalinīti maṃtreṇa pradadyātsaphalākṣatam ||
yāḥ phalinīti maṃtrasya ṛṣiḥ kamalasaṃjñakaḥ ||
triṣṭupchando gaṇapatirdevatā parikīrtitā || 2.2.5.20 ||
jīvaṃtī pīvaraṃ caiva phalānyetāni varjayet || 21 ||
hiraṇyagarbheti ṛcā pañcaratnāni nikṣipet ||
ṛṣirhiraṇyagarbhosya chandastriṣṭubudāhṛtam ||
amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kuryāddaivaśulbanameva ca ||
varuṇasya tveti ṛṣirvaruṇāṃtare yojayet ||23||
śrīśca te iti mantreṇa dadyātpuṣpaṃ sacandanam ||
kāṇḍāditi ca mantreṇa dadyāddūrvākṣataṃ punaḥ ||
vrīhayaśceti mantreṇa pañca vrīhīṃśca nikṣipet ||25||
tilāśca māṣā mudgāśca śyāmākāḥ śālayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
pañca dhānyagaṇaḥ proktaḥ sarvāriṣṭaniṣūdanaḥ || 26 ||
māsavarṇanam
atha māsāśrayaṃ karma kartuṃ māsanirūpaṇam ||
cāndraḥ sauraḥ sāvanaśca nākṣatraśca tathāparaḥ ||
triṃśatā divasairmāsaḥ sāvanaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 3 ||
nākṣatramāso.aśvinyādirevatyanto hi viśrutaḥ||
rāśestriṃśadbhāgakālaḥ kālastvekasya bhāsvataḥ ||5||
ahorātraṃ tu tannaivaṃ saure.api bhāgamānataḥ||
saure cāndre tūpagaṇau triṃśadbhāge tvadarśanāt ||
sāvanā divasā grāhyā ṛṣīṇāṃ samaye gṛhe || 7 ||
atibhāgavyavasthāyāṃ prāyaścittakriyāsu ca||
mantropāsanakārye ca annasya prāśane śiśoḥ||8||
karasya grahaṇe rājño vyavahāreṣu māḥsu ca||
yajñeṣu dinasaṃ khyāyāṃ grāhyo māsastu sāvanaḥ ||9||
sauramāso vivāhādau yadādyaiḥ supragṛhyate ||
cāndrastu pārvaṇe grāhyo vārṣikeṣvaṣṭakāsu ca ||
śrāddheṣu tithikāryeṣu tithyukteṣu vrateṣu ca ||11||
nākṣatraḥ somapādīnāmāryabhāgavicāraṇe ||
karagrahavidhau rājñāṃ nāyaṃ sarvajanākṛtiḥ || 12||
citrānakṣatrayogena caitrī sā pūrṇimā smṛtā||
sa ca tithyātmako māsaścāndraḥ śravaṇabhāskaraḥ ||
cāndraścaitryaṃtiko māso mukhyaścaitrādisaṃjñakaḥ || 16||
mukhyaḥ śuklādidarśāṃto māso lākṣaṇiko mataḥ || 17 ||
caitrādyāścāndramāsā ye dvādaśāpi tu yogataḥ ||
viśākhayādyeṣu yā vā tathā bhādrapadena vā ||
yatra na pūrṇimāyogo māsaḥ sa syādvināśakaḥ || 19 ||
tathā ca māsasāmānye yogenāyaṃ bhavetkvacit ||
yadi varṣasahasrānte tadakṣeṇaiva pūrṇimā || 21 ||
daṇḍadvaye bhuktaśeṣe na bhuñjīta kadācana ||
atikramyāparāṃ bhoktuṃ tithiṃ yatra ubhāvapi ||23||
sa cādhiko yato māsastataḥ syādadhimāsakaḥ ||
samarātriṃ divaṃ kṛtvā vaivasvatapurīgatim || 25 ||
gaśe rāśyaṃtare sūryo yāvadgacchati bhānumān ||
vardhate tithayo yāvattulāṃ yāti divā karaḥ ||
tulādirāśiṣaṭke tu na varddhate kadācana || 27 ||
svabhāvātsamagatyā tu yataḥ saṃkramate raviḥ ||
saṃcayamānātvekaikā pratimāsaṃ vivarddhate ||
sa cāndro malino māsaḥ koṇapādyaiḥ samīhitaḥ || 29 ||
bhuktocchiṣṭā tu tanmāsādasaṃspṛṣṭadivākaraḥ ||
yadā saṃkramate laṃghya tadā jñeyo malimlucaḥ || 2.2.6.30 ||
sārdhavarṣadvaye pūrṇe patatyevaṃ niśākaraḥ ||
parityaktāśca yāvaṃtyo vyutkramiṇyaśca yāḥ punaḥ ||
nirmamaṃ malinaṃ māsaṃ pretānāṃ ca hitāya ca ||32||
ataḥ pretakriyāḥ sarvāḥ kāryā malimluce.api ca||
tadidānīṃ pravakṣyāmi kathitaṃ ca prasaṃgataḥ ||
yacchrāddhaṃ pretasaṃbaṃdhi sarpiḍīkaraṇāvadhi ||
malamāse.api tatkāryaṃ viśi naṣṭi sapiṃḍanam || 34 ||
tadā trayodaśe māsi kartavyaṃ tatsapiṃḍanam|| 36 ||
varjyaṃ māsikayā śrāddhamekaṃ tasmiṃstrayodaśe ||
triṃśatā ghaṭikaiḥ śrāddhaṃ vardhate.adyāpi saṃmitam || 37 ||
vratāraṃbhaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca cūḍākarma ca mekhalām||41||
maṃtropāsāṃ rahasyaṃ ca mahādānaṃ sumaṅgalam ||
vivāhaṃ ca gṛhāraṃbhaṃ praveśaṃ navaveśmanaḥ || 42 ||
upagrahaṃ gavādīnāmāśramāṃtarasaṃkramam ||
dīrghamātrāsu nejyaṃ vai tīrthayātrāvasecanam|| 43 ||
varṣavṛddhivṛṣotsargakanyā dvirnayanādi ca ||
yajñaṃ ca kāmikaṃ vidvānmalamāse vivarjayet ||44||
pādāstaṃ ca mahāstaṃ ca dvividhaṃ cāstamasya tu || 45 ||
pṛthivyāmeva pādāstaṃ bhaveddvādaśa vatsarān || 46 ||
ūnapañcāśadadhikaṃ divasānāṃ śatadvayam ||
pratīcyāmuditaḥ kāvyo dṛśyo bhavati sarvadā || 47 ||
ekarkṣe guruṇā yukto yāvattiṣṭhati bhārgavaḥ ||
malamāsavatkarmāṇi prāhustyājyāni sarvaśaḥ ||48||
ṛkṣabhede tvekarāśau saṃparke yadi vānayoḥ ||
guro rāhorapi tathā tyajedvidvānna saṃśayaḥ || 49 ||
siṃhe rāśau sthite sūrye jīve cāstamupāgate ||
heyāni yāni karmāṇi niṣiddhāni malimluce || 2.2.6.50 ||
dvirāṣāḍha iti khyāto gauṇe śabdavivartanāt || 51 ||
āṣāḍhakīrtanaṃ kāryamevaṃ varṣāṃtare.api ca || 52 ||
āṣāḍhadvayasaṃyuktapūrṇamāsīdvayaṃ tathā ||
yugmakarkaṭayo rāśyo dvirāṣāḍhastadā bhavet || 53 ||
bhavedgauṇo dvirāṣāḍho rāśistatraiva saṃyute ||
karkaṭe śayanaṃ kuryādāgamiṣyaṃ paratrake ||
durgotthānaṃ tulāyāṃ tu viṣṇurnidrāṃ jahātyasau || 56 ||
daivaṃ vā paitṛkaṃ karma kālamāśritya vartate ||
kāle tānyeva karmāṇi phalaṃ yacchaṃti kurvatām || 1 ||
vyayo vā mukhyabhāvena phaladaḥ karmaśālinām || 2 ||
kālastu guṇabhāvena sarvakālāśritā kriyā ||
na kālena vinā kiñcittriṣu lokeṣu jāyate || 3 ||
ataḥ kālaṃ pravakṣyāmi nimittaṃ karmaṇāmiha |
te.api kālāḥ pakṣamāsarāśivarṣāṃtare.api ca ||
tithyādikālabhāveṣu niṣiddhaṃ nihitaṃ hi tat || 6 ||
kālabhāgo niḥsahāyo ye.api syuḥ karmasādhanāḥ ||
tithau pūrvāhṇavyāpinyāṃ kurvīta karma vaidikam || 8 ||
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu madhyāhnavyāpinyāṃ hi samācaret||
parāhṇavyāpinīṃ prāpya tithiṃ kuryāttu pārvaṇam || 9 ||
na tu pūrvāhṇamadhyāhnaparāhṇeṣu yathocitam ||
eko hi kālaḥ prātastu vṛddhiśrāddhādisādhane ||
nāpekṣate sāhāyyaṃ tattithyādiviṣuvādiṣu ||11||
devebhyo brahmaṇā dattaḥ pūrvāhṇastithibhiḥ saha ||
pitṛbhyo hyaparāhṇastu pārvaṇaṃ tu paraṃ vinā || 12 ||
pūrvāhṇamātrasaṃprāptau tato devānprapūjayet ||
pūrvāhṇasparśamātre.api tithikhaṇḍena cārpayet ||13||
kharvā darpā tathā hiṃsrā tithiśca trividhā bhavet ||
hiṃsrā tu kṣayajā jñeyā kālabhedena gṛhyate ||
kharvā darpā pare grāhyā hiṃsrā grāhyā tu pūrvataḥ || 16||
śuklapakṣe parā grāhyā kṛṣṇe pūrvā praśasyate ||
yathāvāste ravirbhāti ghaṭikā daśa vāpi vā||
sā tithistadahorātraṃ vyapadeśyā na cetarā||19||
śukle vā yadi vā kṛṣṇe kharvā darpā tithiśca yā ||
yayāstaṃ savitā yāti pitṛkārye ca sā tithiḥ || 2.2.7.20 ||
śrāddhakālādikaṃ yatra tatra śrāddhaṃ vidhīyate ||
amāvāsyapārvaṇe ca sā tithiḥ pitṛpūjane ||
amāvasyāmṛtasyaiva pārvaṇaṃ yatra kutracit ||22||
śuklapakṣe ca kṛṣṇe ca yo yogaḥ parapūrvayoḥ||
pūrvedyurvā paredyurvā trisaṃdhyavyāpinī tithiḥ||
sā pūjyā ca svakṛtyeṣu pakṣayorubhayorapi ||24||
pūjyā hi vyastaṃ saṃtyajya pūrvaṃ caikādaśīyugam ||
dvitīyā vahninā yuktā caturthī paṃcamīyutā || || 25 ||
etā upoṣyāstithayaḥ puṇyāḥ syurdharmavedibhiḥ ||
etadvyastāstu puṇyāni ghnaṃti pūrvakṛtānyapi || 26 ||
bāṇena viddhā yā ṣaṣṭhī munividdhā tathāṣṭamī ||
daśamyekādaśīviddhā trayodaśyā caturdaśī || 27 ||
tāmastāṃ tu tithiṃ prāpya yugmānyapūjyatāmiyuḥ ||
yugmāni ca divāyoge grāhyāṇi vyastaniṃdanam || 2.2.7.30 ||
rātriyogaṃ vināpi syādekādaśyādikaṃ vratam ||
naktaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ caiva vināyoge.api śasyate || 32 ||
ekādaśyupavāsaṃ tu dvādaśīyogataścaret ||
divāyoge tu saṃpūrṇāṃ tyajedubhayapūrvataḥ || 33 ||
rātriyoge tu saṃpūrṇā sopāsyaikādaśī sadā ||
saptamī śukla pakṣe.api pūjyā ṣaṣṭhyā samanvitā || 34 ||
niśi tu syādyadā ṣaṣṭhī saptamī navamī divā ||
upoṣya kevalāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ toṣayedbhāskaraṃ naraḥ || 35 ||
evaṃ trayodaśīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ vidhiprāptāṃ vinā dvijāḥ ||
upoṣya pārvatīnāthaṃ toṣayedyaśca kevalam ||36 ||
divā trayodaśīyuktā kṛṣṇopoṣyā caturdaśī ||
pareṇāpi caturdaśyā na tu kuryādamātithau ||37||
trisaṃdhyavyāpinī prāpya yadi kuryādupauṣaṇam ||
pāraṇaṃ tu sinīvālyāṃ caturdaśyāmupoṣayet||38||
caturdaśīmatikramya sinīvālyāṃ tu pāraṇāt||
vratāni tasya naśyaṃti prākṛtāni caturdaśīm ||39||
saptamī lalitā bhādre śaktotthānaṃ ca vāruṇī ||
pūjyāścaitāḥ parāḥ kuryāttrisaṃdhyavyāpinīṣvapi ||2.2.7.40||
saṛkṣā ṛkṣayoge tu ṛkṣābhāve parā yutā||41||
ṛkṣābhāve parā grāhyā trisaṃdhyavyāpinīṣvapi ||
śrāvaṇe cādyapāde tu praśastā śakrapūjane ||42||
abhāve cottarāṣāḍhā dhaniṣṭhā ca viśiṣyate ||
daṇḍārdhaṃ daṇḍamekaṃ vā tadardhaṃ palameva vā ||43||
udaye saṃyutā grāhyā sā tithiścottamā bhavet ||
trisaṃdhyavyāpinīṃ hitvā pūjyā śuklāṣṭamī parā ||44||
śuklaikādaśyamāvāsyāsaṃkrāntyāṃ śrāddhavāsare ||46||
narāśvagogajādīnāṃ vāhanātpātakī bhavet ||47||
karturgomahiṣādīnāṃ gardabhoṣṭrakharasya ca ||
na vāhayeddāsa dāsī vāhanenāsti dūṣaṇam || 48 ||
grāmāṃtare na doṣaḥ syāddivi nadyaṃtare.api ca || 49 ||
tatra gomahiṣādīnāṃ vāhane nāsti dūṣaṇam || 2.2.7.50 ||
kuryādaṃbughaṭaśrāddhaṃ na kālaniyamaṃ kvacit ||
na cānnaniyamaṃ kuryādaśmapātraṃ ca varjayet || 51 ||
na yojayenmṛnmayaṃ ca śūdrāṇāṃ mṛnmaye vidhiḥ || 52 ||
nivedayecca māsāṃte mṛnmayaṃ vṛkṣamūlake ||
parvaśrāddhe daivalakaṃ tathā raṇḍāśramaṃ tyajet || 53 ||
mātāpitṛparityāgī tailahavyādivikrayī ||
catvāriṃśadutsavānāṃ sāṣṭānāṃ ca caredyadi || 54 ||
striyā vimucyate kaścitsa tu raṇḍāśramī mataḥ ||
snānādhyayanadāneṣu sā tithiḥ sakalā smṛtā || 57 ||
yayāstaṃ savitā yāti kṛṣṇapakṣe tu sā tithiḥ ||
pitṛrṇāṃ sakalā jñeyā snānadānādikarmasu || || 58 ||
saptamī śuklapakṣe yā yāvadicchecca khaṇḍitā ||
ādyabhāge raveḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ parādau yāṣṭamīyutā ||
yadyakhaṇḍā bhavetsaiva tadā jñeyā bhavātmikā || 59 ||
māghamāsena sāpyevaṃ pūrveṇa ravitoṣiṇī ||
manvaṃtarā pareṇaiva snānapānādikarmasu || 2.2.7.60 ||
tithīnāṃ pravarā yasmādbrahmaṇā samudāhṛtā ||
kārtikāśvayujoścaitre māghe cāpi viśeṣataḥ ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ daśaguṇaṃ śivaviṣṇvośca pūjanam || 2 ||
agnimiṣṭvā ca kṛtvā ca pratipadyāmiti smṛtam ||
haviṣā sarvadhānyāni prāpnuyādīpsitaṃ dhanam || 3 ||
bṛhaspatau dvitīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ vidhipūjanam ||
kṛtvā naktaṃ samaśnīyāllabhate bhūtimīpsitām ||4||
dvitīyā yā tu vipreṃdāstāmupoṣya hariṃ yajet ||
yāmupoṣya na vaidhavyaṃ prayāti strī na saṃśayaḥ || 5 ||
amūlyaśayanaṃ māsaṃ daṃpatī pratipūjayet ||
vāsobhirgandhapuṣpaiśca nānābhakṣyaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 6 ||
vaiśākhe śuklapakṣe tu tṛtīyāyāṃ tathaiva ca ||
gaṃgātoye naraḥ snātvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||7||
svātiyuktatṛtīyāyāṃ vaiśākhe tu viśeṣataḥ ||
māghe tu rohiṇīyuktā vṛṣe cāśvayuje tathā || 8 ||
tasyāṃ yaddīyate kiñcittadakṣayamudāhṛtam ||
viśeṣato haviṣyānnaṃ modakādisamāyutam ||9||
toyadānaṃ viśeṣeṇa praśaṃsaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ ||
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā tṛtīyā yadi labhyate ||
tasyāṃ snānopavāsādyamakṣayaṃ parikīrtitam ||11||
śivā śāṃtā sukhā caiva caturthī trividhā smṛtā ||
sāpi bhādrapade śuklā śivaloke supūjitā || 13 ||
tasyāṃ snānaṃ tapo dānamupavāso japastathā ||
bhavetsahasraguṇitaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhavati cākṣayam || 14 ||
gaṇeśe kārayetpūjāṃ modakādibhirādarāt ||
śrāvaṇe māsi pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣe viśeṣataḥ ||
snāpayennavanāgāṃśca gaṃdhatoyaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ || 16 ||
teṣāṃ kule prayacchaṃti abhayaṃ prāṇarakṣaṇam || 17 ||
supte janārdane kṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ bhavanāṃgaṇe ||
pūjayenmanasādevīṃ vāmāṃ snuhīti saṃśrayām || 19 ||
pūjayitvā naro devīṃ na sarpabhayamāpnu yāt || 2.2.8.20 ||
yeyaṃ bhādrapade ṣaṣṭhī ṣaṣṭhī ca dvijasattama ||
snānadānādikaṃ tasyāṃ sarvamakṣayamucyate || 21 ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ phalāśano viprā viśeṣānmāghakārtike ||
śuddhe pakṣe ca saptamyāṃ yadā saṃkramate raviḥ ||||
mahājayā tadā syādvai saptamī bhāskarapriyā || 23 ||
aparājitā tu bhādrasya mahāpātakanāśinī ||
śuklā vā yadi vā kṛṣṇā ṣaṣṭhī vā saptamī tu vā ||
ravivāreṇa saṃyuktā tithiḥ puṇyatamā smṛtā || 25 ||
āśvinasya sitāṣṭamyāmaṣṭādaśabhujāṃ yajet ||
kārttike śuklapakṣe vā mahāvibhavavistaraiḥ || 26 ||
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe māsi śuklāṣṭamyāṃ ca caṃḍikām ||
prātaḥ snātvārcayedbhaktyā rātrau saṃsnāpayeddvijāḥ || 27 ||
caitramāsi sitāṣṭamyāmaśokakusumairdvijāḥ ||
arcayenmṛnmayīṃ devīmaśokārthaṃ ca sarvadā || 28 ||
satyaṣṭamamuhūrte vā rohiṇīsahitāṣṭamī ||
śrāvaṇe māsi siṃhārke kvacitsāpi ca śasyate || 29 ||
ekādaśīnāṃ koṭīnāṃ vrataiśca labhate phalam||
ato daśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ kṛtvaitatphalamāpnuyāta || 2.2.8.30 ||
kṛtvā vimucyate pāpātsaptakṛtyakṛtāṃ varaḥ ||31||
nāpi nakṣatradoṣo.asti vāradoṣo na gaṇyate || 32 ||
trikālaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ divā rātrau viśeṣataḥ ||
ardharātre viśeṣeṇa puṣpairnānāvidhairapi ||33||
rātrisparśe yadi paraṃ rajanyāmapi cāṣṭamī ||34||
saptamī sārdhayāmaṃ ca rohiṇī vā na saṃspṛśet||
prāgāraṃbhaṃ prakurvīta adhimātrādhike vratī ||
viśvanāthādidevānāṃ darśanaṃ prāgvivarjayet||36||
yatra tatropavāsī syādyāmāṣṭakavrataṃ caret||
yāmārdhaṃ tatparaṃ yāme pāraṇaṃ vicaredvratī||37||
tatpare cā.annajanyaṃ vā na kuryātpāraṇaṃ gṛhī || 38 ||
divāṣṭamyāṃ muhūrte vā prājāpatyena saṃyutam ||
tathāpi ca divākṛtyaṃ samāpya ca vrataṃ caret || 2.2.8.40 ||
muhūrtāṃte ca māsāṃte aṣṭamyāmapi rohiṇī ||
upavāse ca yo doṣaḥ pūjāhomaḥ praśasyate || 41 ||
navamyāṃ ca sadā pūjyāḥ pratimāse.ayutaṃ dvijāḥ ||
kārtikasya tu māsasya daśamī śuklapakṣikā ||
tasyāṃ yuktāśanā viprā brahmalokamavāpnuyuḥ || 43 ||
daśamī jyeṣṭhamāsasya sā ceddaśaharā smṛtā ||
āśvinasya mahāpuṇyā kārtike vijayā smṛtā || 44 ||
ekādaśī vrataparā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktā yathā kurvaṃti mānavāḥ || 45 ||
ekādaśyāmupoṣyātha dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ caret ||46||
dvādaśa dvādaśīrhanti tasmāttathācaredbudhaḥ ||
pūrvedyurekādaśī pūrṇā parehani ca vardhate || 47 ||
vanavāsī parāṃ kuryātpūrvāṃ kuryādgṛhāśramī ||48||
ekādaśī dvādaśī tu tadopoṣyā parā tithiḥ || 49 ||
yadā tu pāraṇā yogyā dvādaśī nopatiṣṭhate ||
tadā pūrvaiva saṃgrāhyā tyājyā vṛddhā pare.ahani || 2.2.8.50 ||
ekādaśī kalāyuktā sakalā dvādaśī yadi ||
tatra kratusamaṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam || 51 ||
dvādaśī pāraṇāyogyā vardhate cāpare.ahani ||
tadā dinadvaye tyājyā pāraṇaṃ ca niyogataḥ || 53 ||
ṣoḍaśīgrahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvādaśī luptapāraṇā ||
caṇḍātithau vrataṃ caiva haṃti puṇyaṃ purā kṛtam || 54 ||
trayodaśyāṃ yadvihitaṃ pāraṇaṃ na tu puṇyadam ||
gṛhāśramī na kuryādvā daśamīdvādaśīkṣayāt || 55 ||
tathāpi saṃparityajya dvādaśyāṃ samupāvaset || 56 ||
vajrālokanamātraṃ tu daśamī saṃviśedyadi ||
ekādaśī na bhoktavyā parā hyekādaśī tadā || 57 ||
tadā ceddaśamīviddhā samupoṣyā na dūṣaṇam|| 58 ||
dvādaśyāmupavāsaṃ tu yaḥ karoti narottamaḥ ||
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra viṣṇuranāmayaḥ || 59 ||
upoṣya daśamīmitrāṃ mohādekādaśīṃ naraḥ ||
ravivāre śukravāre saṃkrāntyāṃ tu dinakṣaye ||
upavāsaṃ prakurvīta pāraṇaṃ tu vivarjayet || 61 ||
śuklāṃ vā yadi vā kṛṣṇāṃ pūrvasaṃkalpitāmapi ||
ekādaśīṃ sadā kuryānna vai kṛṣṇettarāṃ kvacit ||62||
naktena vartayetkṛṣṇāmiti śāstraviniścayaḥ ||
māse caikādaśī yatra labhyate śuklapakṣake ||
tatra kuryātkṛṣṇapakṣe parā tithirna gṛhyate ||63||
śrāvaṇī dvādaśī śuklā cāṃdrabhadre yadā harau ||
tatropoṣya hṛṣīkeśaṃ pūjayedvidhivannaraḥ || 64 ||
śrāvaṇe cāśvine caiva labhyate dvādaśīdine ||
śravaṇena samāyuktā mahatī sā prakīrtitā || 65 ||
puṣyeṇa drādaśīyuktā phālgune vijayā smṛtā ||
kārtike cetparityājyā māghe tu nārakī bhavet ||66||
yā bhādre vijayā proktā śravaṇena samāyutā||
ekādaśyāmuttarato dvādaśī ca divānvitā ||
niśipūrṇā dvādaśī ca śravaṇenāpi saṃyutā ||68||
saphalā dvādaśī jñeyā upoṣyaiṣā mahāphalā || 69 ||
dvādaśyāṃ viṣṇuviddhāyāṃ vāsudevaṃ prapūjayet ||
kṛṣṇāyāṃ tu vrataṃ kuryādbahuduḥkhaṃ samācareta || 2.2.8.70 ||
dvādaśī kāmaviddhā cenmanyate nāpyupoṣaṇam ||
hanyātpurākṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāmupoṣaṇam ||71||
prahareprahare snānaṃ śarvaryāṃ ca vidhīyate ||
pūjanaṃ cāgnikāryaṃ ca ṣaṭsu kāryaṃ vratī caret ||72||
ekādaśīṃ dvādaśīṃ ca prāpnoti śravaṇe yadi ||
ekādaśyāmupoṣyātha dvādaśyāmapyupāvaset||73||
pāraṇaṃ tu trayodaśyāṃ dvādaśī cenna labhyate ||
āmiṣānnaṃ na bhuñjīta haviṣyānnena pāraṇam ||74||
yadā tu pāraṇāyogyā labhyate dvādaśī tadā ||
tasyāṃ nātikramo yuktastadabhāve trayodaśī||75||
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca śravaṇarkṣeṇa saṃyutā ||
viṣṇuśṛṃkhalako nāma budhavāre viśiṣyate ||76||
daśamyāṃ saṃyato bhūtvā prātarekādaśīdine ||
kṛtvā tu saṅgame snānaṃ prahareprahare dvijāḥ ||77||
anena vidhinā kṛtvā vijayāyāṃ vratottamam ||
sarvapāpaṃ kṣayaṃ nītvā viṣṇuloke vasennaraḥ || 78 ||
caturyugānāṃ divyānāṃ yāvatsyādviṣṇurūpadhṛka ||
tretāyāṃ daśajanmāni madhyadeśeṣu bho dvijāḥ ||
tataśca bhārate varṣe vedavedāṃtasāravit ||
jāyate daśa janmāni tretāyāṃ brāhmaṇottamaḥ ||
bhādre māsi site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ pṛthivīpatim ||
śatrumutthāpayetprāhṇe śubhalagne śubhakṣaṇe || 82 ||
śalyaśālmalikasyāpi saptaparṇīyakasya ca ||
eṣāmanyatamaṃ vṛkṣaṃ caṃpakasyārjunasya vā || 83 ||
bṛhatkadaṃbavṛkṣasya dvicatvāriṃśadaṃgulaiḥ ||
dvātriṃśadaṃgulairvāpi mānadvayamathāpi vā ||
trivyāyāmaṃ ca prathamaṃ dvāviṃśahastameva vā || 84 ||
hastaḥ ṣoḍaśavārasya gṛhasthasya viśiṣyate ||
aṣṭahastaṃ tu vaiśyasya śūdrasya pañcahastakam ||
ghanasārasamāyuktāṃ karpūramaṃḍanānvitām ||
raktavastraparicchannāṃ puṣpamālyairalaṃkṛtām || 87 ||
mañcasthāṃ kārayetpūjāṃ bhaktyā ca sudṛḍho naraḥ ||
kākādīnna spṛśejjātu vairapakṣe viśeṣataḥ ||
patākāyā nipāte tu rāṣṭrahāniṃ samādiśet || 89 ||
patāke nissṛte bhagne mahiṣāṇāṃ vināśanam ||
sthūṇāpāte ca bhagne vā cāśvahāniṃ samādiśet || 2.2.8.90 ||
grahāṇāṃ ca tribhāgena cāyutaṃ juhuyādbudhaḥ || 92 ||
ādityasyādbhutamidaṃ dvijapāte tu bho dvijāḥ ||
kapotapāte śukrasya kākādau bhaumamādiśet || 93 ||
bhūkaṃpe jāyate viṣṭaṃ guroradbhutamādiśet ||
kīṭaviddhe kṛte viprāścandrasyādbhutamādiśet || 94 ||
śivā ruvaṃti cāndrasya vānaro vā spṛśetkvacit ||
ketoradbhutamuddiṣṭaṃ bhūmikaṃpe tu te dvijāḥ || 96 ||
trayodaśīṃ sitāṃ prāpya puṣpairnānāvidhairapi ||
caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ śanau śatabhiṣā yadi ||
gaṃgāyā yadi labhyeta sūryagrahaśataiḥ samā || 98 ||
seyaṃ mahāvāruṇīti khyātā kṛṣṇatrayodaśī ||
asyāṃ snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ vākṣayamucyate || 99 ||
madhumāse site pakṣe dambhabhañjī caturdaśī ||
tasyāṃ madanamūle ca akṣaraṃ kāmamarcayet || 2.2.8.100 ||
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ madanasya prabhāvataḥ ||
anantasya vrataṃ vakṣye sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
dvādaśyāṃ pūjite śakre dhvajake vāstuyaṣṭiṣu ||
kṛtvā darbhamayānantaṃ vāridhānyānvitaṃ tathā ||
yavagodhūmaśālīnāṃ cūrṇairnaikatamasya ca || 105 ||
kṛtvā pūpāhvayaṃ tasmai dadyādekaṃ śrutekṣitam ||
caturdaśasūtramayaṃ sūtraṃ kārpāsameva ca || 107 ||
ataḥ preta caturdaśyāṃ bhojayitvā tapodhanān ||
tataḥ pretakathāṃ śrutvā śākairnaktaṃ samācaret ||
caturdaśaṃ dvādaśaṃ vā saptamaṃ vāpi pañcamam || 109 ||
mānamātrādikaṃ kṛtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 2.2.8.110 ||
māghe māsi vaṭāpāyaḥ kasya pāpaṃ punīmahe ||
snātvā tatra caturdaśyāṃ samaye tārakāmaye || 111 ||
saṃbhavetphālgune māsi yā ca kṛṣṇā caturdaśī ||
śivarātririti khyātā sā jagatsarvakāmadā || 112 ||
tithiyoge ca śarvaryāṃ saṃpūrṇe vratamācaret ||
kāmaviddhā sā ca pūjyā rātriyoge caredvratī || 114 ||
atha vakṣyāmi caitrādimāse tu pūrṇimā yathā ||
mahācaitrīti sā jñeyā pūrṇimākṣayapuṇyadā || 116 ||
viśākhādiṣu bhedeṣu pūrṇacandro guruścaret ||
mahāvaiśākhikādyāstu pūrṇimā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ || 117 ||
mahājyaiṣṭhī viśeṣo.ayaṃ prājāpatye yathā raviḥ ||
gurupūrṇacandro jyeṣṭhāyāṃ mahājyaiṣṭhīti sā smṛtā || 118 ||
vināpi guruṇā candraḥ kṛttikā pūrṇimā tathā ||
tathā mahākārttikī sā tithiḥ puṇyatamā bhavet || 119 ||
rohiṇyāṃ tu sthitaścandraḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu kārttike ||
citrā vā yadi vā pūrṇā yadā syātpūrṇimātithiḥ ||
mahācaitrī tathāpi syādaśvamedhaphalapradā || 121 ||
raviṇā kṛttikāyogādravivāre ca pūrṇimā ||
mahācaitrī tathāpi syāddattasyākṣayakārikā || 122 ||
sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti phalaṃ caivāśvamedhikam ||
pitarastarpitā yāṃti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamakṣayam || 124 ||
bharaṇyāṃ kārttike māsi yadi syātpūrṇimā tithiḥ ||
gaṃgādvāre tu mahatī vaiśākhī puṇyadā smṛtā || 125 ||
śālagrāme mahācaitrī kṛtapuṇyā mahātithiḥ ||
gaṃgādvāre tu mahatī vaiśākhī puṇyadā smṛtā || 126 ||
puruṣottame mahājyaiṣṭhī mahāṣāḍhī tu śṛṃkhale ||
mahāśrāvaṇī kedāre mahāpuṇyatamā matā || 127 ||
mahābhādrī badaryāṃ ca kujo.api syānnarastathā ||
mahatī mārgaśīrṣe syādayodhyāyāṃ tathottare ||
mahāpauṣī puṇyatamā mahāmāghī prayāgataḥ || || 129 ||
mahāphālgunī naimiṣe ca nirdiṣṭāḥ syurmahāphalāḥ || 2.2.8.130 ||
atra sma vihitaṃ karma śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham ||
āśvine paurṇamāsī tu kaumudīti prakīrtitā ||
asyāṃ candrodaye lakṣmīṃ pūjayedvidhivannaraḥ || 132 ||
nirvatayenna yaḥ śrāddhaṃ prabhāte paitṛkaṃ dvijaḥ ||
indukṣaye māsimāsi prāyaścittīyate tu saḥ || 133 ||
candrāśvine tu kṛṣṇāyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ yathāvidhi ||
kṛtvā snānādikaṃ karma sopavāso dinaṃ nayet ||134||
pradoṣasamaye lakṣmīṃ pūjayitvā yathāvidhi ||
dīpavṛkṣānyathā vṛkṣā~mllakṣmīprītyai samutsṛjet || || 135 ||
nadītīre girau goṣṭhe śmaśāne vṛkṣamūlataḥ ||
dvirbhojanamamāvāsyāṃ na kartavyaṃ kadācana ||
śarvaryāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa māghaphālgunayornaraiḥ ||137|| ||

aṃkurārpaṇakaṃ kṛtvā madhye kuryācca maṃḍalam || 1 ||
trihastā piṃḍikā kāryā caturasrā udakplavā ||

koṇe catuṣpadaṃ sthāpyaṃ catuṣkoṇe vibhāvayet || 4 ||
catuṣkoṇaṃ bahiḥ kuryātkoṇe cāpi catuṣṭayam ||
dvātriṃśacca bhavedbāhye cātaścāpi trayodaśa || 5 ||

madhye nava pade brahmā tasyāpyaṣṭau samīpagāḥ ||29||

padaikaṃ tu catuṣkoṇe eṣa vāstuvinirṇayaḥ ||
carakyādi tato hitvā catvāriṃśacca paṃcakam|| || 2.2.10.30 ||
aparaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vakṣye yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ ||
dvicatuṣkoṣṭhakairdikṣu yajetāryamaṇaṃ tataḥ ||
koṇeṣu koṣṭhadvaṃdveṣu bāhyādiparikīrtitam ||

kramādīśānaparyaṃtāṃ jayaṃtaḥ śakrabhāskarau ||
satyovṛṣāṃtarikṣau ca diśi prācyāmavasthitāḥ || 35 ||
agniḥ pūṣā ca vitadho yamaśca gṛharakṣakaḥ || gaṃ

ākṛṣṇeneti mantrasya svarṇa ṛṣijagatīchandaḥ savitraryamaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 41 || vivasvaṃtaṃ pītavarṇaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ śubham ||

trinetraṃ tribhujaṃ caiva śvetāṃbaradharaṃ śubham || 44 ||

prītaṃ mahīdharaṃ dhyāyedvṛṣabhopari saṃsthim||
sāvitrīṃ śvetavarṇāṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutām ||

śakraṃ dhyāyetpītavarṇaṃ śuklakairāvatasthitam ||
sarvadevaiḥ stūyamānaṃ dvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam ||51||

raktaśyāmāṃbaradharaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktavāsasam || 55 ||

koṇasūtrasyobhayataḥ śvetakoṣṭhadvaye punaḥ||

guhaṃ dhyāyetpītavarṇaṃ pītapadmāsanasthitama ||

dhyāyecca jambhakaṃ śvetaṃ dvibhujaṃ kuṭilānanam ||
devasya heti mantrasya paṃktiśchaṃdaḥ śacī devatā pilapicchaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 71 || pītāṃ ca carakīṃ dhyāyedraktamālyairalaṃkṛtām ||

raktāṃ ca pūtanāṃ dhyāyetpaṅkajasthāṃ suśobhanām ||
sarvābharaṇasaṃpannāṃ sarvālaṃkāraśobhitām || 76 ||

pūrvādidikṣu sarvāsu sārdhādyaṃtapadeṣu ca ||

dakṣiṇe paraśuṃ dhyāyedoṃkāraṃ ca tathāpare || 81||
jayantaṃ śvetaṃ śvetavṛṣabhārūḍhaṃ dhyātvā||

bhāskaraṃ raktadvibhujaṃ raktāśvasthaṃ dhyātvā māyābījena pūjayet ||85||
satyaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ śvetaṃ trinetraṃ pītavāsasaṃ mandakuṃdabījena pūjayet||
vṛṣaṃ pītaṃ vṛṣabhārūḍhamākāśabījena pūjayet ||86||
ṛkṣaṃ nīlaṃ caturbhujaṃ mahiṣārūḍham ||
ācchīma iti mantrasya hotā yakṣa ṛṣistriṣṭupchandaḥ śaṃkaro devatā ṛkṣaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 87 ||
agniṃ raktaṃ saptajihvaṃ raktavāsasaṃ piṅgākṣaṃ dhyātvā ||
agnidūtamiti maṃtrasya bharadvāja ṛṣistriṣṭucchandaḥ śaṃkaro devatā agniprītaye vini yogaḥ || 88 ||
vitathaṃ raktamajavāhanaṃ dvibhujaṃ dhyātvā gāyatryā pūjayet || 89 ||
gāyatryā viśvāmitra ṛṣirgāyatrīchandaḥ savitā devatā vitathaprītaye viniyogaḥ ||2.2.10.90||
yamaṃ kṛṣṇamahiṣārūḍhaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ dhyāyet ||
gṛhe kṣetraṃ raktamūrdhvakeśaṃ mahābhujaṃ raktavāsasaṃ dhyātvā vahnibījena pūjayet ||92|| gandharvaṃ śvetaṃ dvibhujaṃ padmāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā yamabījena pūjayet ||93||
bhṛṅgarājaṃ raktasiṃhāsanārūḍhaṃ divyayajñopavītinaṃ dhyāyet || 94 ||
hotā yasketi mantrasya bhārgava ṛṣirgāyatrīchando yaśo devatā bhṛṃgarājaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 95 ||
mṛgaṃ pītaṃ mṛgārūḍhaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā ||
nairṛtārddhapadeṣu ca ||
nirṛtiṃ pītaṃ śvetaṃ padmāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā ||
kaidācaneti mantrasya paṃktiśchandaḥ savitā devatā nirṛtiprītaye viniyogaḥ ||97|| nairṛtārddhapadeṣu ca dauvārikaṃ śvetaśarabhārūḍhaṃ trinetraṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ dhyātvā ||
śyāmaṃ sugrīvaṃ kṛṣṇameṣārūḍhaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā ||
puṣpadaṃtaṃ pītaṃ meṣārūḍhaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā ||
asuraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇamālyairalaṃkṛtaṃ kṛtvā ||
ākṛṣṇeti mantrasya hiraṇyavarṇa ṛṣirjagatī chandaḥ savitā devatā asuraprītaye viniyogaḥ || || 102 ||
asuraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nāgahārānvitaṃ padmāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā ||
rogaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nīlendīvaradharaṃ śvetavṛṣabhārūḍhaṃ dhyātvā ||
namaste rudra iti mantrasya nārada ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchandaḥ śrīrdevatā rogaprītaye viniyogaḥ || 104 ||
vāyukoṇādārabhya pūjayet ||
vāyuṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ dhvajahastaṃ mṛgārūḍhaṃ dhyātvā ||
śvetaṃ somaṃ śvetavarṇāsanasthaṃ dhyātvā bhadrabījena pūjayet || || 106 ||
raktaṃ bhallāṭaṃ pītavāsasaṃ dhyātvā vahnibījena pūjayet ||
pītavāsasamajavāhanaṃ hārakeyūrānvitaṃ vāyubījena maṃdarādyaiḥ pūjayet || || 107 || raktāṃ ditiṃ nāgahārānvitāṃ raktapadmāsanasthāṃ dhyātvā ||

aditiṃ pītavarṇāṃ siṃhārūḍhāṃ pītāṃbaradharāṃ dhyātvā ||

pūjākramavarṇanam
atha pūjākramaṃ vakṣye purāṇasmṛticoditam ||

ṣaṭsaptāṃgulikāṃ yoniṃ paścime mekhalopari ||
śrāddhaṃ vṛddhyātmakaṃ kuryātsaṃkalpaṃ mānasaṃ caret ||
śrāddhārthaṃ naiva saṃkalpettathā vai devadarśane || 7 ||
gayāśrāddhārthakaṃ cāṣṭatīrthaśrāddhārthameva ca ||

pitṛvaiśvānaropetaṃ kuṭilabhrūpaśobhitam ||

jayā ca vijayā caiva satyā māyā śivāṃbikā ||
hāsinī kāminī caitā dalamūleṣu bhāvayet || 27 |
puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ dadyādvāstoṣpataya ityapi ||
arghyamaṃtreṇa gaṃdhādyaiḥ pūjayedbhūtimicchatā ||28||
vāstoṣpate bhava mate iti dhyātvā ṛtaṃ ceti maṃtreṇa pūjayet ||
ṛṣirnārāyaṇaśchando gāyatrī parikīrtitam || 29 ||
sūryaśca devatā khyātaḥ prīṇitaḥ kuliśāyudhaḥ ||
sūryaṃ raktāsanārūḍhaṃ dvibhujaṃ raktavāsasam || 2.2.11.30 ||
evaṃ dhyātvā tu matimānhaṃsaṃ samaṃtramīśvaram||31||
haṃsasya iti maṃtrasya ṛṣirautathya īritaḥ ||
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||34||
uddharṣaṇa iti maṃtreṇa kṛṣṇapuṣpairathārcayet ||
satyavrata ṛṣiścāsya triṣṭupchando.asya devatā ||
savitā caiva vijñeyaḥ prītaye ca vṛṣasya ca ||35||
śulkavarṇaṃ tathākāśamṛṣṭisaṃghaiśca saṃstutam ||
ghaṭasthaṃ dvibhujaṃ dhyāyedgadāpadmavidhāriṇam ||36||
ṛṣiḥ syātkardamo viprāśchando jāgatikā tathā ||
devatā ca bhaveccāgnirākāśaprītaye nyaset ||37||
dvibhujaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ ca vāyuṃ dhyātvā prapūjayet||38||

sadasaṃpadṛṣiḥ karṇo virāḍiti udāhṛtaḥ ||
kuśapuṣpodakenāpi devatīrthena sattamāḥ ||
chando.atha devī gāyatrī devatā gaṇanāyakaḥ || 22 ||
kīśādagniṃ samādāya me gṛhṇāmīti saṃpaṭhan ||
me gṛhṇāmīti maṃtrasya ṛṣirgautama īritaḥ ||
chandonuṣṭupsamākhyātaṃ vāmadevo.atha devatā || 23 ||
mantreṇānena matimāndakṣiṇasyāṃ vinikṣipet || 24 ||
asya mantrasya hārīta ṛṣiḥ syācchanda iṣyate ||
āvāhanaṃ tataḥ kuryātsaṃsarakṣeti saṃjapan||
saṃsarakṣeti maṃtrasya ṛṣirnīla udāhṛtaḥ ||
virāṭ chando.atha vijñeyo devatā ca śatakratuḥ || 26 ||
vaiśvānara iti ṛcā agnisthāpanamīritam||
maṃtramācāti prīṇāti ṛṣiḥ syātkāśyapaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
badhnāsīti ca maṃtreṇa agniṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇam ||
ṛṣiḥ svayaṃbhūrākhyāto virāṭchanda udāhṛtam ||
brahmayajñānṛcā dogdhrī dhenuriti tvṛcā ||2.2.13.30||
śakro.asya trāyatāmeti śṛṇu ṛgbhyāmṛṣīdvijāḥ ||31||
prajāpatirṛṣiśchandastriṣṭubdevo.atha śaṃkaraḥ ||
nāradaśca ṛṣiśchandastriṣṭubdevaḥ śacīpatiḥ || 32 ||
praṇītā sthāpanaṃ kuryāddina ehīti saṃjapan|| 33 ||
mantrasya ca ṛṣiśchando vāmadevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
śrīparṇīsahakārotthaṃ varuṇasya viśeṣataḥ ||

dvyaṃgule carakākāyāmāsāsandevakarmaṇi || 36 ||

dvādaśāṃgulaprastāraṃ taijasaṃ mānavarjitam||
imaṃ me varuṇenarcā praṇītāmatha pūrayet || 38 ||
sāgarā atha prīyaṃtāmitthamādhyānamācaret ||
kayā naścitra ityṛcā nāgaḥ prīṇāti sattamāḥ || 2.2.13.40 ||
asya maṃtrasya ca ṛṣirbharadvāja udāhṛtaḥ ||
chando.anuṣṭubdevatā ca īśānaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 41 ||
prayojanādikaṃ dravyaṃ tata āsādayetkramāt ||
dakṣiṇādi uttarāṃtaṃ dhuvāsa ityṛcāpi ca || 42 ||
ṛṣiḥ syānnāradaśchandonuṣṭupcaivātha devatā ||
śatakratuśca prīṇāti yojayedatha sādarāt || 43 ||
