dakṣiṇe caiva āpūpaṃ bhṛṃgarājaṃ tathaiva ca ||
panasaṃ nārikelaṃ ca modakaṃ laḍḍukaṃ tathā ||
praṇītāṃ ca digvidikṣu sthāpayedavicārayan || 46 ||
praṇītāṃ na spṛśejjātu homakāle kathaṃcana ||
snānakuṃbhaṃ ca bho viprā yāvadyāgaḥ pravartate || 47 ||
uccīrakaṃ mātuliṃgaṃ dūrvāṃ dhātrīphalāni ca ||
tulasīmālatījātī jalajāni viśeṣataḥ || 48 ||
aiśānyāṃ sthāpayetsarvaṃ yacca vai kaṃkatīmayam ||
nairṛtyeti viśeṣoyaṃ yacca vaikaṃkatī śamī || 49 ||

pavivacchedanakuśaiśchiṃdyātprādeśikaṃ punaḥ ||

viṣṇo rarāṭamaṃtreṇa chedayedagrabhāgataḥ ||
pāyasena kāṭhinena pramathnīyātkadācana || 52 ||
na rasena na kārṣṇena na dṛḍhena kadācana ||
tāmreṇa bhasmanā cātha śuktiśaṃkhena vāgyataḥ ||53||
chedayetpiñjulīṃ cāpi pavitramatha deśikaḥ||

praṇītābhājanaṃ gṛhya prokṣaṇīṃ pūrayettribhiḥ || 55 ||
vāmahastatale paścātsthāpayetprokṣaṇīyakam || 56 ||
madhyamāmadhyamāṃguṣṭha apāmārgeṇa maṃtribhiḥ ||
ṛṣiḥ syādgautamaśchando dharmarājo.atha devatā ||
sakṛddravye tribhiḥ kāṣṭhaistrivāraṃ maṃtrapuṣpakaiḥ ||
sthirasthāne tu saṃprāptapraṇītāyāśca dakṣiṇe || 59 ||
prādeśāṃtarataścaiva ājyasthālīmathārpayet ||
agrato maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā vahniṃ vipre tu sthāpayet || 2.2.13.60 ||
dyūtaṃ niḥsārayettattu nirūpyāśu krameṇa tu ||
īśāneti ca maṃtreṇa adhiśrapaṇamīritam ||61||
ṛṣirnārāyaṇaśchandaḥ paṃktirīśo.atha devatā||
avekṣya īśamārabhya dakṣiṇāvartakena tu ||
kulāyanīti maṃtreṇa ṛṣicchandādikaṃ smaran || 63 ||
pariveṣyājyasthālīṃ ca triḥ sakṛdvā samāhitaḥ ||
pitarastṛpyatāmiti saṃskāre mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ || 64 ||
ṛṣiḥ syājjamadagniśca gāyatrī chanda īritam ||
devatā ca pinākī syādagniṣṭome ca yojayet || 65 ||
ṣaḍaṃgulaṃ sruvaṃ paścādgṛhītvāgnau pratapya ca || 66 ||
trirātraṃ tu mahāyoge sakṛdanyatra sattamāḥ ||
saṃmārjayetkuśenāpi mūlādagraṃ tu secayet || 67 ||
agrānmūlaṃ punaḥ kuryātsaṃpūjya ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
ājyapātraṃ puraskṛtya pavitraṃ ca samāharet ||69||
aṃguṣṭhe dve anāme tu gṛhṇīyāttatpavitrakam ||
aṣṭāṃgulaṃ madhyakṛtvo ghṛtaṃ triḥ pavanaṃ caret ||2.2.13.70||
pātāle tristathākāśe avekṣyājyaṃ tatastribhiḥ ||
prokṣaṇyāṃ ca tathā kuryādadhaḥ saṃprokṣya deśikaḥ || 71 ||
tūṣṇīṃ dadyāttathā cāgnau sanniveśena tattvataḥ || 72 ||
sapavitraṃ dakṣakare gṛhītvā prokṣaṇīyakam ||
aṣṭāṃgule mūlabhāge tajjalena īśāditaḥ || 73||
agniṃ paryukṣayetpaścāddakṣiṇāvartakena ca ||
pavitraṃ ca praṇītāyāṃ nidhāya prokṣaṇīyakam || 74 ||
saṃyāvārthaṃ ca bho viprā agnivattatra deśikaḥ ||
sruvaṃ gṛhītvā juhuyāttūṣṇīmeva samāhitaḥ || 76 ||
aṃte ca devatoddeśaṃ prājāpatyaṃ samīrayan ||
praṇavāṃtena juhuyātsarvatra dvijasattamāḥ || 77 ||
vāyukoṇaṃ samārabhya vahnikoṇāntakena tu ||
agnīṣomātmakaṃ caiva juhuyādrākṣasāditaḥ ||
aiśānakoṇaparyaṃtaṃ tato naimittikaṃ caret || 79 ||
paścātsviṣṭaṃ tato dadyāddadyācca matibhistathā ||
vāruṇaṃ pañcakaṃ caiva kṛtvā pūrṇāṃ tato labhet || 2.2.13.80 ||
udvāha iti maṃtra sya atharvaṇa ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
chaṃdo devī ca gāyatrī devataṃ cāpi vāruṇam || 81 ||
tvannogna iti maṃtrasya ṛṣirvāśiṣṭhasaṃjñakaḥ ||
chaṃdaśca bṛhatī khyātaṃ tadevāgniḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 82 ||
iḍo gatamiti mantrasya ṛṣiḥ ko guhyasaṃjñakaḥ ||
chandaśca jagatī khyātaṃ devo viṣṇuḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 83 ||
udvartana iti maṃtrasya ṛṣiḥ ko nu prakīrtitaḥ ||
chando devī ca gāyatrī varuṇaścādhidevatā ||84||
kuśakaṇḍīṃ svagṛhyena kṛtvāgniṃ cārcayettataḥ || 1 ||
āghārājyabhāgau tu mahāvyāhṛtayastrayaḥ ||
sarvaṃ prāyaścittasaṃjñakaṃ prājāpatyaṃ ca sviṣṭakṛt || 2 ||
prājāpatye ca indrāya etāvāghārasaṃjñakau || 3 ||
bhūrbhuvaḥsvastrayaścaiva mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||4||
sarvaprāyaścittasaṃjñā ete vai pañca maṃtrakāḥ || 5 ||
prājāpatyāhutiścaikā sviṣṭakṛccāparā smṛtā ||
caturdaśaitāḥ kṛtayo hotavyā nityasaṃjñakāḥ || 6 ||
kṛtvā sakṛddevatoddeśaṃ homaṃ paścātsamācaret ||
naimittikaṃ vinā nityaṃ viphalaṃ yāti nānyathā || || 8 ||
hasādhyādiyāgeṣu yannideśaṃ śṛṇu dvijāḥ || 9 ||
ekāhe vāghārārajyau kṛtvā naimittikīṃ kṛtīḥ ||
samā sviṣṭakṛtaṃ vidyādākṛtyādyāstataḥ param || 2.2.14.10 ||
viśeṣatastryahādau tu aghārāvājyapūrvakam ||
āghārārājyapūrveṇa tato naimittikaṃ caret ||
sviṣṭakṛdvyāhṛtiścaiva vāruṇādyāstathā hi ṣaṭ || 12 ||
dvijātīnāṃ vivāhe tu naityikaṃ prathamaṃ bhavet ||
dadyādekaṃ ca nityaṃ ca pṛthaṅ nityaṃ na cācaret ||
paryagnikaraṇe caiva udvāhe mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ || 17 ||
candrādityau cotpavane vīkṣaṇe ca diśastathā ||
prokṣaṇyāṃ sthāpane durgā ime lakṣmī pratiṣṭhitā || 18 ||
homaṃ kuryāddvijaśreṣṭhā vidhiṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥ||
eteṣu devatāḥ proktā dvijātīnāṃ hitāya ca||19||
devatāḥ sarvā jñātavyā etā yajñe samāhitaiḥ ||2.2.14.20||
adhidaivena jānīyātkaravalyāṃ paṃcaphalaṃ yataḥ||
atha vakṣyāmi saccaiṣāṃ devānāṃ dhyānamuttamam ||
asya yajñe parijñānājjihvā samyakphalapradā ||1||
hiraṇyavarṇāṃ prathamāṃ vahnijihvāṃ mahādyutim ||
kanakāḍhyakarāṃ devīṃ hiraṇyākhyeṣṭasiddhaye || 2 ||
kanakāṃ dvibhujāṃ śuklāṃ hastābhyāṃ darbhasaṃyutām ||
kamaṃḍaluṃ ca bibhrāṇāṃ numaḥ sādhakasiddhidām || 3 ||
śaṃkhacakrābhayavarāndadhatīṃ praṇamāmyaham || 4 ||
bhinnāṃjanacayaprakhyāṃ svarṇakuṃbhaṃ tu vāmataḥ ||
dakṣiṇena varāraktāṃ dhārayaṃtīṃ namāmyaham || 9 ||
suprabhāmaṇḍalābhā ca karābhyāṃ tatkṛtāñjaliḥ ||
japākusumasaṃkāśā bahurūpā sakhe mama ||
śubhadā syādbhujaiḥ śubhrā sahasraṃ dadhatī parān || 7 ||
japāpuṣpadhare nityaṃ satīrūpe prasīda me || 8 ||
mūlena vīkṣayetsthānaṃ maṃtreṇa khananaṃ matam ||
trisūtrīkaraṇaṃ kuryāccatuḥsūtraṃ nipātayet || 9 || ||
pratiṣṭhāyāḥ pūrvadine kuryāddevādhivāsanam ||
dhānyapratiṣṭhāṃ tasyaiva yūpaṃ cāpi yathāvidhi || 1 ||
rātrau mūlāgre ca ghaṭe sthāpayedgaṇanāyakam ||
saṃpūjya ca vidhānena digīśāṃśca tathā grahān || 2 ||
brahmāṇaṃ ca taḍāgeṣu varuṇaṃ śāntiyāgake ||
somaṃ ca maṃḍale sūryaṃ pāde viṣṇuṃ tathaiva ca || 3 ||
śaive śaivaṃ tathā proktaṃ prapāyāmatha vāruṇam ||
ārāme caiva brahmāṇaṃ pādyādyairapi cārcayet || 4 ||
sunābheti ca maṃtreṇa dvābhyāmeva viśiṣyate ||
kāṃḍāditi ca maṃtreṇa dadyāddūrvāśataṃ tataḥ ||
siṃdoriveti siṃdūraṃ viśvāmiti ca mārjanam || 7 ||
samicchetyañjanaṃ dadyādduḥsthaṃ surāsurā japan ||
adyaiva tena maṃtreṇa sthāpayedatha vāriṇā || 9 ||
yogaṃ yogadṛḍhaṃ japtvā pavitraṃ vinyasettataḥ || 11 ||
dvābhyāṃ tailagaṃdhayutaṃ śrīsūktenāpi puṣpakam || 12 ||
anumīmahatāti dadyāddūrvākṣataṃ tataḥ || 13 ||

sunātīti vaco dadyāttataścāvāhayetprabhum ||
tatrādhivāsanaṃ kuryādrakṣayecca surakṣibhiḥ ||17||
ācāryo yajamānaśca ṛtvigbhojanamācaret ||
akṣāralavaṇānyāsī dadhi viśvaṃ tilāṃstyajet ||18||
ādhāraṇaṃ cādhivāsaṃ vakṣye tatrānusārataḥ ||
pañcabhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ gandharvā iti vismaran ||
dadyādgandhaṃ tailayutaṃ gandhadvāretyṛcā punaḥ || 2.2.16.20 ||
yāḥ phalinīti ca phalaṃ pūgatānāmavarjanam ||
kauśikīruttamosīti dadyātkhaḍgaṃ sutīkṣṇakam || 21 ||
śrīśca te iti kusumaṃ viśvānīti ca saṃpaṭhan || 22 ||
nirmathanaṃ tataḥ kāryamiti sādhāraṇo vidhiḥ ||
vinādhivāsanaṃ viprāḥ pratiṣṭhānaṃ samācaret ||
na tatphalamavāpnoti vivāhe śaraṇaṃ diśet || 24 ||
tataḥ prayatnataḥ kāryaṃ pūrvāhne rātriyogataḥ ||
nitye naimittike kāmye kārayetkuṇḍamaṇḍapam || 25 ||
sthaṃḍile hasta mātreṇa vālukānirmite.api ca ||
ekaikāṃgulako viprāḥ pīṭhe nāsti vicāraṇā ||

kāṣṭhaṃ pattraṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca modakaṃ piṣṭakaṃ tathā || 28 ||

śaive yavāditaḥ kāryā śākte puṣpādito bhavet ||
sūrye pakṣe piṣṭakādi gopāle kṛśarāditaḥ || 2.2.16.30 ||
kṛṣṇe ca karavīrādi śrīphalāni ca traipure ||
sārasvate ca śrīvṛkṣe mokṣakāme nigadyate || 31 || ||
aṣṭau hotāro dvārapālāthāṣṭau aṣṭau kāryā brāhmaṇā yājakāśca ||
sarve śuddhā lakṣitā lakṣaṇādyairekaḥ kāryo jāpakosminmahātmā || 1 ||

āvāpyaistu dviguṇairvai balīyo divyairvastrairarhaṇādakṣiṇābhiḥ || 2 ||

pradadyādarhaṇaṃ samyakpaścātpātraṃ nivedayet ||
pratyekaṃ brāhmaṇā yajñe vedamantreṣu pāragāḥ ||
ācāryo yadi kāryeṣu varayeddaśa govrajān || 6 ||

gotrādikīrtanāṃteṣu svanāmoddeśamīrayan || 8 ||
tulāpuruṣadāne ca tathā ca hāṭakācale ||

śūdrasaṃskārakaścaiva kṛpaṇo gaṇayājakaḥ ||

śūdragehanivāsī ca śūdrapreraka eva ca ||

nārāyaṇasvarūpeṇa yajñaṃ me saphalaṃ kuru ||

māṃgalyaṃ karmaṇāṃ nityaṃ sarvajñaṃ jñānarūpi ṇam ||
pālaya tvaṃ diśaḥ sarvā vidiśaśca tathā imam ||
dikpālarūpiṇaṃ vipraṃ yajñasiddhau namā myaham ||
na saṃkalpaṃ caredyāgaṃ vrataṃ devārcanaṃ tathā || 32 ||

ākāśe nikṣipedyāge vrate īśepi nityake ||
śuktikāṃsyādihastaiśca tāmraraupyādibhistathā||

ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyādājyena ca yathākram ||
karālī dhūmalī śvetā lohitā kanakaprabhā || 19 ||
atiraktā padmarāgā vahnijihvā prakīrtitāḥ ||
tāsāṃ maṃtrāḥ krameṇaiva sādivāsāṃta bindavaḥ || 2.3.1.20 ||
yakārasthāśca vijñeyā aṣṭasvaravibhūṣitāḥ ||
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyāddattvā caiva samāhitaḥ ||
agnīṣomaṃ tathendraṃ ca pṛthivīmantarikṣakam || 22 ||
sthālīpākena juhuyānmadhukṣīrayavānvitam ||
ekaikāmāhutiṃ teṣāṃ samuddiśya pṛthakpṛthak || 23 ||
japasva tvaṃ mahābhāga śraddhayā caiva vāgyataḥ || 24 ||
maṅgalaṃ paramānnaṃ ca saurasūktaṃ tathā japet || 25 ||
tataḥ saṃmṛjya vidhinā snāpayitvā yathāvidhi ||
yūpaṃ garbhe vinikṣipya tatra kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||26||
dhvajānāropya prāṃteṣu dadyātsomaṃ vanaspatim ||
ko.adāditi paṭhitvā ca vṛkṣāṇāṃ karṇavedhanam ||27||
sūcyā sutīkṣṇayā kāryaṃ dvipātre vāmadakṣiṇe ||
navagrahāṇāṃ tṛptyarthaṃ yāvakaṃ laḍḍukaṃ tathā || 28 ||
piṣṭakaṃ ca pṛthagdadyātkumārībālakeṣu ca ||
niśāraṃjitasūtreṇa saṃveṣṭya ca sacūrṇakam || 29||
pradadyāddohakaṃ caiva vṛkṣāṇāṃ vidhipūrvakam ||
prāśayeccaiva tānvṛkṣānimaṃ mantramudāharet || 2.3.1.30 ||
vṛkṣāgrātpatitasyāpi ārohātpatitasya ca||
maraṇe vāsthibhaṅge vā kartā pāpairna lipyate ||31||
dhenuṃ suvarṇaṃ dhānyaṃ ca ācāryāya pradakṣiṇam||
dattvā ca ṛtvije dadyātsuvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā || 32 ||
dhānyaṃ ca brahmaṇe dadyādghṛtabhojyaṃ saśarkaram ||
iṣṭāṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsadasyāya tathaiva ca || 33 ||
adhikalaśaṃ samānīya snānaṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ ||
kṛtvā caivāniśaṃ kuryāddadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ tathā ||34||
sarvauṣadhyudakaṃ prokṣya trivāraṃ kṣīradhārayā ||
saṃveṣṭya triścaturvāraṃ brahmaghoṣapuraḥsaram || || 35 ||
taṃtau viśeṣaṃ vakṣyāmi varā evedamityṛcā || 36 ||
balaṃ kāmaṃ hayagrīvaṃ mādhavaṃ puruṣottamam||
vāsudevaṃ dhanādhyakṣaṃ tato nārāyaṇaṃ yajet||37||
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā dakṣiṇe pṛthivīṃ yajet||38||
śuddhakāṃñcanavarṇābhāṃ varābhayakarāṃ śubhām ||
maṃḍūkasthāṃ ca dvibhujāṃ sarvālaṅkārasundarīm ||39||
syonā pṛthivīti mantreṇa pūjayitvā yathāvidhi ||
pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ baliṃ dadyātsaśarkaram || 2.3.1.40 ||
vāmato viśvakarmāṇaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibham ||
śūlaṭaṃkadharaṃ śāṃtaṃ saṃyajedupacārakaiḥ || 41 ||
viśvanniti ṛcā taṃ ca baliṃ ca madhu piṣṭakam ||
dadyājjapecca kauṣmāṇḍaṃ sūktaṃ pauruṣameva ca |||45|||
ekaikaṃ homayetpaścā tpṛthivīhomakarmaṇi ||43||
picchile patitānāṃ ca ucchritenāṃgasaṃgataḥ || 44 ||
ye cātra prāṇinaḥ saṃti rakṣāṃ kurvati setavaḥ ||
gartaṃ kṛtvā pañcaratnaṃ saṃsthāpyaṃ tadanantaram ||
saṃsthāpya ca tato yūpaṃ saṃpūjya ca yathāvidhi || 47 ||
ācāryāya tato dadyādiṣṭāṃ ca varadakṣiṇām ||
pūjayeddvijadāṃpatyaṃ lājābhiḥ paripūjitam || 48 ||
poṭikāṃ ca tataḥ śayyāṃ dadyādiṣṭārthasiddhaye ||
setau vṛkṣa sthitā ye syū ropayetkadalīṃ śubhām || 49 ||
teṣāṃ pārśvadvayepyevamārāme ca pṛthakpṛthak || 2.3.1.50 || ||
gopracāravaiśiṣṭyavarṇanam
gopracāraṃ punarvakṣye viśeṣaṃ tatra me śṛṇu ||
yajedviṣṇuṃ sala kṣmīkamupacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 1 ||
upacāraiśca brahmāṇaṃ rudraṃ caiva karālikām ||
varāhaṃ somasūrye ca mahādevaṃ yathākramam || 2 ||
homaṃ caiva yathā viṣṇoḥ kamalāyāstrayaṃtrayam ||
ājyena kṣetrapālānāmanyeṣāṃ madhumiśritaiḥ || 3 ||
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyāllājādiṣu pṛthakpṛthak ||
samutsṛjya vidhānena yūpaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet || 4 ||
trihastamāttraṃ racitaṃ kuryānnāgaphaṇānvitam ||
lājāsaṃyuktavidhinā viśveṣāmiti sañjapan ||
mayi gṛbhṇāmīti sampūjya yūpaṃ ca rudradaivatama || 7 ||
saṃpūjya rudraṃ pañcāṃgaṃ dhānyaṃ vastraṃ ca dakṣiṇām ||
ācāryāya tathā hotre anyeṣāmiṣṭadakṣiṇām || 8 ||
gopracāre ca śaileyaṃ yūpaṃ hastadvayānvitam ||
pañcaśīrṣānvitaṃ kuryāddhastamātraṃ praropayet || 9 ||
yūpaṃ ca caitravṛkṣaṃ ca kuṇḍalīmaṭhapīṭhikām ||
saṃspṛśyācamya vai viprāḥ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati || 2.3.2.10 ||
caturhastapramāṇena śatakuṇḍena saṃmitam ||
tadardhaṃ ca kaniṣṭhena aṣṭakāṣṭādhikaṃ bhavet || 11 ||
śivalokastathā gāvaḥ sarvadevasupūjitāḥ || 12 ||
gobhya eṣā mayā bhūmiḥ sampradattā śubhārthinā ||
yāvaṃti tṛṇagulmāni saṃti bhūmau śubhāni ca || 14 ||
pūrve sīmāṃ nibadhnīyātkṛtvā vṛkṣasya ropaṇam || 15 ||
setuṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇataḥ paścimeṃgāraropaṇam ||
uttare khānayetkūpaṃ tasya sīmāṃ na laṃghayeta||16||
tataḥ sahasradhārāṃ ca śasyena paripūritām ||
na kuryādagnidigbhāge dakṣiṇāṃ vā tataḥ śubhām || 18 ||
kulāni pātayatyāśu brahmahatyāśca viṃdati || 19 ||
yāvattṛṇāni tadbhūmau saptasaṃkhyāni saṃkhyayā || 2.3.2.20 ||
tāvatkālaṃ vasetsvarge viṣṇulokānna taccyutiḥ || 21 ||
vṛṣotsargā vasāne tu pradadyādyo mahīṃ dvijāḥ ||
na yāti viprāḥ pretatvaṃ tasmādviprādamatsarāḥ || 23 ||
tatra mānaṃ pṛthakcaiva śṛṇutātra samāgatāḥ ||
gavāṃ śataṃ vṛṣaścaiko yatra tiṣṭhatyayaṃtritaḥ ||
yāvatkālāvadhe sīmā atīte nāsti pātakam || 26 ||
maṇḍapaṃ pūjayetsūryaṃ vāsudevasamanvitam||
homastila guḍābhyāṃ ca aṣṭāvaṣṭau pṛthakpṛthak || 27 ||
yatnasiddhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śulkaghaṭacatuṣṭayam|| 28 ||
samutsṛjejjapetpaścātsauraṃ sūktaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ||
vaṭapatre tu saṃlikhya citraṃ nirmāya vā punaḥ || 29 ||
dikpālānsaṃnyasetsvāsu svāsu dikṣu vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
baddhāñjaliḥ paṭhenmaṃtrāniṃdrādīnāṃ yathākramam || 2.3.2.30 ||
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya ātmano vibhavāya ca ||
bho vahne meṣavāhastvaṃ catuḥśṛṃgavirājita ||
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi || 32 ||
yama tvaṃ dakṣiṇāśeśa mahāmahiṣavāhana ||
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi || 33 ||
mañcastho rākṣasendrastvaṃ khaḍgapāṇirmahābalaḥ ||
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi || 34 ||
vārirāṭ dhvajahasto.asi pavano mṛgavāhanaḥ ||
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi || 35 ||
dhanādhyakṣo gadāhastaḥ piṃgākṣo naravāhanaḥ ||
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi || 36 ||
ādidevosi devānāṃ kartā hartā maheśvaraḥ ||
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatastrātumarhasi || 37 ||
anaṃto nāgarājo yo dharāmuddhṛtya tiṣṭhati ||
anāthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvaṃ hi dharmatasrātumarhasi || 38 ||
caturṇāmeva varṇānāṃ sthityarthaṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām ||
prītaye vāsudevasya evaṃ maṇḍapamutsṛjet || 39 ||
bhagne stambhe tṛṇe jīrṇe punastṛṇapradāpane ||
sthāpane ca tathaivāsya pratiṣṭhā syādyathākṣayā || 2.3.2.40 ||
ghātāpāyādidoṣeṇa mriyaṃte yadi jantavaḥ ||
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ tu dharmo me syānna pātakam || 41 ||
mānuṣāḥ paśavo ye ca nivasantīha maṇḍape ||
svasti cāstu sadā teṣāṃ tvatprasādātkila prabho || 42 ||
tatastriguṇasūtreṇa sutrāmāṇeti vai ṛcā ||
saptadhā veṣṭayitvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ saṃprakāśya ca || 43 ||
maṇḍape bhojayedviprāṃsteṣāṃ dadyādyathepsitān || || 44 ||
dīnebhyaśca pṛthagdadyādgṛhaṃ viprapuraḥsaram ||
praviśettūryaghoṣeṇa prakuryācca gṛhārcanam || 45 ||
evaṃ prapāyāṃ vijñeyo viśeṣo varuṇaṃ vrajet ||
vāsudevena sahitaṃ sāṃgopāṃgaṃ sadakṣiṇam || 46 ||
sthālīpākavidhānena prakuryāddeśikottamaḥ ||
ācāryāya gṛhaṃ dadyātparicchedasamanvitam || 47 ||
ṛtvije tāmrapātraṃ ca jalapūrṇaṃ ca dhānyakam ||
dikpālāndvāradeśe tu kūpayāge viśeṣataḥ || 48 ||
brahmāṇaṃ nāgarājānaṃ dvārapālau ca paścime ||
balidānaṃ vidhānena kṛtvā dadyādyathāvidhi ||
patākānāmatastattvaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathākramam || 2.3.2.50 ||
vajrī ca dhūmalī kṛṣṇā pītā caivātha vāruṇī ||
śīghrā gaurī umā caiva pītā śuklā prakīrtitā ||51||
kuṃbheṣu pūjayeddevānmaheśaṃ prathamaṃ budhaḥ ||
grahāṃśca madhyakalaśe brahmāṇaṃ ca tataḥ param || 52 ||
dakṣiṇe kalaśe viṣṇuṃ karṇikāyāṃ jaleśvaram || 53 ||
saṃpūjya vaṭapatre ca nāgānsaṃlikhya nāgajaiḥ || 54 ||
yo nāgāstānpravakṣyāmi anaṃto vāsukistathā ||
puṃḍarīkadalābhāsa śubhakarṇāṃtalocana ||
phaṇāsahasrasaṃyukta śaṃkhābjakṛtalocana || 56 ||
sarvanāgasya śūrasya kṛtasvastikalāṃchana ||
śaṃkhapāla iti khyāta jalādhārapratīkṣaka ||
atipīta suvarṇābha candrārdhāṃkitamastaka ||
dīptabhogakṛtāṭopa śubhalakṣaṇalakṣita || 61 ||
yaḥ suvarṇena varṇena padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ ||
paṃcabiṃdukṛtābhogo grīvāyāmekaśekharaḥ ||
nāginyo nāgakanyāśca tathā nāgakumārakāḥ ||
sarve te prītamanasaḥ pūjāṃ gṛhṇaṃtu me sadā || 64 ||
svagṛhyoktena vidhinā kṛtvāgnisthāpanaṃ budhaḥ ||
ājyaṃ saṃskṛtya juhuyāddigīśānāṃ yathākramam || 65 ||
ādityādigrahāṃścaiva brahmāṇaṃ kṛṣṇameva ca ||
madhupiṣṭena ca śivaṃ varuṇaṃ juhuyāttataḥ || 66 ||
prādeśamātraṃ saṃprokṣya yūpaṃ cāsya pramāṇakam ||
caturasraṃ śūlayuktaṃ gaṇānānīya pūjayet || 67 ||
kūpe nikṣipya tānnāgānpañcaratnaṃ kṣipettataḥ ||
sutrāmāṇeti maṃtreṇa tridhā saṃveṣṭya sūtrakaiḥ || 68 ||
rañjitaḥ kadalīvṛkṣaṃ varuṇāya samutsṛjet ||
trātāramiti maṃtreṇa vastramālyena bhūṣayet ||
karṇavedhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā utsṛjedvākyamuccaran || 69 ||
oṃ adyetyādi sarvabhūtebhyaḥ phalapuṣpapatracchāyāvṛtamukhyanānātaruviracitamārāmaṃ vanaspatidevataṃ supūjitaṃ vedavyāsādyuktaphalāvāptaye amukaṛṣisagotraḥ amukadeva śarmāhamutsṛje ||)
mahotsavaṃ tataḥ kuryātkṛtvā baddhāñjaliḥ paṭhet ||
vṛkṣāgrātpatitasyāpi ārohātpatitasya vā || 2.3.2.70 ||
maraṇe cāsthibhaṃge vā kartā pāpairna lipyate ||
vajrāghātādidoṣeṇa mriyaṃte taravo yadā || 71 ||
taddośamanārthāya tasyāpyetatpratiṣṭhitam ||
madhye yūpaṃ samāropya catuṣko ṇepi yatnataḥ || 72 ||
madhulājākṣataṃ dadyādañjanaṃ mālyameva ca ||
niśāsūtreṇa saṃveṣṭya kadalīviṭapaṃ nyaset || 73 ||
veṣṭayetkṣīradhārāṃ ca pātayedghṛtadhārayā ||
toyānvitaṃ gucchayuktaṃ veṣṭayetsvagṛhaṃ vrajet|| 74 || ||
kṣudrārāmapratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
kṣudrārāmapratiṣṭhāṃ ca vakṣye vai dvijasattamāḥ ||
sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tatra viṣṇuṃ somaṃ samarcayet ||
ācāryamātraṃ varayenniśāsūtraiḥ praveṣṭayet|| 2 ||
vṛkṣānmālyairalaṃkṛtya bhūṣayedbhūṣaṇādinā ||
karṇavedhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā utsṛjedvākyapūrvakam || 4 ||
dadyādyūpaṃ madhyadeśe ropayetkadalīṃ tataḥ ||
raṃbhāśca ropayeddikṣu sthālīpākavidhānataḥ || 5 ||
aṣṭāvaṣṭau ca juhuyādanyeṣāṃ ca ghṛtena tu ||
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyātsviṣṭakṛttadanaṃtaram || 6 ||
dakṣiṇāṃ ca tato dadyātpūrṇāṃ dattvāhutiṃ vrajet ||7||
ekādivṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ vidhiṃ vakṣye dvijottamāḥ ||
vṛkṣamūle yajeddharmaṃ pṛthivī ca viśaṃ tathā ||
digīśāṃśca tathā yakṣānācāryaṃ toṣayettataḥ || 9 ||
dhenuṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāddohadaṃ vṛkṣapūjanam ||
kṣudrārāmapratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
athāśvatthapratiṣṭhāyāṃ mūle bāhupramāṇake||
sthaṃḍilaṃ kārayettatra caṃdanenokṣitaṃ tathā ||1||
pūrvedyu rātrisamaye tadviṣṇoriti vai ṛcā||2||
sthāpayedvāriṇā pūrṇaṃ kayā neti ca gandhakam ||
dadyāddūrvākṣataṃ kalpe brāhmaṇatrayabhojanama ||
kārayetsitasūtraiśca veṣṭayeccandanokṣitaiḥ ||4||
kuṃbhe vināyakaṃ pūjya brahmāṇaṃ ca pare ghaṭam ||
svadikṣu dikpatīṃścaiva vṛkṣamūle navagrahān ||5|
maṃḍale śivamabhyarcya pīṭhapūjāpuraḥsaram ||
atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śvetaṃ vṛṣabhameva ca || 6 ||
dvibhujaṃ śūlahastaṃ ca sarvābharaṇasaṃyutam||
āropayetsvasāmarthyādbhūtaśuddhiṃ samācaret ||7||
tatorghyapātraṃ kṛtvā tu pīṭhapūjāṃ samācaret||
gaṇeśaṃ gurupādaṃ ca jayaṃ bhadraṃ samāhitaḥ||8||
madhye ādhāraśaktiṃ ca kūrmānaṃtau sapadmakau||
candrasūryāgnikādīnāṃ maṃḍalāni kramādyajet||9||
punaḥ pātrāṃtarasthaṃ ca gṛhītvā kusumaṃ budhaḥ ||
pāṇikacchapikāṃ kṛtvā dhyāyedvai varuṇaṃ tathā ||2.3.4.10||
madhuparkaṃ cāsanaṃ ca pṛcchecca svāgataṃ punaḥ || 11 ||
mudrāṃ pradarśya vidhivadaṃgapūjāṃ samācaret ||
pūrvādipatre indrādīnbrahmāṇaṃ madhyato yajet || 12 ||
anaṃtaṃ purataścaiva teṣāmastrāṇi tadbahiḥ ||
madhye toyādhipaṃ rudraṃ śāṃtaṃ caiva praśāṃtakam || 13 ||
kāmaṃ dharmamadharmaṃ ca dikṣu nārā yaṇaṃ śivam || 14 || ||
nairṛte ca yajeddurgāṃ pārśvayośca śatakratum ||
vināyakaṃ ca viṣṇuṃ ca gaṅgāṃ pṛthiviṣaṣṭikam || 15 ||
ṣoḍaśenopacāreṇa pūjayecca viśeṣataḥ ||
maṃḍalasyottare bhāge nāgarūpamanaṃtakam || 16 ||
paṃcakṛṣṇālakaiḥ kuryādbṛhatparvapramāṇakam ||
āropayeccākṣatādyaiḥ śvetacandanapuṣpakaiḥ || 17 ||
varuṇaṃ juhuyātpūrvaṃ madhunā pāyasena vā || 18 ||
tilākṣatairvā ājyairvā trimadhvaktairathāpi vā ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ kuryāddigīśānāṃ ghṛtena tu ||19||
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyātpuṣpaistilaghṛtena ca ||
nārāyaṇaṃ śivaṃ durgāṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca grahānniśi|| || 2.3.4.20 ||
aṣṭāvaṣṭau ca juhuyādghṛtairekāhutirbhaveta ||
brahmāyudhvānamiti maṃtreṇa brahmāṇaṃ pāyasena tu ||21||
ekāhutiṃ tato dadyādāpohiṣṭheti vā tribhiḥ ||
imaṃ varuṇa iti vā tadvaromā ṛcā punaḥ ||
vātasyayamiti punaḥ pañcavarṇaṃ yathākramāt ||
tataḥ sviṣṭakṛte dadyādbaliṃ dadyādanukramāt||
madhvājyapāyasaṃ dadyādvaruṇāya viśeṣataḥ ||25||
yavakṣīraṃ digīśebhyo hyanyebhyaḥ pāyasena tu ||
nāgāya piṣṭakaṃ dadyāllājāhomāṣṭakaṃ punaḥ|| 26 ||
aṣṭāṣṭāpadamānena varuṇaṃ rājatena tu || 27 ||
kuryātpūrvadvayenāpi bāṇarattisuvarṇakaiḥ ||
kuryātpuṣkariṇīṃ tatra pūrvārdhe caturasrake || 28 ||
varuṇaṃ vinyasettatra tathā puṣkariṇīmapi ||
oṃ adyetyādi viṣṇurūpāya karuṇāya śrutiratyādyuktavedavyāsasapraṇītāgniṣṭomaphalaprāptaye puṣkariṇīpratiṣṭhākarmaṇi imāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ suvarṇarājatāṃ svagṛhyoditāṃ sālaṃkārāṃ supūjitāmamukagotraḥ amukadevaśarmā tubhyamahaṃ saṃpradade || ityutsargavākyam || oṃ adyetyādi brāhmaṇamukhyebhyaḥ mamāgniṣṭomādyanekaphalaprāptaye imaṃ jalāśayaṃ varuṇadaivataṃ supūjitaṃ caturmukhasahitaṃ catuḥsattvāvacchinnasnānapānādyupabhogāya amukasagotraḥ amukadevaśarmāhamutsṛje ||)
pūrvāvasthāyinīṃ yaṣṭiṃ samāropya vidhānataḥ ||
puṣkariṇyāsamaṃ tena nāgayaṣṭyaṃtare kṣipet || 31 ||
tatraivānaṃtanāgaṃ ca maṃtrametadudīrayed||
puṃḍarīkadalābhāsa śubharaktāṃtalocana ||
dakṣiṇāṃ ca tato dadyāttataḥ pūrṇāṃ vidhāya ca ||

ādityādhyāyakaṃ japtvā kṣipellājakapardakān ||
pātayetkṣīradhārāṃ ca sahasreṇa śatena ca || 35 ||

pathi saṃtoṣayeddīnānsaṃtoṣya ca gṛhaṃ vrajet || 36 || ||
sarovarādipratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
nalinyāśca tathā vāpyā hradasya dvijasattamāḥ ||
vidhiṃ vakṣye sahāṅgena vidhānaṃ śṛṇuta dvijāḥ || 1 ||
āpohiṣṭheti mantreṇa tathā astraiḥ śatairapi || 2 ||
svamaṇḍale śubhe sthāne viśetpūrvamukhena tu ||
gaṇeśaṃ varuṇaṃ caiva ghaṭe saṃpūjayecchivam || 3 ||
vāgīśaṃ ca tathā viṣṇuṃ sūrye kuṃbhe samarcayet ||
pāyasenāhutiṃ dadyādvaruṇāya ghṛtena ca || 4 ||
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyādanyeṣāṃ ca sruveṇa ca ||
yūpaṃ niveśayetpaścāddadyāddhenuṃ ca dakṣiṇām ||
pūrṇaṃ dadyātsavitre.arghyaṃ dattvā tu svagṛhaṃ vrajet || 6 ||
ārāmasya vidhiṃ vakṣye pratiṣṭhāvidhivistaram ||
hīnārāmasya ca tathā eka vṛkṣasya ca dvijāḥ || 7 ||
araṇyamadhye pāścātye uttare vā viśeṣataḥ ||
maṃḍapaṃ vartulaṃ kuryādarghyahastapramāṇakam || 8 ||
taddakṣiṇe bhavetkuṃḍaṃ caturasraṃ samaṃ śubham ||
maṃdarādikamāvāhya tataḥ saṃpūjayetkramāt ||
bhṛguṃ karṇasamārūḍhaṃ sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ||
viṣvaksenasya maṃtroyaṃ pūjāyāṃ caiva sarvataḥ || 11 ||
dvārapālaṃ ca saṃpūrṇaṃ gauryādīnkalaśeṣu ca ||
svāsu dikṣu digīśānāṃ balipuṣpākṣatādi nā || 12 ||
vedipārśve tato gatvā vedimāvāhya pūjayet ||
āsanaṃ kalpayitvā tu sāmānyārghyaṃ vidhāya ca || 14 ||
aiśāne kalaśe vidyudbrahmāṇaṃ ca tathā grahān ||
maḍaleśaṃ vāsudevaṃ sāsanaṃ ca bṛhaspatim ||
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā pāyasānnaṃ baliṃ haret || 16 ||
dhyātvā āropayedevaṃ bālādīnatha nāyakān ||
vimalādyā nāyikāśca digīśāṃśca yathāvidhi || 19 ||
ṣoḍaśoccaiḥ pṛthagrūpaiḥ pratipuṣpāṃjalikramāt||
paritaḥ pūjayedviṣṇuṃ śivaṃ durgāṃ sarasvatīm || 2.3.5.20 ||
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ dhyāyetsomaṃ caturmukham ||
aśvārūḍhaṃ divya rūpaṃ padmākṣaṃ dhṛtapuṣpakam || 21 ||
śvetaṃ vanaspatiṃ dhyāyeddvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam || 22 ||
svarathasthaṃ mahābāhuṃ śaṃkhāṃkuśasakheṭakam ||
daśasvarānvitaṃ toyaṃ svabhāvaṃ tamasānvitam ||
maṃtro.ayaṃ devadevasya pūjāyāṃ viniyojayet ||24||
nīlaṃ jayaṃ bhṛṃgiṇaṃ ca paritaśca yathākramāt ||
tataḥ kuśakaṃḍikāṃ kṛtvā sthālīpākaṃ vidhānataḥ|| || 25 ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ caiva somāya dvādaśāhutīḥ ||
vānaspatestathāṣṭau ca ājye.anyeṣāṃ vidhīyatām || 26 ||
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyātsaptajihvāmanaṃtaram ||
vāstoṣpataya iti maṃtreṇa sthālīpākadvayaṃ nayet || 27 ||
vṛkṣādīnsthāpayetpūrve gāyatryā prathamaṃ budhaḥ || 28 ||
abjairagraṃ kāṃsyavastraṃ ratnaṃ dikṣu yathākramam ||
brīhayaśceti maṃtreṇa tathā ca saritaśca me || 29 ||
mitratrayaśceti tathā pūṣā ca ma ṛcā tathā ||
saṃsthāpya vrīhīnsaṃvāpya tatraiva vidhipūrvakam || 2.3.5.30 ||
saṃsthāpya yajamānaṃ ca surāstvāmiti mantrakaiḥ || 31 ||
ācāryamātmane tatra saṃsthitaṃ dvijapuṃgavaiḥ ||
samāpya nityavidhinācāryāyātha ca dakṣiṇām || 32 ||
dhenuṃ ca lohapātraṃ ca dattvā iṣṭāṃ ca dakṣiṇām ||
brāhmaṇebhyo yathāśakti dadyātpūrṇāṃ gṛhaṃ vrajet || 33 || || ||
kṣudrārāmapratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
kṣudrārāmapratiṣṭhāṃ ca vakṣye ca dvijasattama ||
amaṃḍale śubhe sthāne dvihastama yasthaṃḍile || 1 ||
sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tatra somaṃ viṣṇuṃ samarcayet ||
ācāryamātraṃ varayenniśāsūtraiḥ praveṣṭayet || 2 ||
vṛkṣānmālyairalaṃkṛtya bhūṣayedbhūṣaṇādinā ||
bhojayetpaṃcaviprāṃśca puratoṃ.ate viśeṣataḥ ||

raṃbhāṃ ca ropayeddikṣu sthālīpākavidhānataḥ || 5 ||
aṣṭāvaṣṭau ca juhuyādanyeṣāṃ ca ghṛtena tu ||
ekaikāmāhutiṃ dadyātsviṣṭakṛttadanaṃtaram || 6 ||

śreṣṭhavṛkṣapratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam

vṛkṣasya paścime bhāge sthāpayetkalaśaṃ tataḥ || 1 ||

aśvatthapratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
athāśvatthapratiṣṭhāyāṃ mūle bāhupramāṇakam ||
sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayettatra caṃdanenāṅkitaṃ yathā || 1 ||

sthāpayedvāriṇā pūrṇaṃ kayā neti ca gaṃdhakam ||
gaṃdhadvāreti tailena śrīśca teti ca caṃdanam || 3 ||
dadyāddūrvākṣataṃ kalye brāhmaṇatrayabhojanam ||
kārayetsitasūtraiśca veṣṭayeccaṃdanasya ca || 4 ||

svadikṣu dikpatīṃścāpi vṛkṣamūle navagrahān || 5 ||
maṃḍale śivamabhyarcyaṃ pīṭhapūjā puraḥsaram ||
pūrve caṃḍaṃ pracaṃḍaṃ ca dakṣiṇe naṃdibhṛṃgiṇau ||6||
anaṃtaṃ paścime kāmamuttare gaṇanāyakam ||
kārtikeyaṃ madhyadeśa ādhāraśaktipūrvakam||7|||
anaṃtaṃ pṛthivīṃ caiva trivṛttaṃ ca trimaṃḍalam||
atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śvetaṃ vṛṣabhameva ca || 8||
dvibhujaṃ śūlahastaṃ ca sarvābharaṇasaṃyutam||
āropayetsvataṃtreṇa mūle viṣṇuṃ samarcayet||9||

bilvapratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam

tryaṃbakaṃ ceti maṃtreṇa sthāpayedgaṃdhavāriṇā || 1 ||

kayāneti tato dhūpaṃ vastraṃ mālyaṃ nivedayet || 2 ||
niśāraktena vā kuryādaṣṭapatraṃ suśobhanam|| 5 ||

sadvṛkṣapratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
śatahastamitāṃ muṣṭiṃ nānātaruvibhūṣitām ||
pūgāmrādiphalairyuktaṃ vāstuṃ kṛtvā yajettu yaḥ || 1 ||

agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām || 4 || ||
maṇḍapapratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
pratiṣṭhāṃ maṃḍapasyaiva śailadārumayasya ca ||
tṛṇakāṣṭhasya ca vibho tṛṇavattasya ca dvijāḥ || 1 ||

dikpālāṃścaiva vinyasya maṃḍape śubhalakṣaṇe || 5 ||
sūryamāvāhayettatra somaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca pārśvayoḥ || 6 ||
gaṇeśaṃ ca grahāṃścaiva dikpālāṃśca ghaṭe.arcayet ||
pāyasaṃ juhuyādagnāvaṣṭottaraśataṃ tathā || 7 ||
ādityasya tathā viṣṇoḥ somasya dvādaśāhutīḥ ||
baliṃ ca pāyasaṃ dadyāttailaṃ kṣīramathāpi vā || 8 ||
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā śanairoṣṭhaṃ na cālayet || 9 ||
tataḥ śvetaghaṭaṃ dadyānmaṇḍapopari sattamāḥ ||
triguṇena niśāktairvā veṣṭayedvāridhārayā || || 11 ||

tṛṇaveśmani vai sūryaṃ vāsudevasamanvitam || 12 ||

mahāyūpanirmāṇapratiṣṭhāvarṇanam

puṣpavāṭikāpratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
puṣpārāmapratiṣṭhāṃ tu vakṣye śṛṇvaṃtu vai dvijāḥ ||

bhadrakasya śamīkoṇacaṃḍātakabakasya ca ||

vṛkṣādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca uttameṣūttamaṃ caret||
madhyemadhye kaniṣṭhā tu kaniṣṭhaṃ parikīrtitam||1||
vartulaṃ maṃḍalaṃ kuryāttattu śīrṣe tathāntyake||
madhye vā vedikāṃ kuryāttanmadhye kuṃḍamaṃḍalam||2||
pūrvedyū rātrisamaye ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet||
śeṣaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatpṛthivīṃ ca śivaṃ tathā|| 3 ||
gaṃdhatoyena gāyatryā setuṃ saṃpūjya mokṣayet||
kayāneti ca mantreṇa āpyāyasveti vai ṛcā || 4 ||
dadyādgandhādikaṃ śrīśca te lakṣmīriti candanam ||
dūrvāmantreṇa dūrvāśca phalamantreṇa vai phalam || 5 ||
añjanālaktakaṃ kuryānmanonnā iti saṃpaṭhan||
varayedatha ācāryaṃ hotāraṃ nṛvaraścaret ||
pātradvayaṃ vidhātavyaṃ sadasyācāryameva ca ||8 ||
setuyāge vidhātavyaṃ tathā dhānyācalepi ca ||
yajedenaṃ kṛte mauliyāgārthaṃ yāgamaṃḍapam ||
vedimāvāhayetpūrvaṃ maṃḍapaṃ pratipūjayet || 2.3.16.10 || vighnagrahā~mllokapālānsarvasiddhipradāyakān||
sthaṃḍile sarvatobhadre śeṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ pradarśayet || 11||
sthālīpākena juhuyādaṣṭāviṃśatikatrayam || 12 ||
baliṃ dadyātpṛthagrūpaṃ śeṣayedvidhipūrvakam ||
piṣṭakānnaṃ ghṛtānnaṃ ca vistare vā guḍaudanam || 14 ||
māṣabhaktaṃ tu lokāya pṛthivyai paramānnakam ||
vākyapūrvaṃ sṛjeddhīro vākyaprakaraṇaṃ śṛṇu || 15 ||
baddhāṃñjaliḥ paṭhenmantraṃ kuryācca vidhivattataḥ ||
picchile patitānāṃ ca udgatenāṅgabhaṅgataḥ ||
ye cātra prāṇinaḥ santi sarveṣāṃ prāṇadhārakāḥ || 17 ||
yūpaṃ dadyāditi mantreṇa ante cāpi tathā dhvajān ||
vidhivaddakṣiṇāṃ dadyātkulāni nava pañca vā || 19 ||
pūrṇāṃ dattvā savitre.arghyaṃ dattvā ca svagṛhaṃ vrajet ||
anātape kṣudrasetoḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivaccaret || 2.3.16.20 ||
viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ hutāśaṃ ca ekakuṇḍe samarcayet ||
kuryādekaikaśo viprā aṣṭā viṃśatisaṃkhyayā ||
utsṛjya dāpayeddhūpaṃ dhvajavarjyaṃ hi sattamāḥ ||
jñātibhiḥ saha bhuñjīta kṛtakṛtyo.abhidhīyate || 23 || ||
ṣaṣṭihastamitāṃ bhūmiṃ tasya pūrṇāṃ manoramām || 1 ||
pracārārthaṃ gavāṃ caiva yo dadyātsusamāhitaḥ ||
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate ||2||
yo dadyātkevalāṃ bhūmiṃ kanyāṃ dāsīṃ tathā vṛṣam || 3 ||
alaṃkāraṃ vinā dhenuṃ phalasyārdhaṃ prakīrtitam||
amaṇḍape śubhe sthāne śarkarādivivarjite || 4 ||
tatra saṃpūjayedbhadraṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca śacīpatim || 5 ||
gaṇeśaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca śeṣaṃ caiva digīśvarān ||
pañcopacārairvidhivatpūjayetpāyasādinā || 6 ||
tryambakenaiva maṃtreṇa bhūmiṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet ||
pañcagavyena ca punaḥ śrīścateti ca puṣpakam || 9 ||
evaṃ yūpasya ca tathā adhigṛhṇāti maṃtrakam ||
surāsureti kusumaṃ dūrvāmantreṇa dūrvikām ||
sthālīpākena vidhinā anyeṣāṃ pūrvavaccaret ||
utsṛjyāropayeddīpaṃ sthiro bhaveti vai ṛcā || 12 ||
pṛthivīṃ ca varāhaṃ ca kūrmamādhavaśaktikān || 15 ||
vāstoṣpatiṃ ca viṣṇuṃ ca yūpe saṃpūjayetkramāt||
yāvaṃti tṛṇagulmāni saṃti bhūmau śubhāni ca ||
dinaikasādhyapratiṣṭhāvidhānavarṇanam
śaratkāle vyatīte tu vasaṃte yajñamārabhet || 2 ||
nārāyaṇādimūrtīnāṃ dvātriṃśadbheda eva tu ||
pratiṣṭhāṃ pratimānāṃ ca gajāsyādīṃśca sattamāḥ || 3 ||
gaṇeśa grahadikpālānpratikuṃbheṣu pūjayet ||
sthaṃḍile pūjayedviṣṇuṃ parivāragaṇaṃ yajet || 5 ||
pañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ paṃcamṛtpiṇḍakairapi || 6 ||
tulasīkusumāpuṣpapatrāṇyāhustripatrakam ||
pañcakāmraśamīpadmakaravīraṃ ca paṃcakam ||8||
mṛttikā karidaṃtasya tathāśvakhuramṛttikā ||
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpistu paṃcamam || || 9 ||
kuryātprāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ ca homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi ||
dakṣiṇāṃ vidhivaddadyātpūrṇāṃ tu tadanaṃtaram || 2.3.18.10 ||
devādipratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
ataḥ paraṃ tu viprendrāḥ kālyādīnāṃ tathaiva ca ||
pañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ karīṣaśatadhārayā ||
śrībilve pūjayeddevīṃ dadyātprāṇamanaṃtaram || 3 ||
bilvapatraiḥ phalairvāpi dadyāccāpi śatāhutīḥ ||
ekaikaśastu sarveṣāṃ dadyātkāñcana dakṣiṇām || 4 ||
pratimāṃ kālikāyāśca tārāyāśca pṛthakpṛthak ||
grāhyaṃ vinārcayedviprāḥ pañcapañcaśatairapi || 5 ||
samīraṇaṃ tato dadyātpeṭikāyāṃ niveśayet ||
tato vai cāṣṭamadine rātrāvapi prapūjayet ||
paśudānaṃ prakartavyamagnikāryaṃ ca pāyasaiḥ || 8 ||
śivaliṅgapratiṣṭhāṃ ca vakṣye taṃtramataṃ yathā ||
trivipraṃ bhojayedviprā adhivāsyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 9 ||
ācāryaṃ varayetprātaḥ snāpayetpūrvavartmanā ||2.3.19.10||
dadyātsamīraṇaṃ paścādagnikāryaṃ samācaret || 11 ||
tilahemamayīṃ gāṃ ca dadyādgāṃ ca vidhānataḥ ||
pūrṇimāyāṃ viśeṣeṇa nānyeṣāṃ ca kathaṃcana ||
homāṃte vasudhārāṃ ca kuṃbhe dattvā vidhānataḥ || 13 ||
śālaśamaśilāyāśca pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivaccaret || 14 ||
sadyodhivāsayeddevaṃ dvādaśyāṃ snāpayedatha ||
kuṃbhe prajāpatiṃ sthāpya śvetābjaṃ navanābhake ||
cakrasvarūpato jñeyaṃ pradadyācca samīraṇam ||
ānīya tāmrabhāṃḍe ca trikālaṃ pratipūjayet ||17||
sakāñcanaṃ vastrayugmaṃ prada dyādbhūridakṣiṇam || 18 ||
śrīsūryasya gaṇeśasya viriñceścāpi sattamāḥ ||
vaṭavṛkṣāṃtikaṃ gatvā sthāpayedvaruṇaṃ tataḥ || 19 ||
aṣṭāviṃśatibhirddattvā dadyātprāṇamanaṃtaram || 2.3.19.20 ||
ekāhamathavākāśe guptaṃ kṛtvā dinatrayam ||
tryahādeva punaḥ pūjāṃ punarhomaṃ samācaret || 21 ||
punaśca bhojayedviprāndadyātkāñcanadakṣiṇām ||
vārāhyāstripurāyāśca nārikelodakairapi ||22||
dadyātsamīraṇaṃ paścātpunaḥ pūjāṃ ca homayet || 23 ||
paśujñānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ ṣaṇmāsaiḥ pañcamodakaiḥ ||
kumārīṃ bhojayedrātrau dadyātkāñcana dakṣiṇām || 24 ||
pratimāṃ bhuvaneśīṃ ca mahāmāyāmbikāmapi ||
kāmākṣīṃ ca tato devīmindrākṣīṃ cāparājitām || 25 ||
pūrvedyū rātrisamaye piṣṭa kāṣṭau nivedayet ||
aṣṭau nirmāṇayetpaścādbaliṃ cāṣṭau vidhānavit || 26 ||
parivāragaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ pūjayetprayataḥ sudhīḥ ||
samīraṇaṃ tato dadyācchivaṃ sūryaṃ yajetpunaḥ || 27 ||
pāyasānnaiśca juhuyāttridinaṃ lipipūjanam ||
kumārīpūjanaṃ kuryādagnikāryaṃ dinatrayam || 28 ||
paśudānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ vibhave sati sattamāḥ ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānmaṭhotsavapuraḥsaram ||29||
durnimittānyatho vakṣye śṛṇvaṃtu munisattamāḥ ||
yasya ye grahadoṣāḥ syusteṣāṃ śāṃtiṃ yathākramāt || 1 ||
graharkṣādyaiḥ kṛtaṃ divyamāntarikṣaṃ nibodha me || 2 ||
jalāśayānāṃ vai kṛtyaṃ bhaumaṃ tadapi kīrtitam || 3 ||
bhaumaṃ cālpaphalaṃ jñeyaṃ divyāntarikṣameva ca ||
saptāhamaphalaṃ dadyāddaivaṃ cāpi ca tatkṣaṇāt || 4 ||
devānāṃ hasanaṃ caiva kalkanaṃ rudhirasravaḥ ||
sarpādyārohaṇaṃ caiva daivaṃ tadapi kīrtitam || 5 ||
tato meghātsamutpannā yadi vṛṣṭiḥ śilātale ||
saptāhābhyaṃtare jīvamutpannaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 6 ||
ekarāśisthitāḥ pāpāḥ śanibhaumadivākarāḥ ||
pṛthvī dhūmākulā tatra rudaṃti bahavo janāḥ ||7||
tatra paśyati rājendraḥ ko dharāṃ dhārayiṣyati||8||
darśanaṃ dhūmaketośca nakṣatre dhūmadarśanam || 9 ||
rājño janmadine vātha śakracāpaṃ dināṃtare || 2.3.20.10 ||
ākāśe.apyatha bhūmau ca tatra maṇḍūkameva ca ||
haridrāvṛṣṭiḥ pāṣāṇe siṃhabilvākṛtiryadi ||
darśane rāṣṭradurbhikṣamakaraṃ nṛpatikṣayaḥ || 12||
ākṛṣṇeneti mantreṇa atha vārkeṇa yatnataḥ ||
prāsādatoraṇaṃ tatra dvāraṃ prākāraveśma ca || 14 ||
dhānyasāraṃ gavāṃ sāraṃ kūpe kumbhapradarśanam ||
ādityasyādbhutaṃ vidyātkamalaṃ juhuyāttataḥ ||15||
sahasraṃ juhuyādvātha tataḥ śāṃtirbhaveddhruvam ||
vikṛtāḥ pakṣiṇaścaiva pāṃḍukapotakāstataḥ || 16 ||
śvetolūko bṛhaṃścaiva droṇakākaśca kokilaḥ ||
gṛhe tasya mahotpāto bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||
sthūlabhaṅgapragrahaṇaṃ prarohaṇamathāpi vā || 18 ||
hārāḥ kaṭakaṭāyaṃte jātasya daṃtasambhavaḥ ||
hasatā devatānāṃ ca gātre svedaśca jāyate ||
nimittānyevamādīni jāyaṃte yasya veśmani ||
ṣaḍbhirmāsaiśca mriyate gṛhiṇī ca śubhā ca yā ||2.3.20.20||
kuryādādityavāre vā ayutaṃ tilapāyasam ||
tataḥ śāṃtirbhavedāśu dhenuṃ dadyācca dakṣiṇām || 23 ||
pāyasaṃ tilamudgau ca puṣpaṃ vā tālavṛntakam ||
ikṣumodakapiṇyākāñjuhuyādravimuddiśan || 24 ||
siṃhāsanaṃ rathacchatraṃ dhvajaścāmarabhūṣite ||
akasmāddṛśyate yatra rājño vānyatra kutracit || 25 ||
āgamasya ca dṛṣṭvaiva bhaṃgaḥ kaṭakaṭāyanam || 26 ||
calatvaṃ cādharasyāpi tathā kaṭakaṭāyanam || 27 ||
rājāmātyavināśāya mahīṃ ca tatsuto.api vā ||
hastino madayuktāśca mriyaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ || 28 ||
akṣatādarśanāttatra somasyādbhutadarśanam ||
dadhi madhu ghṛtaṃ caiva juhuyādayutaṃ dvijāḥ ||2.3.20.30||
imaṃdevā iti maṃtreṇa somāya śrapayeccarum ||31||
utpataṃti gṛhe yasya yavā māṣāśca puṣkalāḥ ||
dadhikṣīrājyapākeṣu rudhiraṃ dṛśyate yadi ||32||
vyādhilīnā vinaśyaṃti nikhilāḥ paśumānuṣāḥ ||
evaṃ sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhavaṃtyakārake dhruvam || 34
rājāmātyavināśāya gehe gehī vinaśyati ||
prāṇanāśāya viprāyāhutyā ca prabhavaṃti hi || 35 ||
dṛṣṭvā vābhadramatyugraṃ juhuyādayutaṃ kramāt ||
agnirmūddheṃti maṃtreṇa śrapitaṃ lohitaṃ carum ||
hastyaśvamahiṣā gāvo dārāpatyadhanāni ca ||
tuṣṭenāṃgārakeṇaiva sarvametatpradīyatām||
āṃgārakeṇa maṃtreṇa khādiraṃ cākṣatairyutam|| || 39 ||
dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśakti dadyādviprāya vā punaḥ ||
dhāvaṃti cordhvapucchāśca gṛhe gāvaḥ svayaṃ yadi ||
dharaṇīhananaṃ yatra dvayorāskadanaṃ tathā ||
nimittānyevamādīni gośvajātāni sattamāḥ ||44||
maṇḍūkasarpakūṣmāṃḍāḥ prasuvaṃti yathā striyaḥ ||45||
śāṃtiṃ tatra pravakṣyāmi yathā saṃpadyate sukham || 46 ||
dadhimadhughṛtāktaṃ ca apāmārgaṃ tathā punaḥ ||
suvarṇaṃ budhamuddiśya gāṃ ca dadyātpayasvinīm || 48 ||
suvarṇaṃ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca suphalaṃ cākṣataṃ tathā ||
gṛhe prāṃgaṇake yasya nipataṃti kadācana ||49||
alaṃkārayutāṃ vāpi sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām ||
gṛhamadhye tu yaḥ paśye tkṣīṇāmaṃtarhitāṃ striyam || 2.3.20.50 ||
akasmānmālatīpuṣpaṃ jātaṃ syāttasya vā gṛhe ||
śrīścateti ca mantreṇa apāmārgaṃ tathā budhaḥ ||
payasvinīṃ tathā gāṃ ca vāsoyugasamanvitam ||
dvijāya śraddhayā dadyāttataḥ saṃpadyate śubham|| 54 ||
siṃhavyāghragavādīnāṃ dhanahānivipatkaraḥ || 55 ||
eko vṛṣastrayo gāvaḥ saptāṣṭa nava daṃtinaḥ ||
saṃvatsareṇa tasyaikā prasūtirvihatā punaḥ || 56 ||
punaḥpunarvrataṃ cāśu akāle maithunaṃ tathā ||
bhuñjīkṛtāni dhānyāni vrīhayo yavataṃḍulāḥ ||
grāvimārjāramaṃḍūkāḥ sthūṇābhaṃge ca prāṅgaṇe || 58 ||
gṛhe yasya prajāyaṃte tasyā mṛtyurna saṃśayaḥ || 59 ||
ṣaṇmāsābhyantare yatra śmaśānaṃ yāsyati dhruvam ||
kalahaṃ jñātivairaṃ ca vyādhipīḍā bhaviṣyati || 2.3.20.60 ||
amātyavargāśca pure rājñāṃ rājyaparāṅmukhāḥ ||
bṛhaspatiṃ samuddiśya gāṃ ca dadyātpayasvinīm || 63 ||
vārimaṃḍe ca kūpe ca vāpyāṃ ca madhukāṃjike ||
kṣīraṃ dadhighṛtaṃ caiva jātaṃ yadi bhaviṣyati || 64 ||
akasmāttatra vṛkṣaśca phalena saha saṃyutaḥ ||
gauraṃ bṛhaspateścaiva prakuryātprāyadakṣiṇām || 66 ||
aśubhaṃ hi śubhenaiva śāṃtiṃ homaṃ ca kārayet ||
tatraiva rākṣasaṃ yatra ghaṭakaṃ pariśoṣaṇam || 67 ||
kesarī śarkarā tailaṃ rājataṃ tāṃḍavaṃ sthitam ||
māṣabhaktaṃ tathā dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃ rajatāni ca || 68 ||
tāmraṃ kāṃsyaṃ tathā lohaṃ sīsakaṃ pittalaṃ tathā ||
sthāpitānīva dṛśyaṃte gṛhe caitāni yasya vai || 69 ||
vyādhipīḍe tathā ghore rājopadravabaṃdhane ||
gajāśvapaśubhṛtyānāṃ vināśo jāyate dhruvam || 2.3.20.70 ||
yasyaitāni pradṛśyaṃte parvataḥ kanakāni ca ||
saṃpattasya prajāyeta niścalā sukhadā sadā || 71 ||
daṃtottareṣu daṃtāśca paṃktimākramya saṃsthitāḥ ||
te.api doṣakarāḥ sarve śalā kākṛtinastathā ||
upadaṃtāśca sarve te na te doṣakarāḥ kvacit || 72 ||
bhāṃḍe kuṃbhe yadā caiva śrūyate ghanagarjitam ||
kaṃcukānāṃ gṛhe caiva prākāraḥ śrūyate yadi || 73 ||
mūṣikānāṃ mukhe caiva jvalaṃtī yasya paśyati ||
śāṃtiṃ tatra pravakṣyāmi yayā saṃpadyate śubham ||
śamīpatraṃ nirmitaṃ ca yavairyuktaṃ gṛhiṇyapi ||
śuklavāsoyugaṃ caiva gāṃ ca śuklāṃ payasvinīm ||
suvarṇaṃ śraddhayā caiva dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām || 76 ||
puṣpitāśca gṛhastaṃbhāḥ śarīraṃ ca ghaṭastathā || 79 ||
hastyaśvamahiṣāścaiva ajā gāvastathaiva ca ||
nityaṃ svāmivadhārthāya puṣpitāṃ pravahaṃti ca || 2.3.20.80 ||
gṛhe haṃso gṛhe samyaṅmaṇḍūkā jalacāriṇaḥ ||
manuṣyāṅganānāṃ maraṇaṃ tathā syādrāṣṭraviplavaḥ || 84 ||
rasasiddhāni vastūni surādyāścāpi vā punaḥ ||
hastino madayuktāśca aśvā dhīritahiṃsakāḥ ||
nagare vā tathā grāme jāyante tasya vairiṇaḥ ||
divā vā yadi vā rātrau śaneradbhutadarśanam || 86 ||
mṛgavyāghrādirakṣāṃsi tathā gomahiṣā api ||
juhuyādayutaṃ samyaksasyāṃśca samidhaṃ dvijāḥ || 88 ||
śanno devīti maṃtreṇa śubhārthaṃ śanivāsare ||
gāṃ ca nīlāṃ tato dadyājjīvadvatsāṃ payasvinīm ||
vāsoyugaṃ ca viprāya suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā || 2.3.20.90 ||
dattvā tu śraddhayā samyagdakṣiṇāṃ śirasi sthitām ||
vidhiṃ homāvasāne tu tataḥ saṃpadyate śubham || 91 ||
yadā dvāre godhikā ca śaṃkhinī praviśedgṛham ||
tatra saṃdṛśyate cābhraṃ vṛkṣā vātavivarjitāḥ ||
divā śivā purā rauti ulūko vā niśācaraḥ ||
niśi nipatya kākutsthe pradeśe rauti vā vṛṣaḥ || 95 ||
adharmaprabalā deśā rājā dharmaparāṅmukhaḥ ||
rājyanāśo bhavedrājño maraṇaṃ vāhanasya ca ||
viparītāni deśāni kramataḥ saṃbhavaṃti hi || 98 ||
rāhuṇā grastasūryo.api niśi cātha yadā divā ||
tārakāgaṇavaccaiva rājñāṃ nidhanakārakaḥ || 99 ||
sahāmātyā vinaśyaṃti svarge ye ca sudurjayāḥ ||
paracakreṇa pātyaṃte rājāno nātra saṃśayaḥ || 2.3.20.100 ||
chāyādhvajaśca gagane dṛśyate cetkadācana ||
darśanādeva rājñastu vināśaḥ saharāṣṭrakaiḥ || 101 ||
dvāropāṃte tathā staṃbhe āgnirvā dhūma eva vā ||
gagane.aśanighātaśca śaktihastena vā punaḥ ||
abdasyābhyaṃtare tasya maraṇaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||104||
śikhāvalayamadhye tu sadhūmaḥ pāvakodgamaḥ ||
śavasya nīyamānasya utthānaṃ vā pramādataḥ ||
nirghātaścāpi bhūkaṃpo nivātolkāpradarśanam ||
akāle puṣpitā vṛkṣāḥ phalaṃ cākālasaṃbhavam || || 107 ||
dadhimadhughṛtāktaṃ ca kuryāddūrvākṣataṃ tathā ||

|| śaunaka uvāca || ||

|| śaunaka uvāca ||

vikramādityanāmānaṃ pitā kṛtvā mumoda ha ||

dvādaśābdaṃ prayatnena vikrameṇa kṛtaṃ tapaḥ || 17 ||
paścādambāvatīṃ divyāṃ purīṃ yātaḥ śriyānvitaḥ ||

|| śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śivaṃ manasi saṃsthāpya rājñānamidamabravīt||

iti bhāvaṃ ca sā kṛtvā.a.alibhiḥ sārdhaṃ yayau gṛham || 14 ||

ruṣṭā padmāvatī prāha caṃdanārdrāṃgulīyikā ||
aṃgulībhiḥ kapolau ca tasyāḥ spṛṣṭvā yayau gṛham ||

tanmadhye vedikāṃ ramyāṃ kārayetsa vratī dvijaiḥ ||
tatra sthāpya śilārūpaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ svarṇa samanvitam ||16||
kuryādgaṃdhādibhiḥ pūjāṃ premabhaktisamanvitaḥ||
bhūmiśāyī hariṃ dhyāyansaptarātraṃ vyatītayet ||17||
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatiḥ kāśyāṃ devamapūjayat ||
śatrupakṣakṣayakaraṃ prāpya khaṅgaṃ nṛpottamaḥ ||
praṇamya ca sadānandaṃ kedāramaṇimā yayau || 19 ||
hatvā dasyūnṣaṣṭiśatāṃsteṣāṃ labdhvā mahaddhanam ||
hariṃ prapūjayāmāsa narmadāyāstaṭe śubhe ||3.2.26.20||
paurṇamāsyāṃ vidhānena māsimāsi nṛpottamaḥ||
rājyaṃ kṛtvā sa ṣaṣṭyabdamante viṣṇupuraṃ yayau||22||
athetihāsaṃ śṛṇuta yathā bhillāḥ kṛtārthinaḥ ||
vicaraṃto vane nityaṃ niṣādāḥ kāṣṭhavāhinaḥ ||1||
vanātkāṣṭhāni vikretuṃ purīṃ kāśīṃ yayuḥ kvacit||
ekastṛṣākulo yāto viṣṇudāsāśramaṃ tadā ||2||
yo dṛṣṭo.akiṃcano vipro dṛśyate.adya mahādhanaḥ||
ājñāpaya mahābhāga śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 5 ||
|| sadānaṃda uvāca || ||
satyanārāyaṇasyāṃga sevayā kiṃ na labhyate ||
na kiṃcitsukhamāpnoti vinā tasyānukaṃpayā || 6 ||
||niṣāda uvāca || ||
aho kimiti māhātmyaṃ satyanārāyaṇārcane ||
vidhānaṃ sopacāraṃ ca hyupadeṣṭuṃ tvamarhasi || 7 ||
sādhūnāṃ samacittānāmupakāravatāṃ satām ||
na gopyaṃ vidyate kiṃcidārtānāmārtināśanam || 8 ||
iti pṛṣṭo vidhiṃ vaktumitihāsamathābravīt ||
candracūḍo mahīpālaḥ kedāramaṇipūrake || 9 ||
mamāśramaṃ samāyātaḥ satyanārāyaṇārcane ||
vidhānaṃ śrotukāmo.asau māmāha sādaraṃ vacaḥ || 3.2.27.10 ||
saṃkalpya manasā kāmaṃ niṣkāmo vā janaḥ kvacit || 11 ||
godhūmacūrṇaṃ pādārdhaṃ seṭakādyaiḥ sucūrṇakam ||
paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya candanādyaiśca pūjayet ||
pāyasāpūpasaṃyāvadadhikṣīramathoharet || 13 ||
uccāvacaḥ phalaiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpaimarnoramaiḥ ||
bhagavānparitaḥ pūrṇo na mānaṃ vṛṇuyātkvacit || 15 ||
duryodhanakṛtāṃ tyatkvā rājapūjāṃ janārdanaḥ ||
vidurasyāśrame vāsamātithyaṃ jagṛhe vibhuḥ || 16 ||
sudāmnastaṃḍulakaṇāñjagdhvā mānuṣyadurlabhāḥ ||
saṃpado.adāddhariḥ prītyā bhaktimātramapekṣyate || 17 ||
gopo gṛdhro vaṇigvyādho hanumānsavibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
ye.anye pāpātmakā daityā vṛtrakāyādhavādayaḥ || 18 ||
nārāyaṇāntikaṃ prāpya modaṃte.adyāpi yadvaśāḥ ||
iti śrutvā narapatiḥ pūjāsaṃbhāramādarāt || 19 ||
kṛtavānsa dhanaṃ labdhvā modate narmadātaṭe ||
niṣāda tvamapi prītyā satyanārāyaṇaṃ bhaja || 3.2.27.20 ||
iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya cānte sānnidhyamāpnuyāḥ ||
kṛtakṛtyo niṣādo.abhūtpraṇamya dvijapuṃgavam || 21 ||
sa gatvā svagaṇānāha māhātmyaṃ harisevane ||
te hṛṣṭamanasaḥ sarve samayaṃ cakrurādṛtāḥ || 22 ||
satyanārāyaṇe pūjāṃ kāṣṭhalabdhena yāvatā ||
vayaṃ kulaiḥ kariṣyāmaḥ puṇyavṛkṣavidhānataḥ || 23 ||
iti niścitya manasā kāṣṭhaṃ vikrīya lebhire ||
caturguṇaṃ dhanaṃ hṛṣṭāḥ svaṃsvaṃ bhavanamāyayuḥ ||24||
mudā strībhyassamācakhyurvṛttāṃtaṃ sarvamāditaḥ||
tāḥ śrutvā hṛṣṭamanasaḥ pūjanaṃ cakrurādarāt ||25||
atha te varṇayiṣyāmi kathāṃ sādhūpacāritām ||
nṛpopadeśataḥ sādhuḥ kṛtārtho.abhūdvaṇigyathā|| || 1 ||
maṇipūrapatī rājā candracūḍo mahāyaśāḥ ||
saha prajābhirānarca satyanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 2 ||
dhanairāpūrya taraṇīḥ saha gacchannadītaṭe || 3 ||
dadarśa bahulaṃ lokaṃ nānāgrāmavilāsinam ||
vedavādāṃśca śuśrāva gītavāditrasaṃgatān ||
ramyaṃ sthānaṃ samālokya karṇadhāraṃ samādiśat || 5 ||
viśrāmayātra taraṇīriti paśyāmi kautukam ||
bhartrādiṣṭastathā cakre karṇadhāraḥ sabhṛtyakaiḥ || 6 ||
taṭasīmnaḥ samuttīrya mallalīlāvilāsinaḥ ||
karṇadhārā nagā vīrā yuyudhurmallalīlayā || 7 ||
sabhyā ūcuśca te sarve satyanārāyaṇo vibhuḥ || 9 ||
pūjyate baṃdhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ rājñā lokānukaṃpinā ||
prāptaṃ niṣkaṭakaṃ rājyaṃ satyanārāyaṇārcanāt || 3.2.28.10 ||
jñānārthī labhate cakṣurnirbhayaḥ syādbhayāturaḥ || 11 ||
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti naraḥ satyasurārca nāt ||
vidhānaṃ tu tataḥ śrutvā cailaṃ baddhvā gale.asakṛt || 12 ||
hariṃ praṇamya sabhyāśca prasādaṃ bhuktavāṃstadā || 15 ||
jagāma svālayaṃ sādhurmanasā ciṃtayanharim||
svagṛhe hyāgate tasminnāryo maṃgalapāṇayaḥ || 16 ||
viveśāṃtaḥpure sādhurmahākautukamaṃgalaḥ || 17 ||
ṛtusnātā satī līlāvatī paryacaratpatim ||
garbhaṃ dhṛtavatī sādhvī samaye suṣuve tu sā || 18 ||
kanyāṃ kamalalolākṣīṃ bāṃdhavāmodakāriṇīm ||
sādhuḥ parāṃ mudaṃ lebhe vitatāra dhanaṃ bahu || 19 ||
viprānāhūya vedajñānkārayāmāsa maṃgalam ||
lekhayitvā janmapatrīṃ nāma cakre kalāvatīm || 3.2.28.20 ||
kalānidhikale vāsau vavṛdhe sā kalāvatī ||
aṣṭavarṣā bhavedgaurī navavarṣā ca rohiṇī || 21 ||
daśavarṣā bhavetkanyā tataḥ prauḍhā rajasvalā ||
prauḍhāṃ kālena tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vivāhārthamacintayat || 22 ||
nagare kāṃcanapure vaṇikchaṃkhapatiḥ śrutaḥ ||
mahāmodamanāḥ sādhurmaṃgalārthaṃ dadau ca ha ||
vismṛtya saha jāmātrā vāṇijyāya yayau punaḥ ||
atha sādhuḥ samādāya ratnāni vividhāni ca || 28 ||
naukāḥ saṃsthāpya sa yayau deśāddeśāntaraṃ prati ||
nagaraṃ narmadātīre tatra vāsaṃ cakāra saḥ ||29||
karmaṇā manasā vācā na kṛtaṃ satyasevanam || 3.2.28.30 ||
tataḥ karmavipākena tāpamāpācirādvaṇik ||
kasmiṃściddivase rātrau rājño gehe tamovṛte:|| 31 ||
jñātvā nidrāgatānsarvānhṛtaṃ caurairmahādhanam ||
prabhāte vācito rājā sūtamāgadhabaṃdibhiḥ || || 32 ||
prātaḥkṛtyaṃ nṛpaḥ kṛtvā sadaḥ saṃprāviśacca saḥ ||
tatastatra samāyātaḥ kiṃkaro rājavallabhaḥ || 33 ||
uvāca sa tadā vākyaṃ śṛṇuṣva tvaṃ dharā pate ||
muktāmālāśca bahudhā ratnāni vividhāni ca || 34 ||
mumuṣuścaurā gatāssarve na jānīmo vayaṃ nṛpa ||
iti vijñāpito rājā puṇyaśloka śikhāmaṇiḥ || 35 ||
uvāca krodhatāmrākṣo yūyaṃ saṃyāta mā ciram ||
sacauraṃ dravyamādāya matpārśvaṃ tvamupānaya || 36 ||
no ceddhaniṣye sagaṇāniti dūtānsamādiśat ||
nṛpavākyaṃ samākarṇya prajagmuste ca kiṃkarāḥ || 37 ||
ekībhūtvā niśi tadā mahāciṃtāturo.abhavat || 38 ||
hantā māṃ sagaṇaṃ rājā kiṃ karomi kutaḥ sukham ||

narmadāyāṃ ca maraṇaṃ śivalokapradāyakam ||
ityevaṃ saṃmataṃ kṛtvā narmadāyāstaṭaṃ yayuḥ || 3.2.28.40 ||
muktāhāraṃ gale tasya luṃṭhitaṃ vaṇijo.asya ca || 41 ||
sadhanaṃ saha jāmātrā nṛpāntikamupānayat || 42 ||
dhanāgāre dhanaṃ nītvā badhnīta tau sudurmatī || 43 ||
kārāgāre lohamayaiḥ śṛṃkhalairaṃgapādayoḥ ||
iti rājājñayā dūtāstathā cakrurnibaṃdhanam || 44 ||
mayā bahutaraṃ dhāturvipriyaṃ hi purākṛtam ||
samaṃ śvaśurajāmātrau dvādaśeṣu viṣādinau || 48 ||
tāpatrayaharaṃ viṣṇoścaritaṃ tasya te śivam ||
śṛṇvaṃti sudhiyo nityaṃ te vasaṃti hareḥ padam || || 1 ||
tatpriyā kamalā devī catvārastasya cātmajāḥ || 2 ||
dharmo yajño nṛpaścauraḥ sarve lakṣmīpriyaṃkarāḥ ||
mātṛbhyo devatābhyaśca svadhā svāheti vai makhaḥ ||
hṛtavānavanīpālaḥ caurairbhāryātiduḥkhitā || 6 ||
vāsolaṃkaraṇādīni vikrīya bubhuje kila ||

gatā vipragṛhe.apaśyatsatyanārāyaṇārcanam || 8 ||
prārthayaṃtaṃ jagannāthaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā prārthayaddharim ||
satyanārāyaṇa hare pitā bhartā ca me gṛham ||9||
tathāstu brāhmaṇairuktā tataḥ sā tvāśramaṃ yayau || 3.2.29.10 ||
mātrā nirbhartsiteyaṃtaṃ kālaṃ kutra sthitā śubhe ||
vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāmāsa satyanārāyaṇārcane || 11 ||
deśamāyātu janakaḥ svāmī ca mama kāmanā ||
rātrau niścitya manasā prabhāte sā kalāvatī || 13 ||
śīlapālasya guptasya gehe prāptā dhanārthinī ||
iti śrutvā śīlapālaḥ paṃcaniṣkaṃ dhanaṃ dadau ||
tvatpituśca ṛṇaṃ śeṣaṃ mayītyeva kalāvati || 15 ||
ityuktvā so.anṛṇo bhūtvā gayāśrāddhāya saṃyayau ||
sutāpi tena dravyeṇa kṛtaṃ satyārcanaṃ śubham || 16 ||
līlāvatī saha tayā bhaktyākārṣītprapūjanam||
pūjanena viśeṣeṇa tuṣṭo nārāyaṇo.abhavat||17||
narmadātīranagare nṛpaḥ suṣvāpa maṃdire ||
rātriśeṣe suparyaṃke nidrāṃ kurvati rājani ||
uvāca viprarūpeṇa bodhayañchlakṣṇayā girā || 18 ||
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha rājendra tau sādhū parimocaya ||
ityevaṃ bhūpatiścaiva viprarūpeṇa bodhitaḥ ||
sabhāyāṃ maṃtriṇe rājā svapnahetuṃ nyavedayat || 21 ||
mahāmantrī ca bhūpālaṃ prāha satyena bho dvija ||
ānīya sādhuṃ papraccha satyamālaṃbya bhūpatiḥ ||
kutratyau vāṃ kulaṃ kiṃ vā vasatiḥ kasya vā pure || 23 ||
|| sādhuruvāca || ||
vāṇijyārthaṃ mahārāja vāṇijyaṃ jīvikāvayoḥ || 24 ||
prāptau dūtaiśca baddhvāvāṃ tvatsamīpamupāgatau || 25 ||
pratikūle vidhau ko vā daśāṃ nāpnoti vai pumān ||
vināparādhaṃ rājendra maṇicaurānavādayan || 26 ||
āvāṃ na cauro rājeṃdra tattvatastvaṃ vicāraya ||
śrutvā tanniścayaṃ jñātvā tayorbaṃdhanakāraṇam || 27 ||
chedayitvā dṛḍhaṃ pāśaṃ lomaśātimakārayat ||
kārayitvā pariṣkāraṃ bhojayāmāsa tau nṛpaḥ || 28 ||
nagare pūjayāmāsa vastrābhūṣaṇavāhanaiḥ ||
abravītpūjitaḥ sādhurbhūpatiṃ vinayānvitaḥ || 29 ||
kārāgāre bahuvidhaṃ prāptaṃ duḥkhamataḥ param ||
ājñāpaya mahārāja deśaṃ gaṃtuṃ kṛpānidhe || 3.2.29.30 ||
śrutvā sādhuvaco rājā prāha kośādhikāriṇam ||
mudrābhistaraṇīḥ sadyaḥ pūrayāśu madājñayā || 31 ||
jāmātrā sahitaḥ sādhurgītavāditramaṃgalaiḥ ||
satyanārāyaṇo devaḥ pratyakṣaphaladaḥ kalau ||
sa eva tāpaso bhūtvā cakre sādhuviḍaṃbanam || 33 ||
|| tāpasa uvāca || ||
dharmaḥ kiṃ nauṣu te sādho māmanādṛtya yāsi bhoḥ ||
bhoḥ svāminme dhanaṃ nāsti latāpatrādipūritam ||
ityuktastāpasaḥ prāha tathāstviti vacaḥ kṣaṇāt ||
dhanamaṃtardadhe sādhorlatāpatrāvaśeṣitam || 36 ||
dhanaṃ naukāsu nāstīti sādhuściṃtāturo.abhavat ||
vajrapātāhata iva bhṛśaṃ duḥkhitamānasaḥ ||
kva yāsyāmi kva tiṣṭhāmi kiṃ karomi dhanaṃ kutaḥ || 38 ||
iti mūrchāgataḥ sādhurvilalāpa punaḥpunaḥ ||
jāmātrā bodhitaḥ paścāttāpasaṃ taṃ jagāma ha || 39 ||
ājñāpaya mahābhāga tadviḍambanakāraṇam || 41 ||
|| tāpasa uvāca || ||
ātmā caivātmanaḥ śatrustathātra ca priyo.apriyaḥ ||
tyaja mauḍhyamati sādho pravādaṃ mā vṛthā kṛthāḥ ||42||
iti vijñāpitaḥ sādhurna bubodha mahādhanaḥ ||
punaḥ sa tāpasaḥ prāha kṛpayā pūrvakarmataḥ||43||
caṃdracūḍo yadānarca satyanārāyaṇaṃ nṛpaḥ ||
prārthitaṃ na smṛtaṃ hyeva idānīṃ tapyase vṛthā ||
satyanārāyaṇo devo viśvavyāpī phalapradaḥ ||45||
purālabdhavaraṃ smṛtvā sasmāra jagadīśvaram || 46 ||
satyanārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ tāpasaṃ taṃ dadarśa ha ||
tuṣṭāva tāpasaṃ tatra sādhurgadgadayā girā || 47 ||
|| sādhuruvāca || ||
satyarūpaṃ satyasaṃdhaṃ satyanārāyaṇaṃ harim ||
tvanmāyāmohitātmāno na paśyaṃtyātmanaḥ śubham ||
duḥkhāṃbhodhau sadā magnā duḥkhe ca sukhamāninaḥ || 49 ||
mūḍhohaṃ dhanagarveṇa madāṃdhīkṛtalocanaḥ ||
na jāne svātmanaḥ kṣemaṃ kathaṃ paśyāmi mūḍhadhīḥ || 3.2.29.50 ||

pātuṃ patimukhāṃbhojaṃ cakorīva dinātyaye || 58 ||
avajñānātprasādasya naukāśaṃkhapateratha ||
nimagnā jalamadhye tu jāmātrā saha tatkṣaṇāt || 59 ||
magnaṃ jāmātaraṃ paśyanvilalāpa sa mūrcchitaḥ ||
līlāvatī tu taddṛṣṭvā mūrcchitā vilalāpa ha || 3.2.29.60 ||
tataḥ kalāvatī dṛṣṭvā papāta bhuvi mūrcchitā ||
raṃbheva vātavihatā kāntakāntetivādinī || 61 ||
hā nātha priya dharmajña karuṇākarakauśala ||
tvayā virahitā patyā nirāśā vidhinā kṛtā ||

tatraiva sādhuḥ sāhlādo bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ ||
pūjanaṃ lakṣamudrābhiḥ satyadevasya cākarot || 67 ||
itihāsamimaṃ bhaktyā śṛṇuyādyo hi mānavaḥ ||
so.api viṣṇupriyataraḥ kāmasiddhimavāpnuyāt || || 69 ||
vratānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nārāyaṇavratam || 1 ||
tvanmukhena śrutaṃ sūta tāpatrayavināśanam ||
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi liṃgajaṃ karma cottamam || 2 ||
sarveṣāṃ brahmacaryāṇāṃ brahmacarye hi kiṃ param ||
āsītpurā kaliyuge pitṛśarmā dvijottamaḥ ||
jñātvā ghoratamaṃ kālaṃ kali kālamadharmajam||
vārdhanaṃ yamarāṣṭrasya tadā ciṃtāturo.abhavat || 5 ||
kalau saṃnyāsamārgo hi daṃbhapākhaṃḍakhaṃḍitaḥ || 6 ||
gārhasthyaṃ karma sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ śreṣṭhamucyate || 7 ||
yadi me ca bhavennārī manovṛttyanusāriṇī ||

|| pitṛśarmovāca ||

brahmamātarnamastubhyaṃ sāhaṃkārapitāmahi || 11 ||

dṛṣṭvā parājitaṃ sainyaṃ dhuṃdhukāro mahābalaḥ ||
āhlādaṃ ca svabhallena gajārūḍhaḥ samāvadhīt || 42 ||
āhlāde mūrcchite tatra devasiṃho mahābalaḥ ||
bhallena bhrātaraṃ tasya daṃśayāmāsa vegataḥ || 43 ||
sa tīkṣṇavraṇamāsādya gajasthaḥ saṃmumoha vai ||
āgatāḥ śatarājāno nānādeśyā mahābalāḥ || 44 ||

etasminnaṃtare vīraḥ sukhakhānirmahābalaḥ |
mūrcchayitvā mahīrājaṃ svabaṃdhūṃśca savāhanān ||
kṛtvā nṛpāṃtamāgamya baṃdhanāya samudyataḥ || 51 ||

hāhābhūtaṃ svasainyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā sa udayo hariḥ ||
nabhomārge hayaṃ kṛtvā tāḥ śatadhnīranāśayat || 54 ||
mahīrājagajaṃ prāpya baddhvā taṃ nigaḍairbalo ||
āhlādapārśvamāgamya bhrātre bhūpaṃ samarpayat || 55 ||
pañcakoṭidhanaṃ dattvā svagehaṃ punarāyayau || 56 ||
devasiṃhājñayā śūro balakhānirhi vatsajaḥ ||
tairdravyairnagarīṃ ramyāṃ kārayāmāsa sundarīm || 57 ||
śirīṣākhyaṃ puraṃ nāma tena vīreṇa vai kṛtam ||
sarvavarṇasamāyuktaṃ dvikrośāyāmasaṃmitam || 58 ||

śrutvā parimalo rājā tatrāgatya mudānvitaḥ ||
āghrāya vatsajaṃ śūraṃ deśarājasutaṃ tathā || 3.3.11.60 ||
dvādaśābde hi kṛṣṇāṃśe yathājātaṃ tathā śṛṇu ||
iṣaśukladaśamyāṃ ca rājñāṃ jātaḥ samāgamaḥ || 1 ||
kānyakubje mahāramye nānābhūpāḥ samāyayuḥ ||
śrutvā parājayaṃ rājño mahīrājasya lakṣaṇaḥ || 2 ||
kṛṣṇāṃśadarśane vāṃchā tasya cāsīttadā mune ||
pitṛvyaṃ bhūpatiṃ prāha draṣṭuṃ yāsyāmi taṃ śubham || 3 ||
bhrātṛjaṃ praṇataṃ prāha śṛṇu śuklayaśaskara ||4||
ityuktvā jayacaṃdrastu tadājñāṃ naiva dattavān || 5 ||

kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ draṣṭumicchantaḥ saṃyayuśca mahīpatim || 6 ||

śilāpatre samāropya tayorgātramacūrṇayat ||

mlecchairnarāśanaiḥ sārddhaṃ tannṛpeṇa raṇo.abhavat ||

mātulenādya kathitaṃ navīnaṃ maraṇaṃ tayoḥ||

balakhānistadā prāptaścaikalakṣabalānvitaḥ ||

vihvalaṃ nṛpamālokya kṛṣṇāṃśo.a.aśvāsayanmudā || 23 ||

patākāḥ pañcasāhasrāḥ sāhasraṃ kāṣṭhakāriṇaḥ ||
gajā daśasahasrāśca rathāḥ paṃcasahasrakāḥ || 25 ||

śeṣāḥ padātayo jñeyāsta sminsainye bhayānake || 26 ||

āhlādaśca gajānāṃ ca sarveṣāmadhipo.abhavat ||
pattīnāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaścādhipo.abhavat || 28 ||
natvā te malanāṃ bhūpo dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ ||
samāyayuśca te sarve dakṣiṇāśāṃ balānvitāḥ || 29 ||

chittvā tatra vanaṃ ghoraṃ nānākaṃṭakasaṃyutam ||
senāṃ nivāsayāmāsurnirbhayāste mahābalāḥ || 3.3.12.30 ||
nartakaścaiva kṛṣṇāṃśaścāhlādo ḍamarupriyaḥ || 31||
maḍḍudhārī tadā devo vīṇādhārī ca tālanaḥ ||
vatsajaḥ kāṃsyadhārī ca balakhānirmahābalaḥ || 32 ||
mohitā devakī cāsīnna jñātaṃ tatra kāraṇam || 33||
mohitāṃ mātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā paraṃ harṣamupāyayuḥ ||

tadā tu duḥkhitā devī dolāmāruhya satvarā ||

tatpaścātsva purīṃ prāya tadā kimabhavanmune || 1 ||

devaḥ papīhakārūḍhaḥ sukhakhāniḥ karālake || 9 ||

devyā dugdhaṃ sa vai pītvā ṣoḍaśābdasamobhavat || 3.3.14.10 ||
induṃ pīyūṣabhavanaṃ gṛhṇāti vapuṣā svayam ||
sa bālaḥ svapiturvidyāṃ paṭhitvā śreṣṭhatāmagāt || 11 ||
vinaṣṭe bālake tasmindevī svarṇavatī tadā ||
jñātvāhlādaṃ tathā bhūtaṃ daśagrāme tathāvidhe ||
raudraḥ kolāhalo jāto rudatāṃ ca nṛṇāṃ mune || 13 ||
āhlādaḥ svakulaiḥ sārddhaṃ nirāhāro yateṃdriyaḥ ||
śāradāṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptastrirātraṃ tatra cāvasat || 14||
yāvattvaṃ bhūtale.avātsīstāvatsa bhūtale vaset ||
daśagrāmapuraṃ prāpya samūṣurjñāna tatparāḥ || 18 ||
indule svargasaṃprāpte te vīrāḥ śokakātarāḥ ||
śāradāṃ pūjayāmāsuḥ sarvalokanivāsinīm || 1 ||
dvādaśābde tato jāte tricaritrasya pāṭhataḥ ||
parīkṣārthaṃ tu bhaktānāṃ sākṣānmūrtitvamāgatā || 4 ||
kuṃḍikeyaṃ ca bho bhaktāḥ pūrayāmi ca tāmaham ||
yūyaṃ tu manasopāyaiḥ kurudhvaṃ pūraṇe matim || 5 ||
kuṇḍikāṃ pūrayā māsa na pūrṇatvamupāgatā ||
balakhānistathā māṃsairmūlaśarmā tu raktakaiḥ || 6 ||
kuṇḍikāṃ pūrayāmāsa na pūrṇatvamupāgatā || 7 ||
āhrādaścaiva sarvāṃgairudayaḥ śirasā svayam ||
kuṇḍikāṃ pūrayāmāsa tadā pūrṇatvamāgatā || 8 ||
sukhākhāne bhavānvīro bhaviṣyati surapriyaḥ || 9 ||
balakhānirmahāvīro dīrghe kāle sa mṛtyubhāk ||
mūlaśarmā tu balavānraktabījo bhaviṣyati || 3.3.15.10 ||
āhlādaścaiva kṛṣṇāṃśastayormadhye dvayaṃ varam ||
niṣkāmo.ayaṃ devasiṃho mṛto mokṣatvamāpnuyāt ||
ityuktvāntardadhe mātā te sarve tṛptimāgatāḥ || 12 ||
prāpte saptadaśābde ca kṛṣṇāṃśe tatra cābhavat ||
śṛṇu tvaṃ muniśārdūla dṛṣṭaṃ yadyogadarśanāt || 1 ||
ratnabhānau mṛte rājñi marudhanvamahīpatiḥ ||
gajasenastadā vipra pṛthvīrājabhayāturaḥ || 2 ||
ārādhya pāvakaṃ devaṃ yajñadhyānavratārcanaiḥ ||
dvādaśābdaṃ sadācāraḥ premabhaktyā hyatoṣayat || 3||
tadā prasanno bhagavānpāvakīyaṃ hayaṃ śubham ||
pāvakāste hi catvāraḥ samudbhūtā mahītale ||
agnivarṇā mahāvīrāḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitāḥ || 5 ||
aṣṭādaśavayobhūtāḥ sarve te munipuṃgava ||
jātamātrā devasamāḥ sarvavidyāviśāradāḥ || 6 ||
aṣṭādaśābdavayasā sā kanyā varavarṇinī ||
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe cāṣṭamyāṃ caṃdravāsare ||
tasyāḥ svayaṃvaraścāsītsā nṛpānprati cāyayau || 9 ||
vidyudvarṇaṃ mukhaṃ tasyāścaṃcalāyāstathāgatam ||
dṛṣṭvā mumoha dharmāṃśo balakhānirmahīpatiḥ || 3.3.16.10 ||
sāpi dṛṣṭvā ca taṃ vīraṃ mumoha gajamuktikā ||
buddhvā tasmai dadau mālāṃ vaijayaṃtī śubhānanā || 11 ||
tārakādyāśca bhūpālāḥ sarvaśastrāstrasaṃyutāḥ ||
tathāvidhānnṛpāndṛṣṭvā bhūpānpaṃcaśatānbalī ||
sa śīghraṃ khaṅgamutsṛjya śatabhūpaśirāṃsyahan || || 13 ||
sarvato vadhyamānaṃ taṃ balakhāniṃ sa tārakaḥ ||
tadbhujābhyāṃ dadau khaḍgaṃ sa tadaṃge dvidhābhavat || 14 ||
mahīrājasuto jyeṣṭho dṛṣṭvā khaḍgaṃ tathā gatam ||
apovāha raṇācchūrastatpaścātte nṛpā yayuḥ || 15 ||
tāṃ kanyāṃ śibikārūḍhāṃ svagehaṃ so.anayadbalī || 16 ||
tāṃ gacchaṃtīṃ sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā gajaseno mahīpatiḥ ||
mahīpatyājñayā prāpto jñātvā taṃ kṣatriyādhamam || 17 ||
jaṃbukaghnaṃ mahāvīraṃ māyayā tamamohayat ||
jāte nidrāture vīre durgāyāḥ śāpamohite || 18 ||
nigaḍaistaṃ babaṃdhāśu dṛḍhairlohamayai ruṣā ||
lohadurgaṃ ca saṃprāpya grāmarūpaṃ mahīpatiḥ || 19 ||
cāṃḍālāṃśca samāhūya kaṭhināṃstatravāsinaḥ ||
vadhāyājñāpayāmāsa tasya daṃḍairanekaśaḥ || 3.3.16.20 ||
te raudrāstaṃ samābadhya tāḍayāmāsurūjjitāḥ ||
tattāḍanāttadā nidrā tatraiva vilayaṃ gatā || 21 ||
dṛṣṭvā tatastu caṃḍālānbalakhāniratāḍayat ||
talamuṣṭiprahāreṇa cāṃḍālā maraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 22 ||
kapāṭaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā nṛpāṃtikamupāyayuḥ || 23 ||
sa nṛpaḥ kāraṇaṃ jñātvā hastabaddho mahābalī ||
bhavānmahābalo vīra cāṃḍālairbaṃdhanaṃ gataḥ ||
matsutā bhavane prāptā diṣṭyā tvaṃ jīvitaṃ gataḥ ||
udvāhya matsutāṃ śīghraṃ svagehaṃ yātumarhasi ||
iti śrutvā priyaṃ vākyaṃ taṃ praśasya tathākarot||26||
maṃḍape vedakarmāṇi vivāhārthaṃ cakāra saḥ ||
jātāyāṃ maṃḍapārcāyāṃ patramāhlādahetave || 27 ||
uṣṭrārūḍhaṃ samāhūya śīghraṃ patramacodayat || 28 ||
saṃprāpya yogyadravyāṇi bhuktvā tvaṃ tṛptimāvaha || 29 ||
ityukte niśi jātāyāṃ balakhānirmahābalaḥ ||
bhojanaṃ kṛtavāṃstatra viṣajuṣṭaṃ nṛpārpitam || 3.3.16.30 ||
tataḥ kāle ca saṃprāpte dṛṣṭvā mohatvamāgatam ||
punarbabaṃdha nigaḍaistāḍayāmāsa vetasaiḥ || 31 ||
viṣadoṣamasṛkdvārānnissṛtaṃ sarvadehataḥ ||
tadā bubodha balavānbhūpatiṃ prāha namradhīḥ || 32 ||
rājankimīdṛśaṃ jātaṃ tvatsainyaṃ tāḍane ratam ||
sa āha bho mahāvīra matkule rītirīdṛśī ||
yātanāṃ prathamaṃ prāpya tadanūdvāhito bhavet || 33 ||
pitaraṃ prāha vacanaṃ ko.ayaṃ tattāḍane gataḥ || 34 ||
nṛpaḥ prāha sute śīghraṃ yāhi tvaṃ nijamaṃdire ||
kṛṣikaroyamāyāto dravyārthaṃ tāḍane gataḥ || 35 ||
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ balakhānirmahābalaḥ ||
chittvā tadbaṃdhanaṃ ghoraṃ khaḍgahastaḥ samāyayau || 36 ||
śūrānpaṃcaśataṃ taṃ ca ruddhvā śastraiḥ samaṃtataḥ ||
gajasena suto jyeṣṭhaḥ sūryadyutirupāgataḥ ||
tathā gataṃ patiṃ dṛṣṭvā gajamuktā suduḥkhitā ||
niśi tatra gatā devī dattvā dravyaṃ tu rakṣakān || 39||
rātraurātrau tathā prāptā vyatītaṃ pakṣamātrakam || 3.3.16.40 ||
etasminnaṃtare vīraścāhlādaḥ saptalakṣakaiḥ ||
sainyaiḥ sahāyayau śīghraṃ śrutvā tatraiva kāraṇam || 41 ||
gajaiḥ ṣoḍaśasāhasrairgajaseno raṇaṃ yayau || 42 ||
trilakṣaiśca hayaiḥ sārddhaṃ sūryadyutirupāyayau ||
kāṃtāmalastadā prāptastrilakṣaiśca padātibhiḥ || 43 ||
prabhagnaṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā pāvakī.ayaṃ samāruhat ||
dāhayāmāsa tatsainyaṃ tālanādyaiśca pālitam || 45 ||
bhasmībhūtaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā tālanaḥ śatrusammukhe ||
gatvā bhallena bhūpālaṃ tāḍayāmāsa vegataḥ || 46 ||
mūrchitaṃ nṛpamājñāya sūryadyutirupāyayau ||
pāvakīyaṃ samāruhya dāhayāmāsa tālanam || 47 ||
etasminnaṃtare śūrau devau cāhlādakṛṣṇakau ||
babandhatū ruṣāviṣṭau sūryadyutimariṃdamam || 48 ||
subaddhaṃ bhrātaraṃ jñātvā hayaṃ kāṃtāmalo.aruhat ||
devasiṃhaṃ ca saṃmohya kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati so.agamat ||
gṛhītvā taṃ sa kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ tasya tejaḥ samāharat || 49 ||
vijayaṃ nṛpatiḥ prāpya harṣito gehamāyayau | 51 ||
vahnibhūtaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ dṛṣṭvāhlādaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ ||
durgāṃ devīṃ sa tuṣṭāva manasā raṇamūrddhani || 52 ||
svargādāgatya sarvāṇi punarujjīvayiṣyati || 53 ||
dvādaśābdasamaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā vidyāviśāradaḥ ||
vaḍavāmṛtamāruhya hayaṃ tatra samāgataḥ || 54 ||
tadaṅgāduddhṛtā vāhā meghā iva samantataḥ ||
pāvakaṃ śamayāmāsustrayaste devatopamāḥ || 55 ||
śamībhūte tadā vahnau svamukhātsahayo mudā ||
lālāmudvāhayāmāsa tayā te jīvitāstataḥ || 56 ||
jīvite saptalakṣe tu śamībhūte hi pāvake ||
gajasenaḥ sutābhyāṃ ca prayātaḥ sarvatodiśam || 57 ||
lakṣaṃ sainyaṃ tu ye śiṣṭāste sarve.api bhayāturāḥ ||
dudruvurbhārgavaśreṣṭha divyarūpatvadhāriṇaḥ || 58 ||
kecitsaṃnyāsino bhūtvā kecidvai brahmacāriṇaḥ ||
jīvatvaṃ prāptavantaste tathānye saṃkṣayaṃ gatāḥ || 59 ||
baddhvā tāngajasenādīṃstrīñchūrānsa ca tālanaḥ ||
kṛṣṇāṃśena samāyukta iṃdradurgaṃ samāyayau || 3.3.16.60 ||
balakhāniṃ ca niṣkāsya tālanastadanaṃtaram ||
pṛṣṭavān kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ śrutvā tanmukhato vacaḥ ||
tānvīrāṃstāḍayāmāsa vetasaiḥ staṃbhabaṃdhanaiḥ || 61 ||
gajamuktājñayā vipra senāpatarirudāradhīḥ ||
tālanastānsamutsṛjya vivāhārthaṃ samāyayau ||
balakhānirhayārūḍho gajamuktā ca maṃḍape || 62 ||
nivāsya lohadurge tānkapāṭaḥ sudṛḍhīkṛtaḥ ||
lakṣaśūrānsa saṃsthāpya svayaṃ rudrapuraṃ yayau ||63||
prabhāte ca kapāṭe na dvāraṃ dṛṣṭvā tadābravīt ||
dvāramudghāṭayāśu tvaṃ no cetprāṇāṃstyajiṣyasi || 64 ||
iti senāpatiḥ śrutvā lakṣaśūrānsamādiśat ||
nānāyatnaiśca haṃtavyāḥ śatravo bhayakāriṇaḥ || 65 ||
iti śrutvā tu te śūrāḥ śataghnyastaiḥ suropitāḥ ||
ekaikaṃ kramaśo jaghnurvṛṃdaṃ te vairatatparāḥ || 66 ||
hate daśasahasre tu kṛṣṇāṃśo biṃdulaṃ hayam ||
hataśeṣā bhayārtāśca sahayāśītisammitāḥ ||
iṃdradurgaṃ prati prāhuryathā jāto balakṣayaḥ || 68 ||
śrutvā bhayāturo rājā svasutābhyāṃ samanvitaḥ ||
svapāpaṃ kṣālayāmāsa dattvā kanyāṃ vidhānataḥ || 69 ||
ṣoḍaśoṣṭrāṇi svarṇāni gṛhītvāhlāda eva saḥ ||
saṃprāpte gehamāhlāde devī svarṇavatī svayam ||
iti śrutvendulo vīro natvāha jananīṃ mudā||
anṛṇaṃ nādhigacchāmi tvatto mātaḥ kadācana||73||
saṃprāpte gehamāhlāde rājā parimalaḥ sudhīḥ ||
vādyāni vādayāmāsa viprebhyaśca dadau dhanam|| 74||
kṛṣṇāṃśe.aṣṭādaśābde tu yathājātaṃ tathā śṛṇu ||
mṛte kṛṣṇakumāre tu bhūpatau ratnabhānunā || 1 ||
mahīrājaḥ suduḥkhārto lakṣacaṃḍīmakārayat ||
homānte tu tadā devī vāguvāca nṛpaṃ prati || 2 ||
varṣevarṣe tu te sapta bhaviṣyaṃtyaṃgasambhavāḥ ||
kumārāḥ kauravāṃśāśca draupadyaṃśā sutā nṛpa || 3 ||
karṇāṃśaśca suto jātastārako balavattaraḥ || 4 ||
dvitīyābde tathā jāte duśśāsanaśubhāṃśataḥ ||
nṛhaririti vikhyātastṛtīyābde tu cābhavat || 5 ||
uddharṣāṃśaḥ saradano durmukhāṃśastu mardanaḥ ||
vikarṇāṃśaḥ sūryyakarmā bhīmaścāṃśo viviṃśateḥ || 6 ||
varddhanaścitrabāṇāṃśo velā tadanu cābhavat ||
yathā kṛṣṇā tathā saiva rūpaceṣṭāguṇairmune || 7 ||
bhuvi tasyāṃ ca jātāyāṃ bhūkampo dāruṇo.abhavat ||
aṭṭāṭṭahāsamaśivaṃ cāmuṃḍā khe cakāra ha ||
raktavṛṣṭiḥ pure cāsīdasthiśarkarayā yutā || 8 ||
brāhmaṇāśca samāgatya jātakarmādikāṃ kriyām ||
kṛtvā nāma tathā cakre śṛṇu bhūmipa sākṣaram || 9 ||9||
ilā ca śaśino mātā vikalpenā.abhavadbhuvi ||
tasmādveleti vikhyātā kanyeyaṃ rūpaśālinī || 3.3.17.10 ||
jātāyāṃ ca sutāyāṃ sa pitā viprebhya uttamam ||
dadau dānaṃ mudā yukto vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca || 11 ||
dvādaśābdavayaḥ prāpte sā sutā varavarṇinī ||
uvāca pitaraṃ namrā śṛṇu tvaṃ pṛthivīpate || 12 ||
maṃḍape raktadhārābhiryo māṃ saṃsnāpayiṣyati ||
draupadyā bhūṣaṇaṃ dātā sa me bhartā bhaviṣyati ||13||
sārddhaṃ lakṣatrayaṃ dravyaṃ gṛhītvā lakṣasainyakaḥ ||
nṛpāntaraṃ yayau śīghraṃ tārakaḥ piturājñayā || 15||
siṃdhusthāne cāryadeśe bhūpaṃ bhūpaṃ yayau balī ||
na gṛhītaṃ nṛpaiḥ keścittadvākyaṃ ghoramulbaṇam ||
mahīpatiṃ sa saṃprāpya mātulaṃ tadvaco.abravīt || 16 ||
śrutvā sa āha bho vīra brahmānando mahābalaḥ ||
sa ca vākyaṃ pragṛhṇīyādāhlādādyaiḥ surakṣitaḥ || 17 ||
bhavānṣaḍbaṃdhusahitaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyairvivāhitaḥ || 18 ||
nāsti bhūmaṃḍale kaścittadbalena samo nṛpaḥ || 19 ||
iti śrutvā yayau tūrṇaṃ tārakaḥ svabalaiḥ saha ||
kṛṣṇāṃśastu gṛhītvāśu padyaṃ vākyamuvāca ha ||
ahaṃ vivāhayiṣyāmi brahmānaṃdaṃ nṛpottamam || 21 ||
tūṣṇīṃ bhūtāstadā sarve tārakaḥ sa dvijaiḥ saha ||
abhiṣekaṃ tadā kṛtvā svagehaṃ punarāyayau || 22 ||
māghamāse site pakṣe trayodaśyāṃ suvāsare ||
vivāhalagnaṃ śubhadaṃ varakanyārthayostadā || 23 ||
saptalakṣabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ lakṣaṇaśca satālanaḥ ||
mahāvatīṃ purīṃ prāpto balī parimalādibhiḥ || 24 ||
āhlādo lakṣasainyāḍhyaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśena samanvitaḥ ||
balakhānirlakṣasainyaḥ saṃyutaḥ sukhakhāninā || 25 ||
raṇajicca balī bālo dvilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ || 26 ||
evaṃ dvādaśalakṣāṇāṃ sainyānāmadhipo balī ||
tālanaḥ siṃhinīsaṃstho vaḍavāṃ prayayau saha || 27 ||
āyayau dehalīgrāme mahīrājānupālite || 28 ||
devo manorathārūḍho viṃdulasthaḥ sa kṛṣṇakaḥ ||
vaḍavāmṛtamāsādya svarṇavatyāḥ suto gataḥ || || 29 ||
rūpaṇaśca karālastha āhlādaśca papīhake ||
pañcaśabdagajārūḍho mahāvatyadhipo gataḥ || 31 ||
vimānavaramāruhya dhīvaraiḥ śatavāhikaiḥ ||
ayutaiśca patākaiśca vetrapāṇisahakrakaiḥ ||
sahasraiḥ śibikābhiśca pañcasāhasrakai rathaiḥ || 33 ||
śakaṭairmahiṣoḍhaistu tathā pañcasahasrakaiḥ ||
sarvatopaskṛtaṃ ramyaṃ brahmānaṃdaṃ samāgataḥ || 34 ||
śrutvā kolāhalaṃ teṣāṃ mahīrājo nṛpottamaḥ ||
vismitaḥ sa babhūvātra śibirāṇi mudā dadau || 35 ||
durgadvāri kriyāṃ ramyāṃ kṛtvā vidhividhānataḥ ||
draupadyā bhūṣaṇaṃ dehi velāyai sa tamabravīt || 36 ||
draupadyā bhūṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ dehi mahyaṃ surottama || 37 ||
kuberātsa samānīya divyamābhūṣaṇaṃ dadau ||
āhlādastu svayaṃ gatvā velāye bhūṣaṇaṃ dadau ||
saṃprāpte prathamāvarte tārakaḥ khaḍgamādadau ||
āhlādastaṃ samāsādya yuyudhe bahulīlayā || 3.3.17.40 ||
nṛharistu dvitīye ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati cārudhat ||
tathā saradanaṃ vīraṃ balakhānirupāyayau || 41 ||
raṇajitsūryavarmāṇaṃ sa bhīmaṃ rūpaṇo balī ||
śatabhūpānkhaḍgadharāngajasenādikāṃstadā ||
lakṣaṇādyāḥ samājagmurmaṃḍape bahuvistate || 43 ||
bhagnabhūtaṃ nṛpabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā ruṣānvitaḥ ||
mahīrājo yayau rūḍho gajaṃ cāribhayaṃkaram || 44 ||
jitvā tānnetrasiṃhādīñchabdavedhī nṛpottamaḥ ||
lakṣaṇaṃ prayayau śīghraṃ bauddhinīṃ hastinīṃ sthitam || 45 ||
śivaṃ manasi saṃsthāpya jitvā baddhvā ruṣānvitaḥ ||
agamattamupagṛhya darśayāmāsa taṃ nṛpam || 46 ||
śrutvā parimalo rājā kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ bhīruko yayau ||
vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa cāhrādādiparājayam|| 47 ||
ajitaḥ sa ca kṛṣṇāṃśo nabhomārgeṇa maṃdiram ||
gatvā jagarja balavānyoginyānaṃdadāyakaḥ || 48 ||
viṣṇuṃ manasi saṃsthāpya mahīrājaṃ samāyayau || 49 ||
gṛhītvā cāgamāṃ dolāṃ svayaṃ śibiramāptavān || 3.3.17.50 ||
etasminnaṃtare sarve tyaktvā mūrcchāṃ samaṃtataḥ ||
khaḍgayuddhena tāñjitvā baddhvā tānnigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ || 51 ||
sānvayāñchatabhūpāṃśca hatvā tadrudhirāvahaiḥ ||
draupadīṃ snāpayāmāsurvelārūpāṃ kalottamām || 52 ||
vivāhānte ca te sarve śibirāṇi samāyayuḥ ||
sahasraśūrāṃstānhatvā punarbaddhvā mahābalān ||
śibirāṇi samājagmusteṣāṃ hāsyaviśāradāḥ || 55 ||
daśalakṣasuvarṇāni gṛhītvā nṛpatirbalī ||
velāṃ navoḍhāmādāya gatvā natvā tamabravīt || 56 ||
mama patnīṃ samādāya dāsīṃ kartuṃ samicchati || 57 ||
tadā mahāsatī velā vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ ||

rurodoccaistadā gāḍhaṃ citramāyāvimohitaḥ || 13 ||
yayau śīghraṃ prasannātmā yatrāhlādaḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ ||
ruditvā tatra vai gāḍhaṃ vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ || 14 ||
pratyakṣaṃ ca mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tena vīreṇa vai kṛtam ||
śataṃ svarṇaṃ ca me dattvā vinayenāvarodhitaḥ || 16 ||
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ niścayaṃ nādhigacchati || 17 ||
tadviyogena kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ svadehaṃ tyaktumudyataḥ || 18 ||
āhlādo niścayaṃ jñātvā bhāṣitaṃ ca mahīpateḥ ||
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ tāḍayāmāsa vaitasaiścarmakartanaiḥ||19||
tasya mātā tathā patnī bhaginī premaduḥkhitāḥ ||
āhlādaṃ bodhayāmāsurdhūrtamāyāvimohitam ||
na bodhitastadā vīraścitramāyāvimohitaḥ || 3.3.23.20 ||
tadā puṣpavatī devī svapatiṃ bhrātṛpīḍitam ||
dṛṣṭvā tatra gatā śīghraṃ patiduḥkhena duḥkhitā ||21||
vināparādhaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśo mahāniṃdāmavāptavān ||
saṃprāpya daṃpatī vīraścāṃḍālebhyo vanaṃ yayau || 26 ||
daṃpatī pālayāmāsa guhyagehe mudā yutā || 27 ||
cāṃḍālāste tu saṃgatya mṛganetre ca taṃ daduḥ ||
dhiktvāṃ pāpaṃ durācāraṃ tvayā me hiṃsitaḥ sakhā || 28 ||
yāsyāmi vividhānrāṣṭrānsatyaṃsatyaṃ bravīmyaham ||
ityuktvā prayayau vīraḥ śirīṣākhyapuraṃ śubham || 29 ||
gajamuktāmanujñāpya daṃpatī prāpya nirbhayaḥ ||
mayūranagaraṃ ramyaṃ niśi ghoraṃ samāyayau || 3.3.23.30 ||
makaraṃdastu balavānjñātvā tatsarvakāraṇam ||
svasuḥ patiṃ ca bhaginīṃ svāṃte premṇā nyavāsayat || 31 ||
dharmamārādhayāmāsa yajñairnānāvidhaiḥ stavaiḥ ||
nāṭyātmajā kesariṇī tatsakhī daṃbhakovidā || 33 ||
kesariṇyā gururjñeyaḥ kutuko yogurūpadhṛk ||
tena prasāritā māyā śatayojanamantarā || 34 ||
śatrubhirdurgamā bhūmiḥ śatrupāṣāṇakāriṇī ||
citrarekhābhūpasutā jayaṃtastu tayā hṛtaḥ ||
indulaśca sthito duḥkhī citramāyāvimohitaḥ || 36 ||
kṛṣṇāṃśaśca bhavāndevaḥ sahitaḥ sūryavarmaṇā ||
mayā dattāni yaṃtrāṇi gṛhītvā te mudā yutāḥ ||
citrarekhāṃ samāgatya nṛtyādīṃstaiḥ samaṃ kuru || 37 ||
mohayitvā ca tāṃ devīṃ paṭhitvā tanmataṃ śubham ||
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ varṇayāmāsa yathā dharmeṇa bhāṣitam || 39 ||
phālgune māsi saṃprāpte trayaste yogirūpiṇaḥ ||
yayurinnagaṭaṃ ramyaṃ nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ || 3.3.23.40 ||
mṛdaṃgāṃkastadā devo makaraṃdo vipaṃcimān||
nṛtyagānakaro vīraḥ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sarva mohanaḥ || 41 ||
sakulaṃ ca sasainyaṃ ca tuṣṭo rājābravīdididam || 42 ||
vāṃchitaṃ brūhi me yoginsa śrutvā prāha namradhīḥ ||
dehi me sūryavarmāṇaṃ svasutaṃ kāryahetave ||43||
kṛtvā kāryamahaṃ śīghraṃ punardāsyami te sutam||
svarājñīmāyayau rājā gatāste kāryatatparāḥ ||45||
pakṣamātreṇa bāhlīkaṃ nagaraṃ prayayurmudā ||
dharmadattāni yaṃtrāṇi gṛhītvā śatrumaṃdiram || 46 ||
āyayurlāsyatattvajñā nṛpamohanatatparāḥ ||
sarve ca nāgarāḥ prāptāstatra kṣatragaṇā mudā ||47||
mohitāstaiśca te sarve gītanṛtyaviśāradaiḥ ||
tānādāya punarbhūpaḥ svagehamabhinaṃdanaḥ ||
āyayau gehanṛtyārthī kārayāmāsa vai punaḥ ||49||
makaraṃdastadā vīṇāṃ mṛdaṃgaṃ bhīṣmajo balī||
maṃjīraṃ sūryavarmā ca kṛṣṇāṃśo gānanṛtyakam ||3.3.23.50||
gṛhītvā modayāmāsurnārīvṛndā mahottamam ||
citrarekhā svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ mohanahetave || 51 ||
māyāṃ nirvāpayāmāsa niṣphalā sā.abhavatkṣaṇāt ||
mohitā taiśca sā devī tānuvāca mudānvitā || 52 ||
vāṃchitaṃ brūhi me vīra kṛṣṇāṃśaścāha tāṃ vadhūm||
iti śrutvā citrarekhā śokavyākulacetanā ||
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ yoginaṃ prāha satyaṃ kathaya ko bhavān || 54 ||
iṃdrādyā devatāssarve mayā nirmitayā yayā ||
mohitāḥ kṣaṇamātreṇa na bhavānmohito mayā ||55||
devo nārāyaṇo vāpi dharmo vāpi śivaḥ svayam ||
ityuktassa tu kṛṣṇāṃśo vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ||56||
macchyālo makaraṃdo.ayaṃ sūryavarmā tathāvidhaḥ || 57 ||
śukaṃ dehi mahāmāye iṃdulaṃ dehi vā yadi ||
darśanaṃ dehi me śīghraṃ no cetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham ||
tathāvidhau ca tau dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃśo harṣasaṃyutaḥ || 62 ||
sūryavarmā gato gehaṃ makaraṃdena mānitaḥ ||
yayau manorathārūḍho yatrāhlādaḥ śucānvitaḥ ||
iti śrutvā sa āhlādaścā hlādaṃ paramāptavān ||
jñātvā tatkāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvidhi suto hṛtaḥ ||67||
mahīpatiṃ samāhūya vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ||
satyaṃ kathaya me bhūpa kṛṣṇāṃśena hatassutaḥ || 68 ||
sa hovāca śrutaṃ vīra kṛṣṇāṃśena yathā hataḥ ||
ityuktvā tu vihasyāśu kāryasiddhimupāgataḥ || 69 ||
ahlādaḥ krodhatāmrākṣaḥ keśānā kṛṣya taṃ mudā ||
vetasaistāḍayāmāsa svahastena punaḥ punaḥ || 3.3.23.70 ||
śrutvā parimalo rājā sapatnīkassamāgataḥ ||
bahudhā modayāmāsa rāmāṃśaṃ bahurūpiṇam || 71 ||
gato yatra mama prāṇassakulaṃ tvāṃ nayāmyaham || 72 ||
tadā mahīpatirduḥkhī niḥśvāso maunamāsthitaḥ ||
tadaghaṃ hṛdi saṃsthāpya mahāpīḍāmavāptavān || 73 ||
etasminnaṃtare vīro balakhāniḥ samāgataḥ ||
vimucya mātulaṃ dhūrtaṃ jyeṣṭhabandhumasāntvayat || 74 ||
sa cakāra vivāhārthamudyogaṃ bhrātṛjasya vai ||
tārakaśca tamāyātassārddhaṃ śūrasahasrakaiḥ ||
vīrasenaḥ svayaṃ prāptaḥ śūraiḥ sārddhaṃ navā.ayutaiḥ || 76 ||
brahmānaṃdaḥ svayaṃ prāptastrilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ ||
āhlādaśca śucāviṣṭo lakṣasainya samanvitaḥ || 78 ||
hā baṃdho kva gatastvaṃ vai māṃ tyaktvā puruṣādhamam ||
ityuktvā prayayau vīraḥ śokavyākulacetanaḥ || 79 ||
ahorātrapramāṇena māsaikaḥ pathi vai gataḥ ||
jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇasya paṃcamyāṃ vāhlīkagrāmamāptavān ||
vyūhaḥ svakīyasainyānāṃ racito balakhāninā || 81 ||
eko rathaḥ sthito yuddhe tatpaścātsaṃsthitā gajāḥ ||
pañcāśacca kramātteṣāṃ vājinaśca śataṃśatam || 82 ||
teṣāṃ paścātkramājjñeyā pattayo daśa saṃsthitāḥ ||
ekā senā ca sā jñeyā tatpramāṇaṃ bravīmyaham || 83 ||
senāyāṃ pañcasāhasrāḥ śataghnyastu tathā smṛtāḥ|| 84 ||
pañcāyutāni senāyāṃ sarve padacarāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
evaṃvidhāśca tāḥ senā balakhāneśca ṣoḍaśa || 85 ||
gajāstu daśasāhasrā madamattāḥ pṛthagyayuḥ ||
yuddhe .asmingaṇitaṃ hyevaṃ śūrāḥ śatruprahāriṇaḥ || 86 ||
abhinandanabhūpasya mlecchāḥ paiśācadharmiṇaḥ ||
trilakṣāśca hayārūḍhā ekalakṣāḥ śatapripāḥ? || || 87 ||
ekalakṣaḥ padacarā bhuśuṇḍīparighāyudhāḥ ||
tomarānvayasaṃyuktāḥ kṣatriyāḥ prayutāni vai ||
gajasthāstatra saṃprāptā yatrāhlādamahā camūḥ || 88 ||
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam ||
madamattāśca te sarve nirbhayā raṇamāyayuḥ || 89 ||
saptāhorātramabhavadyuddhaṃ samaraśāli nām ||
bāhlīkasyārddhasenā ca kṣayaṃ nītā ca tairnṛpaiḥ || 3.3.23.90 ||
ekalakṣaṃ hatāḥ sarve balakhāneśca sainyapaiḥ ||
hāhābhūte śatrusainye bhayabhīte diśo gate ||
dṛṣṭvā sainyavināśaṃ ca rājñaḥ saptakumārakāḥ ||
kauravāṃśāśca te jagmuryatra jāto mahārathāḥ||92||
gajasthāste mahāvīrāstomarānvayasaṃbhavāḥ ||
senāṃ jaghnuḥ śaraistīkṣṇairbalakhānermahātmanaḥ || 94 ||
dṛṣṭvā sainyaṃ parābhūtaṃ balakhānistadā ruṣā || 95 ||
naṃdaṃ prati tathā devaḥ parānaṃdaṃ ca tālanaḥ || 96 ||
upanandaṃ sūryavarmā sunandaṃ prati tārakaḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ balaṃ ghoramabhinandanabhūmipaḥ ||
kutukaṃ ca samāhūya nāṭyāṃ kesīraṇīṃ tathā ||
kathitaṃ kāraṇaṃ rājñā yathā jātaḥ parājayaḥ || 3.3.23.100 ||
iti śrutvā tu kutukastamāśvāsya mahīpatim ||
sa dhyātvā śāṃbarīṃ māyāṃ mahādevena nirmitām ||
tatsainyaṃ mohayāmāsa śilābhūtamacetanam || 101 ||
tadā kesariṇī nāṭyā aṣṭau baddhvā mahābalān||
rājñaḥ pārśvamupāgamya dattvā tāngehamāyayau ||102||
bāhlīkaśca prasannātmā baddhvā tānnigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ ||
luṃṭhitvā draviṇaṃ teṣāṃ kośamadhye samākṣipat || 103 ||
devyāśca varadānena devasiṃho bhayāturaḥ ||
jñātvā svarṇavatī devī sarvavidyāviśāradā ||
śyenīṃ mūrtiṃ samāsthāya yayau puṣpavatīṃ prati || 105 ||
dṛṣṭvā tu daṃpatī tatra makaraṃdaṃ gṛhe sthitau ||
ruditvā kathayāmāsa yathā prāptaḥ parājayaḥ || || 106 ||
kṛṣṇāṃśastu tadā duḥkhī makarandaṃ vaco.abravīt ||
gaccha vīra mayā sārddhaṃ madgururbaṃdhanaṃ gataḥ || 107 ||
kulakṣaye mahatpāpaṃ suproktaṃ pūrva sūribhiḥ ||
iti śrutvā tu tacchayālaḥ śūrāyutasamanvitaḥ ||
kṛṣṇāṃśena hayārūḍho bāhlīkaṃ tvarito yayau || 109 ||
tadā svarṇavatī devī puṣpavatyā samanvitā ||
śyenīrūpamupāsthāya yayau yatra mahāraṇaḥ || 3.3.23.110 ||
sa chittvā śāṃbarīṃ māyāṃ bodhayitvā svasainikān ||
rurodha nagarīṃ tasya bāhlīkasya mahātmanaḥ || 111 ||
dṛṣṭvā tāñchatrusaṃyuktānkutukastu tayā saha ||
punaśca śāṃbarīṃ māyāṃ preṣayāmāsa tānprati || 112 ||
chittvā sā sakalāṃ māyāṃ baddhvā tau daityasannibhau ||
nagaraṃ dāhayāmāsa tasya bhūpasya māyayā || 113 ||
svarṇavatyā kṛtaṃ citraṃ svayaṃ devyā ca māyayā || || 114 ||
tadā puṣpavatī devī hatvā kesariṇī ruṣā ||
tanmāṃsaistarpayāmāsa gṛdhragomāyuvāyasān || 115 ||
kutukaṃ ca tathābhūtaṃ hatvā svarṇavatī svayam ||
kārāgāre lohamaye sthitānvīrānamocayat || 116 ||
punarāgamya sā devī tayā sārddhaṃ śubhānanā ||
makarandaḥ sthito yatra kṛṣṇāṃśena samanvitaḥ || 117 ||
te sarve vismitāścāsañjñātvā devyā vimohitāḥ ||
krodhavanto mahāvīrā yuddhāya samupāyayuḥ || 118 ||
balakhāniṃ mahānando nandaścāhlādamāyayau || 119 ||
parānaṃdastathā devaṃ tārakaṃ copanaṃdanaḥ ||
sunando netra siṃhaṃ ca surānaṃdaśca tālanam || 3.3.23.120 ||
ahorātramabhūdyuddhaṃ teṣāṃ ca tumulaṃ kramāt || 121 ||
svakīyānvyākulībhūtāṃstādṛśāṃśca vilokya vai || 122 ||
citraguptaṃ tadā dhyātvā citramāyāmacīkarat ||
tadā tadbāṃdhavāścāsanbahudhā cābhinaṃdanāḥ || 123 ||
tān dṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarve bhayabhītāśca dudruvuḥ ||
tyaktvā yuddhamayīṃ bhūmiṃ śokavyākulacetanā || 124 ||
saṃdhyākāle tamobhūte nirutsāhā mahābalāḥ || 125||
hā kṛṣṇāṃśa mahābāho śaraṇāgatavatsala ||
indulaste kumāro.ayaṃ saṃhṛtaścitrarekhayā || 126 ||
tayā vimohitā vīrā vayaṃ te śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||
tadā kolāhalaścāsīdrudatāṃ balaśālinām ||
āhlādaṃ garhayitvā te mūrchitā bhuvi vihvalāḥ || 128 ||
āhlādastu.atathā śrutvā vajrapātāhataḥ svayam ||
unmādivattadā bhūtvā tāḍayāmāsa vakṣasi || 129 ||
etasminnaṃtare yogī kṛṣṇāṃśo bhagavatkalā ||
caṃdrodaye svayaṃ prāptaścāṣṭamyāṃ bhṛguvāsare || 3.3.23.130 ||
śūraśca daśasāhasrairmakaraṃdena saṃyutaḥ ||
tatsenāṃ bodhayāmāsa pālitāṃ balakhā ninā || 131 ||
jitvā tānsarvabhūpālāngṛhītvā vipulaṃ dhanam ||
tasya śabdena śeṣāṃśo bodhito balaśālinā ||
śakunaṃ śubhamālokya bhujāvutthāpya vīryavān ||
svāṃke niveśayāmāsa kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ yogirūpiṇam || 133 ||
snāpayitvā śrudhārābhiḥ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ premavihvalaḥ ||
dattvā dvijātimukhyebhyo varṇayāmāsa kāraṇam || 134 ||
kṛṣṇāṃśo.api prasannātmā svakīyāṃ sakalāṃ kathām||
varṇayitvā yathābhūtāṃ punarbāhlīkamāyayau ||135||
citravidyāṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā pāṭhitāṃ citrarekhayā ||
baddhvābhinaṃdanaṃ bhūpaṃ sasutaṃ ca samaṃtriṇam ||
vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa jayaṃtasya tayā saha || 136 ||
svasutāṃ citrarekhāṃ ca jayantāya mudā dadau ||137||
śataṃ gajānhayāṃstatra sahasrāṇi dhanairyutān ||
śataṃ dāsāṃstathā dāsīrjayaṃtāya svaya dadau || 138 ||
prasthānaṃ kārayāmāsa balakhānermahātmanaḥ ||
śrāvaṇe māsi saṃprāptāste sarve ca mahāvatīm || 139 ||
svaṃsvaṃ gehaṃ yayussarve bhūpāścāhlādamānitāḥ ||
śṛṇvatāṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ kathayiṣyāmi vai punaḥ || 3.3.23.140 ||
kṛṣṇāṃśe ca gṛhaṃ prāpte cendule ca vivāhite ||
mahīpatissadā duḥkhī dehalīṃ prati cāgamat|| 1 ||
vṛttāṃtaṃ ca nṛpasyāgre kathayitvā sa tārakaḥ ||
paraṃ vismayamāpannaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśacaritaṃ prati || 2 ||
etasminnaṃtare maṃtrī caṃdrabhaṭṭa udāradhīḥ ||
bhūmirājaṃ vacaḥ prāha śṛṇu pārthivasattama||3||
mayā cārādhitā devī vaiṣṇavī viśvakāriṇī ||
trivarṣāṃte ca tuṣṭābhūdvaradā bhayahāriṇī||4||
tayā dattaṃ śubhaṃ jñānaṃ kumatidhvaṃsakārakam||
tato.ahaṃ jñānavānbhūtvā kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati bhṛpate ||
caritraṃ varṇayāmāsa tasya kalmaṣanāśanam || 5 ||
ityuktvā sa ca śuddhātmā graṃthaṃ bhāṣāmayaṃ śubham ||
māhātmyaṃ devibhaktānāṃ śrāvayāmāsa vai sabhām ||6||
tacchrutvā bhūmirājastu vismitaścābhavatkṣa ṇāt ||
mahīpatistadā prāha divyāśvabaladarpitaḥ| ||
udayo nāma balavānyasyaivaṃ varṇitā kathā ||7||
śīghraṃ tāṃśca samāhṛtya svayaṃ bhūpa balī bhava || 8 ||
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatiḥ śrutavākyaviśāradam ||
āhūya kuṃdanamalaṃ preṣayāmāsa satvaram || 9 ||
mahāvatīṃ samāgatya sa dūto bhūpatiṃ prati ||
uvāca vacanaṃ premṇā mahīrājasya bhūpateḥ || 3.3.24.10 ||
vājinaste hi catvāro divyarūpāḥ śubha prabhāḥ ||
darśanātheṃ tava vadhūrvelā nāma mamātmajā || 11 ||
tayāhūtānhayānbhūpa dehi me vismayaṃ tyaja ||
no cedvelāgninā sarve kṣayaṃ yāsyaṃti sainyapāḥ || 12 ||
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ sa bhūpo bhayakātaraḥ ||
āhlādādīnsamāhūya vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ ||
hayānsvānsvānmudā dehi madīyaṃ vacanaṃ kuru || ||13||
iti śrutvā sa āhlādo dhyātvā sarvamayīṃ śivām ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ śṛṇu bhūpa śivapriya ||14||
yatra naḥ saṃsthitāḥ prāṇāstatra te vā jinaḥ sthitāḥ ||
na dāsyāmo vayaṃ rājansatyaṃsatyaṃ na cānyathā || 15 ||
śapathaṃ kṛtavānghoraṃ śṛṇvatāṃ balaśālinām ||
bhojanaṃ brahmamāṃsasya pānīyaṃ go.asṛjopamam||17||
śayyā svamātṛsadṛśī brahmahatyopamā sabhā ||
mama rāṣṭre ca yuṣmābhirvāsaḥ pāpamayo mahān ||18||
iti śrutvā tu śapathaṃ devakī śokatatparā ||
cakāra rodanaṃ gāḍhaṃ sagehajanavigrahā||19||
paṃcaviṃśābdake prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe yogatatpare ||
bhādraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ tadgehāddharmatatparāḥ || 3.3.24.20 ||
niryayuḥ kānyakubjaṃ te jayacaṃdreṇa pālitam ||
svarṇavatyā puṣpavatyā sahitāścitrarekhayā ||21||
karālaṃ hayamāruhya paṃcaśabdaṃ ca tatpitā ||
kṛṣṇāṃśo biṃdulārūḍho devakīmanusaṃyayau ||22||
natvā taṃ bhūpatiṃ premṇā gaditvā sarvakāraṇam ||
uṣitvā śītalāsthāne pūjayāmāsurambikām||24||
jayacaṃdrastu bhūpālo devasiṃhena varṇitaḥ||
tebhyaśca na dadau vṛttiṃ bhūmā parimalājñayā||25||
kuṃṭhito devasiṃhastu gatvā kṛṣṇāṃśamuttamam ||
uditvā kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ sa śrutvā roṣamādadhau || 26||
tvaritaṃ biṃdulārūḍho hayapaṃcaśatāvṛtaḥ ||
luṃṭhayāmāsa nagaraṃ pālitaṃ lakṣaṇena tat || 27 ||
dṛṣṭvā taṃ lakṣaṇo vīro hastinaḥ pṛṣṭhamāsthitaḥ ||
śareṇa tāḍayāmāsa kṛṣṇāṃśahṛdayaṃ dṛḍham ||28||
niṣphalatvaṃ gato bāṇo viṣṇumaṃtreṇa preritaḥ ||
