vināhlādaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ mahadduḥkhamupāgatam ||
ityuktasya vihasyāha brāhmaṇo.ayaṃ mahābalī ||
kānyakubjātsamāyātaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśena prayojitaḥ ||35||
devīdattaśca nāmnā.ayaṃ sa te kāryaṃ kariṣyati ||
śrutvā caṃdrāvalī devī sarvabhūṣaṇasaṃyutā ||36||
kāmāgnipīḍitaṃ vipraṃ cāmuṃḍaṃ ca dadarśa ha||
dhūrto.ayaṃ brāhmaṇo mātarniścayaṃ māṃ hariṣyati ||
ko.ayaṃ vīro na jānāmi kathaṃ yāmi pativratā ||38||
cāmuṃḍena yutaḥ prāpto yatrābhūtsa mahāraṇaḥ||39||
etasminnaṃtare te vai brahmādyāstaiḥ parājitāḥ||
tyaktvā yuddhaṃ gṛhaṃ prāptāstrilakṣabalasaṃyutāḥ ||3.3.26.40||
kapāṭaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā mahāciṃtāmupāyayuḥ |
pramadāvanamāgatya ṣaṣṭilakṣabalānvitaḥ||
tālanādyāśca catvāraḥ śirīṣākhyapuraṃ yayuḥ||
sthalībhūtaṃ ca taṃ grāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā te vismayānvitāḥ||
praṇamyocuḥ śucāviṣṭā balakhā nirmune balī ||
kva gataḥ samaraślāghī sa ca kunāgarairyutaḥ ||44||
śrutvāha himado yogī mahīrājena nāśitaḥ ||
chadmanā balakhāniśca tasyeyaṃ sundarī citā ||45||
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ śokatatparaḥ ||46||
vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ tatra hā bandho dharmajāṃśaka ||
tvadṛte bhūtale vāso mamātīva bhayaṃkaraḥ || 47 ||
darśanaṃ dehi me kṣipraṃ no cetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham || 48 ||
ityuktaḥ sa tu tadbhrātā balakhāniḥ piśācagaḥ ||
sapatnīkassamāyāto rodanaṃ kṛtavānbahu ||
kathitvā sarvavṛttāntaṃ yathājātaṃ svavaiśasam || 49 ||
yudhiṣṭhire tasya kalā balakhānerlayaṃ gatā || 3.3.26.50 ||
tadā duḥkhī sa kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ kṛtvā bhrātustilāṃjalim ||
mahāvatīṃ samāgatya rājagehamupāyayau || 51 ||
veṇuśabdena kṛṣṇāṃśo nanarta janamohanaḥ ||
vīṇāpravādyaṃ ca jagau tālano yogirūpadhṛka || 52 ||
mṛdaṃgadhvaninā devo lakṣaṇaḥ kāṃsyavādyakaḥ ||
susvaraṃ ca jagau tatra śrutvā rājā vimohitaḥ || 53 ||
tadā tu malanā rājñī dṛṣṭvā tadvāmanotsavam ||
kṛṣṇāṃśo bandhusahitastyaktvā māṃ mandabhāginīm ||
tvayā virahito deśo mahīrājena luṃṭhitaḥ || 55 ||
ityuktāṃ malanāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sneha kātaraḥ ||
vacanaṃ prāha namrātmā devi tvaṃ vacanaṃ kuru || 56 ||
yoginaśca vayaṃ rājñi sarvayuddhaviśāradāḥ ||
tavedaṃ sakalaṃ kāryaṃ kṛtvā yāmo hi naimiṣam || 57 ||
gṛhītvā yoṣitassarvā gacchantu sāgarāntikam ||
mātaraṃ vacanaṃ prāha kṛṣṇāṃśo.ayaṃ na nartakaḥ || 59 ||
puṇḍarīkanibhe netre śyāmāṃgaṃ tasya sundaram ||
kṛṣṇāṃśena vinā mātaḥ ko rakṣārthaṃ kṣamo bhuvi ||
durjayaśca mahīrājaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśena vinirjitaḥ || 3.3.26.60 ||
yavavīhayo niṣkāsya yoṣitāṃ sthāpitāḥ kare || 61 ||
jagustā yoṣitassarvāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśacaritaṃ śubham ||
lakṣaṇaḥ śīghramāgamya yogiveṣānsvasainikān ||
sajjīkṛtya sthitastatra tālanādyaiḥ surakṣitaḥ || 62 ||
kīrtisāgaramāgamya te vīrā bala darpitāḥ ||
rurudhuḥ sarvato nārīrdolāyutamitasthitāḥ || 63 ||
mahīpatistu kulahā jñātvā kṛṣṇāṃśamāgatam ||
yogibhistairmahārāja luṃṭhitāḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ ||
malanā saṃhṛtā tatra tathā caṃdrāvalī sutā || 65 ||
mahīrājasya te sainyā yogiveṣāssamāgatāḥ ||
tārakāya sutāṃ prādānmahīrājāya matsvasām || 66 ||
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ brahmānando mahābalaḥ ||
mahīrājastu kalahī sainyāyutamahātmajaḥ ||
rakṣitaḥ kāmasenena tathā raṇajitā yayau || 68 ||
tālano yogiveṣaśca brahmānaṃdamupāyayau || 69 ||
lakṣaṇaścābhayaṃ śūraṃ devasiṃho mahīpatim ||
lakṣaṇaḥ kāmasenaṃ ca devo raṇajitaṃ tadā ||
lakṣaṇaṃ chinnadhanvānaṃ punarbaddhvā mahābalaḥ ||
devasiṃhamupāgamya mūrchitaṃ taṃ cakāra ha || 73 ||
kṛṣṇāṃśo yoṣitassarvā vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ || 74 ||
tasmādyūyaṃ mayā sārddhaṃ gacchāśu ca taṃ prati || 75 ||
ityuktvā tāssamādāya brahmānandamupāyayau ||
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ naranārāyaṇāṃ śayoḥ || 76 ||
kṛṣṇāṃśastatra balavānnabhomārgeṇa taṃ prati ||
yoṣitastāḥ samādāya svagehāya dadhau manaḥ || 79 ||
mahīrājastu saṃprāpto mahīpatyanumoditaḥ ||
nṛharaścābhayaṃ śūraṃ mardanaścaiva rūpaṇam ||
madanaṃ vai saradano brahmānaṃdaṃ ca tārakaḥ || 81 ||
cāmuṇḍaḥ kāmasenaṃ ca dhanuryuddhamacīkarat ||
tadābhayo mahāvīro dhunvaṃtaṃ nṛharaṃ ripum || 82 ||
bhavānvai mātṛṣvasrīyo mahīrājasya cātmajaḥ || 84 ||
kṣatriyāṇāṃ paraṃ dharmaṃ kathaṃ saṃhartumicchati ||
iti śrutvā tu nṛharo gṛhītvā parighaṃ ruṣā || 85 ||
sa ca vai kṛtavarmāṃśo vilīnaḥ kṛtavarmaṇi || 86 ||
uttarāṃśaśca sa jñeyo madanaścottare layaḥ || 87 ||
rūpaṇaśca samāgatya mūrchayitvā ca mardanam ||
brahmānaṃdaśca balavānsa baddhvā tārakaṃ ruṣā ||
mahīrājāntamāgamya dhanuryuddhaṃ cakāra ha || 89 ||
nṛharaṃ raṇajitprāpya svabhallena tadā ruṣā ||
jaghāna samaraślāghī mahīrājasutaṃ śubham ||3.3.26.90||
sa vai duśśāsanāṃśaśca mṛtastasminsamāgataḥ || 91 ||
svaśaraistāḍayāmāsa sātyakeraṃśamuttamam || 92 ||
tāḍayāmāsa taṃ vīraṃ svabhallenaiva vakṣasi || 94 ||
svakhaṅgena śiraḥ kāyādapāharata vairiṇaḥ || 95 ||
rathasthaśca rathasthaṃ ca tāḍayāmāsa vai śaraiḥ || 96 ||
triśaraistāḍayāmāsa karṇāṃśaṃ tārakaṃ hṛdi || 97 ||
amarṣavaśamāpanno yathā daṃḍairbhujaṃgamaḥ ||
dhyātvā ca śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ viṣadhautaṃ śaraṃ punaḥ || 98 ||
saṃdhāya tarjayitvā ca śatrukaṃṭhamatāḍayat ||
tena bāṇena raṇajittyaktvā dehaṃ divaṃ gataḥ || 99 ||
hate tasminmahāvīrye brahmānaṃdaśca duḥkhitaḥ ||
mahīrājabhayādbrahmā puraskṛsya ca yoṣitaḥ ||
saṃdhyākāle tu saṃprāpte bhādrakṛṣṇāṣṭamīdine || 3.3.26.100 ||
kapāṭaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā sainyaiḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrakaiḥ ||
śirīṣākhyapuraṃ ramyaṃ yathā śūnyaṃ mayā kṛtam ||
paṃcalakṣabalaissārddhaṃ śīghramāgamyatāṃ priya || 104 ||
iti śrutvā dhuṃdhukāro gatvā śīghraṃ ca dehalīm ||
tadāṣṭalakṣasahito mahīrājo mahābalaḥ ||
saptaviṃśābdake prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe sarvamaṃgale ||
bhādrakṛṣṇadaśamyāṃ ca malanā śokakātarā ||
jananāyakamāhūya vacanaṃ prāha duḥkhitā || 1 ||
malanāṃ duḥkhitāṃ prāha na tvāyāsyati sa prabhuḥ ||
rājñaḥ parimalasyaiva vākyaṃ matvā suduḥkhadam || 4 ||
punarmūrcchāṃ gatā bhūmau jīvanaṃ tyaktumudyatā || 5 ||
hā rāmāṃśa mahābāho vatsa kṛṣṇāṃśa sundara ||
romaharṣaṇa no brūhi so.ayaṃ kastena kiṃ kṛtam || 8 ||
pitā parimalasyaivāmātyo.anaṃgamahīpateḥ || 9 ||
tasya kanyā samājātā nāmnā parimalā mune ||
duḥśalāṃśasamudbhūtā raṃbheva sukumārikā || 3.3.27.10 ||
jitvā bhūpānbalādvīraḥ siṃdhutīralanivāsinaḥ ||
ṣaḍaṃśakaramādāya pitṛrājyamupasthitaḥ ||13||
ekadā tu mahīrājaḥ svasainyaparivāritaḥ ||
parimalastu tadā rājā tasmai grāmaṃ śubhaṃ dadau || 16 ||
nivāsaṃ kṛtavāṃstatra svanāmnā prathitaṃ bhuvi ||
cāmuṃḍaṃ śīghramāhūya lakṣasainyasamanvitam ||
ādeśaṃ kṛtavānrājā tasya baṃdhanahetave || 18 ||
tatra śūraśataṃ hatvā nabhomārgamupāyayau ||3.3.27.20||
senāpateśca mukuṭaṃ gajasthasya gṛhītavān ||
lajjitaḥ sa tu cāmuṃḍo vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ ||21||
dehi me mukuṭaṃ vīra ciraṃ jīva sukhī bhava||22||
iti śrutvā sa vinayaṃ dattvā tasmai śubhaṃ vasu ||
kuṭhāranagare prāpto vāmanena surakṣitaḥ ||23||
dṛṣṭvā tatra vaṭacchāyāṃ śrameṇātīva karṣitaḥ||
tadā tu vāmano jñātvā svadūtaistatra kāraṇam ||
vastrāṇyācchādya cāgamya cāharaddharināgaram || 25 ||
hṛte tasmiṃśca divyāśve prabuddho jananāyakaḥ ||
ciṃtāmavāpya mahatīṃ rodanaṃ kṛtavānbahu || 26 ||
aśvāṃghricihnamālokya vāmanaṃ prāpya nirbhayaḥ ||
vacanaṃ prāha namrātmā nṛpaṃ gaurānvayodbhavam || 27 ||
kṣatriyāṇāṃ hi saṃhāsyo bhayado bhuvi sarvadā ||
sa bhavānrājanītijño dehi me.aśvaṃ sukhī bhava ||28||
gacchagaccha mahārāja mṛtānujīvayādhunā || 36 ||
prītiṃ ca kṛtavāṃstena macchatrordehalīpateḥ || 39 ||
priyaṃ saṃbadhinaṃ matvā saṃtyaktāstena rakṣakāḥ ||
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ prāha namradhīḥ ||
rājañchuddhaḥ parimalo mahīpatyanuvācakaḥ ||
ato vai tvāṃ samutsṛjya bhūmirājavaśaṃ gataḥ ||41||
ājñāṃ dehi mahārāja nivatsyāmastadaṃtikam|| 42 ||
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ jayacaṃdro mahīpatiḥ ||
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prāha bho vīra dehi me bhuktimūlyakam ||
iti śrutvā vihasyāha kṛṣṇāṃśassarvamohanaḥ ||
mayā digvijayaḥ sarvaḥ kṛto bhīrubhayaṃkaraḥ ||

sainyamājñāpayāmāsa saptalakṣaṃ mahābalam || 45 ||
tadā vai sakulo vīraścāhlādo lakṣaṇānvitaḥ ||
nṛpasyāgre samāsthāya namaskṛtya yayau mudā || 46 ||
kuṭhāranagaraṃ prāpya nṛpadurgaṃ rurodha ha ||

sainyāyuta yutaṃ bhūpaṃ vāmanaṃ lakṣaṇo balī ||
paścātkṛtya yayau śīghraṃ yamunātaṭamuttamam || 48 ||

nadīṃ vetravatīṃ ramyāṃ samāgamya balaissaha ||
tatroṣuḥ kṣatriyāḥ śūrāssarva śastrāstrasaṃyutāḥ || 3.3.27.50 ||
etasminnaṃtare vīraścāmuṃḍo lakṣasainyapaḥ ||
śataghnīḥ sthāpayāmāsa bhairavīḥ śatrunāśinīḥ || 51 ||
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ śataghrīraṇasaṃsthayoḥ ||

svabāṇaistāḍayāmāsa sainyaṃ tālanapālitam || 53 ||
kecicchūrā hatā yuddhe kecittatra parājitāḥ ||
dudruvurbhayabhītāśca cāmuṃḍena ca pīḍitāḥ || 54 ||
prabhagnaṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā tālanaḥ parighāyudhaḥ ||
jaghāna tena sa gajaṃ cāmuṃḍo bhūmimāgataḥ 55 ||
bhujayostāḍayāmāsa tadā te bahudhā.abhavan|| 57 ||

tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti bhāṣantaḥ kṣatriyānyuddhadurmadān || 58 ||
āhlādādyāśca te śūrā raktabījabhayāturāḥ ||
brahmānaṃdastu tāndṛṣṭvā gatvā svapitaraṃ prati ||
vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāmāsa lakṣaṇāgamanaṃ mune || 3.3.27.60 ||
āhlādapārśvamāgamya ruroda bhṛśamāturaḥ || 61 ||
uvāca sumukhī dīnā vayaṃ te bhakti tatparāḥ || 62 ||
iti śrutvā ca nṛpatiḥ paramā naṃdanirbharaḥ ||
maṃtriṇaścādhikāraṃ ca rāmāṃśāya dadau mudā ||
svakīyaṃ lakṣasainyaṃ ca tatpatiścodayaḥ kṛtaḥ || 64 ||
tataḥ paṃcadinānte tu mahīrājassamāgataḥ ||
rurodha nagarīṃ sarvāṃ cāmuṃḍabaladarpitaḥ ||
tayoścāsīnmahayuddhaṃ māsamātraṃ bhayānakam ||65||
prabhāte vimale jāte kṛṣṇāṃśo lakṣasainyapaḥ||
cāmuḍāntamupāgamya sahasraṃ svāṃgasaṃbhavam ||
ciccheda ca śirasteṣāṃ cāmuṃḍānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 66 ||

tuṣṭāva śāradāṃ devīṃ sarvamaṃgalakāriṇīm || 68 ||
kṛṣṇāṃśa uvāca||
tvayā tatamidaṃ viśvaṃ śabdamātraniraṃtaram||69||
raktabījavināśāya cāmuṃḍārūpadhāriṇi||
namaste divyacāmuṇḍe pāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam||3.3.27.70||
iti śrutvā stavaṃ devī varadā sarvakāriṇī||
bhasmībhūte lakṣaripau cāmuṇḍo bhūmimāgataḥ||
babaṃdha taṃ sa kṛṣṇāṃśo brahmānaṃdāṃtikaṃ yayau||
bhūmirājastu tacchrutvā bhayabhītaḥ samāgataḥ||
tadā parimalaṃ bhūpaṃ dayāluṃ premavihvalam ||

brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa sahasraṃ vedatatparān || 79 ||

kārtikyāmiṃduvāre ca kṛttikāvyatipātabhe||1||
kṛṣṇāṃśo.ayutasenāḍhyaḥ svarṇavatyā samanvitaḥ||
vivāhamukuṭasyaiva saṃtyāgāya yayau mudā||2||
tatra gatvā sa śuddhātmā puṣpavatyā samanvitaḥ||
śobhā nāma mahāramyā veśyā paramasundarī|| 5 ||
sā dadarśa paraṃ ramyaṃ kṛṣṇāśaṃ puruṣottamam||
taddṛṣṭimohamāpannā vyākulā cābhavatkṣaṇāt || 6 ||
mūrcchitāṃ tāṃ samālokya kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sarvamohanaḥ ||
svanivāsamupāgamya viprānāhūya pṛṣṭavān || 7 ||
aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni kena proktāni kiṃ phalam ||

iti śrutvā vaco ramyaṃ vidvāṃsaḥ śāstrakovidāḥ ||
abruvanvacanaṃ ramyaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ sarvadharmagam || 9 ||
parāśareṇa racitaṃ purāṇaṃ viṣṇudaivatam ||
śivena racitaṃ skāṃdaṃ pādmaṃ brahmamukhodbhavam || 3.3.28.10 ||
śukaproktaṃ bhāgavataṃ brāhmaṃ vai brahmaṇā kṛtam ||
gāruḍaṃ hariṇā proktaṃ ṣaḍ vai sāttvikasaṃbhavāḥ || 11 ||

sarveṣāṃ ca purāṇānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhāgavataṃ smṛtam || 15 ||

sūtaṃ sañcodayāmāsusteṣāṃ tacchravaṇāya ca ||
proktānyupapurāṇāni sūtenāṣṭādaśaiva ca || 17 ||
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśo dharmatatparaḥ ||
śrutvā bhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ saptame.ahni mahottamam || 18 ||
brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa sahasraṃ vedatatparān ||19||

māyāṃ kṛtavatī prāpya kṛṣṇāṃśo yatra vai sthitaḥ || 3.3.28.20 ||
chittvā cāhlādya vāmāṃgīṃ svagehaṃ gaṃtumudyatā 22 ||

saṃhṛtya māyayā dhūrtā deśaṃ vāhlīkamāyayau || 23 ||

gṛhītvā mama śṛṃgāraṃ śīghramāgaccha māṃ prati || 25 ||
guṭikeyaṃ mayā vīra racitā tāṃ mukhena ca ||
dhūrtamāyāvināśāya tava maṃgalahetave || 26 ||
iti śrutvā tathā kṛtvā kṛṣṇāṃśassarvamohanaḥ ||
śūkarakṣetramāgamya tatra veśyāṃ dadarśa ha || 27 ||
sā tu veśyā ca taṃ vīraṃ dṛṣṭvā kandarpakāriṇam ||
racayitvā punarmāyāṃ tadaṃtikamupāgatā || 28 ||

gṛhītvā sarvaśṛṃgāraṃ vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ||
kiṃ rodiṣi mahābhāge satyaṃ kathaya mā ciram || 3.3.28.30 ||

ityuktvā māyayā dhūrtā kṛtvā śavamayāntyajān || 32 ||

kathaṃ te jīvayiṣyanti śobhane kathayāśu me || 34 ||
sāha vīra tavāsye tu saṃsthitā guṭikā śubhā ||
dehi me kṛpayā vīra jīvayiṣyanti te tathā || 35 ||
tadā prasannā sā dhūrtā kṛtvā śukamayaṃ vapuḥ ||

āliliṃga hi kāmārtā kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ dharmakovidam || 38 ||

punaḥ śukamayaṃ kṛtvā ciṃciṇīvṛkṣamāruhat || 3.3.28.40 ||
tadā svarṇavatī devī bodhitā viṣṇumāyayā ||

narabhūtaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ || 42 ||
aye prāṇapriya svāminbhaja māṃ kāmavihvalām ||

siṃhādīnbhakṣayāmāsurjaghnuścaiva sahasraśaḥ ||77||
śobhanā cābhavaddāsī svarṇavatyāśca māyinī || 78||
sahurastairnaṭaissārddhaṃ cāhlādenaiva cūrṇitaḥ ||
teṣāṃ rudhirakabhāśca? bhūmimadhye samāruhan || 79 ||
evaṃ ca muniśārdūla caturmāssvabhavadraṇaḥ ||
vaiśākhe māsi saṃprāpte te vīrā gehamāyayuḥ ||
kinnarī nāma yā kanyā tvayā proktā mahāmune ||
kutra sthāne kathaṃ jātā tatsarvaṃ kṛpayā vada || 1 ||
maṃjughoṣā ca svarveśyā śukasthāne samāgatā ||
dṛṣṭvā taṃ sundaraṃ bālaṃ mohanāya samudyatā || 3 ||

etasminnaṃtare mantrī cadrabhaṭṭo viśāradaḥ ||
sarvaśāstrārthakuśalo vaiṣṇavīśaktipūjakaḥ ||33||
mahīrājaṃ samāgamya vacaḥ prāha śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ ||
mayā vai ca rahaḥ krīḍā dṛṣṭā devīprasādataḥ ||34||
tatrodayaśca kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ pūrṇabrahmāṇamāgamat ||
punastavāntikaṃ prāpya rahaḥ krīḍāṃ karomyaham ||
ityuktvā biṃdulārūḍhaḥ sa vīrastvāmupa sthitaḥ ||
ityahaṃ dṛṣṭavānbhūpa kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ yoganidrayā || 37 ||
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa bhūpo vismayānvitaḥ ||
bhayabhītaḥ sahasrāṇi śūrānāhūya satvaram ||
tebhyaśca lakṣaṇaṃ dattvā vacanaṃ prāha tānprati || 38 ||
padmākarāya bhūpāya gatvā dattvāśu lakṣaṇam ||
bhagadaṃtaśca teṣāṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ ca nāyakaḥ||
mahīrājaṃ vacaḥ prāha śṛṇu tannṛpabhāṣitam ||41||
padminī me svasā rājan guptavidyāviśāradā ||
tayā yajñapatirdevaḥ samyagārādhitaḥ purā || 42 ||
sā tu taṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kāṃtamaṃtardhānaṃ kariṣyati ||
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatiḥ paramānandamāptavān || 43 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyā mahābalāḥ ||
rurudhurdehalīṃ sarvāṃ mahīrājena pālitām || 44 ||
sa tadā pṛthivīrājo gṛhītvā bahubhūṣaṇam ||
sarvebhyaśca dadau premṇā vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ || 45 ||
lakṣaṇo nāma te rājā kārāgāre na vai mama ||
yadi mannagare cāsti tarhi te roṣa īdṛśaḥ || 46 ||
ityuktvā taṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ darśayāmāsa vai gṛham| ||
mahādevasya śapathaṃ kṛtavānbhūpatirbhayāt || 47 ||
tadodayo bhūpavacaḥ satyaṃ matvā suduḥkhitaḥ ||
svakīyaiḥ saha saṃprāpto grāmaṃ biṃdugaḍhaṃ śubham || 48|
kāmapālastu tacchrutvā kṛṣṇāṃśāgamanaṃ balī ||
baliṃ bahuṃ gṛhītvāśu kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ||
prāṃjaliḥ praṇato bhūtvā vacanaṃ prāha bhīrukaḥ || 49 ||
sutā me padminī nārī lakṣaṇena samanvitā ||
na jñātvā kva gatā.asmābhissatyaṃ satyaṃ bravīmyaham ||3.3.30.50||
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ svabalaissaha ||
bhrātṛjastava bhūpāla padminyā lakṣaṇo.anvitaḥ ||
kāmapālagṛhe nāsti niścito bahudhā mayā || 52 ||
yadi bhūpa na paśyāmi satyaṃ prāṇāṃstyajāmyaham || 53 ||
hā ratnabhānutanaya viṣṇubhakta śubhaṃkara ||
svamitraṃ māṃ parityajya kāṃ diśaṃ gatavānbhavān ||
ityuktvā mūrchitaścāsītkṛṣṇāṃśo vaiṣṇavapriyaḥ || 54 ||
tadā svarṇavatī devī svadāsyā śobhayā saha ||
dhṛtvā śukamayaṃ rūpaṃ tatrāgatya svamūrtigā || 55 ||
tayā saṃpreṣitā śobhā mlecchamāyāviśāradā ||
jayacaṃdramupāgamya dhṛtvā divyamayaṃ vapuḥ || 56 ||
uvāca vacanaṃ tatra śṛṇu bhūpaśiromaṇe ||
māyāvinī ca māṃ viddhi śobhanāṃ nāma viśrutām || 57||
daṃpatī tava bhūpāla saṃhṛtau yena yatra vai ||
tatrāhaṃ ca gamiṣyāmi mahāmadasamanvitā || 58 ||
āhlādaścendulo vīro devo vai tālano balī ||
kṛṣṇāṃśapālitāssarve yāsyāmo bhūpate vayam || 59||
ityuktvā śobhanā veśyā kṛtvā yogamayaṃ vapuḥ ||
mahāmadaṃ samāruhya paiśācaṃ rudrakiṃkaram ||
prayayau tānpuraskṛtya yogiveṣānmahāba lān|| 3.3.30.60 ||
āhlādo gajasaṃstho vai karālārūḍha indulaḥ ||
tālanaḥ siṃhinīsaṃstho devasiṃho manorathe ||
kṛṣṇāṃśo bindulārūḍho nartayāmāsa taṃ hayam|| 61 ||
kāmarūpamayaṃ deśaṃ śatayojanagāminaḥ ||
lakṣaṇaṃ śodhayāmāsurna prāptāstatra taṃ nṛpam || 62 ||
punarmayūranagaraṃ śobhanā taiḥ samanvitā ||
cinvatī taṃ manuṣyeṣu na prāptā tatra vai nṛpam || 63 ||
lakṣaṇaṃ mṛgayāmāsa na prāpa tatra lakṣaṇam|| 64 ||
gatvā bāhlīkanagaraṃ śobhanā taissamanvitā ||
lakṣaṇaṃ ca nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ nāpaśyattatra duḥkhitā || 65 ||
punaḥ svadeśamāgamya bāhlīkaṃ mlecchavāsinam ||
markaṭeśvaramīśānaṃ tatrāha vanavāsinam ||
pūjayitvā ca sā veśyā gānanṛtyaparābhavat || 66 ||
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ praṇato bhūtvā.abravīnmlecchaprapūjitaḥ || 67 ||
ahaṃ kālāgnirudreṇa bhūmigarte suropitaḥ ||
iti śrutvā ca sā śobhā nirāśābhūttadā svayam || 69 ||
punaḥ svarṇavatīṃ prāpya sarvamevā dito.abravīt ||
triṃśadabdaiśca kṛṣṇāṃśe caitraśukla samāgate || 3.3.30.70 ||
tānāśvāsya suvarṇāṃgī pūjayāmāsa caṃḍikām ||
navarātraṃ gataṃ tasyā bhojanācchādanaṃ vinā ||
niśīthānte tamaḥprāpte gatvāha jagadambikā || 71 ||
padminī nāma yā nārī maṇidevasya vai priyā ||
jātā sā kāmapālasya gṛhe yajñāvamānitā || 72 ||
pūrvaṃ hi bhīmasenena yakṣayuddheṣu ghātitaḥ || 73 ||
tuṣṭāva ca nirāhārā matpatiṃ dehi śaṃkara || 74 ||
śatavarṣāṃtare devo mahādeva uvāca tām ||
nakulāṃśaṃ ca saṃprāpya bhuktvā tena mahatsukham ||
svapatiṃ ca tadā prāpya kailāsaṃ punareṣyasi || 76 ||
mahāvatīṃ purīṃ ramyāṃ rāṣṭrapālāya śāradā ||
tayā viracito bhūmau grāmarakṣārthamudyataḥ ||
prāptastvāṃ padminīṃ nārīṃ kailāsaṃ punareṣyati || 78 ||
gatvāśu padminīṃ tatra bodhayāśu vacaḥ kuru || 79 ||
iti śrutvā svarṇavatī padminīṃ prati cāgamat ||
vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayitvāgre padminīṃ tu dayāturā || 3.3.30.80 ||
kāmapālagṛhaṃ prāpya tatra vāsamakārayat ||
svarṇavatyapi saṃprāptā tadā śīghraṃ mahāvatīm || 81 ||
tasyāṃ gatāyāṃ gehe vai padminyā likhitaṃ śubham ||
patraṃ parimalo rājā vartayāmāsa harṣitaḥ ||83||
āgaccha senayā sārddhaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśa balavattara ||
jitvā padmākaraṃ baṃdhuṃ matpatiṃ mocayāśu vai||
bhūtale lakṣaṇo rājā sthitaḥ padmākarārtigaḥ || 83 ||
iti jñātvā ca kṛṣṇāṃśo lakṣadvādaśasenayā ||
rurodha nagarīṃ sarvāṃ kāmapālena rakṣitām || 84 ||
kāmapālastu balavāṃstrilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ ||
sutājñayā yayau yuddhaṃ sārddhaṃ padmākareṇa vai || 85||
ahorātrapramāṇena bhūpasenā parājitā || 86 ||
padminīṃ śaraṇaṃ prāpya tadā bhrātā pitā sthitaḥ ||
tayorvijayamevāśu yathāprāptaṃ cakāra sā ||
tālanādyā raṇaṃ tyaktvā kṛṣṇāṃṇaśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||
kṛṣṇāṃśo.api tadā duḥkhī dhyātvā sarvamayīṃ śivām || 89 ||
divyadṛṣṭistato jātaḥ saṃprāpya tamayudhyata ||
nabhogataṃ kāmapālaṃ tathā padmākaraṃ nṛpam || 3.3.30.90 ||
baddhvā tatra mudāviṣṭo lakṣaṇaṃ prāpya nirbhayaḥ ||
dolāmāropya tāṃ devīṃ svagehāya mudā yayau || 91 ||
jayacaṃdrāya bhūpāya dattvā vai tau ca daṃpatī ||
lakṣaṇaṃ padminīṃ caiva kṛtakṛtyastadābhavat || 92 ||
jayacaṃdro.api balavāndṛṣṭvā gehe svadaṃpatī ||
jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe kṛṣṇāṃśo gehamāgataḥ || 93 ||
iti te kathitaṃ vipra kṛṣṇāṃśacaritaṃ śubham ||
punaste kathayiṣyāmi dṛṣṭaṃ yogabalena vai ||94||
śṛṇu vipra mahābhāga caṃdrabhaṭṭastadā svayam ||
mahīrājaṃ sadaḥsthaṃ taṃ candratulyassamāgataḥ || 1 ||
tamāgataṃ samālokya sa rājā śokatatparaḥ ||
uvāca vacanaṃ ramyaṃ śṛṇu maṃtrivara prabho || 2 ||
kṛṣṇāṃśādyairmahāśūrairmadgrāme bhayamāgatam ||
kadā te ca mariṣyaṃti kaṃṭakā mama dāruṇāḥ || 3 ||
ityuktassa tu śuddhātmā dhyātvā sarvamayīṃ śivām ||
vacanaṃ prāha rājānaṃ stha bhūpaśiromaṇe || 4 ||
jiṣṇoraṃśātsamudbhūto brahmānaṃdo mahāvatīm ||
sa kṛṣṇāṃśasakhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadā tatpriye rataḥ || 5 ||
tadā te sarvadevāṃśā gamiṣyaṃti yato gatāḥ || 6 ||
ityevaṃvādinaṃ dhīramamātyaṃ ca mahīpatiḥ ||
vacanaṃ prāha namrātmā ko.apyarthaściṃtito mayā || 7 || |
ekākinaṃ mahāśūraṃ brahmānaṃdaṃ nṛpottamam ||
samāhūya mahīrājo dvirāgamanahetave ||
chadmanā ghātayitvā taṃ kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyati || 8 ||
ityukte nṛpatiṃ prāha mahīrājaḥ prasannadhīḥ ||
vacanaṃ śṛṇu bho mitra gaccha śīghraṃ mahāvatīm || 9 ||
malanāṃ ca samāgatya bodhayitvā tu tāṃ svayam ||
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ natvā taṃ ca mahīpatiḥ ||
rātrau ghoraṃ muniśreṣṭha malanāṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ||11 ||
vadhūstava mahārājñi velā nāma surūpiṇī ||
saṃprāptā yauvanavatī patiyogyā śubhānanā || 12 ||
kujātiścaiva kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ śruto rājñā mahātmanā ||
mayā sārddhaṃ tava suto brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ ||
urvīyāṃ nagarīṃ prāpya tadā matsainyasaṃyutaḥ || 14 ||
mahīrājamupāgamya patnīṃ śīghramavāpsyati ||
no cenmamājñayā velā tyaktvā kāntaṃ mariṣyati || 15 ||
iti śrutvā tu sā rājñī mohitā devamāyayā ||
kathayāmāsa vai sarvaṃ śrutvā bhūpo.abravīdidam || 16 ||
mahīpatirmahādhūrto madvināśāya codyataḥ ||
iti śrutvā ca malanā rājānaṃ kopasaṃyutam ||
vacanaṃ kuru me rājanno cetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham||18||
ityuktavādinīṃ rātrau tadā parimalo nṛpaḥ ||
māturājñāṃ puraskṛtya mātulena samanvitaḥ ||
prātaḥkāle ca saṃprāpte harināgaramāsthitaḥ ||
ekākī dehalīṃ ramyāṃ prayayau devamohitaḥ || 21 ||
sāyaṃkāle tu saṃprāpte mahīrājasya maṃdire ||
agamāṃ darśayāmāsa surūpāṃ divyavigrahām || 22 ||
māghaśuklasya cāṣṭamyāṃ brahmānaṃdaśca nirbhayaḥ ||
śyālānāṃ yoṣitaḥ sapta dadarśa rucirānanā || 23 ||
tisro nāryaśca vidhavāścatasro dhavasaṃyutāḥ ||
brahmānaṃdaṃ śarumayaṃ vākyamūcurmudānvitāḥ || 24 ||
brahmānaṃda mahābhāga sāvadhānaṃ vacaḥ śṛṇu ||
tava patnī svayaṃ kālī velā kalaharūpiṇī ||
saṃjahāra dhavāneva no vayaṃ tu suduḥkhitā || 25 ||
sāpatnyamastu tattasyā gṛhāṇāsmānmanohara ||
iti śrutvā vacastāsāṃ brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ ||
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ śrutismṛtisamanvitam || 27 ||
tretāyāṃ madhyamā jātā nikṛṣṭā dvāpare punaḥ || 28 ||
satī satye tu sā proktā tretāyāṃ patibhasmagā ||3.3.31.30||
satī sā madhyamā proktā dvāpare vidhavā satī ||
ato yūyaṃ mayā sārddhaṃ bhuṃkṣadhvamamalaṃ sukham ||
iti śrutvā priyaṃ vākyaṃ tisrastā vidhavāḥ striyaḥ || 32 ||
kṛtvā śṛṃgāra rūpāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca sarvaśaḥ ||
yuṣmānato na gṛhṇīyāṃ satyaṃsatyaṃ bravīmyaham||
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ hāsyayuktaṃ ca yoṣitaḥ ||36||
mahīrājantamāgamya rurudurbhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ||
daṃḍaṃ dehi ca dhūrtāya no cetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham || 37 ||
iti śrutvā mahīrājo brahmānandaṃ mahābalam ||
samāhūya vacaḥ prāha bhavānbhūpakulādhamaḥ || 38 ||
adyaiva tvaṃ sutākānta kārāgṛhamavāpnuyāḥ || 39 ||
itiśrutvā vaco ghoraṃ brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ ||
satsaroḥ khaḍgamutsṛjya mahīrājamadhāvata || 3.3.31.40 ||
dṛṣṭvā bhayāturo rājā cāmuṃḍāntamupāyayau||
kapāṭaṃ dṛḍhamācchādya tatra vāsamakārayat || 41 ||
tāsāṃ kathaṃ vivāhāḥ syustattvaṃ no brūhi vistarāt||
kutratyāstāḥ kimaṃśāśca dṛṣṭā yogena vai tvayā || 42||
aṃgadeśe muniśreṣṭha māyāvarmanṛpo.abhavat ||
tāmasīṃ pūjayitvā vai śaktiṃ sarvavimohinīm || 43 ||
teṣāṃ svasānujā cāsītsunāmnā madirekṣaṇā||46||
tasyā vai suṃdaraṃ rūpaṃ madāghūrṇitalocanam ||
kitavo nāma vai daityo dṛṣṭvā mohamupāgataḥ || 47||
māyāvarmāṇamāgatya vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ ||
yadi tvaṃ me svatanayāṃ dehi kāmāturāya ca ||48||
tarhi te sakalaṃ kāryaṃ kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||
prātaḥkāle tu tāṃ tyaktvā kandarāntamupāyayau||3.3.31.50||
mahīrājāya saṃpreṣya tārakaṃ sa samāvṛṇot ||51||
mahīrājastu balavā~mllakṣaṣoḍaśasainyapaḥ||
saṃyutaḥ śatabhūpālairmāsānte samupāgamat ||52||
kṛṣṇāṃśe paṃcadaśake saṃprāpte vratatatpare||
tārakaśca vivāhāya bahubhūpoṃgamānayat||53||
māyāvarmā ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā tārakaṃ bhūpasaṃyutam||
hatā bhūpakumārāśca matsutārthaṃ samāgatāḥ||
teṣāṃ ca bahudhā dravyaṃ luṃṭhayitvā madāturaḥ||
kitavassa tu māyāvī jitvā sarvānmahābalān||
tārakaṃ ca samāhṛtya guhāyāṃ samupāgamat || 59 ||
tārakaśca tadā duḥkhī dhyātvā śaṃkaramuttamam ||
pāṣāṇabhūto hyagamanmahādevaprasādataḥ || 3.3.31.60 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptā mahāvatīnivāsinaḥ ||
kṣatriyā daśasāhasrā kṛṣṇāṃśādyaiśca pālitāḥ || 61 ||
iti śrutvā tu te dhīrāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśo devasiṃhakaḥ ||
ahorātramabhūdyuddhaṃ teṣāṃ tena samanvitam ||
kitavastu ruṣāviṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ devasiṃhakam ||
sukhakhānistadā śūraḥ kitavaṃ balavattaram ||
mahīrājāya ca dadau tārakaṃ kaitavaṃ śiraḥ || || 67 ||
tadā bhūpasutā devī sukhakhāniṃ samāvṛṇot ||
mahīpatistadāgatya tatsutāṃ madirekṣaṇām || 68 ||
saṃbodhya vividhairvākyairbhūmirājāṃtamāgamat ||
koṭisvarṇaṃ nṛpātprāpya balakhānirmahābalaḥ ||
prayayau baṃdhubhissārddhaṃ śirīṣākhyapuraṃ śubham || 3.3.31.70 ||
pañcavarṣāṃtare jāte tena bhuktā kumārikā || 73 ||
mūlavarmā mahīrājaṃ samāhūya sasainyakam ||
vacanaṃ prāha namrātmā rājarāja vacaḥ kuru || 74 ||
daṃpatī pīḍayāmāsa jitvā sarvamahīpatīn || 76 ||
dayālū vatsajau vīrau karabhāṃtamupeyatuḥ ||
nāgapāśena tau baddhvā pīḍayāmāsa daṃpatī || 7 ||
iti śrutvā sa kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ karabhaṃ yakṣakiṃkaram ||
bhrātarau tau samāgamya nāgapāśaṃ tu cāsinā ||
chittvā mumoda balavānkoṭisvarṇaṃ gṛhītavān||
bhūmirājaḥ prasannātmā dehalīṃ mudito.agamat|| 3.3.31.80 || ||
sa bhūpo bhūmirājaṃ ca samāhūya vaco.abravīt ||
gaṃdharvassukalo nāma matkanyāṃ ca śubhānanām ||
jyotsnāyāṃ niśi saṃhṛtya tayā sārdraṃ hi dīvyati || 84 ||
pūrṇimāyāṃ ca saṃprāptaḥ sa vai citrarathapriyaḥ ||
vaiśākhasyāsite pakṣe cāṣṭamī cādya maṃgalā ||
vadhaṃ kuru nṛpaśreṣṭha dehalīṃ gaṃtumarhasi || 85 ||
iti śrutvā mahīrājo lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ||
gṛhītvā daṃpatī śīghraṃ dehalīnagaraṃ yayau || 86 ||
vaiśākhyāṃ sukhajātāyāṃ sukalonāma vīryavān ||
gaṃdharvo daśa sāhasrai rurodha nagaraṃ ruṣā || 87 ||
nagarācca bahirjātā ye śūrā madavihvalāḥ ||
hatvā tānsukalaḥ śīghraṃ rājñe duḥkhaṃ cakāra ha || 88 ||
bhayabhīto mahīrājo dhyātvā sarvamayīṃ śivām ||
suṣvāpa niśi śuddhātmā tuṣṭābhūjjagadaṃbikā || 89 ||
kṛṣṇāṃśādīnbodhayitvā taiśca sārdhaṃ samāgamat ||
teṣāṃ cāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ gaṃdharveṇa tadāhnikam|| 3.3.31.90 ||
bahudhā te hi gaṃdharvāstaiśca sārddhaṃ samārudhan || 92 ||
bhayabhītāstadā sarve rāmāṃśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||
āhlādaśca prasannātmā śāradāṃ sarvamaṃgalām || 93 ||
divāsūktena tuṣṭāva tadā prādurabhūcchivā| ||
gaṃdharvānmohayitvāśu drāvayāmāsa śāradā || 94 ||
parājite ca gaṃdharve kṛṣṇāṃśo janamohanaḥ ||
mahīrājamupāgamya koṭisvarṇaṃ gṛhītavān || 95 ||
ṣoḍaśābde ca kṛṣṇāṃśe saṃprāpte devipūjake ||
mārgamāsaṃ tu saṃprāpte mardanaśca vivāhitaḥ || 96 ||
puṃḍradeśe mahārājo nāgavarmā mahābalaḥ ||
patnī nāgavatī tasya takṣakasya sutā śubhā ||
pituḥ śāpena sañjātā kaliṃgādhipateḥ sutā || 98 ||
daśaiva tanayāścāsankanyā tasya śubhānanā ||
suvelā nāma vikhyātā rūpayauvanaśālinī || 99 ||
purohitaṃ samāhūya mahīrājāya praiṣayat ||
maṃgalaṃ kārayāmāsa gatvā nāgapure śubhe || 101 ||
suvelā pitaraṃ prāha dehi me nāgabhūṣaṇam||
vivāhaṃ hi kariṣyāmi nocetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham || 102 ||
iti śrutvā nāgavarmā mahīrājāntamāyayau ||

hatvā dvijānmahāmūḍhasteṣāṃ yajñopavītakam ||

śūdrasya vastu rudhiramiti jñātvā dvijā dhamaḥ ||
sa jaghāna trivarṇāṃśca brāhmaṇānbahulānkhalaḥ || 3.4.10.40 ||

parameṣṭhinamāgamya kathāṃścakuśca kāraṇam|| || 41 ||

iti śrutvā marīcistu vaśiṣṭhādibhiranvitaḥ ||
mṛgavyādhastu tāndṛṣṭvā dhanurbāṇadharo balī ||
marīcādyā vihasyāhuḥ kimarthaṃ haṃtumudyataḥ ||
kulārthaṃ vātmano.arthaṃ vā śīghraṃ vada mahābala || 45 ||
hanmi yuṣmāndhanairyuktānbrāhmaṇā~mśca viśeṣataḥ || 46 ||

sākṣīyaṃ bhūmiracalā sākṣī sūryo.ayamuttamaḥ ||
iti śrutvā mṛgavyādho munīnāha kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 3.4.10.50 ||
yathā pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti tathā mājñātumarhatha ||
ityuktāstena te prāhuḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ maṃtramuttamam || 51 ||

dṛṣṭvā śuddhaṃ tadā vipramūcuste vismayānvitāḥ || 55 ||

evamuktvā yayurlokaṃ sa tu rāmāyaṇaṃ muniḥ ||
kalpāṣṭādaśayuktaṃ hi śatakoṭipravistaram ||57||
tatpaścātsa śivo bhūtvā tatra vāsamakārayat || 58 ||
adyāpi saṃsthitaḥ svāmī mṛgavyādhaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
śṛṇudhvaṃ ca surāḥ sarve taccaritraṃ harapriyam || 59 ||
brahmāgatyotpalāraṇyaṃ tatra yajñaṃ cakāra ha || 3.4.10.60 ||
tadā sarasvatī devī nadī bhūtvā samāgatā ||

ratnānāmākaro yo vai sa hi ratnākaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 64||
gaṃbhīraścāsti sadṛśaḥ kośo yasya saritpatiḥ || 65 ||
lokāndakṣati yaḥ kṛtyaiḥ sa tu dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
brahmaṇoṃgācca te jātāstasmādvai brāhmaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 66 ||

dakṣasya manaso jātāḥ kanyāḥ paṃcaśataṃ tataḥ ||
viṣṇu māyāprabhāvena kalābhūtāḥ sthitā bhuvi ||67||
tadā tu bhagavānbrahmā somāyāśvinimaṇḍalam ||

teṣāṃ patistvayaṃ dakṣo.abhūdvidherājñayā bhuvi || 3.4.10.70 ||

mṛgavyādhaḥ śivaḥ kruddho vīrabhadro babhūva ha ||
tadā vai yajñapuruṣo bhayabhītaḥ samaṃtataḥ || 74 ||

iti śrutvā vīrabhadro rudraḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ||

tripuṇḍraścākṣamālā ca maṃtraḥ paṃcākṣaraḥ śubhaḥ ||

hirburnāma purā cāsīddānavo lokakaṃṭakaḥ||1||
nikuṃbhānvayasaṃbhūtaḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ ||

namaskṛtya vidhātāraṃ vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ ||

śivādviṣṇurmahīṃ yāto viṣṇorbrahmā ca padmabhūḥ | | 3.4.14.110
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ prāha rāmānujastadā |
satyaṃ satyaṃ mamājñeyaṃ kartā kārayitā śivaḥ |
anantā sṛṣṭayaḥ sarvā udbhūtā yasya tejasā |
anantaḥ śeṣataḥ śeṣā ramante yogino hi tam | | 113
iti śrutvā tadā vākyaṃ lajjitaḥ śaṅkaro.abhavat | | 114
yogaśāstra paro devaḥ kṛṣṇastenaiva darśitaḥ |
kālātmā bhagavānkṛṣṇo yogeśo yogatatparaḥ | | 115
kaṃ vīryaṃ pāti yo vai sa kapistaṃ caiva lāti yaḥ | |
kapilassa tu vijñeyaḥ kapī rudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ | | 116
kapilo bhagavānviṣṇuḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvarūpavān |
tadā tu śaṅkarācāryo lajjito namrakandharaḥ | | 117
jajāpa hṛdi śuddhātmā śiṣyo rāmānujasya vai | | 118
bhṛguvarya mahābhāga śṛṇu tvaṃ jīvavarṇitam |
ilvalā tāmasī śaktiḥ priyā viśravaso muneḥ | |
śivamārādhayāmāsa satī sā pārthivārcanaiḥ | | 2
yakṣaśarmā mahādhūrto yakṣiṇīpūjane rataḥ | | 3
tasya mitrasnuṣā subhrū ramitā tena pāpinā |
kuṣṭhabhūtaṃ dvijaṃ tyaktvā yakṣiṇī mantravatsalā |
śivalokaṃ yayau devī kailāsaṃ guhyakālayam | | 5

darśitaṃ pūjanaṃ tena yoṣidbhyaścopadeśataḥ | | 6
prabhāte samanuprāpte pāraṇāṃ kṛtavāndvijaḥ |
maraṇaṃ prāptavānkuṣṭhī tatraiva śivamandire | | 7
tena puṇyaprabhāvena rājāsītkaraṇāṭake |
rājarāja iti khyāto maṇḍalīko nṛpo.abhavat | | 8
brāhmaṇaiḥ kārayāmāsa rājarājo mahābalaḥ | | 9
śatābdaṃ bhūtale rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena mahātmanā |
rājyādhikāraṃ śreṣṭhasya sutasya pradadau nṛpaḥ | |
tataḥ kāśīpurīṃ prāpya śivaṃ tuṣṭāva pūjanaiḥ | | 3.4.15.10
sa nṛpaḥ pāvitastena tyaktvā prāṇāṃstadā svayam |
jātaḥ kutsitavelāyāṃ rātrau ghoratamovṛte |
tapasā toṣayāmāsa sa bālaḥ parameṣṭhinam |
tasmai brahmā tadāgatya laṅkāṃ nāma purīṃ śubhām | |
suvarṇaracitāṃ ramyāṃ kārayitvā dadau prabhuḥ | | 14
tisraḥ koṭyaḥ smṛtā yakṣā lokakāryaparāyaṇāḥ |
teṣāṃ svāmī sa vai cāsīdyakṣarāḍiti viśrutaḥ | | 15
kinnarā bahurūpāśca tadādeśanivāsinaḥ |
balibhiḥ pūjayāmāsuḥ kinnareśastadā svayam | | 16
guhyakā narabhāvasthā divyamūlyaprakāriṇaḥ |
teṣāṃ svāmī sa vai cāsītkubero bhagavānsvayam | | 17
dharmakāryakarā ye tu narā vedaparāyaṇāḥ |
teṣāṃ kośāśca tenaiva pūritā naradharmiṇā | | 19

teṣāṃ rājā sa bhagavāndravyado rākṣaseśvaraḥ | | 3.4.15.20
śavabhūtā narā ye vai dāhitā vahnikarmaṇi |
agnidvāreṇa tanmāṃsaṃ bhuñjate rākṣasāḥ sadā | | 21
ābhirvibhūtibhiryuktaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ rāvaṇo balī |
jitvā niṣkāsya laṅkāyāḥ svayaṃ rājā babhūva ha | | 22
kubero duḥkhitastatra śaṅkaraḥ duḥkhanāśanam |
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptastadā tu bhagavānharaḥ | |
tena maitrī kṛtā ramyā kubereṇa samaṃ dadhau | | 23
alakāvatī nāma purī racitā viśvakarmaṇā |
sa tāṃ maṅgaladāmāpya kubero harṣamāptavān | | 24
iti śrutvā tadanujo rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā pulastyatanayaḥ pasparśa madhurānanām |
tadā pativratā devī suprabhā prāha taṃ ruṣā | | 26

kuṣṭho bhavettava tanau tena doṣeṇa dāruṇaḥ | | 27

iti śāpānvito vīrastathābhūtaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ |
śivamārādhayāmāsa kailāse pārthivārcanaiḥ | | 29

sa rudro na prasanno.abhūttadā duḥkhī sa rāvaṇaḥ | | 3.4.15.30
juhāva vahnau kramataḥ śirāṃsi puruṣādanaḥ |
bhasmabhūtastadā rakṣo na mṛto brahmaṇo varāt |
pāvakādudbhavaṃ cānyaṃ dehaṃ prāpya manoharam | | 32

piśācairvāyurūpaiśca bhakṣitaḥ sa ca rāvaṇaḥ | | 33
gṛhītvā sa ca rudrāya nabhobhūtāya cārpayat | | 34
tadā mātṛgaṇairghorairbhakṣito.abhūtsa rāvaṇaḥ |
nabhasaścodbhavaṃ dehaṃ śūnyabhūtaṃ sa rāvaṇaḥ |
punaḥ prāpya śivāyaiva so.ahaṃ bhūtāya cārpayat | | 36
devadaityamanuṣyāṇāṃ pannagānāṃ ca yoṣitaḥ |
navoḍhā ramitāścāsanbrahmāṇḍe tena rakṣasā | | 39

anye surā vinā yajñaiḥ kṣudhitāḥ sambabhūvire | | 41

ekībhūya surāssarve tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram | | 42
kalpākhye śvetavārāhe nedṛśaḥ ko.api dānavaḥ |
babhūva ca yathaivāsau rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ | | 44
purā mārkaṇḍakalpe ca niśumbhaḥ śumbha eva hi |
yathā jātau tathā ghorau kumbhakarṇaśca rāvaṇaḥ | | 45
rāvaṇā bahavaścāsanhīdṛśo naiva rāvaṇaḥ |
ahaṃ brahmā tathā rudro yato jātāssanātanāḥ | |
sā tu vai prakṛtirmāyā koṭiviśvavidhāyinī | | 46
rudrāṇāṃ saṅkaṭe ghore samartho.ahaṃ sadā bhuvi |
brahmaṇaḥ parame duḥkhe samarthā prakṛtiḥ parā |
tābhyāṃ dukhamayo brahmā tuṣṭāva jagadambikām |
tadā tasyā balenāhaṃ jaghāna madhukaiṭabhau | | 3.4.15.50
ato madājñayā sarve viṣṇumāyāṃ sanātanīm |
śaraṇyāṃ śaraṇaṃ prāpya kurvatāṃ jagato hitam | | 51
iti śrutvā tu te devāstuṣṭuvuḥ prakṛtiṃ parām |
prasannā ca tadā devī brahmajyotirmayī śivā | | 52
dvidhābhūtā mahīṃ prāptā sītārāmau parāparau |
triliṅgajananī sītā tayā tadaparaṃ dvidhā | |
kṛtaṃ tau ca dvidhā jātau śabdārthau rāmalakṣmaṇau | | 53
śabdamātrasamūhānāṃ svāmī rāmassanātanaḥ |
arthamātrasamūhānāmīśaḥ klībassa lakṣmaṇaḥ | | 54
yasya vajramayaṃ vīryaṃ brahmacaryaṃ dṛḍhaṃ tathā |
sa klībaśca tato.anye vai ktībabhūtā hi vānarāḥ | | 55
parā tu prakṛtissītā tayormaṅgaḥladāyinī |
bhūmimadhyātsamudbhūtā hyayoniryonikāriṇī | | 56
sahasraṃ rāmarāmeti japitaṃ yena dhīmatā |
sītānāmnā ca tasyaiva phalaṃ jñeyaṃ ca tatsamam | | 57
idaṃ dṛśyaṃ yadā nāsīttāmasī prakṛtistadā | |
akṣarāśeṣabhūtā ca svayaṃ jātā tridhecchayā | | 58
pūrvaṃ śeṣassa vai rāmo madhye klībasya lakṣmaṇaḥ |
paro bhāgastu sā devī yoganidrā sanātanī | | 59
anyakalpeṣu he devāḥ kṣīraśāyī hariḥ svayam |
rāmo jñeyastathā śeṣo rudrarūpassa lakṣmaṇaḥ | | 3.4.15.60
sītā bhagavatī lakṣmīrjātā janakanandinī |
kalpākhye śvetavārāhe rāmo jātaḥ parātparaḥ |
taiśca sarve vidalitā rākṣasā rāvaṇādayaḥ | | 62
kīrtiṃ svakīyāṃ lokeṣu saṃsthāpya pāvanīṃ prabhuḥ |
puṣpakaṃ ca kuberāya vimānaṃ ca tadā dadau | |
rudrasaṅkhyā sahasrābdaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtvā paraṃ yayau | | 63
svamukhātsvāṃśamutpādya vaiśyayonau babhūva ha | | 64
sarvadravyavyayaṃ kṛtvā nānātīrtheṣu harṣitaḥ |
purīṃ kāśīṃ samāgamya rāmānandaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam | |
svagehaṃ punarāgatya sa vaiśyaścājñayā guroḥ |
rāmabhaktiparaścāsītsādhusevāparāyaṇaḥ | | 67
tadā tu bhagavānrāmo dāsabhūtaśca tadgṛhe |
maṇiratnahiraṇyāni vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca |
nānā vyañjanayogyāni brāhmaṇebhyaḥ svayaṃ dadau | | 69
tatastrilocanaṃ prāha bhagavānrāvaṇārtihā | | 3.4.15.70
uṣitvā sarayūtīre rāmadhyānaparobhavat | | 73
rājā prācīnabarhiśca babhūva makhakārakaḥ | | 1
teṣāṃ tu tapasā tuṣṭaḥ svayambhūścaturānanaḥ |
dvitīyo varuṇo nāma yādasāṃ patirappatiḥ | | 6
pāśī nāma tato jātaṃ varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ | | 7
sa tu pūrvabhave cāsīdbrāhmaṇaḥ śaktipūjakaḥ. |
āpavo nāma vikhyāto vāruṇīpānatatparaḥ | | 8
nānāraktamayaiḥ puṣpairguṇṭhitāṃ raktamālikām | | 9
raktacandanasaṃyuktāṃ gṛhītvā mantrasaṃyutaḥ |
dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyaistāmbūlairṛtujaiḥ phalaiḥ |
pūjayitvā mahālakṣmīṃ bhadrakālīṃ sanātanīm | | 11
vahnidvāreṇa saṃhṛtya tuṣṭāva jagadambikām | | 12

prasannābhūttadā devī varadā sarvamaṅgalā | |
iti vākyaṃ priyaṃ śrutvā dvija āpava namradhīḥ |
tuṣṭāva daṇḍavad bhūtvā bhadrakālīṃ sanātanīm | | 15
āpava uvāca
viṣṇukalpe purā cāsīddānavo mahiṣāsuraḥ |
svārociṣāntaraḥ kālo gato rājyaṃ prakurvataḥ | | 17

sa jāto rāghavagṛhe rāmassaṅkarṣaṇaḥ svayam | | 22
ṣoḍaśābdavapurbhūtvā sa gato janakālaye |
dhanuścājagavaṃ ghoraṃ prabhagnaṃ tena dhīmatā | | 23

haṃsayānapatākāyāṃ saṃsthito hanumānkapiḥ |
vedāśca vājinastatra netā brahmā sanātanaḥ | | 26

jagarja balavānghorassa ca brahmāṇḍarāvaṇaḥ | | 28
brāhmaṇā saṃstutā mātā bhavatī brahmarūpiṇī |
sītā śāntimayī nityā tayā brahmāṇḍarāvaṇaḥ | |
brahmakalpe purā cāsīttālajaṃ ghānvayodbhavaḥ |
brahmāṇḍeśaṃ mahārudraṃ mahendrādisamanvitam |
sa babhūva parājityādhikārī raudra āsane | | 31

jagāma garuḍārūḍho yatra daityo muraḥ sthitaḥ |
sahasrābdamato jātaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā bhayānvitaḥ |
parāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ nityāṃ tuṣṭāva ślakṣṇayā girā | | 34

vijayā nāma me ramyā kaiścinnāhaṃ parājitā | | 36
unmīlinī viñculī ca trispṛśā pakṣavarddhinī |
jayā jayantī vijayā varṣevarṣe kramādaham | | 37

pāṇiṃ grahāṇa me ramyaṃ sarvapūjyo bhavānbhavet | | 39
iti śrutvā muro daityastasyā rūpeṇa mohitaḥ |
yuyudhe sa tayā sārddhaṃ kṣaṇārddhena layaṅgataḥ | | 3.4.16.40
taṃ muraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvānujastannarakāsuraḥ |
daityamāyāṃ mahāghorāṃ cakāra suranāśinīm | | 41
ekādaśī svayaṃ māyā huṅkāreṇaiva taṃ tadā |
duṣṭabhūtamamūdannaṃ nṛṇāṃ rogabhayapradam | | 43

ekārṇave purā tvaṃ vai matprasādātsukhī bhava | | 47

natvā tacchiṣyatāṃ prāpya tatra vāsamakārayat |

kārayāmāsa vai kāśyāṃ śubhraṃ sarvaṃ śilāmayam | | 55

kṛṣṇacaitanyavarṇanam

ūrdhvarekhādvayormadhye sūkṣmarekhā ca pītikā | |

devyāśca nirmalaṃ nāma teṣāṃ tatra babhūva ha | | 69

viśvanāthetitanmantraṃ teṣāṃ tatra babhūva ha | | 72

tadyantraṃ niṣphalaṃ yātaṃ tadadho ye gatā narāḥ | | 74

nirguṇāḥ saguṇā ye tu śaivā jñeyā budhaistadā | | 76

nityānandaḥ śāntipure nadīhāpattane hariḥ | | 77

mayādyā niṣphalā daityā balipārśvamupāgatāḥ | | 3.4.21.80

vyāsa uvāca
tadā sa bhagavānkalkiḥ purāṇapuruṣodbhavaḥ |
divyaṃ vājinamāruhya khaḍgī varmī ca carmadhṛk | |
mlecchāṃstāndaityabhūtāṃśca hatvā yogaṃ gamiṣyati | | 1
ṣoḍaśābdasahasrāṇi tadyogāgnipratāpitā |
bhasmabhūtā karmabhūmirnirjīvā bhavitā tadā | | 2

yajñabhāgamupādāya devāste balasaṃyutāḥ |
bāhvoḥ kṣatraṃ viśo jānvoḥ śūdro varṇastadaṅghrayoḥ | | 6
jātidharmamupādāya yajiṣyaṃti surānmudā | | 8
ayodhyāyāṃ rājapadaṃ kariṣyati tadājñayā | | 9

divyavarṣaśatāyuśca tyaktvā dehaṃ gamiṣyati | | 3.4.26.10
yadā tu bhagavānkalkī brahmasūtraṃ kariṣyati |
tadā vedāśca catvāro mūrtimantaśca sāṅgaḥkāḥ | |
aṣṭādaśapurāṇaiśca tatrāyāsyanti harṣitāḥ | | 11

kārttike śuklapakṣe ca navamyāṃ guruvāsare | | 12
yajñakuṇḍācca puruṣo bhaviṣyati mahottamaḥ |

dṛṣṭavā taṃ puruṣaṃ ramyaṃ tadā brahmādayaḥ surāḥ |

yo.arcayiṣyati yāndevāndevāste tasya vaśyagāḥ | | 15

lokamaṅgaladātrī ca sarvakilviṣanāśinī | | 16

saṃsthāpya vedavidhinā śālagrāmaṃ yajanti ye | |
jīvanmuktāśca te jñeyā pitṛrṇāṃ tṛptikārakāḥ | | 17
dhātṛvṛkṣatale gatvā yo vai śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati |
ityukte vacane teṣāṃ kalkī devo mudānvitaḥ |
ityuktvā bhagavānkalkī paśyatāṃ devarūpiṇām |
virahāgnimatī bhūtvā bījāṃstānsaṃkṣayiṣyati | | 22
tasminkāle mahādaityāḥ pātālatalavāsinaḥ |
prahlādaṃ ca puraskṛtya gamiṣyanti surānprati | | 23 kharoṣṭragṛddhramahiṣakākakarkasamāsthitāḥ |
siṃhavyāghravṛkārūḍhāḥ śṛgālaśyenavāhanaḥ | | 24
prāsapaṭṭiśakhaḍgāṃśca bhuśuṇḍīparighādikān |
gṛhītvā vegavantaste garjiṣyanti punaḥ punaḥ | | 25
tadā śakrādayo devāstrayastriṃśadgaṇā mudā |
svāyudhāni gṛhītvāśu kariṣyanti raṇaṃ mahat | | 26
divyavarṣamayaṃ ghoraṃ yuddhaṃ teṣāṃ bhaviṣyati |
mṛtānmṛtānraṇe daityānbhārgavo jīvayiṣyati | | 27
śramabhūtāstathā devāstyaktvā yuddhaṃ samantataḥ |
kṣīrābdhiṃ ca gamiṣyanti yatra sākṣādhariḥ svayam | | 28
teṣāṃ stutyā sa bhagavāndevamaṅgalahetave |
svapūrvārddha svarūpaṃ ca kariṣyati sanātanaḥ | | 29
sa ca haṃso hariḥ sākṣācchatasūryasamaprabhaḥ |
śukraṃ prahlādapramukhāṃstejasā tāpayiṣyati | | 3.4.26.30
tadā parājitā daityāstyaktvā gāṃ duḥkhitā bhṛśam |
divyavarṣaśatāyuśca sa ikṣvākurbhaviṣyati |
varṣāṇāṃ ca pramāṇena nṛṇāmāyuścatuśśatam | | 33
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yatpṛṣṭo.ahaṃ mano tvayā |
caturyugānāṃ caritaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak | | 34
catuṣpādā hi dharmasya jñānaṃ dhyānaṃ śamo damaḥ |
ātmajñānaṃ sa vai jñānaṃ dhyānamadhyātmacintanam | |
tatsaṅkhyayā hi dharmasya pādaścaikaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | | 36
prāhṇamadhyāhnasāyāhnaṃ trisandhyaṃ ca bhavetsadā |

saubhāgyāṣṭakavarṇanam
saubhāgyaśayanaṃ nāma yatpurāṇavido viduḥ || 1 ||

prāśane nāmamaṃtre ca viśeṣo.ayaṃ nibodha me ||

hitāya sarvabhūtānāṃ lalanānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
nāma prāśananaivedyairmāsimāsi pṛthakpṛthaka || 2 ||
apūrvaṃ sarvamaṃtrāṇāmānaṃtaryavrataṃ śṛṇu || 3 ||
naktaṃ kuryāddvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāmupoṣitā || 4 ||
tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā jitendriyā || 7 ||
japetkātyāyanīṃ nāma nāli keraṃ nivedayet ||
dāṃpatyaṃ subhagaṃ bhojyaṃ gomedhaphalamāpnuyāt || 8 ||
pauṣasyāditṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā jitendriyā ||
gaurīṃ nāma tu saṃpūjya laḍḍukānvinivedayet || 9 ||
svapyātprāśya ghṛtaṃ rātrau tyaktvā kāmaṃ tadagrataḥ||
evaṃ kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ pārvatīmiti pūjayet ||
nivedayānnaṃ śaṣkulyo gomayaṃ prāśayenniśi ||
māghasya śuklapakṣe tu tṛtīyāyāmupoṣitaḥ ||
suranāyikāṃ ca saṃpūjya khaṇḍabilvaṃ nivedayet || 12 ||
tataḥ kuśodakaṃ prāśya svapyādbhūmau jitendriyā ||
kṣamāpyāṃte namaskṛtya iti svarṇaphalaṃ labhet || 13 ||
punaretattato māghe kṛṣṇapakṣe śucivratā ||
āryāṃ nāmnā prapūjyātha khādyakāni nivedayet || 14 ||
evaṃ vai phālgune māsi sopavāsā śucivratā ||
bhadrīṃ nāma prapūjyātha kāsāraṃ vinivedayet || 16 ||
suprāśya śarkarāṃ cātha svapyādrātrau vimatsarā ||
punaḥ kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ phālgunasyaiva bhārata||
viśālākṣīṃ samabhyarcya pūrikā vinivedayet || 18 ||
sodakāṃstaṃḍulāndattvā svapyādbhūmau manasvinī ||
caitrasyāditṛtīyāyāṃ śucirbhūtā jitendriyā ||
śriyaṃ devīṃ yajedbhaktyā vaṭakānvinivedayet || 4.29.20 ||
bilvapatraṃ tataḥ prāśya svapyāddhyāna parāyaṇā ||
prātarutthāya madbhaktyā mithunaṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ ||
praṇipatya kṣamāpyaivaṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet || 21 ||
punaḥ kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ caitre samyagupoṣitaḥ ||
kālīṃ nāma samabhyarcya piṣṭaṃ prāśya svapenniśi || 22 ||
pūpakāni nivedyātha kuryādrātrau prajāgaram ||
evaṃ vaiśākhamāse tu sopavāsā jitendriyā ||
pūjayeccaṇḍikāṃ devīṃ madhukāni nivedayet || 24 ||
śrīkhaṃḍaṃ caṃdanaṃ liptvā svapyāddevyagrato bhuvi ||
bhojayitvā ca dāṃpatyaṃ cāṃdrāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet || 25 ||
tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā vimatsarā ||
pūjayetkālarātriṃ tu gandhapuṣpaiḥ sadīpakaiḥ || 26 ||
surājyaṃ yāvakaṃ dattvā tilānbhuṃjansvapenniśi ||
jyeṣṭhe sitatṛtīyāyāṃ hyupavāsakṛtāṃ varā ||
śubhāṃ devīṃ samabhyarcya āmrāṇi vinivedayet ||
saṃprāśyāmalakaṃ rātrau gaurīṃ dhyātvā sukhaṃ svapet || 28 ||
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya daṃpatī rūpaśālinau ||
punaḥ kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā suvāsinī ||
āṣāḍhamāse saṃprāpte pūjayecca yaśodhanam ||
karaṃjakaṃ ca naivedyaṃ gośṛṃgāṃbhaḥ pibenniśi ||
tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ kūṣmāṃḍīṃ śaktito yajet ||
kuśodakaṃ ca saṃprāśya svapyādrātrau jitendriyā ||
śrāvaṇe sopavāsā ca caṃḍāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ prapūjayet ||
kulmāṣāstatra naivedyaṃ pibetpuṣpodakaṃ punaḥ || 35 ||
prāpnotyabhayadānasya phalaṃ naivātra saṃśayaḥ || 36 ||
tadvatkṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ rudrāṇīṃ nāmabhiryajet ||
siddhapiṃḍāni divyāni naivedyaṃ dāpayettathā || 37 ||
piṇyākaṃ prāśa yitvā tu svapyādrātrau vimatsarā ||
saṃpūjya dvijadāṃpatyamiṣṭāpūrtaphalaṃ labhet || 38 ||
bhādre śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ pūjayeta himādrijām ||
gandhodakaṃ tataḥ prāśya sakhībhiḥ sahitā svapet ||
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyaṃ mārgapālīśataṃ labhet || 4.29.40 ||
tadvatkṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ durgāṃ daivīṃ samarcayet || dadyātpiṣṭaphalāndivyānguḍājyaparipūritān || 41 ||
prāśayitvā tu gomūtraṃ svapyācchāṃtena cetasā ||
māsi cāśvayuje bhaktyā devīṃ nārāyaṇīṃ yajet ||
sopavāsā khaṇḍapūpānnaivedyaṃ parikalpayet || || 43 ||
prāśayeccaṃdanaṃ raktaṃ svapyācca gatamatsarā ||
tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ svasti nāma prapūja yet ||
śālyodanaṃ guḍopetaṃ naivedyaṃ nirvapettataḥ || 45 ||
kusuṃbhabījānsaṃprāśya tyaktvā kāmaṃ svapenniśi ||
kārtikasya tṛtīyāyāṃ svāhānāmnīṃ prapūjayet ||
kṣīraṃ khaṇḍaghṛtopetaṃ naivedyaṃ dāpayecca tām || 47 ||
svapyādrātrau jitakrodhā prāśya kuṃkumakeśarān ||
tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ svadhānāmnīṃ prapūjayet ||
mudgaudanaṃ nivedyātha ghṛtaṃ prāśya svapenniśi ||49||
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā muktapāpā śucirbhavet ||4.29.50||
śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā nirāmayā ||
vijñāya ca drutaṃ bhaktyā umāṃ śāstrārthabodhakaiḥ || 51 ||
tābhyāṃ netreṣu dātavyaṃ mauktikaṃ nīlameva ca ||
pravālamoṣṭhayordadyātkarṇayo ratnakuṇḍale || 53 ||
maṃḍale pūjayitvā ca homaṃ kuryāttato.aguroḥ ||55||
tato.aparājitāṃ nāma devīṃ tatraiva pujayet ||
mṛtsnāṃ saṃprāśayitvā ca rātrau kuryātprajāgaram || 56 || gītavādyotsavairhṛdyairvīṇāmaṃgalapāṭhakaiḥ ||
tūlīgaṃḍakasaṃyukte paryaṃketyaṃtaśobhite ||
uddhṛtya maṇḍalāddevaṃ paryaṃkopari vinyaset || 58 || vitānadhvajamālālikiṃkiṇīdarppaṇānvitam ||
puṣpamaṇḍapikācchannaṃ dhūpagugguluvāsitam || 59 ||
prīṇayedbhakṣyabhojyaiśca pakvānnairmadhuraiḥ śubhaiḥ || 4.29.60 ||
tato dattvā.akṣatānhaste tāṃbūlaṃ vinivedayet ||
prīyatāṃ me umākāṃtaḥ pārvatyā sahitaḥ śivaḥ || 61 ||
ucchiṣṭaṃ śodhayitvā tu punaḥ prokṣya samantataḥ ||
raktavarṇāṃ suśīlāṃ ca surūpāṃ supayasvinīm || 62 ||
śṛṃgābhyāṃ dattakanakāṃ rājatakhurasaṃyutām ||
kāṃsyadohanakopetāṃ raktavastrāvaguṃṭhitām || 63 ||
ghaṇṭābharaṇaśobhāḍhyāṃ devadevyagrasaṃsthitām ||
tridhā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya guroḥ sarvaṃ nivedayet || 64 ||
praṇamya śirasā bhūmau kṣamasveti guruṃ vadet ||
evaṃ samāpyate devyāṃ ānaṃtaryavratodyamam ||
yaḥ prakuryātpumānstrī vā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 66 ||
ṛṣisiddhāmaraṃ brāhmaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ sanātanam ||67||
bhuktvā bhogānaśeṣāṃśca ekaviṃśatkulānvitaḥ ||
ratnayāne samārūḍho guhyāpsarasasaṃvṛtaḥ || 68 |||
devavidyādharairyakṣairvṛto yāti śivālayam||
bhuktvā bhogānyadā bhūtaḥ kadācittapasaḥ kṣayāta ||
pṛthivyāṃ tu samāgamya bhavetsakalabhūmipaḥ || 4.29.70 ||
strī vā samācaredyā tu mahādevī tu jāyate ||
ānaṃtaryavyavacchinnānbhogāndevī umā yathā ||
manurddevyā yathāmahyā śacyā śakro yathāsukham ||
nairaṃtaryaṃ yathā saukhyaṃ sā bhuṃkte patinā saha || 72 ||
muneraruṃdhatī yadvadviṣṇorlakṣmīrhṛdi sthitā ||
eṣā viśeṣavihitābhihitā tṛtīyā yānaṃtarītya vidhavābhirudīritoccaiḥ ||
akṣayatṛtīyāvratavarṇanam
vaiśākhasya sitāmekāṃ tṛtīyāṃ śṛṇu pāṇḍava || 1 ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam ||
yadasyāṃ kriyate kiñcitsarvaṃ syāttadihākṣa yam || 2 ||
śākale nagare kaściddharmanāmābhavadvaṇik ||
priyaṃvadaḥ satyarato devabrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ || 4 ||
tena śrutaṃ vācyamānaṃ tṛtīyā rohiṇī purā ||

etadvrataṃ mayākhyātaṃ śrūyatāmatra yo vidhiḥ ||
chatropānatpradānaṃ ca gobhūkāṃcanavāsasām || 16 ||
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ cānyattaddeyamaviśaṃkayā ||
asyāṃ tithau kṣayamupaiti hutaṃ na dattaṃ tenākṣayā ca munibhiḥ kathitā tṛtīyā ||
pāpāpahaṃ bahuphalaṃ sukaraṃ sūpavāsakam ||1||
śṛṇu pārtha paraṃ guhyaṃ yanmayā kathitaṃ na ca ||
śivayoratisaṃharṣādraktabiṃduścyutaḥ kṣitau ||
śivāṃgādrabhasā jāta stenāṃgāraka ucyate ||
agasthoṃ.agārakāṃtiśca aṃgapratyaṅgasaṃbhavaḥ || 6 || saubhāgyārogyakṛdyasmāttasmādaṃgārakaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
taṃ pūjayati yatnena nārī vā.ananyamānasā ||
rūpaṃ saubhāgyasaṃpannaṃ naranārīmanoharam || 8 ||
sahomamaṃtrasaṃsthānaṃ sādhivāsavidhānataḥ || 9 ||

snānārthaṃ mṛttikāṃ maṃtrairgṛhṇīyādaṃbhasi sthitaḥ ||4.31.1 0||
tvaṃ mṛde vaṃditā pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇenoddharatā kila||
imaṃ maṃtraṃ paṭhanpārtha ādityāya pradarśayet ||
ādityaraśmisaṃtaptāṃ gaṃgājalakaṇokṣitām ||12||
tāṃ mṛdaṃ śirasi prārthya pūrvaṃ dattvāṃgasaṃdhiṣu ||
tataḥ snānaṃ prakurvīta maṃtreṇāntarjale punaḥ || 13 ||
tvamāpo yoniḥ sarveṣāṃ daityadānavarakṣasām ||
svedajodbhijjayonīnāṃ rasānāṃ pataye namaḥ ||14||
nadīṣu devakhāteṣu snānaṃ teṣu ca me bhavet||15||
dhyāyandhvanimimaṃ maṃtraṃ tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret ||
tataḥ snātvā śucirbhūtvā gṛhamāgatya na spṛśet ||
dūrvāśvatthau śamīṃ spṛṣṭvā māṃ ca maṃtreṇa maṃtravit ||
tvaṃ dūrve.amṛtajanmāsi sarvadevaiśca vaṃditā ||
vaṃditā daha tatsarvaṃ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam ||18|| ( iti dūrvāmaṃtraḥ ||)
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ tvaṃ kāśyapī paṭhyase śrutau||
śamī śamaya tatpāpaṃ yanmayā duranuṣṭhi tam || 19 || ( iti śamīmaṃtraḥ)
akṣispaṃdaṃ bhujaspaṃdaṃ duḥsvapnaṃ durviciṃtitam ||
śatrūṇāṃ ca samutthānamaśvattha śamayasva me || 4.31.20 || ( ityaśvatthamaṃtraḥ)
gāṃ dadyāttu tato devīṃ savatsāṃ sapradakṣiṇām ||
tasmātspṛśāmi vaṃdāmi vaṃditā pāpahā bhava ||22|| ( iti gomaṃtraḥ)
evaṃ maṃtraṃ paṭhanpārtha bhaktibhāvena bhāvitaḥ ||
pradakṣiṇāṃ yaḥ kurute gāṃ dṛṣṭvā varavarṇinīm || 23 ||
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
evaṃ maunena cāgatya vaṃdyānvaṃdya gṛhaṃ vrajet || 24 ||
bhūyobhūyoyamāhutyā hutvāhutvā juhoti vai || 26 ||

ebhimaṃtrapadairbhaktyā śaktyā vā kāmameva vā ||
bhakṣyairnānāvidhairanyaiḥ śaktyā vā maṃtravidvaśī ||

eṣāṣṭapuṣpikā ||
puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtaḥ pātre kujaṃ maṃtraiḥ samarcayet ||

ādityamaṇḍalavidhivarṇanam
ādityamaṃḍalaṃ nāma sarvāśubhavināśanam || 1 ||

ādityaprītaye dattaṃ pratigṛhṇāmi maṃḍalam || 6 || ( iti pratigrahamaṃtra)

ulkāvatsa sapatnānāṃ jvalannāste sadā hṛdi || 16 ||
tāṃ śuṣkakoharamukhīṃ prakaṭorudaṃṣṭrāṃ kāpālinīṃ samavalaṃbitamuṇḍamālām ||
uktavrateṣu puruṣo navamīṣu caṇḍīṃ saṃpūjya kasya hṛdaye na ca śaṃ karoti|| 17 ||
pūrvaṃ kṛtayugasyādau bhṛgorbhāryā mahāsatī ||
divyārāmāśrame ramyā gṛhakāryaikatatparā || 1 ||
babhūva sā bhṛgornityaṃ hṛdayepsitakāriṇī ||
tasyāṃ munirmahātejā agnihotraṃ nidhāya ca || 2 ||
viṣṇostrāsāddānavānāṃ kulatrāṇasamākulam ||
dattvā nikṣepakaṃ sarvaṃ divyāyai sumahātapāḥ |||
jagāma himavatpārśve haraṃ toṣayituṃ rahaḥ || 4 ||
saṃjīvanīkṛte nityaṃ kaṇairdhūmamadhomukhaḥ ||
ājagāma gate tasmingaruḍenāśrito hariḥ ||
dṛṣṭvāsurabalaṃ sarvaṃ nihataṃ viṣṇunā tadā ||
divyā saṃśaptukāmābhūdviṣṇuṃ sāsrāvilekṣaṇā || 7 ||
yāvannoccarate vācaṃ cakreṇa kṛttakaṃdharam ||
tāvannipātayāmāsa śirastasyāḥ sakuṇḍalam || 8 ||
prāpya saṃjīvanīṃ vidyāṃ yāvadāyātyasau muniḥ ||
roṣācchaśāpa ca hariṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanaḥ ||
avaśyabhāvabhāvitvādviśvasya hitakāraṇāt || 4.63.10 ||
yasmāttvayā hatā daityā brahmaṇo matparigrahāḥ ||
tasmāttvaṃ mānuṣe loke daśa vārāngamiṣyasi || 11 ||
ato.arthaṃ mānuṣe loke rakṣārthaṃ ca mahīkṣitām||
avatāraṃ cakārāhaṃ bhūyobhūyaḥ pṛthagvidham || 12 |||||
pūrvoktaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ pārtha avatīrṇaṃ mahītale ||
māṃ narā ye.arcayiṣyaṃti teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape || 13 ||
vrataṃ daśāvatārākhyaṃ kṛṣṇa brūhi savistaram ||
samaṃtraṃ sarahasyaṃ ca sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 14 ||
proṣṭhapade site pakṣe daśamyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ ||
snātvā jalāśaye svacche pitṛdevāditarpaṇam|| 15 ||
kṛtvā kurukulaśreṣṭha gṛhamāgatya mānavaḥ ||
gṛhṇīyāddhānyacūrṇasya dvihastaprasṛti trayam || 16 ||
krameṇa pāvayettāṃ tu puṃsaṃjñaṃ ghṛtasaṃśritam ||
varṣe varṣe dine tasminyāvadvarṣāṇi vai daśa || 17 ||
prathame pūrikānvarṣe dvitīye ghṛtapūrakān ||
tṛtīye śuklakāsāraṃ caturthe modakāñchubhān || 18 ||
sohālakānpañcame.abde ṣaṣṭhe.abde khaṇḍaveṣṭakān ||
saptame.abde kokarasānapūpāṃśca tathāṣṭame || 19 ||
navame karṇaveṣṭāṃstu daśame khaṇḍakāñchubhān ||
daśa dhenūrdaśahare daśaviprāya dāpayet || 4.63.20 ||
arddhārddhaṃ piṣṭayedevamarddhārddhaṃ vā dvijātaye ||
svata evārdhamaśnīyādgatvā ramye jalāśaye || 21 ||
daśāvatārānabhyarcya puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ ||
maṃtreṇānena medhāvī harimabhyukṣya vāriṇā || 22 ||
matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ varāhaṃ ca narasiṃhaṃ trivikramam ||
śrīrāmaṃ rāma kṛṣṇau ca buddhaṃ caiva sakalkinam || 23 ||
gato.asmi śaraṇaṃ devaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||
praṇato.asmi jagannāthaṃ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu || 24 ||
chinattu vaiṣṇavīṃ māyāṃ bhaktyā jāto janardanaḥ ||
daśāvatāranāmākhyaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 26 ||
śrūyate yāstvimālocya puruṣāṇāṃ daśā daśa ||
tāśchinatti na saṃdehaḥ śakrapraharaṇairhariḥ || || 27 ||
saṃsārasāgare ghore majjata tatra māṃ hariḥ ||
śvetadvīpaṃ nayatvāśu vratenānena toṣitaḥ || 28 ||
so.ahaṃ janārdano rājankālarūpī dharāsutaḥ ||
ye pūjayaṃti puruṣāḥ puruṣottamasya matsyādikāṃstu daśamīṣu daśāvatārān ||
martyā daśasvapi daśāsu sukhaṃ vihṛtya te yāṃti yānamadhiruhya sureśalokān || 32 || ||
āśādaśamīvarṇanam
pārtha pārthivavṛndānāṃ mukhapaṅkajasadrave ||
śṛṇuṣvāvahito vacmi tavāśādaśamīvratam || || 1||
nalanāmābhavatpūrvaṃ niṣadheṣu mahīpate ||
sa bhrātrā nirjito rājye puṣkareṇeti naḥ śrutam || 2 ||
vanaṃ pratibhayaṃ śūnyaṃ jhillīkagaṇanāditam || 3 ||
dadarśa vanamadhyasthāñchakunīnkāṃcanacchavīn || 4 ||
grahītumicchaṃstānrājansamācchādya svavāsasā ||
khamāpetuḥ khagāstūrṇaṃ gṛhītvā vasanaṃ śubham ||5||
āsasāda samāḥ kāściddhṛtavāsāḥ suduḥkhitaḥ||
damayaṃtīṃ samāprāpya nidrayāpahṛtāṃ tadā ||
duḥkhādutsṛjya gatavānbhāgyataḥ prāgdhaneśvaram || 5 ||
apaśyaṃtī nalaṃ vīraṃ vīra bhīmasutā vane ||
itaścetaśca babhrāma hāheti rudatī muhuḥ || 7 ||
duḥkhaśokasamākrāṃtā naladarśanalālasā ||
āsasāda dine kaiścitsā caidyapuramaṃjasā || 8 ||
unmattavatparivṛtā śiśubhiḥ kautukākulaiḥ ||
sā dṛṣṭā cedirājasya jananyā janaveṣṭitā ||9||
āropya sā svabhavanaṃ pṛṣṭā kā tvaṃ varānane || 4.64.10 ||
uvāca bhaimī savrīḍaṃ sairaṃdhrīṃ māṃ nibodhatām ||
na dhāvayeyaṃ caraṇau nocchiṣṭaṃ bhakṣayāmyaham || 11 ||
yadi prārthayate kaściddaṃḍyaste sāṃprataṃ bhavet ||
pratijñayānayā devi tiṣṭheyaṃ tava veśmani ||
evamastvanavadyāṃgi rāja mātāpyuvāca tām || 12 ||
evaṃvidhā tadbhavane kaṃcitkālamaniṃditā ||
uvāsa vasanārddhena pravṛttāṃte kila dvijaḥ ||
ānayāmāsa mudito damayaṃtīṃ gṛhaṃ pituḥ || 13 ||
mātrā pitrā samāyuktā sutairbhrātṛbhireva ca ||
damayaṃtī tathāpyāste duḥkhaṃ naiṣadhavarjitā || 14 ||
provāca vimanāhūya vrataṃ dānamathāpi vā ||
kathayadhvaṃ yathā me syādiṣṭena saha saṃgamaḥ || 15 ||
bhadre tvamāśādaśamīṃ kuruṣvepsitasiddhidām || 16 ||
cakāra sarvaṃ tanvaṃgī yatpurāṇavidā tadā ||
khyātamākhyānaviduṣā damanena purodhasā || 17 ||
saṃjātaḥ sukhado.atyarthaṃ bharttrā saha samāgamaḥ || 18 ||
kathamāśādaśamyeṣā govinda kriyate kadā ||
sarvametatsamācakṣva māṃ sarvajñosi yādava || 19 ||
eteṣvanyeṣu kartavyamāśāvratamidaṃ sadā || 22 ||
śuklapakṣe daśamyāṃ tu snātvā saṃpūjya devatāḥ ||23||
naktaṃ tadāśāḥ saṃpūjyāḥ puṣpālaktakacandanaiḥ ||
gṛhāṅgaṇe lekhayitvā yavaiḥ piṣṭātakena vā ||
dattvā ghṛtāktaṃ naivedyaṃ punaḥ kāryaṃ nivedayet ||24||
āśāścāśāḥ sadā saṃtu vidyaṃtāṃ ca manorathāḥ||
bhavatīnāṃ prasādena sadā kalyāṇamastviti ||25||
evaṃ saṃpūjya bhuñjīta dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām||
yāvanmanorathaḥ pūrṇastataḥ paścātsamudyamāt ||
māsi pūrṇe ca ṣaṇmāse varṣe varṣadvaye gate||27||
sauvarṇāḥ kārayedāśā raupyapiṣṭātakena vā||
jñātibaṃdhujanaiḥ sārddhaṃ snātaḥ samyagalaṃkṛtaḥ ||28||
pūjayenmaṃtrasaṃdarbhairebhirdhyātvā gṛhāṃgaṇe|||
tava saṃnihitaḥ śakraḥ surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ ||
pūrvā candreṇa sahitā aindrīdigdevate namaḥ || 29 ||
agneḥ parigrahādārye tvamāgneyīti paṭhyase ||
tejomayī parā śaktirāgneyī varadā bhava || 4.64.30 ||
devarājaṃ samāsādya lokaḥ saṃyamayatyasau ||
tena saṃyamanī yāsi yāmye kāmapradā bhava || 31 ||
khaḍgaṃsahātivikṛtā nairṛtistvamupābhṛtā ||
tena nairṛtanāmnītvaṃ kṛtavānmaghavā sadā || 32 ||
tvayyāste bhavanādhāravaruṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ ||
iṣṭakāmārthasiddhyarthaṃ vāruṇiprabhavā bhava || 33 ||
adhiśritāsi yasmāttvaṃ vāyunā jagadāyunā||
vāyavye tvamataḥ śāntiṃ nityaṃ yaccha namonamaḥ || 34 ||
aiśānī jagadīśena śaṃbhunā tvamalaṃkṛtā ||
atastvaṃ śivasānnidhyaṃ devi dehi śive namaḥ || 35 ||
sarpāṣṭakakulena tvaṃ sevitāsi tathāpyadhaḥ ||
nāgāṃganābhiḥ sahitā hitā naḥ sarvadā bhava || 36 ||
saptalokaiḥ parigatā sarvadā tvaṃ śivā yataḥ ||
sanakādyaiḥ parivṛtā brāhmī jihmānapākuru || 37 ||
nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi grahāstārāgrahāstathā ||
nakṣatramātaro ye ca bhūtapretavināyakāḥ ||
sarve mameṣṭasiddhyarthe bhavaṃtu praṇatāḥ sadā || 38 ||
ebhirmaṃtraiḥ samabhyarcya puṣpadhūpādinā tataḥ ||
nṛtyatībhirvarastrībhistāṃ rātrimativāhayet || 4.64.40 ||
kuṃkumakṣodatīvreṇa dānamānādibhiḥ sukham ||
ya evaṃ kurute pārtha daśamīvratamādarāt ||
sa sarvakāmamāpnoti manasābhīpsitaṃ naraḥ || 43 ||
strībhirviśeṣataḥ kāryaṃ vratametadyudhiṣṭhira ||
laghucittā yato nāryaḥ sadā kāmaparāyaṇāḥ || 44 ||
ye mānavā manujapuṅgava kāmakāmāḥ saṃpūjayaṃti daśamīṣu sadā daśāśāḥ ||
teṣāṃ viśeṣanihitā hṛdaye prakāmamāśāḥ phalaṃtyalamalaṃ bahunoditena || 46 ||
tārakadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
ahaṃ tvāgaskaraḥ pāpaḥ pṛthivīkṣayakārakaḥ ||
paripṛcchāmi govinda tvāṃ namaskṛtya pādayoḥ || 1 ||
tarāmi yena pāpaughaṃ bhīṣmadroṇavadhārṇavam || 2 ||
āsītpurottaro nāmnā vidarbhāyāṃ kuśadhvajaḥ ||
sāṃtaḥpurasuto yaśca cakre rājyamataṃdritaḥ || 3 ||
jaghāna tāpasaṃ so.atha pramādānmṛgayāṃ gataḥ ||
mṛgaṃ matvā mahāraṇye brāhmaṇaṃ daivamohitaḥ || 4 ||
tatrāsau yātanā ghorā anubhūyātipīḍitaḥ || 5 ||
adaśatso.api rājendra brāhmaṇaṃ caraṇe ruṣā || 6 ||
vipannastu tataḥ siṃho dvitīye.abhūtsudāruṇaḥ || 7 ||
vidāritamukho hiṃsro nānāsattvabhayaṃkaraḥ ||
jaghānāsau punaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ rājanyaṃ mṛgayā gatam || 8 ||
punarvyāghro babhūvāsau tṛtīye.api bhavāṃtare || 9 || tīkṣṇapādanakhāghātavyāpāditamṛgānvayaḥ ||
tenāpi vaiśyo nidhanaṃ nītaḥ kiñcidvanāṃtaram || 4.65.10 ||
sa nītaḥ kṛmirāśitvaṃ lokaiḥ khātanipātanāt ||
saṃjātastu mahānṛkṣo nakharāhatajaṃturuk || 11 ||
jaghāna bālaṃ caṇḍālādasau mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ||
striyaṃ jaghāna taruṇīṃ snātukāmāmathāgatām ||
prabhāte śaṅkarasyāgre śaśāṅkagrahaṇe niśi || 13 ||
tatrāpi baḍiśaṃ dattvā janaiḥ prāṇairviyojitaḥ ||
punaḥ ṣaṣṭhe bhave jātaḥ piśācaḥ piśitāśanaḥ || 14 ||
krūraśchidraparaḥ kṣudro naraprāṇaviyojakaḥ ||
so.avatīrṇo narasyāṃgaṃ karṣayāmāsa kasyacit || 15 ||
maṃtreṇāhūya siddhena vātikena vyasuḥ kṛtaḥ ||
krūradaṃṣdraḥ karālāsyo māṃsaśoṇitabhojanaḥ ||
digvāsā marubhūmīṣu vāśiṣṭho brahmarākṣasaḥ ||17||
sa rāṣṭraṃ jarjaraṃ śūnyaṃ sarvaṃ cakre viṣādiṣu ||
ākramya bhīmadāsena rājñā rākṣasaśatruṇā || 18||
samāropya dhanuḥ saṃkhye brahmāstreṇa nipātitaḥ ||
vanecarāṇāṃ kruddhāṅgo brāhmaṇānnidhanaṃ gataḥ ||
tato hastī ca bhallūko mātaṃgena dhanuṣmatā || 4.65.20 ||
ekādaśe.api pāñcālo bhavamadhye.api bhīṣaṇaḥ ||
ūrdhvakeśoti raktākṣo jāto hrasvatanurdṛḍhaḥ || 21 ||
sa daṇḍapāśikenaiva vṛkṣāgre hyavalaṃbitaḥ || 22 ||
dvādaśe sa punarjātaḥ puṣkalakleśabhājanaḥ ||
tena cāsītkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ tārakadvādaśīvratam ||
tasya prabhāvājāto.api duṣṭayonau punaḥpunaḥ || 24 ||
avāpa śīghraṃ paṃcatvaṃ saṃsārabhavasāgare ||
punarevābhavadrājā vidarbhāyāṃ sudhārmikaḥ || 25 ||
bhūyaścopoṣitā tena tārakadvādaśī śubhā ||
dṛśyatāṃ vratamāhātmyaṃ jātojātaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 26 ||
prāpa viṣṇupure sthānaṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 27 ||
kathametadvrataṃ kṛṣṇa kartavyaṃ puruṣottamaiḥ ||
strībhirvā bhartṛvākyena snānadānajapādikam || 28 ||
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe gṛhītvā dvādaśīvratam ||
praṇamya bhāskarāyātha kṛtvā devārcanaṃ tathā ||
sajalaṃ sākṣataṃ kṛtvā sahiraṇyaṃ śubhaiḥ phalaiḥ || 31 ||
ramye tāmramaye pātre jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gataḥ ||
pūrvāmukhaḥ pradoṣāgre mūrdhni kṛtvārghyabhājanam || 32 ||
bhūmau tu maṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā gomayena satārakam ||
sahasraśīrṣāmaṃtreṇa bhūmau śaktyā śanaiḥ svayam ||
tārakāṇāṃ kuruśreṣṭha dadyādarghyamataṃdritaḥ ||34||
paryukṣya dhūmamutkṣipya dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām ||
mārgaśīrṣe khaṃḍakhādyaṃ pauṣe sohālakaṃ tathā ||
tilataṃḍulakaṃ māghe guḍāpūpaṃ ca phālgune ||36||
modakāṃścaitramāse tu vaiśākhe khaṃḍaveṣṭakam ||
jyeṣṭhe saktubhṛtaiḥ pātrairāṣāḍhe guḍapūrikaiḥ || 37 ||
śrāvaṇe madhuśīrṣeṇa nabhasye pāyasena ca ||
ghṛtaparṇaiścāśvayuje kāṃsāraiḥ kārttike kramān || 38 ||
bhuñjīta bhaktyā rājendra paścāddevaṃ kṣamāpayet || 39 ||
samāpte tu vrate kṛtvā rājataṃ tārakāgaṇam ||
dṛṣṭvā vā pūrvavidhinā pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet || 4.65.40 ||
kumbhā dvādaśa dātavyāḥ sodakā modakāśritāḥ ||
brāhmaṇyāṃ paridhānaṃ ca padmarāgaḥ sakuṃcakaḥ || 41 ||
brāhmaṇe valgulallāṭaṃ lakṣapuṣpopaśobhitam ||
cālakenopavītaṃ ca puṣpaṃ dattvā kṣamāpayet || 42 ||
nārī vā bharataśreṣṭha bhaktibhāvapuraḥsarā || 43 ||
etadvrataṃ purā cīrṇaṃ śacyā rājñyā śriyomayā ||
sītayā damayaṃtyā ca rukmiṇyā satyabhāmayā || 46 ||
menayā raṃbhayā svarge urvaśyā devadattayā ||
anyābhirapi nārībhiḥ puruṣaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 47 ||
janmāṃtareṣvapi kṛtāni haratyaghāni yā saṃdahatyaharahaḥ sukṛtopayogāt ||
sā dvādaśī jagati tārakanāmadheyā tannāsti yanna vidadhāti kṛtā manuṣyaiḥ || 49 ||
araṇyadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
saprāśanaṃ sopavāsaṃ sarahasyaṃ samantrakam || 1 ||
kauṃteya yatpurā cīrṇaṃ sītayā vanasaṃsthayā ||
bhojitāstarpitāḥ sarvairāhāraiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ || 3 ||
padminīpatravistīrṇe sopadaṃśai ryathā navaiḥ ||
bhakṣyabhojyaistathā lehyaiścoṣyaiścāpi yadṛcchayā || 4 ||
tāmihaikamanāḥ pārthaḥ śṛṇuṣvāraṇyadvādaśīm ||
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe ekādaśyāṃ dinodaye || 5 ||
snātvā naraḥ sopavāsaḥ kṛtvā pūjāṃ janārdane ||
gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatairdhūpairdīpairjāgaraṇairniśām ||6||
nītvā prabhāte gatvā ca vane vedāṅgapāragān ||
bhojayitvā phalaprāyaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ || 7 ||
pañcagavyaṃ prāśayitvā pūrvamevātha taddine ||
varṣamekaṃ śubhaṃ pūrṇa pārayitvā yudhiṣṭhira||8||
śrāvaṇe kārttike māghe caitre vātha samarcite ||
sopadaṃśaiḥ patraśākaistilaśaṣkulikādibhiḥ || 9 ||
apūpaiḥ khaṇḍaveṣṭaiśca marīcaiḥ siṃhakesaraiḥ ||
dhūlīmukhai ramṛtaphalaiḥ svādukokarasaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 4.66.10 ||
śītalaistarpayedvidvānarkapuṣpaiḥ sumālakaiḥ ||
dadhikṣīrājyapāṇijyaiścāturjātakaraṃjitaiḥ || 11 ||
bahuvṛkṣaṃ vanaṃ gatvā susvādusalilaṃ śivam ||12||
sukhāsanopaviṣṭāṃśca prāgudaṅmukhavacchucīn ||
bhojayeddaśa ca dvau vā munīnāraṇyavāsinaḥ || 13 ||
ekadaṃḍīstridaṃḍīśca gṛhasthāṃścāpi suvratān ||
brāhmaṇīrvividhāḥ sapta ekapatnīḥ pativratāḥ || 14 ||
cārvaṃgyaścārcitāḥ snātāḥ sarvāvayamaśobhanāḥ ||
suvastrāḥ kukumāktāṅgāḥ sugaṃdhakusumāṃcitāḥ || 15 ||
aṃgairvā bhojanīyāstāstāścādityasya devatāḥ ||
vāsudevajanārdanadāmodaramadhusūdanāḥ || 16 ||
padmanābhakṛṣṇaviṣṇugovarddhanatrivikramāḥ ||
śrīdharaśca hṛṣīkeśaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣa ādivārāhāḥ || 17 ||
gaṃdhacandanasaṃvastraṃ dhūpaṃ dattvā pṛthakpṛthak || 18 ||
bhojayitvā śubhānnāni dadyāttābhyaḥ sudakṣiṇām ||
praṇamya prārthayedbhaktyā viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti || 19 ||
āgatābhyāgatairlokaiḥ suhṛtsaṃbaṃdhibaṃdhubhiḥ || || 4.66.20 ||
evaṃ kauṃteya kurute yo.araṇyadvādaśīṃ naraḥ ||
sa dehāṃte vimānastho divyakanyāsamāvṛtaḥ ||
yāti jñātisamāyuktaḥ śvetadvīpaṃ hareḥ puram || || 21 ||
yatra lokāḥ pītavastrāḥ śyāmadehāścaturbhujāḥ ||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmacāruhastāḥ sakaustubhāḥ || 22 ||
garuḍāsanāḥ sābharaṇā mukuṭotkaṭa kuṃḍalāḥ ||
nīlotpaloddāmapadmamālayālaṃkṛtorasaḥ ||23||

tiṣṭhaṃti viṣṇusāmānye yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || || 24 ||

martyaloke kīrtimaṃtaḥ saṃbhavaṃti narottamāḥ || 25 ||

ye dvādaśīmupavasaṃti sitāmaraṇyanāmnīṃ vane dvijavarānatha bhojayaṃti ||
sādhvyaḥ striyaḥ sucaritābharaṇāśca tāsāṃ viṣṇuḥ prasādamupayāti dadāti mokṣam || 27 || ||
mayūrakekākulite dardurārāvapūrite || 1 ||
kiṃ vrataṃ kṛṣṇa vikhyātamannaṃ kasyāṃ tithau bhavet || 2 ||
pravṛtte śrāvaṇe māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe hyupasthite ||
ekādaśyāṃ śucirbhūtvā sarvauṣadhijalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 3 ||
māṣacūrṇena rājendra kuryādiṃdurikāśanam ||
modakāṃśca tathā paṃca ghṛtapakvānsunirmalān || 4 ||
kṛtvā maṃḍalakaṃ vṛttaṃ piṣṭakādibhirarcitam || 6 ||
prīyatāmiti me devī rohiṇī sahitapriyā || 9 ||
kaṃṭhāṃtaṃ kaṭimātraṃ vā gulphāṃtaṃ vā jalā śaye || 4.67.10 ||
dhyāyecca manasā somaṃ rohiṇīsahitaṃ tadā ||
yāvatsamastaṃ tadbhuktaṃ bhuktvā cāṃtastaṭe sthitaḥ || 11 ||
dakṣiṇāsahitaṃ deyaṃ niścayaṃ vāci kalpayet ||
bhaktyā śaktyā yathācittaṃ yathāvittaṃ tathā tathā || 12 ||
yaḥ karoti naro rājannārī vātha kumārikā ||
khe rohiṇī śaśadharābhimatā hitā ca kiṃ kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu narendra nivedayāmi || saṃpiṣṭamāṣaraciteṃdurikāśituṃ yadbhuktaṃ jale guḍaghṛtena phalaṃ tadetat ||16|| ||
vidhānaṃ tasya kīdṛkca kiṃ puṇyaṃ kā.atra devatā || 1 ||
śṛṇu pāṃḍava yatnena kathyamānaṃ yathākhilam ||
prauṣṭhapade śuklapakṣe dvādaśyāṃ prātarutthitaḥ ||
yastu śuklāṃbaradharaḥ snātvā pūrvaṃ jalāśaye || 3 ||
godhūmacūrṇapiṣṭena lakṣmī tatpārśvavartinīm || 4 ||
tatraiva ca haraṃ gaurīṃ sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇā saha ||
rājñīsahitaṃ ca raviṃ trailokyodyotakārakam || 5 ||
gaṃdhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpairnaivedyairarcayedyathāśaktyā ||
aviyogavratacārī maṃtreṇānena rājendra||6||
nārī vā puruṣo vā aviyogamatiṃ dṛḍhāṃ kṛtvā ||
bhaktyā dhyānī maunī dāṃpatyaṃ pūjayeddevam || 7 ||
sahasramūrddhā puruṣaḥ padmanābho janārdanaḥ ||
vyāso.api kapilācāryo bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ ||8||
nārāyaṇo madhuliho viṣṇurdāmoharo hariḥ ||
mahāvarāho goviṃdaḥ keśavo garuḍadhvajaḥ || 9 ||
śrīdharaḥ puṃḍarīkākṣo viśvarūpastrivikramaḥ ||
upendro vāmano rāmo vaikuṃṭho mādhavo dhruvaḥ || 4.68.10 ||
vāsudevo hṛṣīkeśaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sakarṣaṇo.acyutaḥ ||
nityaṃ sa me śubhaḥ prītaḥ saśrīkaḥ keśaśūlinaḥ ||
umāpatinīlakaṃṭhaḥ sthāṇuḥ śaṃbhurbhagākṣihā || || 12 ||

kapardīśo mahāliṃgī mahākālo vṛṣadhvajaḥ ||13||
śivaḥ śarvo mahādevo rudro bhūtamaheśvaraḥ ||

hiraṇyagarbho vedajñaḥ parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ ||15 ||

mārtaṃḍo maṃḍalajyetiragniraśmirjaneśvaraḥ || 17 ||
prabhākaraḥ saptasaptistaraṇiḥ saraṇiḥ khagaḥ ||
divākaro dinakaraḥ sahasrāṃśurmarīcimān || 18 |||
padmaprabodhanaḥ pūṣā kiraṇī merubhūṣaṇaḥ ||
lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ saṃpadā padmā mā vibhūtirharipriyā ||
pārvatī lalitā gaurī umā śaṃkaravallabhā || 4.68.20 ||

rājñī bhānumatī saṃjñā nityabhā bhāskarapriyā| || 21 ||
iti padmanābhaśaṃkarapitāmahārkkādīnsapriyānpūjya ||
dattvādattvā dānaṃ bhuktvā cāṃte vrajedveśma || 22 ||

tatra brāhmaṇarājanyavaiśyaśūdrādayo hatāḥ ||

goṣu vedāḥ samutkīrṇāḥ saṣa ḍaṃgapadakramāḥ || 24 ||

tathā kaṣṭaviyogā diduḥkhairdaurgatyasaṃbhavaiḥ ||13||
lālapyamānā bahavaḥ parapīḍopajīvinaḥ ||
evaṃ vidhānyanekāni duḥkhāni munipuṅgava ||14||
dṛṣṭvaiva tāni tānyeva bhṛśaṃ me vyādhitaṃ manaḥ ||
teṣāṃ duḥkhāni bhūtānāṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi mānada || 15 ||
upakārakaraṃ brūhi mamānugrahakāmyayā ||
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ||
yadupoṣya na duḥkhānāṃ bhājano jāyate janaḥ || 17 ||
māghamāse site pakṣe dvādaśī pāvanī smṛtā ||
|| bhīma uvāca || ||
kathaṃ sā muniśārdūla upoṣyā dvādaśī bhavet ||
śṛṇu rājannavahito vrataṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ||
tava śuśrūṣaṇādvācyaṃ mamāpyetanna saṃśayaḥ || 4.74.20 ||
adīkṣitāya no deyā nāśiṣyāya kadācana ||
viṣṇubhaktāya śāṃtāya dharmaniṣṭhāya caiva hi || 21 ||
brahmahā gurughātī ca bālastrīghātakastathā || 22 ||
śuddhe tithau muhūrte ca maṃḍapaṃ kārayettataḥ ||
śuklāṃ sukuṭṭimāṃ bhūmiṃ vedyāṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ || 25 ||
vilikhenmaṃḍalaṃ tatra paṃcavarṇairvidhānataḥ ||
pañcaviṃśatitattvajñaḥ svācārābhiratastathā ||
kuṃḍāni kalpayettatra aṣṭau catvāri vā punaḥ ||27||
brāhmaṇāṃsteṣu yuṃjīta cātuścaraṇikāñchubhān ||
madhye ca maṃḍalasyātha karṇikāyāṃ janārdanam ||28 ||
pūjayettaṃ vidhānena śāstroktena vicakṣaṇaḥ || 29 ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha deśikaḥ || 4.74.30 ||
nyasetstaṃbhadvayaṃ paścāttiṣṭhankāṣṭhasamanvitam ||
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ caturasraṃ samaṃtataḥ ||
tatra śikyaṃ samālaṃbya suvṛttaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ navam || 32 ||
āropayeddhaṭaṃ tatra yādṛśaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva me ||
kaladhautaṃ tathā raupyaṃ tāmraṃ vāpyatha mṛnmayam || 33 ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ dṛḍhaṃ vyaṃgavivarjitam ||
kuśalatvānurūpeṇa pāśaikacchidrameva vā ||
homārthaṃ kalpayeccāpi pālāśyaḥ samidhaḥ śubhāḥ ||
tilā ghṛtaṃ tathā kṣīraṃ śamīpatrāṇi caiva hi || 36 ||
vedyāḥ pūrvottare bhāge grahapīṭhaṃ prakalpayet ||
tatra pūjyā grahāḥ sarve graha yajñavidhānataḥ || 37 ||
pūrvasyāṃ diśi śakrasya pūjāṃ kurvīta yatnataḥ ||
dakṣiṇasyāṃ yamasyātha pratīcyāṃ varuṇasya ca || 38
kuberasya tathodīcyāṃ baliṃ kuryātphalākṣataiḥ ||
evaṃ saṃbhṛtya saṃbhāraṃ śuklāṃbaradharastathā || 39 ||
pīṭhamāropayeyuste yajamānaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||4.74.40 ||
yajamāno.api devasya saṃmukhaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
upaviśya paṭhenmaṃtraṃ purāṇoktamidaṃ śṛṇu || 41 ||
tatodakasya dhārāstāḥ pratyaṃgaṣu samanvitāḥ ||
śirasā dhārayettūṣṇīṃ tadgatenāṃtarātmanā || || 43 ||
homaṃ kuryustato viprā dikṣu sarvāsu tatparāḥ ||
paṭheyuḥ śāṃtikādhyāyaṃ viṣṇusaṃjñāni yāni vai || 44 ||
vāditraistāḍyamānaiśca śaṃkhageya svanaistathā ||
vyākhyānakuśalāḥ kecicchrāvayeyurataṃdritāḥ ||
anena vidhinā sarvāṃ tāṃ rātriṃ prītivarddhinīm || 48 ||
brāhmaṇāścāpi tāṃ rātrīṃ juhvato jātavedasam || 49 ||
vāsudevasya śirasi vasorddhārāṃ prapātayet || 4.74.50 ||
kṣīreṇājyena vā rājansarvasiddhi pradāyinīm ||
snānaṃ kuryānnṛpaśreṣṭha nadyāṃ sarasi vā punaḥ ||
atha vā śaktihīnastu yajamānoṣṇa vāriṇā || 52 ||
tataḥ śuklāni vastrāṇi paridhāya yatavrataḥ ||
arghyaṃ dattvā bhāskarāya savidhānaṃ prasannadhīḥ || 53 ||
hutvā hutāśanaṃ bhaktyā dattvā pūrṇahutiṃ tataḥ || 54 ||
pūjayedbrāhmaṇānsarvānhotāro yajñakalpitāḥ ||
ācāryaḥ pūjanīyo.atra sarvasvenāpi bhārata ||
dīnānāthaviśiṣṭāśca baṃdinaśca samāgatāḥ || 57 ||
teṣāmannaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca dadyācchuddhena cetasā ||
yathāvibhavasāreṇa paścādbhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ ||
haviṣyamannaṃ yajñena haviṣyā satilāstathā || 59 ||
evaṃ yajño mahārājaścoktaste saṃprakīrtitaḥ ||
pāpiṣṭhāḥ sarvapāpebhyo mucyaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ || 4.74.60 ||
vājapeyātirātrābhyāṃ ye yajaṃti śataṃ samāḥ ||
sarve te viṣṇuyāgasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 61 ||
sapta janmāni saubhāgyamāyurārogyasaṃpadaḥ ||
prāpnoti dvādaśīmetāṃ tāmupoṣya vidhānataḥ || 62 ||
mṛto viṣṇupuraṃ yāti viṣṇunā saha modate ||
caturyugāni dvātriṃśadviṣṇurūpadharaḥ sthitaḥ ||63||
pṛthivyadhipatiḥ śrīmānvijitāriḥ pratāpavān || 65 ||
vratametatpurā cīrṇaṃ sagareṇa mahātmanā ||
ajena dhuṃdhumāreṇa dilīpena yayātinā || 66 ||
anyaiśca pṛthivīpālaiḥ pālitāśeṣabhūtalaiḥ||
strībhirvaiśyaistathā śūdrairdharmakāmaiḥ sadā nṛpa || 67 ||
tvayā ca pṛṣṭena mayā kathitaṃ te narādhipa || 68 ||
bhīmākhyā dvādaśī ceti kṛtakṛtyā ca bhārata || 69 ||
yaścaināṃ kathitāṃ dhyātvā kuryādvā bhaktibhāvataḥ || 4.74.70 ||
daridraścāpi bhoḥ pārtha vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ||
viṣṇubhaktena kartavyā saṃsārabhayabhīruṇā || 71 ||
bhīmena yā kila purā samupoṣitā ca rātrau ghaṭasthirasuśatilavāridhārā ||
tāṃ dvādaśī daśamu khārimukhācchrutāṃ ca samyagvratī carati yāti sa viṣṇuloke || 72 ||
śravaṇadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
upavāsāsamarthānāṃ sadaiva puruṣottama ||
ekā yā dvādaśī puṇyā tāṃ vadasva mamānagha || 1 ||
māsi bhādrapade śuklā dvādaśī śravaṇānvitā ||
sarvakāmapradā puṇyā copavāse mahāphalā || 2 ||
saṃgame saritāṃ snātvā dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ ||
ayatnātsamavāpnoti dvādaśadvādaśīphalam || 3 ||
budhaśravaṇadvādaśyāmevaṃ vai saṃyato bhavet ||
atīva mahatī tasyāṃ kṛtaṃ sarvamathākṣayam || 4 ||
dvādaśī śravaṇopetā yadā bhavati bhārata ||
saṃgame saritāṃ snātvā gaṃgādisnānajaṃ phalam||
sopavāsaḥ samāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 5 ||
jalapūrṇe tathā kuṃbhe sthāpayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
yathāśakti svarṇamayaṃ śaṃkhaśārṅgavibhūṣitam || 7 ||
oṃ namo vāsudevāyeti śiraḥ saṃpūjayaddhareḥ ||
śrīdharāya mukhaṃ tadvatkaṃṭha kṛṣṇāya vai punaḥ || 9 ||
oṃ namaḥ śrīmate vakṣo bhujau sarvāstradhāriṇe ||
vyāpakāya namaḥ kukṣī keśavāyodaraṃ namaḥ || 4.75.10 ||
sodakāṃśca navānkuṃbhāñchaktyā dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya gorvidaṃ jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet || 13 ||
tataḥ puṣpāṃjaliṃ baddhvā maṃtrametamudīrayet || 14 ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya goviṃda brāhmaṇaṃ pūjayettataḥ ||
anaṃtaraṃ brāhmaṇe vai vedavedāṃtapārage ||
purāṇajñe viśeṣeṇa vidhivatsaṃpradāpayet || 16 ||
dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇe yukte aśeṣāhaskarānvite ||
karakaṃ saṃgame snātvā prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ|| 17 || ||
atrāpyudāharaṃtīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ||
mahatyaraṇye yadvṛttaṃ bhūmipāla śṛṇuṣva tat ||18||
deśo daśārṇako nāma tasya bhāge tu paścime ||
sutaptasikatā bhūmiryatra duṣṭā mahoragāḥ||
alpacchāyadrumākīrṇo mṛtaprāṇi samākulaḥ ||4.75.20 ||
śamīkhadirapālāśakarīraiḥ pīlubhiḥ saha ||
tatra bhīmā drumāḥ pārtha kaṃṭakaiḥ śabalā dṛḍhaiḥ ||21||
dagdhaprāṇigaṇākīrṇā yatra bhūrddṛśyate kvacit||
annodakaṃ no labhaṃte rājaṃstatra balāhakāḥ ||22||
kadācidapi dṛśyaṃte bhrāmyanto hi vihagamāḥ||
vṛkṣāṃtaragatairnityaṃ śiśubhistṛṣitaiḥ samam ||
utkṛttajīvitā rājandṛśyaṃte vihagottamāḥ ||23||
tṛṣāturāśca sahasā mṛgāḥ saikatamāgatāḥ||
tasmiṃstathāvidhe deśe kaściddaivavaśādvaṇik ||
nijasārthaparibhraṣṭaḥ praviṣṭo marujāṃgale || 25 || piśācānmalināṃstīkṣṇānnirmāṃsānbhīmadarśanān ||
babhrāmodbhrāṃtahṛdayaḥ kṣuttṛṣābhramakarṣitaḥ ||
kva grāmaḥ kva jalaṃ kvāhaṃ yāsyāmi na bubodha saḥ ||27||
atha pretāndadarśāsau tṛṣṇāvyākuliteṃdriyān || snāyubaddhāsthicaraṇānprekṣamāṇānitastataḥ || 28 ||
pretaskaṃdhasamārūḍhamekaṃ pretaṃ dadarśa ha ||
pretaskaṃdhānmahīṃ gatvā tasyāṃtikamupāgamat || 4.75.30 ||
sa dṛṣṭvātha vaṇikchreṣṭhamidaṃ vacanamabravīt ||
tamuvāca vaṇigdhīmānsārthabhraṣṭasya caiva me ||
tṛṣṇā māṃ bādhate.atyarthaṃ kṣuddunoti bhṛśaṃ tathā ||
prāṇāḥ kaṃṭhamanuprāptā vacanaṃ naśyatīva me ||
atropāyaṃ na paśyāmi jīveyaṃ yena kenacit ||33||
puṃnāgamimamāśritya pratīkṣasva muhūrtakam ||34||
kṛtātithyo yathālābhaṃ gamiṣyasi yathāsukham ||
evamuktastathā cakre sa vaṇiktṛṣṇayārditaḥ || 35 ||
madhyāhnasamaye prāpte tatastaṃ deśamāgataḥ ||
punnāgavṛkṣātkarako vāridhārāmanoramaḥ ||
bhuktvānnaṃ ca jalaṃ pītvā vaṇiktuṣṭimupāgataḥ ||
vitṛṣṇo vijvaraścaiva kṣaṇena samapadyata || 37 ||
dadhyodadanaṃ sapānīyaṃ pretāstṛptiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ || 38 ||

tṛptāḥ paraṃ kathaṃ tvete nirmāṃsā bhinnaku kṣayaḥ || 42 ||

kastvamasyāṃ sughorāyāmaṭavyāṃ tu kṛtālayaḥ ||

śṛṇu bhadra pravakṣyāmi duṣkṛtaṃ karma cātmanaḥ || 45 ||

prativeśe ca tatrāsīdbrāhmaṇo guṇavānmama ||
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge māsi bhādrapade tathā || 48 ||
sa kadācinmayā sārdhaṃ toṣāṃ nāma nadīṃ yayau ||
tasyāśca saṃgamaḥ puṇyo yatrāsīccandrabhāgayā || 49 ||
caṃdrabhāgā somasutā toṣā caivārkanaṃdinī ||
tayoḥ śītoṣṇasalilasaṃgamaḥ sumanoharaḥ || 4.75.50 ||
tattīrthavaramāsādya prātiveśyaḥ sa ca dvijaḥ ||
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge snātaścaivamupoṣitaḥ || 51 ||
caṃdrabhāgātoṣayośca vāridhānyairnavairdṛḍhaiḥ ||
caṃdrabhāgājīvanena dadhyodanayutaṃ tadā || 53 ||
etatkṛtvā gṛhaṃ prāptastataḥ kālena kenacit ||
pañcatvamahamāsādya nāstikyātpretatāṃ gataḥ ||
asyāmaṭavyāṃ ghorāyāṃ yathā dṛṣṭastvayānagha || 54 ||
brahmasvahāriṇastvete pāpāḥ pretatvamāgatāḥ ||
paradāraratāḥ kecitsvāmidroharatāḥ pare || 55 ||
mitradroharatāḥ keciddeśe.asmiṃstu sudāruṇe ||
mamaite bhṛtyatāṃ yātā annapānakṛtena ca || ||56||
akṣayyo bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ ||
mayā vihīnāḥ kiṃ tvete vane.asminbhṛśadāruṇe||
pīḍāmanubhaviṣyaṃti dāruṇāṃ karmayonijām ||58||
eteṣāṃ tvaṃ mahābhāga mamānugrahakāmyayā ||
anekanāmagotrāṇi gṛhāṇa lekhanena ca ||59||
astu kakṣāgatā caiva tava saṃpuṭikā śubhā ||
gayāśīrṣe tato gatvā śrāddhaṃ kuru mahāmate ||
evaṃ sambhāṣamāṇo.asau taptajāṃbūnadaprabhaḥ ||
nāmagotrāṇi saṃgṛhya prayātaḥ sa himācalam || 63 ||
dhanabhāgamupādāya gayāśīrṣavaṭaṃ yayau ||
pretānāṃ kramaśastatra cakre śrāddhaṃ dinedine || 64 ||
sa kṛtvā dhanalobhācca pretānāṃ satkṛtiṃ vaṇik ||
jagāma svagṛhaṃ tatra māsi bhādrapade tathā || 67 ||
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge pūjayitvā janārdanam ||
mahānadīsaṃgameṣu prativarṣaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ||

avāpa paramaṃ sthānaṃ durlabhaṃ cātra mānavaiḥ ||
yatra kāmaphalā vṛkṣā nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ ||
śītalāmalapānīyāḥ puṣkariṇyo manoharāḥ || 4.75.70 ||

vijayaśravaṇadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
dvādaśyāste vidhiḥ proktaḥ śrāvaṇe yo yudhiṣṭhira ||
ekādaśī yadā sā syācchravaṇena samanvitā ||
vijayā sā tithiḥ proktā bhaktānāṃ vijayapradā || 2 ||

bhayaṃ babhūva daityānāṃ devānāṃ toṣa ābhavat ||

kuśasvacchodakadharaḥ kamaṃḍaluvibhūṣitaḥ ||

tatra tvamīpsitānbhogānbhuktvā madbāhupālitaḥ ||
visṛjyemaṃ baliṃ devānsakalānsa uvāca ha || 26 ||
svāni dhiṣṇyāni gacchadhvaṃ tiṣṭhadhvaṃ vigata jvarāḥ ||
devenoktā gatā devā hṛṣṭāḥ saṃpūjya vāmanam || 27 ||
devaḥ kṛtvā jagatkāryaṃ tatraivāṃtarddhimāgamat ||
etatsarvaṃ samabhavadekādaśyāṃ narādhipa|||
teneṣṭā devadevasya sarvadā vijayā tithiḥ || 28 ||
eṣā vai phālgune māsi puṣyeṇa sahitā nṛpa ||

svasvavittānusāreṇa sahiraṇyaṃ ca kārayet ||
maṃtraiḥ śataguṇaṃ caiva bhaktyā lakṣa guṇottaram ||
bhaktimāṃśca guṇopetaṃ koṭikoṭiguṇottaram || 35 ||
upahārairnaraśreṣṭha śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ || || 36 ||
oṃ jalajopamadehāya jalajāsyāya śaṃkhine ||
mayā niveditaṃ puṣpaṃ gṛhāṇa puruṣottama || 4.76.40 || iti puṣpamantraḥ ||
manoharavapuḥskandhadhṛtacakrāya śārṅgiṇe || 41 || iti pūjāmaṃtraḥ ||
matsyaḥ kūrmo varā haśca nārasiṃhaśca vāmanaḥ ||
rāmo rāmaśca kṛṣṇaśca nāmabhirvāmanāya te ||
pādādyaikaikāṃgasya pūjanaṃ śīrṣagaṃ tataḥ || 42 || iti sarvāṃgapūjā ||
dhūpo.ayaṃ devadeveśa śaṃkhacakragadādhara ||
tvameva pṛthivī jyotirvāyurākāśameva ca ||
tvameva jyotiṣāṃ jyotirdīpo.ayaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 44 || iti dīpamaṃtraḥ ||
annaṃ caturvidhaṃ svādu rasaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ samanvitam ||
annaṃ prajāpatirviṣṇū rudreṃdraśaśibhāskarāḥ ||
annaṃ tvaṣṭā yamo.agniśca pāpaṃ haratu me.avyayaḥ || 46 || iti naivedyamaṃtraḥ || jagadādirjagadūpamanādirjagadaṃtakṛt ||
jalāśayo jagadyoniḥ prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ || 47 || iti prīṇanamaṃtraḥ || anekakarmanirbaṃdhadhvaṃsinaṃ jala śāyinam||
nato.asmi mathurāvāsaṃ mādhavaṃ madhusūdanam || 48 ||

sarvagaḥ sarvadeveśaḥ śrīdharaḥ śrīniketanaḥ ||
viśveśvaraśca viṣṇuśca śrīśāyī ca namonamaḥ ||52|| iti śayanamaṃtraḥ ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya yo rātrāvekādaśyāṃ nṛpottama ||
jāgaraṃ tatra kurvīta gītavāditranisvanaiḥ || 53 ||
yā ca śravaṇasaṃyuktā dvādaśī paramā tithiḥ ||
tasyāṃ ca saṃgame snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 54 ||
pradeyaṃ śāstraviduṣe brāhmaṇāya ca maṃtrataḥ || 55 ||
brāhmaṇaścāpi mantreṇa pratigṛhṇīta maṃtravat ||
vāmano.asya pratigrāhī vāmanāya namonamaḥ || 56 ||
naro dadyādupoṣyaivamekādaśyāṃ samaṃtrakam || 57 ||
pūrvoktavidhinā prātarbhojanaṃ pṛṣadājyakam ||
pūrvaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paścādbhuñjīta vāgyataḥ || 58 ||
bhūyobhūyo.api rājeṃdra sarvatraivaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
prāpya viṣṇupure rājankrīḍate kālamakṣayam || 4.76.60 ||
ihāgatya bhavedrājā pratipakṣakṣayaṃkaraḥ ||

samprāptidvādaśīvratavarṇanam
kṛṣṇapakṣe tu pauṣasya saṃprāptaṃ dvādaśīvratam ||
pauṣādipāraṇaṃ māsaiḥ ṣaḍbhirjyeṣṭhāṃtikaṃ smṛtam || 1 ||
prathamaṃ puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ nāma kṛṣṇasya gīyate ||

ṣaṣṭhe jayeti deveśa guhyanāma prakīrtitam || 3 ||
pūrvokteṣu ca māseṣu snānaprāśana yostilāḥ ||
āṣāḍhādiṣu māseṣu paṃcagavyamudāhṛtam ||4||

pratimāsaṃ ca deveśa kṛtvā pūjāṃ yathāvidhi ||

dhanaṃ vasu hiraṇyaṃ ca dhānyaṃ bhājanamāsanam ||
śayyāṃ vā brāhmaṇe dadyātkeśavaḥ pratigṛhyatām || 9 ||
etāmupoṣya vidhinā viṣṇuprītau ca tatparaḥ ||
tato lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ saṃprāptaṃ dvādaśīti vai || 4.77.10 ||
kṛtābhilaṣitā dṛṣṭā prārabdhā dharmatatparaiḥ||
pūrayedakhilānkāmānsaṃsmṛtā vā dinedine || 11 ||
saṃprāptikāmupavasaṃti samīhitārthā ye mānavā manu japuṃgava viṣṇubhaktāḥ ||
teṣāṃ samīhitaphalāni dadāti śaśvadvāsaḥ sureśabhavane bhagavatprasādāt || 12 ||
tathānyāmapi te vacmi goviṃda dvādaśīṃ śṛṇu ||
tasyāḥ samyaganuṣṭhānātprāpnotyabhimataṃ phalam || 1 ||
pauṣe māse site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ ||
dhūpapuṣpopacāraiśca naivedyaiśca samāhitaḥ ||
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyathāśaktyā narādhipa ||
pākhaṃḍibhirvikarmasthairālāpāṃśca vivarjayet ||
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ vāpi dadhi kṣīrama thāpi vā || 5 ||
godohataḥ samudbhūtaṃ prāśnīyādātmaśuddhaye ||

evamevākhilānmāsānupoṣya prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
dadyādgavāhnikaṃ vidvānpratimāsaṃ tu śaktitaḥ || 8 ||
govindaḥ prītimāyātu vratenānena me sadā || 9 ||
bhaktyā paramayā rājañchṛṇu yatphalamāpnuyāt || 4.78.10 ||
svarṇaśṛṃgaṃ raupyakhuraṃ gośatairvṛṣabhaṃ varam ||
govindadvādaśīmetāṃ samupoṣya vidhānataḥ ||

yo dvādaśīṣu kururāja kṛtopavāsaḥ prāpnotyasau surabhilokamapetaśokam || 14 ||
akhaṇḍadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
