tasmātpākhaṃḍisaṃsargamakurvandvādaśīmimām ||
dharaṇīvratavarṇanam
sa devaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇo hariḥ || 1 ||
prāpyante susahāyaiśca kvacittyaktāḥ suduṣkarāḥ || 3 ||
vittena ca vinā dānaṃ dātuṃ kṛṣṇa na śakyate ||
vidyamāne.api na matiḥ kuṭuṃbāsaktacetasaḥ || 4 ||
tasya mokṣaḥ kathaṃ kṛṣṇa sarvathā durllabho hariḥ ||
dharaṇyā yatkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ majjantyā vasudhātale || 6 ||
pṛthivyāḥ pārthiva purā saṃjātaḥ saṃgamo.ambubhiḥ ||
sā bhūtadhātrī dharaṇī rasātalagatā śubhā ||
ārādhayāmāsa vibhuṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ param || 8 ||
kālena mahatā tasyāḥ prasanno garuḍadhvajaḥ ||
ujjahāra sthitau cemāṃ sthāpayāmāsa cācyutaḥ || 9 ||
prāpte mārgaśire māse daśamyāṃ niyatātmavān ||
snātvā devārcanaṃ kṛtvā agnikāryaṃ yathāvidhi || 4.83.10 ||
śucivāsāḥ prasannātmā hyatyalpānna susaṃskṛtam ||
bhuktvā pañcapadaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ śaucaṃ ca pādayoḥ || 11 ||
kṛtvāṣṭāṃgulamātraṃ tu kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhavam ||
bhakṣayeddantakāṣṭhaṃ tu tataścācamya yatnataḥ || 12 ||
spṛṣṭvā nyasyānyakarmāṇi ciraṃ dhyātvā janārdanam |||
śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ pītāmbarasamāvṛtam || 13 ||
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sthitvāhamaparehani ||
saṃbhokṣye puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇaṃ me bhavācyuta || 14 ||
japennārāyaṇāyeti rūpe tatra vidhānataḥ || 15 ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale nadīṃ gatvā samudragām ||
itarāṃ vā taḍāgaṃ vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān || 16 ||
ānīya mṛttikāṃ śuddhāṃ maṃtreṇānena mānavaḥ ||
dhāraṇaṃ poṣaṇaṃ tvatto bhūtānāṃ devi sarvadā ||
tena sattvena māṃ pāhi pāpānmocaya suvrate || 17 || || iti mṛttikāmantraḥ || || brahmāṇḍodaratīrthāni karaiḥ spṛṣṭāni te raveḥ ||
bhavaṃti bhūtāni satāṃ mṛttikāmālabhetpunaḥ || 18 || ityadityādarśanamantraḥ ||
evaṃ mṛdaṃ raveragre kṛtvāthātmānamā labhet ||
triḥkṛtvāśeṣamṛdayā kuṇḍamālikhya vai jale || 19 ||
ācamyāvaśyakaṃ kṛtvā punardeva gṛhaṃ vrajet || 4.83.20 ||
tamārādhya mahāyogaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||
keśavāya namaḥ pādau kaṭiṃ dāmodarāya ca || 21 ||
ūruyugmaṃ nṛsiṃhāya uraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe ||
kaṇṭhaṃ kaustubhanāthāya vakṣaḥ śrīpataye tathā || 22 ||
rathāṃgadhāriṇe cakraṃ śaṃkarāyeti cāṃbujam || 23 ||
gambhīrāyeti ca gadāmabhayaṃ śāṃtamūrtaye ||
evamabhyarcya deveśaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 24 ||
punastasyāgrataḥ kumbhāṃścaturaḥ sthāpayedbudhaḥ ||
jalapūrṇānsamālyāṃśca sitacandanacarcitān || 25 ||
catvāraste samudrāstu kalaśāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 26 ||
teṣāṃ madhye tu saṃpīṭhaṃ sthāpayedvastrasaṃvṛtam ||
tasminsauvarṇaṃ raupyaṃ vā tāmraṃ vā dāravaṃ tathā ||
sauvarṇaṃ mātsyarūpeṇa kṛtvā devaṃ janārdanam ||
vedavedāṃgasaṃyuktaṃ śrutismṛti vibhūṣitam || 28 ||
rasātalagatā vedā yathā deva tvayāhṛtāḥ ||
matsyarūpeṇa tadvanmāṃ bhavāduddhara keśava || 4.83.30 ||
yathāvibhavasāreṇa prabhā te.api punaḥpunaḥ ||
caturṇāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu caturo dāpayeddhaṭān || 31 ||
pūrvaṃ tu bahvṛce dayācchaṃdoge dakṣiṇaṃ tathā ||
yajuḥśākhānvite dadyātpaścimaṃ ghaṭamuttamam || 32 ||
ṛgvedaḥ prīyatāṃ pūrvaṃ sāmavedaśca dakṣiṇaḥ || 33 ||
yajuṣaḥ paścimo nāmnā ātharvāyottaraṃ tathā ||
pūrṇapātraistu satilaiḥ sthagitānkārayeddhaṭān || 34 ||
tatastaṃ jalapātrasthaṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine ||
dadyādevaṃ mahābhāga tataḥ paścāttu bhojayet || 35 ||
brāhmaṇānpāyasānnena tataḥ paścātsvayaṃ gṛhī ||
bhuñjīta bhṛtyasahito vāgyataḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ || 36 ||
anena vidhinā yastu dvādaśīṃ kṣapayennaraḥ ||
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ rājañchṛṇu satyavatāṃ vara || 37 ||
tadasya phalasaṃkhyānaṃ kartuṃ śakyaṃ na dhārayet || 38 ||
yaḥ kṛṣṇadvādaśīmetāmanena vidhinā nṛpa ||
brahmahatyādipāpāni janmāṃtarakṛtānyapi ||
akāmataḥ kāmato vā praṇaśyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 4.83.40 ||
tathaiva pauṣamāsena amṛtaṃ mathitaṃ suraiḥ ||
tasyeyaṃ tithiruddiṣṭā harervai kūrmarūpiṇaḥ ||
pauṣamāsaṃ samāsādya dvādaśīṃ śuklasaṃyutām || 42 ||
tasyāṃ prāgvatsaṃkalpaḥ prātaḥsnānādikāḥ kriyāḥ ||
nirvartyārādhayedrātryāmekādaśyāṃ janārdanam ||
prīyamaṃtrairnṛpaśreṣṭha devadevaṃ jagadgurum || 43 ||
kūrmāya pādau prathamaṃ supūjya nārāṇāyeti kaṭiṃ harestu ||
saṅkarṣaṇāyetyudaraṃ viśodhetpurobhavāyeti ca kaṃṭhapīṭham || 44 ||
subāhavetyeva bhujau śiraśca sarvātmane pāṃḍava pūjanīyau ||
svanāmamaṃtreṇa ca śaṃkhacakre gadāṃ namaskārapareṇa caiva || 45 ||
taṃ ratnagarbhaṃ susugaṃdhatoyaṃ kṛtvā tato hemamayaṃ svaśa ktyā ||
samaṃdaraṃ kūrmatanuṃ sureśaṃ saṃsthāpayeccātra śubhe ca pātre ||47||
ghṛtaiśca pūrṇe kalaśā.agrasaṃsthaṃ saṃpūjayejjāgaranṛtyagītaiḥ||
saṃpūjya viprānghṛtapāyasena nivedya pūrvaṃ dvijapuṅgavāya ||
nirvartya sarvaṃ vidhivattataśca bhuñjīta saṃtuṣṭamanāḥ sabhṛtyaḥ || 48 ||
evaṃ kṛte kalpayugāṃtarāṇi svarge vasetsarvasamṛddhakāmaḥ ||49||
saṃsāracakraṃ sa vihāya śīghramāpnoti loke tu hareḥ purāṇe ||
prayāṃti pāpāni vināśamāśu śriyā yuto jāyati satyadharma ||4.83.50|| anekajanmārjitasaṃyutāni naśyaṃti pāpāni narasya bhaktyā ||
prāguktarūpaṃ ca phalaṃ labheta nārāyaṇaṃ vastumupaiti sadyaḥ || 51 ||
evaṃ māghe site pakṣe dvādaśīṃ dharaṇīdhara ||
varāhasya śṛṇuṣvānyāṃ rājanparamadhārmika || 52 ||
kṛtvā devaṃ samabhyarcya ekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ || 53 ||
paścāttasyāgrataḥ kuṃbhaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ tu vinyaset || 54 ||
varāhāyeti pādau tu mādhavāyeti vai kaṭim ||
kṣetrajñāyeti jaṭharaṃ viśvarūpetyuro hareḥ ||55||
pūrvatrāyeti kaṃṭhaṃ tu prajānāṃ pataye śiraḥ ||
amṛtodbhavāya śaṃkhaṃ tu gadine ca gadāṃ tathā ||
sauvarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ tāmraṃ vā pātraṃ vibhavaśaktitaḥ ||
sarvabījaistu saṃpūrṇaṃ sthāpayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ || 58 ||
tatra śaktyā ca sauvarṇaṃ vārāhaṃ kārayettataḥ ||
daṃṣṭrāgreṇoddharanpṛthvīṃ saparvatavanadrumām || 59 ||
mādhavaṃ madhuhaṃtāraṃ vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitam ||
sthāpayetparamaṃ devaṃ jātarūpamayaṃ harim ||
puṣpamaṃḍapikāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet || 62 ||
prādurbhāvaṃ harerdivyaṃ vācayedgāpayedbudhaḥ ||
vedavedāṅgaviduṣe sādhuvṛttāya dhīmate ||
viṣṇubhaktāya rājendra viśeṣeṇa pradāpayet || 64 ||
evaṃ sakuṃbhaṃ dattvā ca hariṃ vārāharūpiṇam ||
iha janmani saubhāgyaṃ śrīkāntī puṣṭimeva ca ||
eṣā ca phālgune māsi śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśī ||
upoṣyā pūrvavidhinā harimārādhayetsudhīḥ || 68 ||
narasiṃhāya pādau tu goviṃdāyodaraṃ tathā ||
kaṭiṃ viśvasṛje pūjya aniruddhetyuro hareḥ || 69 ||
kaṃṭhaṃ tu śitikaṃṭhāya vainateyāya vai śiraḥ .||
śaṃkhamityeva saṃpūjya gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ phalaistathā ||
eṣā vaṃdyā pāpaharā dvādaśī bhavate mayā ||
evamenāṃ naravyāghra caitre saṃkalpya dvādaśīm ||
upoṣyārādhayetpaścāddevadevaṃ janārdanam || 75 ||
kuṇḍikāṃ sthāpayetpārśve chatrikāṃ pāduke tathā ||
amalaṃ vāmanaṃ sthāpya bṛsīṃ kāṃsaparicchadām || 76 ||
dāpayetprīyatāṃ viṣṇurhrasvarūpītyudīrayet || || 77 ||
māsanāmnātra saṃyuktaṃ prādurbhāvaṃ vidhānataḥ ||
bhraṣṭarājyo labhedrājyaṃ mṛto viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet || 79 ||
krīḍitvā suciraṃ kālamiha martyamupāgataḥ ||
cakravartī bhaveddhīmānyayātiriti nāhuṣaḥ||4.83.80||
tatrārādhya hariṃ bhaktyā ebhirmantrairvicakṣaṇaḥ ||
jāmadagnyāya pādau tu udaraṃ sarvadhāriṇe || 82 ||
madhusūdanāyeti kaṭimuraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe ||
kṣatrāṃtakāya ca bhujau maṇikaṇṭhāya kaṇṭhakam || 83 ||
sarvagandhaistu saṃpūjya puṣpairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||87||
tatastasyāgrataḥ kuryājjāgaraṃ bhaktimānnaraḥ ||
kāśyape brahmaṇo loke coṣitvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ||
arcayetparamaṃ devaṃ puṣpairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||4.83.90||
trivikramāyeti kaṭiṃ dhṛtaviśvāya codaram ||91||
uraḥ saṃvartakāyeti kaṇṭhaṃ saṃvatsarāya ca ||
sarvāsudhāriṇe bāhuṃ svanāmnābjarathāṃgake || 92 ||
arcayitvā vidhānena prabhāte brāhmaṇāya tau ||
āṣāḍhe.apyevameva tu saṃkalpya vidhinā naraḥ ||
arcayetparamaṃ devaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ samāhitaḥ || 98 ||
vāsudevāya pādau tu kaṭiṃ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca ||
cakrapāṇiṃ bhujau kaṃṭhaṃ mukhaṃ bhūpataye tathā ||
svanāmnā śaṃkhacakre tu puruṣāyeti vai śiraḥ || 4.83.100 ||
kāṃcanaṃ vāsudeveti cakrabāhuṃ sanātanam || 101 ||
manvaṃtarāṇi ṣaṭtriṃśattataḥ kālātyaye punaḥ ||
dātā yaśaḥkṣamāyuktastato nirvāṇamāpnuyāt || 105 || ||
evamevaṃ śrāvaṇe tu māsi saṃkalpya dvādaśīm ||
budhāya pādau saṃpūjya śrīdharāyeti vai kaṭim ||
prāgvadastrāṇi saṃpūjya brāhma ṇāya nivedayet || 108 ||
anena vidhinā sarvāṃ dvādaśīṃ samupoṣitaḥ ||
bhuktvā rājyaśriyaṃ sotha gataḥ paramikāṃ gatim || 4.83.110 ||
eṣa te vidhiruddiṣṭaḥ śrāvaṇe māsi sattama||
tadvadbhādrapade māsi śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśīm ||
namo.astu kalkine pādau hṛṣīkeśāya vai kaṭim ||
śitikaṇṭhāya kaṇṭhaṃ tu khaḍgapāṇīti vai bhujau ||
śaṃkhacakre svanāmnātra viśvamūrte tathāsitaḥ || 114 ||
vāmanaṃ mohanāśāya vittārthe jamadagnijam ||
sarvāṃ dattvā vidhānena pūjāṃ prāpnoti vāṃchitam || 121 ||
tadvadāśvayuje māsi śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśīm ||
udaraṃ sarvadevāya puṣkarākṣāya vā uraḥ ||
avyayāya tathā śīrṣaṃ prāgvadastrāṇi pūjayet || 123 ||
yathāśaktyā kāñcanena padmanābheti bhūṣitam || 124 ||
rātrau tu jāgaraṃ kṛtvā prabhāte vimale tataḥ ||
brāhmaṇe tatpradātavyaṃ saṃsārabhayabhīruṇā || 125 ||
brahmahatyādipāpāni kiṃ tu paṃcaiva bhārata ||
naśyaṃti kṛtapuṇyasya viṣṇornāmānukīrtanāt || 126 || ||
śṛṇu rājanmahābāho kārtike māsi dvādaśīm ||
upoṣya vidhinā yena yathāsyāḥ prāpyate phalam|| 127 ||
anulomena deveśaṃ pūjayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
namo dāmodarāyeti sarvāṅgaṃ pūjayeddharim || 128 ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā tasyāśca caturo ghaṭān ||
sragdāmālaṃbitagrīvānsitavastraiśca guṇṭhitān ||
sthagitāṃstāmrapātre tu tilapūrṇaiḥ sakāṃcanaiḥ || 4.83.130 ||
catvāraḥ sāgarāste ca kathitā rājasattama ||
yogeśvaramaṃganidhiṃ viraktaṃ pītavāsasam ||
tadvaddeyaṃ ca saṃpūjya jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet || 132 ||
kṛtvā tu vaiṣṇavaṃ yogaṃ yajedyogeśvaraṃ harim ||
ṣoḍaśe vai rathāṃgeṣu rajobhirbahubhiḥ kṛte || 133 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā prabhāte tu brāhmaṇānpañca bhojayet ||
catvāraḥ kalaśā deyāścaturṇāṃ pañcamasya hi || 134 ||
yogeśvaraṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ dāpayetprayataḥ śuciḥ ||
brāhmaṇāya samaṃ dattaṃ dviguṇaṃ vedavādine ||135||
itihāsapurāṇajñe dattaṃ caivākṣayaṃ bhavet || 137 ||
pañcadattvā vidhānena dvādaśyāṃ viṣṇumarcya ca ||
viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ dayādyathāśaktyā sadakṣiṇam ||
dīnānāthādikānsarvānpūjayecchaktito nṛpa ||138||
dharaṇīvratametattu purā kṛtvā prajāpatiḥ ||
prajāṃ lebhe tato muktirbrahmaṇā viṣṇave śubhe || 139 ||
yuvanāśvo hi rājarṣiranena vidhinā purā ||
dharaṇyā api pātāle magnayācaritaṃ purā ||
samāpte.asmiṃstadā devī hariṇā kroḍarūpiṇā ||
uddhṛtā daśanāgreṇa sthāpitā naurivāṃbhasi || 145 ||
dharaṇīvratametatte kathitaṃ pāṃḍunandana ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā yaśca kuryānnarottama ||
viśokadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
kimabhīṣṭaviyogaśokasaṃghāllaghu iha samupoṣatāṃ vrataṃ vā||
paripṛṣṭamidaṃ jagatpriyaṃ te vibudhānāmapi durllabhaṃ mahattvāt ||
puṇyamāśvayuje māsi viśokadvādaśīvratam ||
udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam ||
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samyagabhyarcya keśavam || 4 ||
evaṃ niyamakṛtsuptvā prātarutthāya mānavaḥ || 5 ||
śuklamālyāṃbarastadvatpūjayecchrīśamutpalaiḥ || 6 ||
viśokāya namaḥ pādau jaṃghe ca varadāya vai ||
śrīśāya jānunī tadvadūrū ca jalaśāyine || 7 ||
kaṃdarpāya namo guhye mādhavāya namaḥ kaṭim ||
dāmodarāyetyudaraṃ pārśve ca vipulāya vai || 8 ||
nābhiṃ ca padmanābhāya hṛdayaṃ manmathāya vai ||
cakriṇe nāma bāhuṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ gadine namaḥ ||
vaikuṇṭhāya namaḥ kaṇṭhamāsyaṃ yajñamukhāya vai || 4.84.10 ||
nāsāmaśokanidhaye vāsudevāya cākṣiṇī ||
lalāṭaṃ vāmanāyeti kirīṭaṃ viśvarūpiṇe || 11 ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya goviṃdaṃ phalamālyānulepanaiḥ || 12 ||
tatastasyāgrato bhavyaṃ sthaṃḍilaṃ kārayenmṛdā ||
nadīvālukayā pūrṇaṃ lakṣmyākṛtiṃ kṛtī nyaset ||
sthaṃḍile sūryamāropya lakṣmīmityarcayedbudhaḥ || 14 ||
namo devyai namaḥ śāṃtyai namo lakṣmyai namaḥ śriye ||
namaḥ puṣṭyai namastuṣṭyai namo dṛṣṭyai namonamaḥ || 15 ||
viśokā duḥkhanāśāya viśokā varadāstu me ||
viśokā vāstu saṃtatyai viśokā sarvasiddhaye ||16||
tataḥ śuklāṃbaradharo śūrpaṃ saṃveṣṭya pūjayet ||
abhigamya ca viprāṇāṃ mithunāni sadārcayet || 19 ||
śaktitastrīṇi caikaṃ vā vastramālyānulepanaiḥ ||
śayanāsthāni pūjyāni namo.astu jalaśāyine || 4.84.20 ||
tatastu gītavādyādyai rātrau jāgaraṇe kṛte ||
prabhāte vimale snānaṃ kṛtvā dāṃpatyamarcayet || 21 ||
bhojanaṃ ca yathāśaktyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
bhuktvā śrutvā purāṇāni taddinaṃ tvativāhayet || 22 ||
vratāṃte śayanaṃ dadyādguḍadhenusamanvitam ||
sopadhānakaviśrāmamāstarāvaraṇaṃ śubham || 23 ||
tathā kuru yathāyogyamaśokaṃ cāstu me sadā ||24||
maṃtreṇānena dhyātvā tu guḍadhenusamanvitam ||
śūrpaṃ ca lakṣmyā sahitaṃ dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā || 26 ||
utpātaṃ karavīraṃ ca bāṇamamlāna kuṃḍalam ||
kesaraṃ siṃduvāraṃ ca mallikāgaṃdhapāṭalam ||
kādaṃbaiḥ kuṃkumairjātyā tathānyairapi pūjayet || 27 ||
kiṃrūpā kena maṃtreṇa dātavyā tadihocyatām ||28||
tadidānīṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 29 ||
kṛṣṇājinaṃ caturhastaṃ prāgevaṃ vinyasedbhuvi ||
gomayenānuliptāyāṃ darbhānāstīrya sarvataḥ || || 4.84.30 ||
prāṅmukhīṃ kalpayeddhenumudakpādāṃ savatsikām || 31 ||
uttamā guḍadhenuḥ syātsadā bhāra catuṣṭayā ||
vatsaṃ bhāreṇa kurvīta dvābhyāṃ vai madhyamā smṛtā || 32.||
arddhabhāreṇa vatsaḥ syātkaniṣṭhā bhārakeṇa tu ||
caturthāṃśena vatsaḥ syādgṛhavittā nusārataḥ || 33 ||
dhenuvatsau kṛtāvetau sitasūkṣmāṃbarāvṛtau ||
śuktikarṇāvikṣupādau śuktimuktāphalekṣaṇau || 34 ||
suvarṇaśṛṃgābharaṇau rājatakhurasaṃyutau ||
nānāphalasamāyuktau ghrāṇagaṃdhakaraṃḍakau ||
yā lakṣmīḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yā ca deve vyavasthitā ||
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu || 38 ||
viṣṇorvakṣasi yā lakṣmīḥ svāhāyāṃ ca vibhāvasau ||
caṃdrārkaśakraśaktiryā dhenurūpāstu sā śriye || 39 ||
yā lakṣmīrlokapālānāṃ sā dhenurvaradāstu me || || 4.84.40 ||
svadhā tvaṃ pitṛmukhyānāṃ svāhā yajñabhujāṃ punaḥ ||
evamāmaṃtrya tāṃ dhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya nive dayet ||

prathamā guḍadhenuḥ syād ghṛtadhenurathāparā ||
tiladhenustṛtīyā syāccaturthī madhudhenukā || 44 ||
jaladhenuḥ paṃcamī tu ṣaṣṭhī tu kṣīrasaṃbhavā ||
saptamī śarkarādhenurdadhidhenurathāṣṭamī ||
rasadhenuśca navamī daśamī syātsvarūpataḥ || 45 ||
kuṃbhā syurdaśadhenūnāmitarāsāṃ tu rāśayaḥ ||
etadeva vidhānaṃ syātta evopaskarāḥ smṛtāḥ || 47 ||
maṃtrāvāhanasaṃyuktāṃ sadā parvaṇiparvaṇi ||
aśeṣayajña phaladāḥ sarvapāpaharāḥ śubhāḥ || 49 ||
vratānāmuttamaṃ yatsyādviśokadvādaśīvratam ||
tadaṃgatvena caivaiṣā guḍadhenuḥ praśasyate || 4.84.50 ||
ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāte.atha vā punaḥ ||
viśokadvādaśī caiṣā sarvapāpaharā śubhā ||
yāmupoṣya naro yāti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 52 ||
bhavārbudasahasrāṇi daśa cāṣṭau ca dharmavit ||
na śokaduḥkhadaurgatyaṃ tasya saṃjāyate nṛpa || 54 ||
nārī vā kurute yā tu viśokadvādaśīmi mām ||
nṛtyagītaparā nityaṃ sāpi tatphalamāpnuyāt || 55 ||
iti paṭhati ya itthaṃ yaḥ śṛṇotīha samyaṅ madhupuranarakārerarcanaṃ yaśca paśyet || matimapi ca janānāṃ yo dadātīndraloke vasati sa vibudhādyaiḥ pūjyamānaḥ sadaiva || 56 || ||
vibhūtidvādaśīvratavarṇanam
śṛṇu bhūpāla vakṣyāmi viṣṇuvratamanuttamam ||
vibhūtidvādaśīṃ nāma sarvāmaranamaskṛtam || 1 ||
kārttike vātha vaiśākhe mārgaśīrṣe ca phālgune ||
āṣāḍhe vā daśamyāṃ ca śuklāyāṃ laghubhuṅnaraḥ || 2 ||
kṛtvā sāyaṃtanīṃ saṃdhyāṃ gṛhṇīyānniyamaṃ budhaḥ ||
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya janārdanam || 3 ||

tataḥ prabhāta utthāya kṛtasnānajapaḥ śuciḥ ||
pūjayetpuṇḍarīkākṣaṃ śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ || 5 ||

namaḥ śivāyetyūrū ca viśvamūrte namaḥ kaṭim || 6 ||
kaṃdarpāya namo meḍhramādityāya namaḥ karau ||

śrīdharāya mukhaṃ keśānkeśavāyeti pāṃḍava || 8 ||

svanāmnā śaṃkhacakrāsigadāparaśupāṇaye || 9 ||

dadyādanena vidhinā pākhaṃḍānapi varjayet || 11 ||
samāpyaivaṃ yathāśaktyā dvādaśa dvādaśīrnaraḥ ||
śayyāṃ dadyānmuniśreṣṭha gurave rasasaṃyutām || || 12 ||
grāmaṃ ca śaktimāndadyātkṣetraṃ vā bhavanānvitam ||
guruṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadvadvastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 13 ||
anyānapi yathāśaktyā bhojayitvā dvijottamān||
yaścātiniḥsvaḥ puruṣo bhaktimānmādhavaṃ prati ||

purā rathaṃtare kalpe rājāsītpuṣpavāhanaḥ ||
nāmnā lokeṣu vikhyātastejasā sūryasannibhaḥ || 19 ||

sobhyāgataṃ pūjya munipravīraṃ pracetasaṃ vācamimāṃ babhāṣe || 26 ||

nālakṣya sambādhatayā hi bādhastārāgaṇairapi surāsuralokapālaiḥ || 28 || tasmātkimanyajananījaṭharodbhavena dharmādikaṃ kṛtamaśeṣajanātigaṃ syāt ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dhyānenā vekṣya cākhilam ||
pracetāstamuvācātha śṛṇu bhūpa purātanam || 4.85.30 ||
āsīdasādhucaritaḥ suhṛnmitravi varjitaḥ || 31 ||

alaṃkṛtya hṛṣīkeśaṃ sīvarṇaṃ paramaṃ padam ||
sātha dṛṣṭā tatastābhyāmidaṃ cittevadhāritam||37||
kimebhiḥ kamalaiḥ kāryaṃ varaṃ viṣṇuralaṃkṛtaḥ||
śayyā ca puṣpaprakaraiḥ pūjitābhūcca sarvadā || 39 ||
athānaṃgavatī tuṣṭā tayorhonaśatatrayam ||

ānāyyopahṛtaṃ kṛtvā bhujyatāmiti bhūpate|| ||41||
tābhyāṃ tu tadapi tyaktaṃ bhojyāvaḥ śvo varānane ||

vastrālaṃkārayuktāṃgā gāvaśca kanakāṃcitāḥ || 45 ||
bhojanaṃ ca suhṛnmitradīnāṃdhakṛpaṇaiḥ samam ||
puṣpāṇāṃ prakare tasmātkeśavasya prapūjanam ||47||
tasya sarvasya māhātmyādalaṃ na tapasā nṛpa || 48 ||

saṃtuṣṭastasya rājendra brahmarūpī janārdanaḥ ||49 ||
śayyānaṃgavatī veśyā kāmadeśasya sāṃpratam ||
patnī sapatnī saṃjātā ratyā prītiriti śrutā || 4.85.50 ||
lokeṣvānaṃdajananī sakalāmarapūjitā ||

yathākathaṃcitkālena dvādaśa dvādaśīrmune ||

sutānekonapaṃcāśadyena lebhe ditiḥ purā || 1 ||

śāṃtodarāyetyudaramanaṃgāyetyuro hareḥ ||

sūryaṃ śvetāramaṃdāraśvetārkāsyasaṃśayam ||

vidhānaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tatra kiṃ dānaṃ kasya pūjanam || 28 ||
|| striya ūcuḥ || ||
kartavyaṃ tu sarittīre kathāṃ śrutvā harerimām ||
anaṃtānaṃtamabhyarcya maṃḍale gaṃdhadīpakaiḥ || 30 ||
dhūpaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ pītālaktaiścatuḥśataiḥ ||
tasyāgrato dṛḍhaṃ sūtraṃ kuṃkumāktaṃ sudorakam || 31 ||
caturdaśagraṃthiyutaṃ vāme strī dakṣiṇe pumān ||
maṃtreṇānena rājendra yāvadvarṣaṃ samāpyate || 32 ||
dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devamanaṃtaṃ viśvarūpiṇam || 34 ||
bhuktvā cāṃte vrajedveśma hīdaṃ proktaṃ vrataṃ tava ||
sāpi śrutvā vrataṃ cakre śīlā baddhvā sudorakam || 35 ||
bhartā tasyāḥ samāgatya tāṃ dadarśa mahādhanām ||
pātheyaśeṣaṃ viprāya dattvā bhuktvā tathaiva ca || 36 ||
punarjagāma sā hṛṣṭā gorathena svamāśramam ||
bhartrā sahaiva śanakaiḥ pratyakṣaṃ tatkṣaṇādabhūt ||
tenānaṃtaprabhāveṇa śubhagodhanasaṃkulaḥ || 37 ||
gṛhāśramaḥ śriyā yukto dhanadhānyasamāyutaḥ ||
ākulo vyākulo ramyaḥ sarvatrātithipūjanaḥ || 38 ||
sāpi māṇikyakāñcībhirmuktāhāravibhūṣitā ||
divyāṃgavastrasaṃchannā sāvitrīpratimābhavat || 39 ||
kadācidupaviṣṭena dṛṣṭaṃ baddhaṃ sudorakam ||
śīlāyā hastamūle tu sākṣepaṃ troṭitaṃ ruṣā || 40 ||
tena karmavipākeṇa tasya sā śrīḥ kṣayaṃ gatā ||
godhanaṃ taskarairnītaṃ gṛhaṃ cāgnividāhitam || 41 ||
anaṃtākṣepadoṣeṇa dāridryaṃ patitaṃ gṛhe ||
manasā dhyāyatenaṃtaṃ kadā drakṣyāmi keśavam || 44 ||
tatrāpaśyanmahāvṛkṣaṃ phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ tathā ||
tamapṛcchattvayānaṃtaḥ kaccidṛṣṭo mahādruma ||
tadbrūhi sopyuvācedaṃ nānaṃtaṃ vedmyahaṃ dvija || 46 ||
evaṃ nirīkṣitastena gāṃ dadarśa savatsakām ||
tṛṇamadhye pradhāvantīmitaścetaśca pāṃḍava ||47||
gauruvācātha kauṃḍinya nānaṃtaṃ vedmyahaṃ vibho || 48 ||
tato jagāmātha vane govṛṣaṃ śādvale sthitam ||
dṛṣṭvā papraccha gosvāminnanaṃto lakṣitastvayā || 49 ||
govṛṣastamuvācātha nānanto vīkṣito mayā ||
sevitaṃ bhramarairhaṃsaiścakraiḥ kāraṃḍavairbakaiḥ ||
ūcatuḥ puṣkariṇyau taṃ nānaṃtaṃ vidvahe dvija ||
praveśayitvā svagṛhaṃ gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare || 56 ||
tāṃ purīṃ darśayāmāsa divyanārīnarairyutām ||
tasyāṃ niviṣṭamātmānaṃ varasiṃhāsane nṛpa || 57 ||
pārśvasthaśaṃkhacakrāsigadāgaruḍaśobhitam ||
darśayāmāsa viprāya pūrvoktaṃ viśvarūpiṇam|| 58 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu dvijonantamuvāca parayā mudā || 59 ||
pāpohaṃ pāpakarmāhaṃ pāpātmā pāpasambhavaḥ ||
pāhi māṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa sarvapāpaharo bhava ||60||
cūtavṛkṣo vṛṣaḥ kastu kā gauḥ puṣkariṇīdvayam ||
|| anaṃta uvāca || ||
vidyādānaṃ nopakurvañchiṣyebhyastarutāṃ gataḥ || 62 ||
sā gaurvasundharā dṛṣṭā niṣphalā yā tvayekṣitā ||
sa harṣo vṛṣabho dṛṣṭo lābhārthaṃ yastvayā vṛtaḥ || 63 ||
kharaḥ krodhastvayā dṛṣṭaḥ kuṃjaro dharmadūṣakaḥ ||
brāhmaṇosāvanaṃtohaṃ guhāsaṃsāragahvare || 64 ||
carānaṃtavrataṃ tattvaṃ nava varṣāṇi paṃca ca ||
tatastuṣṭaḥ pradāsyāmi nakṣatrasthānamuttamam || 66 ||
bhuktvā ca vipulānbhogānsarvānkāmānyathepsitān ||
kauṃḍinyopyāgato gehaṃ cacārānaṃtasadvratam || 68 ||
śīlayā saha dharmātmā bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān||
kalpasthānī ca saṃbhūto dṛśyatedyāpi sa jvalan| ||
yatkṛtvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 71 ||
ye ca śṛṇvaṃti satataṃ vācyamānaṃ narottama ||
te sarve pāpanirmuktā yāsyaṃti paramāṃ gatim || 72 ||
saṃsārasāgaraguhāṃ susukhaṃ vihartuṃ vāṃchaṃti ye kurukulodbhava śuddhasattvāḥ ||
araṇyavāsamuṣito yudhiṣṭhiranṛpo vaśī |
prāptastrailokyanāthena kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ||
viśeṣeṇa ca govindaṃ papraccha ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||
kena vratena deveśa vāñchitaṃ prāpyate phalaṃ |
niṣpāpāḥ sakalā lokāḥ bhavanti janmajanmani ||
indrādyairlokapālaiśca tanma kathayataḥ śṛṇu |
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ māsi bhādrapade tathā |
tasyānuṣṭhānamātreṇa sarvvapāpaṃ praṇaśyati ||
kṛṣṇa ko.ayaṃ tvayākhyāto yo.ananta iti saṃjñitaḥ
ko.ayaṃ śeṣaśca nāgaśca anantastakṣakaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
ādityagatirūpeśa yaḥ kāla upapadyate ||
kalākāṣṭhāmuhūrttādi dinarātrivyavasthayā |
pakṣo māsa ṛturvvarṣaṃ yugakalpavyavasthayā ||
so.ahaṃ kālo.avatīrṇo.asmi bhuvo bhārāvatāraṇāt |
dānavānāṃ vināśāya vasudevatanūdbhavaṃ |!
anantaṃ viddhi māṃ pārtha kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ hariṃ śivaṃ
brahmāṇaṃ bhāskaraṃ śeṣaṃ sarvvavyāpinamīśvaraṃ |
pratyayārthaṃ mayā pārtha viśvarūpaṃ nibotha tat |
anantavratamāhātmyaṃ vidhiṃ vidhividāṃ vara |
kiṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tasya anuṣṭhānañca tasya kiṃ ||
kena vā tatkṛtaṃ pūrvvaṃ loke kena prakāśitaṃ |
āsītpurā kṛtayuge sumanturnāma vai dvijaḥ |
vaśiṣṭhagotrajo vidvān śīlavān vijitendriyaḥ ||
mātā tasyāstu kālena jvaradāhaprapīḍitā |
kṛtaṃ sumantunā tasyāḥ karmma yat pāralaukikaṃ |
tataḥ sumantuḥ saṃtyajya duḥkhaṃ śokaṃ kramāt punaḥ
devalasya muneḥ kanyāṃ karkaśāṃ pariṇītavān |
sā karkaśātiduḥśīlā sadā niṣṭhurabhāṣiṇī ||
adakṣā gṛhṛkṛtyeṣu dakṣā bhojanakarmmaṇi ||
kalahena tu santuṣṭā ruṣṭā bandhujanān prati |
karoti sakhibhiḥ sārddhaṃ śiśukrīḍāmanuttamāṃ |
gṛhāntarasthaladvāradehalītoraṇādiṣu |
caturaṅgakavarṇaiśca raktapītasitāsitaiḥ |
svastikaṃ padmaśaṅkhau ca maṇḍayantī punaḥ punaḥ ||
kurvvantī pratyahaṃ bālā devatātithipūjanaṃ |
gṛhakṛtye sadā dakṣā pituratyantavallabhā ||
kālena kiyatā viprastāṃ dṛṣṭvā yauvanodgatāṃ |
tato davavaśāttatra kauṇḍinyaḥ samupāgataḥ |
muniśreṣṭho mahābhāgaḥ kulīno dharmatatparaḥ ||
manasā cintayāmāsa sumantuḥ sutapāḥ sudhīḥ |
asmai bhāgyavaśācchīlā pratipādyā prayatnataḥ ||
iti kṛtvā matiṃ vipro dadau kanyāṃ śubhe dine |
kanyāmalaṅkṛtāṃ sādhvīṃ śīlāṃ candranibhānanāṃ ||
sumantuḥ karkaśāṃ prāha jāmātre dehi dakṣiṇāṃ
dakṣiṇārahitaṃ karmma niṣphalaṃ jāyate yataḥ |
sā tu tadvacanaṃ śrutvā karkaśā kupitābhavat |
alaṅkāraṃ samānīya svakīyañcāpi bandhanaṃ ||
nikṣipya nibhṛte sthāne karkaśānyagṛhṛṃ yayau |
sumantuścātidīnātmā lajjitaścābhavattadā ||
tato vivāhaṃ nirvvartya kauṇḍinyo.api nijāśramaṃ |
goyāne tāṃ samāropya śīlāmādāya vai yayau
tataḥ sā pathi gacchantī śīlā candranibhānanā
dadarśa śīlā nārīṇāṃ samūhaṃ vratacāriṇāṃ |
puṃsāṃ vṛndañca tatreva raktapītāmbarāsanaṃ ||
dṛṣṭvā samūhaṃ nārīṇāṃ satī papraccha sādaraṃ ||
vinayāvanatā sādhvī praṇipatya sureśvaraṃ |
striya ūcuḥ |
ārādhite mahendre ca dhvajākārāsu yaṣṭiṣu ||
natvā sarasi yaḥ snātvā anantārccanamārabhet |
kṛtvā darbhamayaṃ devaṃ vārivājasamanvitaṃ ||
anantaṃ devadeveśaṃ caturbbāhuṃ kirīṭinaṃ |
atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ kāñcanāṅgadabhūṣaṇaṃ ||
śaṅkhacakragadāśārṅgaṃ vividhāyudhadhāriṇaṃ |
vāridhānyāṃ tathānantaṃ bhagavantaṃ niyojayet |
maṇḍale puṣpanevedyaṃ dhūpavastrānulepanaṃ ||
dattvā ca pūjayedbhaktyā anantaṃ viśvarūpiṇaṃ |
piṣṭakārthaṃ vrīhicūrṇaṃ yavagodhūmayośca vā ||
eteṣāṃ prāpyate yattu tadgrāhyaṃ prasthasaṃjñitaṃ |
pūjayitvā tathā devaṃ gandhapuṣpairyathākramaṃ |
śrutvā kathāṃ tatastasya kuṅkamāktaṃ suḍorakaṃ ||
pumāṃstu dakṣiṇe bāhau tadānantaṃ prapūjayet ||
nirvvarttya pūjāṃ devasya pūpaṃ bhuktvā yathāsukhaṃ |
visṛjya dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā praṇamya ca yathāsukhaṃ ||
śīlā śrutvā vacastāsāṃ yathā tābhirudāhṛtaṃ |
vrataṃ cakāra sā bāhau vaddhā ḍorakamuttamaṃ |
pūpaprasthañca sāṃ kṛtvā bhuktvā caiva tathaiva ca |
tenānantaprasādena gṛhaṃ godhanasaṅkulaṃ |
tadāśramaṃ śriyā yuktaṃ dhanadhānyasamanvitaṃ ||
vividhātithisampūrṇaṃ nānāratnairvibhūṣitaṃ |
varāśvamattamātaṅgamahiṣairgodhanānvitaṃ ||
śīlā ca maṇikāñcībhirmuktābharaṇabhūṣitā |
divyāṅgī śīlasampannā sāvitrīpratimā yathā ||
kadācidupaviṣṭā sā vahnikuṇḍaṃ samāgatā |
kauṇḍinyo.api viśedroṣāt dṛṣṭvā ḍoramanantakaṃ |
śolāyāḥ karamūle ca baddhameva prayatnataḥ |
papraccha krodhavacasā bhṛkuṭīkuṭilaṃ mukhaṃ ||
kimidaṃ ḍorakaṃ haste baddhvā bhāryye.atra tiṣṭhasi |
śīlovāca |
anantaṃ devadevasya prameyaṃ ḍorakaṃ śubhaṃ |
kare baddhaṃ vidhānena śṛṇu me vacanaṃ prabho ||
na jānāsi kathaṃ nātha tadevaṃ jagadīśvaraṃ ||
śīlāvākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā kauṇḍinyaḥ kupito.abhavat |
ityutvākṛṣya kupito bhujāḍḍoramanantakaṃ |
kṣiptaṃ jvālākule vahnau nirbhartsya bahudhā priyāṃ ||
tataḥ sā saṃbhramāt śīlā hāhā kṛtvā pradhāvitā
vahneḥ sūtraṃ samādāya kṣīramadhye tato.akṣipat ||
anantākṣepadoṣeṇa dāridryaṃ patitaṃ gṛhe ||
gātre malinatā prāptā cakṣurnidrāṃ tathaiva ca ||
śūnyāni gṛharūpāṇi dagdhāni vahninā kvacit |
nirīkṣya svapuraṃ vipraścintayāmāsa cetasā ||
atha śīlā vivarṇā sā duḥkhitā patidoṣataḥ;
vicacāra purīṃ sarvvāṃ śūnyāgārasamanvitāṃ ||
mamāpi duṣkṛtaṃ karmma kṛtaṃ vā me vigarhitaṃ ||
anantākṣepadoṣeṇa mamāpi gatirīdṛśī |
anantaṃ yatra paśyāmi tatra yāsyāmi durmatiḥ ||
tato jagāma kauṇḍinyo vanaṃ vyāghrādisaṅkulaṃ |
vratasyānveṣaṇaṃ karttuṃ pādau draṣṭuṃ tathā hareḥ ||
tatrāpaśyacca taṃ vṛkṣaṃ phalapuṣpasamanvitaṃ ||
varjitaṃ pakṣisaṅghātaiḥ kīṭaiścaiva viśeṣataḥ |
tamapṛcchat tvayānantaḥ kvaciddṛṣṭo mahādruma ||
sa covāca mahāvṛkṣo nānantaṃ vedmi bho dvija
tato gacchan dadarśāgre vṛṣaśreṣṭhaṃ vane sthitaṃ ||
tamapṛcchadayaṃ vipraḥ ananto vīkṣitastvayā |
vṛṣabhastamuvācedaṃ viṣaṇṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prati ||
yadyanantamahaṃ jāne tadā me gatirīdṛśī |
nānāmāyāpracarantaṃ madagarjjanadarpitaṃ |
sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā dvijo.arṛcchadanantaṃ dṛṣṭavān kimu |
tato vrajan dadarśāgre ramyaṃ puṣkariṇīdvayaṃ ||
bhramaraiścakravākaiśca haṃsakāraṇḍavairyutaṃ |
puṣkariṇyāvūcatusta na jānīvo hariṃ kvacit |
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kathaṃ paśyāmi taṃ vibhuṃ |
tataḥ kṛpālu hṛdayo deveśo devapūjitaḥ ||
tatkṣaṇādbhagavān viṣṇurdvijapratyakṣamāgataḥ |
vṛddhabrāhmaṇarūpeṇa provāca vacanaṃ dvijaṃ ||
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha viprendra tyaja duḥkhaṃ sukhī bhava |
anantaṃ darśayiṣyāmi kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ hariṃ śivaṃ ||
brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ samādāya pātālavartmanā purīṃ |
tāṃ purīṃ darśayāmāsa tataścāntardadhe dvijaḥ |
sa tāṃ dadarśa kauṇḍinyaḥ purīṃ trailokyadurllabhāṃ
divyanārīnarairyuktāṃ maṇiratnavibhūṣitāṃ ||
suvarṇaracitāṃ sarvvāṃ veṣṭitāṃ takṣakādibhiḥ |
viśvarūpaṃ jagannāthaṃ caturbbāhuṃ kirīṭinaṃ |
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇaṃ garuḍadhvajaṃ ||
dakṣiṇe vilasallakṣmīṃ vāme krīḍatsarasvatīṃ |
saptaphaṇāsamāyuktaṃ divyasiṃhāsanesthitaṃ |
evaṃ rūpaṃ jagannāthaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktyā stutiḥ kṛtā |
jagāma bhūmau śirasā anantasya samīpataḥ ||
sahasranāmne puruṣāya śāśvate sahasrakoṭīyugadhāriṇe namaḥ ||
ajñānena mayā deva yat kṛtaṃ pāpakarmaṇā |
tatsarvvaṃ kṛpayā śaṃsa kṣamasva madhusūdana || ||
atha kauṇḍinyaviprasya stutiṃ śrutvā janārddanaḥ |
tuṣṭo.ahaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha bhaktyā tava viśeṣataḥ |
varaṃ gṛhāṇa viprendra tuṣṭo.asmi tyaja vismayaṃ ||
| kauṇḍinya uvāca |
svakarmmaphalabhogena yāṃ yāṃ yoniṃ vrajāmyahaṃ |
tasyāṃ tasyāṃ hṛṣīkeśa haribhaktirdṛḍhāstu me ||
atipramādānmohādvā yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ |
tadāgaḥ kṣamyatāṃ nātha praṇamāmi punaḥ punaḥ ||
dāridranāśanaṃ dharmmaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ tathākṣayaṃ |0||
kauṇḍinya uvāca |
pūrṇo manoratho deva mama cādya viśeṣataḥ |
kaścūtaḥ ko vṛṣaḥ kā gauḥ kintat puṣkariṇīdvayaṃ |
kaḥ kharaḥ kuñjaraḥ ko vā ko vā vṛddhadvijottamaḥ |
kṛpayā kathayasvādya pathi dṛṣṭo mayā vibho |
śrīananta uvāca |
yaścāmravṛkṣo dṛṣṭo hi vipro vidyāsu garvvitaḥ |
upasthitāya śiṣyāya vidyāṃ yasmānna dattavān |
tena karmmavipākena vṛkṣatvaṃ prāpya tiṣṭhati |
vṛṣabho yastvayā dṛṣṭo lobhakarmmakṛtaḥ purā ||
dattaṃ paryyuṣitaṃ dravyaṃ svādu bhuktaṃ svayaṃ yataḥ |
vṛṣabhatvaṃ samāsādya tatastiṣṭhati nirjjane ||
viprāya vasudhāṃ dattvā niṣphalāṃ śasyavarjjitāṃ |
tenāsau gotvamāsādya tṛṇamadhye pradhāvati ||
dharmmādharmmau vijānīyādyattat puṣkariṇīdvayaṃ |
bhuktvā bhogāṃśca vipulān saṃprāpsyasi mahat padaṃ ||
anantākhyaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ varṣāṇāñca caturdaśaṃ |
śīlayā saha dharmmātmā sukhaṃ bhuktvā manorathān ||
viṣṇurokaṃ samāsādya rarāja śīlayā saha |
śravaṇikāvratam
loke prasiddhāḥ śrūyaṃte śrāvaṇyo nāma devatāḥ ||
etāḥ kāḥ kiṃ ca kurvaṃti dharmaṃ cāsāṃ bravīhi me || 1 ||
vidyaṃte devatāḥ puṇyāḥ śrāvaṇyo nāma pāṃḍava ||
brahmaṇā prathamaṃ sṛṣṭā niyogaśca jane kṛtaḥ || 2 ||
śrāvayaṃti hi tacchīghraṃ brāhmaṇyaḥ karmagocaram ||3||
dūrācchravaṇavijñānaṃ dūrāddarśanagocaram ||4||
tāsāmastīha sā śaktiracintyā tarkahetubhiḥ ||
naraistuṣṭaiśca yatproktaṃ kāryākāryasya kāraṇāt ||5||
tacchṛṇvaṃti yataḥ pārtha naikā śrāvaṇikā matāḥ ||
yathā devā yathā daityā yathā vidyādharā narāḥ||6||
yathā hi siddhagaṃdharvā nāgāḥ kiṃpuruṣāḥ khagāḥ||
rākṣasāśca piśācāśca devānāmaṣṭayonayaḥ||
tathaitāḥ puṇyanāmāno vaṃdyāḥ śrāvaṇikāḥ smṛtāḥ||7||
kiṃ tu tāsāṃ mahograṃ tu vrataṃ saṃyamanaṃ tadā ||8||
āghrāya dhūpaṃ pakvānnaṃ jalaṃ cāgandha meva ca ||
dātavyā punaranyāsāṃ nārīṇāṃ bhojyapāraṇā ||9||
adattvā yadi mṛtyuḥ syādaṃtarālepi pāṃḍava ||
śrūyaṃte hi purā pārtha pṛthivyāṃ nahuṣo nṛpaḥ ||
tasya bhāryā mahādevī jayaśrīrnāma bhārata || 11 ||
pratyakṣarūpasaṃpannā darśanīyatarā śubhā ||
pīvarorustanā śyāmā mṛdukuñcitamūrddhajā || 12 ||
śabdagadgadasaṃbhāṣā mattamātaṃgagāminī ||
yathārūpā tathā śīlā satī ceṣṭā mahītale || 13 ||
sā kadācidgatā snātuṃ gaṃgāyāṃ cāśrame muneḥ ||
vaśiṣṭhasya dadarśātha satīṃ bhāryāmaruṃdhatīm || 14 ||
bhojayaṃtī munīnāṃ tu patnīrnānānnabhojanaiḥ ||
tayā ca praṇipatyātha pṛṣṭā devyā mahāsatī || 15 ||
jayaśriye śṛṇuṣva tvaṃ nāmnā śrāvaṇikāvratam||
etadbhartrā samākhyātaṃ vaśiṣṭhena maharṣiṇā||17||
gūḍhaṃ bahmarṣisarvasvaṃ supativratakaṃ śubham ||
gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā rājñi tavātidhyaṃ karomyaham||18||
bubhuje sāpi tatraiva aruṃdhatyā kṛtā darā || 19 ||
tatastu samaye pūrṇe mriyamāṇā mahāsatī ||
jayaśrīrghargharaṃ gaṃtuṃ kurvāṇā kaṃṭhagadgadam || 21 ||
phenaṃ lālāvilādvaktrādudgiraṃtī muhurmuhuḥ ||
sthitā paṃcadaśāhāni bībhatsā dāruṇānanā || 22 ||
tataḥ ṣoḍaśake prāpte dine svayamaruṃdhatī ||
praviśyābhyaṃtaraṃ pūrṇaṃ tāṃ rājñīmavalokya ca ||
nahuṣāya samācakhyau yaduktaṃ śrāvaṇī vrate || 23 ||
datvā ca karakānaṣṭau tāmuddiśya jayaśriyam ||
kṣaṇājjagāma pañcatvaṃ karakāṇāṃ pradānataḥ || 25 ||
jagāma śakralokaṃ sā vimānenārkavarcasā ||
dodhūyamānā camaraiḥ stūyamānā surā suraiḥ || 26 ||
mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu dvādaśasvapi pāṃḍava ||
bhuktvā yajñe caturdaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ vā yudhiṣṭhira ||
vratī snātvā tu pūrvāhṇe nadyādau vimale jale || 28 ||
āmaṃtrayeddaśaikaikā nārīrgaurīsvarūpiṇīḥ ||
yatācārāḥ suveṣāśca brāhmaṇīrvā svagotrajāḥ || 29 ||
dvādaśa brāhmaṇāṃstatra vedavedāṃgapāragān ||
maṃtrajñānitihāsajñānupaśāṃtāñjitendriyān || 4.95.30 ||
sarvaṃ dadyādvidhānena pādakṣālanapūrvakam ||
caṃdanena sugandhena puṣpadhūpādinā tathā || 31 ||
grīvāsūtrakasiṃdūrakuṃkumena ca bhūṣayet ||
acchidrā jalapūrṇāstu suvṛttāḥ sūtraveṣṭitāḥ ||
sohālakādibhiścchannāḥ puṣpamālāvibhūṣitāḥ || 33 ||
caṃdanena samālabdhāḥ sahiraṇyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak ||
tanmadhye varddhanīṃ caikāṃ svake śīrṣe niveśayet || 34 ||
sthitvā maṇḍalake madhye yajamānaḥ svayaṃ tadā ||
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyātu pitṛdevarṣiṇāṃ nṛṇām || 35 ||
imā me samayaṃ svarṇaṃ tārayasva bhavārṇavāt ||
adyāhaṃ gantumicchāmi viṣṇoḥ padamanuttamam ||
evamastviti tā brūyuḥ striyaḥ sarvā yudhiṣṭhira || 36 ||
tato brāhmaṇamāhūya yajamāna idaṃ vadet ||
uttīrya śrāvaṇaṃ māsaṃ samuttāraya sāṃpratam ||
uttārayeta maṃtreṇa brāhmaṇo vardhanī ca tām || 38 ||
upoṣya śiraso devyāḥ samuttīrya ruhadrumān ||
kaṭukaṃ niṃbavṛkṣaṃ vā tato madhukamāruha ||
evaṃ tāḥ samayaṃ procya dattvāśīrvacanāni ca ||4.95.40||
tāṃ varddhanikāmekānte viprāya pratipādayet ||
gṛhītvā karakānnāryyo vrajeyuḥ sveṣu veśmasu || 41 ||
yajamāno.api yātāsu yatheṣṭaṃ kāmamācaret ||
strīṇāṃ tulyaṃ sa hīno.api vratī vrataphalaṃ vrajet ||
tadekenāpi labhate pārtha śrāvaṇikāvrate ||
śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvādavarṇanam
atha naktopavāsasya vidhānaṃ śṛṇu pāṃḍava ||
yena vijñātamātreṇa naro mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 1 ||
yeṣu teṣu ca māseṣu śuklapakṣe caturdaśīm ||
māsimāsi bhavaṃti dvāvaṣṭamyau ca caturdaśī ||
śivārcanarato bhūtvā śivadhyānaikamānasaḥ ||
vasudhābhājanaṃ kṛtvā bhuñjīyānnaktabhojanam || 3 ||
upavāsātparaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ bhaikṣyātparamayācitam ||
devaiśca bhuktaṃ pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne munibhistathā ||
aparāhṇe ca pitṛbhiḥ sandhyāyāṃ guhyakādibhiḥ || 5 ||
haviṣya bhojanaṃ snānaṃ satyamāhāralāghavam || 6 ||
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte vratapūrṇasya sarpiṣā ||
kapilāpañcagavyena sthāpayenmṛnmayaṃ śivam ||
phalaṃ puṣpaṃ yavakṣīraṃ dadhi dūrvāṃkurāṃstathā ||8 ||
tatkumbhānāṃ jalonmiśramarghamaṣṭāṃgamucyate ||
śirasā dhārayitvā tu jānū kṛtvā mahītale || 9 ||
mahādevāya dātavyaṃ gandhapuṣpaṃ yathākramam ||
bhakṣyodenairbaliṃ kṛtvā praṇamya parameśvarīm || 4.96.10 ||
dhenuṃ vā dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādvṛṣaṃ vāpi dhuraṃdharam ||
yo dadāti śive bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 11 ||
ārūḍho.apsarasāṃ gītairyāti rudrālaye sukham || 12 ||
iha loke nṛpaśreṣṭha grāmalakṣeśvaro bhavet || 13 ||
śivacaturdaśīvratavarṇanam
śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājanvakṣye māheśvaraṃ vratam ||
triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ nāmnā śivacaturdaśī || 1 ||
mārgaśīrṣatrayodaśyāṃ sitāyāmekabhuṅnaraḥ ||
māseṣvanyeṣu vā rājanpārtha evaṃ na kārayet || 2 ||
caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya maheśvaram ||
sauvarṇaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ dattvā bhakṣyāmi ca pare.ahani|| 3 ||
evaṃ niyamakṛtsuptvā prātarutthāya mānavaḥ ||
kṛtasnānajapaḥ paścādumayā saha śaṃkaram ||
pūjayetkusumaiḥ śuklairgaṃdhadhūpānulepanaiḥ || 4 ||
pādau namaḥ śivāyeti śiraḥ sarvātmane namaḥ ||
lalāṭaṃ tu trinetrāya netrāṇi haraye namaḥ || 5 ||
pārśve cānaṃtadharmāya jñānarūpāya vai kaṭim || 6 ||
ūrū cānantyavairāgyaṃ jānunī cārcayedbudhaḥ ||
vyomavyomātmarūpāya pṛṣṭhamabhyarcayennaraḥ ||
namaḥ sṛṣṭyai namastuṣṭyai pārvatīṃ cāpi pūjayet || 8 ||
śuklamālyāṃbarayutaṃ pañcaratnavibhūṣitam || 9 ||
bhakṣyairnānāvidhairyuktaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
prīyatāṃ devadevo.atra sadyojātaḥ pinākadhṛk|| 4.97.10 ||
pṛṣadājyaṃ ca saṃprāśya svapyādbhūmāvudaṅmukhaḥ ||
pañcadaśyāṃ tataḥ prātaḥ sarvametatsamācaret || 11 ||
tarpayitvā tatonnena brāhmaṇāñchaktitaḥ śubhān ||
suhṛtpadātisahitaḥ paścādbhuñjīta vāgyataḥ || 12 ||
tataḥ kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāmetatsarvaṃ samācaret ||
caturdaśīṣu sarvāsu kuryātpūrvavadarcanam || 13 ||
ye ca māse viśeṣāḥ syustānnibodha kramādiha ||
mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu svapannetānudīrayet || 14 ||
namaḥ paśupate nātha namaste śaṃbhave namaḥ || 16 ||
namaste paramānaṃda namaḥ somārddhadhāriṇe ||
namo bhīmāya cogrāya tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 17 ||
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhisarpiḥ kuśodakam ||
paṃcagavyaṃ tathā bilvaṃ yavāgūkṣīravārijam || 18 ||
tilāṃśca kṛṣṇānvidhivatprāśnīyātsamudāhṛtān ||
pratimāsaṃ caturdaśyāmekaikaṃ prāśanaṃ smṛtam || 19 ||
maṃdārairmālatībhiśca tathā dhattūkairapi ||
siṃduvārairaśokaiśca mallikākubjapāṭalaiḥ || 4.97.20 ||
karavīraiśca rājendra tathā pūjyo maheśvaraḥ || 21 ||
punaśca kārttike māsi saṃprāpte tarpayeddvijān || 22 || annairnānāvidhairbhakṣyairvastrairmālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
kṛtvā nīlaṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ śrutyuktavidhinā naraḥ||23||
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ ca gavā saha||
muktāphalāṣṭakayutaṃ sitanetrapaṭāvṛtam||24||
sarvopaskarayuktāyāṃ śayyāyāṃ vinivedayet||
sthāpya viprāya śāṃtāya vedavrataparāya ca||
avyaṃgāya ca saumyāya sadākalyāṇakāriṇe ||
sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
na vittaśāṭhyaṃ kurvīta kurvaṃllobhātpatatyadhaḥ || 27 ||
brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ yadatrāmutra vā kṛtam||
pitṛbhirmātṛbhirvāpi tatsarvaṃ nāśamāpnuyāt || 29 || dīrghāyurārogyakulābhivṛddhiratrākṣayānyatra caturbhujatvam ||
gaṇādhipatyaṃ divi kalpakoṭī svarge uṣitvā padameti śaṃbhoḥ || 4.97.30 ||
imāṃ śivacaturdaśīmamarakāminīkoṭayaḥ stuvaṃti divi naṃditā kimu samācaredyaḥ sadā || 32 ||
yā pārtha nārī kurute.atibhaktyā bharttāramāpṛcchya śubhaṃ guruṃ vā ||
sāpi prasādātparameśvarasya paraṃ padaṃ yāti pinākapāṇeḥ || 33 ||
tathā sarvaphalatyāgamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu bhārata ||
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi caturdaśyāṃ dhṛtavrataḥ ||
āraṃbhe śuklapakṣasya kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam || 2 ||
anyeṣvapi tu māseṣu aṣṭamyāṃ narasattama ||
sadakṣiṇāpāyasena śaktitaḥ pūjayeddvijān||3||
aṣṭādaśānāṃ dhānyānāmanyatra phalamūlakam ||
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca ||
kūṣmāṇḍaṃ mātuluṃgaṃ ca vṛṃtākaṃ panasaṃ tathā ||6||
āmrāmrātakapitthaṃ ca kaliṃgaṃ servavārukam? ||
śrīphalaṃ savaṭāśvatthaṃ jaṃbīraṃ kadalīphalam ||7||
badaraṃ dāḍimaṃ śaktyā kāryāṇyetāni ṣoḍaśa ||
mūlakāmalakaṃ jaṃbūpuṣkaraṃ karamardakam || 8 ||
uduṃbaraṃ nālikeraṃ drākṣā ca bṛhatīdvayam ||
kaṃkālī kākatuṃḍīraṃ karīrakuṭajaṃ śamī || 9 ||
raupyāṇi kārayecchaktyā phalānīmāni ṣoḍaśa ||
tāmraṃ tālaphalaṃ kuryādagastyaphalameva vā || 4.98.10 ||
piṃḍīrakaṃ ca kharjūraṃ tathā sūraṇa kaṃdakam ||
panasaṃ lakucaṃ caiva karkaṭaṃ tiṃtiḍiṃ tathā || 11 ||
citrāvallīphalaṃ tadvatkūṭaśālmalikāphalam ||
madhūkaṃ kāravellaṃ ca vallīṃ gudapaṭola kam ||12||
kārayecchaktito dhīmānphalānyetāni ṣoḍaśa ||
dhenvā sahaiva śāṃtāya viprāyātha kuṭuṃbine ||
yathā phaleṣu sarveṣu vasaṃtyamarakoṭayaḥ ||
yathā phalānāṃ kāmasya śivabhaktasya sarvadā ||
yathā bhedaṃ na paśyāmi śivaviṣṇvarkapadmajām ||
tathā mamāstu viśvātmā śaṅkaraḥ śaṃkaraḥ sadā || 18 ||
ityuccārya ca tatsarvamalaṃkṛtya vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
anyānapi yathā śaktyā bhojayeddvijapuṅgavān || 4.98.20 ||
na śaknoti vihātuṃ cetsarvāṇyapi phalānyuta ||
etattyāgavratānāṃ tu gave vaiṣṇavayoginām ||
nārībhiśca yathāśaktyā kartavyaṃ rājasattama || 22 ||
sauvarṇaraupyatāmreṣu yāvaṃtaḥ paramāṇavaḥ||
bhavaṃti cūryamāṇeṣu phaleṣu nṛpasattama ||
etatsamastakaluṣāpaharaṃ janānāmājīvanāya manujeśvara sarvadā syāt ||
yo vā śṛṇoti puruṣolpadhano naro vā yo brāhmaṇastu bhavaneṣu ca dhārmikāṇām|| pāpairvimuktaśca paratra puraṃ murārerānaṃdakṛtparamupaiti narendra sopi ||26|| ||
paurṇamāsīvratavarṇanam
paurṇamāsī mahārāja somasya dayitā tithiḥ ||
pūrṇamāso bhavedyasyāṃ paurṇamāsī tataḥ smṛtā || 1 ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ ca saṃjātaḥ saṃgrāmo jayalakṣaṇaḥ ||
tārāyāṃ candramāḥ saktastasyā bhartā bṛhaspatiḥ ||
tayorabhūnmahāyuddhaṃ bhāryākṛtyeṣu vai purā || 3 ||
tārā kasya sutā kasmātsa kruddhaḥ sasurārihā ||
prajāpaterabhūtkanyā tārā vṛtrasya cānujā ||
tāṃ bṛhaspataye prādātpṛthivyāmekasuṃdarīm || 5 ||
devācāryāya sā bhāryā tvanirdeśyā tathāvidhā ||
rūpeṇābhyāṃ rūpavatī sā nirdhūya vyavasthitā || 6 ||
bṛhaspatiṃ paryacaradyathā cānyāḥ striyaḥ kvacit ||
tāṃ dadarśāyatāpāṃgīṃ tanvaṃgīṃ cāruhāsinīm || 7 ||
śītāṃśurdarśanādeva kāmasya vaśamīyivān ||
ābabhāṣe ca madhuraṃ tāre ehyehi mā ciram || 8 ||
iṃgitākārakuśalā tārā somasya ceṣṭitam ||
buddhvā śuddhimatho tanvī prāhedaṃ madhurākṣaram || 9 ||
aṃgirāstvāṃ kila purā sasurāsurarākṣasaiḥ ||
kathamadya niśānātha hyanaṃgenāsi pīḍitaḥ ||
evamuktastathā cāsau na caitatkṛtavāṃstataḥ ||
gṛhītvākarṣayāmāsa somo.anaṃgavaśīkṛtaḥ || 13 ||
bṛhaspatistu tāṃ jñātvā sa taṃ somamagarhayat ||
preṣayiṣyati me bhāryāṃ svayameva mamāṃtikam || 14 ||
evaṃ cireṇa vijñāya bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ ||
nāsasāda svakāṃ bhāryāṃ roṣātprasphuritādharaḥ || 15 ||
iṃdraḥ samāhvayāmāsa devānṛṣigaṇāṃstathā || 16 ||
ākāryaṃ tridaśānsarvānācakhyau candraceṣṭitam || 17 ||
tacchrutvā devagaṃdharvāḥ krodhāndhāḥ kṣubdhamānasāḥ ||
pragṛhītapraharaṇā rathānāruruhuḥ svakān|| 18 ||
somo.api devānsodyogāñjñātvā sukṛtaniścayān ||
daityadānavarakṣāṃsi samānīya vyavasthitaḥ || 19 ||
kauṇapaiḥ kṣmāsuraiḥ śūlairdevadānavadāraṇam ||
sa teṣāṃ sumahadyuddhaṃ dattvā tārāgaṇādhipaḥ|||
babhaṃja devānsendrāṃśca hemavṛṣṭyā kṣapākaraḥ || 21 ||
śriyā paramayā yukto yathā nānyo havirbhujām || || 22 ||
ājagmuḥ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ śaraṇyaṃ svargavāsinām || 23 ||
śrutvā kruddho hṛṣīkeśa āruhya garuḍaṃ ruṣā ||
gṛhītvā cāyudhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yuddhāyaiva mano dadhe || 24 ||
prakartuṃ sumahadyuddhaṃ cakraśārṅgagadā dharaḥ ||
jagāma vibudhaiḥ sārdhaṃ somasyopari roṣitaḥ || 25 ||
viṣṇuṃ viditvā saṃprāptaṃ somo daityagaṇaiḥ saha ||
yuddhāya samarāmarṣī sthitaḥ pradhmāya vārijam || 26 ||
sa jitvā devasaṃghātaṃ seṃdraṃ vāyupurassaram ||
viṣṇunā saha saṃyuktaḥ śastrāstrairasubhojanaiḥ || 27 ||
yadā nāsāvuparamedyuddhāya saha viṣṇunā ||
tadā.a.adade ruṣā viṣṇuścakaṃ krodhasamanvitaḥ || 28 ||
athāha brahmā deveśamajitaṃ viṣṇumavyayam ||
yo.asau meghaprapuṣṭāṃgaṃ yattvāṃ vacmi nibodha tat || 29 ||
sinīvālī kuhūrnāma tasyāṃ naṣṭaḥ kṣapākaraḥ ||
vinaṣṭo.api punarjanma prāpsyatīti na saṃśayaḥ || 32 ||

āpyāyitaśca śrutyuktaiḥ pitṛpiṇḍaiḥ samaṃtrakaiḥ ||
vṛddhiḥ kṛṣṇena caivāsya na ca jātasya bhūyasī ||
śaptaśca somo dakṣeṇa sa cāvaśyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 35 ||
arpayasva gurorbhāryāṃ na kāryaṃ punarīdṛśam || 37 ||
sa tathoktaḥ samānīya dadau tārāṃ bṛhaspateḥ ||
punarūce śaśī spaṣṭaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tridivaukasām ||38 ||
bṛhaspatirathovāca mayā garbhaḥ samāhitaḥ || 39 ||
uktaṃ ca vedaśāstrajñairṣibhirddharmadarśibhiḥ || 4.99.40 ||
uptaṃ vātāhṛtaṃ bījaṃ yasya kṣetre prarohati ||
kṣetriṇastasya tadbījaṃ na bījī phalabhāgbhavet || 41 ||
vivadaṃtau nivāryātha brahmā provāca tāṃ vadhūm ||
śanairekāṃtamānīya garbhoyaṃ kasya śaṃsa me || 43 ||
evamuktā tu sā tārā hriyā novāca kiṃcana ||
utsasarja kṣaṇādgarbhaṃ bhābhāsitasurālayam || 44 ||
somo.api tanayaṃ labdhvā harṣavyākulamānasaḥ || 47 ||
evamanyo.api pūrṇārthaḥ pūrṇāṃśaḥ pūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ ||49||
evameṣā tithiḥ pārtha somasya dayitā śubhā ||
paurṇamāsī samākhyātā pūrṇo māso bhavedyathā || 51 ||
tadasyāṃ srotasi snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ||
ālikhya maṃḍale somaṃ nakṣatraiḥ sahitaṃ vibhum || 52 ||
śuklākṣataiḥ śuklavastraiḥ pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet||
śākāharaṇamunyannairnaktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ || 53 ||
vasaṃtabāṃdhava vidho śītāṃśo svasti naḥ kuru ||
gaganārṇavamāṇikya candra dākṣāyaṇīpate || 54 ||
pakṣepakṣe paurṇamāsyāṃ vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ ||
kṛṣṇapakṣe.api yaḥ kaścicchraddhāvānvai vratī bhavet || 55||
āmāvāsyā tithiriyaṃ pitṛrṇāṃ dayitā sadā ||
asyāṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ pitṛrṇāmakṣayaṃ bhavet || 56 ||
amāvāsyā mahārāja prayatnairyairupoṣitā ||
yaḥ kaścitkurute tasminpitṛpiṇḍodakakriyām ||
sa tārayati puṇyātmā puruṣānekaviṃśatim || 58 ||
bhaveyurakṣayāstasya lokāḥ pitṛniṣevitāḥ ||
yadā tu iha kālāṃte tasyātrāgamanaṃ bhavet || 59 ||
brāhmaṇaḥ pitṛbhaktaśca sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ ||
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte haimaṃ kṛtvā suśobhanam ||
saṃpūjya vastrābharaṇairmaṃtreṇetthaṃ nivedayet ||
yo na śaknoti vā kartuṃ pakṣaṃ vātha niraṃtaram ||
sa ekāmapyupoṣyaiva kuryādudyāpanaṃ sudhīḥ || 63 ||
yaścaitatkurute pārtha paurṇamāsīvrataṃ naraḥ ||
saṃtatiṃ vipulāṃ prāpya prayāge maraṇaṃ bhajet || 65 ||
tataścaivākṣayā~mllokānprāpnoti surasevitān ||
sevyamānaḥ sa gandharvaiḥ stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ ||
āste saṃpūrṇasarvāṃgo yāvatkalpāyutatrayam || 66 ||

vaiśākhīkārttikīmāghīvratavarṇanam

snānadānavihīnaistā na neyāḥ pāṃḍunandana || 2 ||

vaiśākhyāṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha śreṣṭhā dyotanikā matā || 3 ||

madhurānnarasaiḥ pūrṇānbhājanānkanakojjvalān ||

vaṭasāvitrīvratavarṇanam

aparādhaśatāghaughaṃ vratenānena nāśayet || 4.146.60 ||
kāñcanavratavarṇanam
vāsudevaṃ jagannāthaṃ sthitisaṃyamakārakam || 1 ||
parāvarāṇāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ purāṇaṃ paramavyayam ||
ādidevaṃ jagannāthaṃ jagataḥ kāraṇātma kam|| 2 ||
lakṣmīḥ provāca rājendra pādasaṃvāhane sthitā || 3 ||
praṣṭavyaṃ kiñcidicchāmi praṣṭuṃ praśnavidāṃ vara || 4 ||
prakuruṣva mahābhāga dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari ||
uttamaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ vratānāmapi cottamam||
gṛhasthaścāśramāṇāṃ ca varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā ||
yathā nadīṣu sarvāsu jāhnavī lokaviśrutā || 7 ||
hradānāmudadhiḥ śreṣṭho devānāṃ viṣṇuruttamaḥ ||
strīṇāṃ devā yathā lakṣmīstathedaṃ vratamuttamam|| 8 ||
na gaṅgā na kurukṣetraṃ na kāśī na ca puṣkaram ||
gauryā devyā kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā ||
rāmeṇa sītayā sārddhaṃ rājyaṃ prāpya kṛtaṃ purā || 4.147.10 ||
kṛṣṇayā sahitaiḥ pārtha pāṃḍavairvana vāsibhiḥ || 11 ||
raṃbhayā menayā vāpi paulomyā satyabhāmayā || 12 ||
śāṃḍilyā cāpyarundhatyā urvaśyā devadattayā ||
kṛtaṃ vratamidaṃ bhadraṃ saubhāgyasukhakāmyayā || 13 ||
pātāle nāgakanyābhiḥ kṛtametatsuśobhanam ||
gāyatryā ca sarasvatyā sāvitryā brahmabhāryayā || 14 ||
anyābhiḥ sarvanārībhiḥ sarvakāmaphalepsubhiḥ ||
tasmātte.ahaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 15 ||
vasuprītikaraṃ ramyaṃ vratānāṃ paramaṃ śṛṇu ||
brahmahā mucyate pāpātsurāpo vasuhārakaḥ || 16 ||
gurubhāryābhigāmī ca hyeteṣāṃ saṃgamī ca yaḥ ||
mānakūṭaṃ tulākūṭaṃ kanyāvṛttirgavāṃ vratī || 17 ||
agamyāgamano yastu māṃsāśī vṛṣalīpatiḥ ||
kuṇḍāgnibhojī yastu syādbhūbhihartā tathaiva ca || 18 ||
ebhiḥ sarvairmahāpāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
kāñcanākhyā purī nāma vrataṃ trailokyaviśrutam || 4.147.20 ||
yaḥ karoti naro devi nārī vā bhaktisaṃyutā ||
tasminmāse ca kartavyā kāñcanākhyā purī śubhā || 22 || śuklakṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāmekādaśyāṃ ca pūrṇimā ||
saṃkrāṃtirvā mahābhāge kuhūrvā cāṣṭamī tithiḥ || 23 ||
parvasvanyeṣu sarveṣu dātavyā kāñcanī purī ||
vratī snātvā tu pūrvāhṇe nadyādau vimale jale || 24 ||
mṛttikālaṃbhanaṃ kāryaṃ maṃtreṇānena suvrate ||
uddhṛtāsi yathāpūrvaṃ viṣṇunā kroḍarūpiṇā ||25||
lokānāmupakārārthaṃ vandanātsiddhikāmadā ||
tasmāttvaṃ vaṃditā pāpaṃ hara me.anekajanmajam || 26 || ( iti mṛttikāmaṃtraḥ ||) || āpastu viśvayonirhi viṣṇunā nirmitāḥ svayam ||
sānnidhyaṃ tīrthasahitaṃ kartavyaṃ mama sāṃpratam || 27 || ( ityammaṃtraḥ ||) ||
anena vidhinā snātvā yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ ||
gṛhamāgamya śuddhātmā nālapanpiśunāṃstva rāt || 28 ||
pākhaṃḍino vikarmasthāndhūrtāṃśca kitavācchaṭhān ||
prakṣālya pāṇivadanaṃ kuryāttvācamanaṃ tataḥ || 29 ||
dvādaśākṣaramaṃtreṇa tajjalaṃ cābhimaṃtrayet ||
śamīvṛkṣamayā vedī catuḥstaṃbhasamanvitā ||
caturhastapramāṇena kāryyā caiva suśobhanā || 32 ||
vastreṇāveṣṭitāḥ stambhā vitānavara maṇḍitāḥ ||
puṣpamālānvitāḥ kāryā divyadhūpādhivāsitāḥ || 33 ||
madhye tu maṃḍalaṃ kāryaṃ padmākhyaṃ varṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
yena dṛṣṭena deveśi sarvapāpa kṣayo bhavet ||
agre tu kalaśaḥ kāryo jalapūrṇaḥ suśobhanaḥ ||
kṣīrasāgaranāmā sa kalpitavyaḥ prayatnataḥ || 36 ||
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ vastreṇāve ṣṭayeddhanam ||
tasyopariṣṭātsaṃsthāpya kāṃcanākhyāṃ purīṃ śubhām||
catuṣpalā hyuttamā syāddvipalā madhyamā smṛtā || 38 ||
sāmānyaikapalā kāryā kalaśaistu samanvitā || modakānsthāpayeddivyānsamaṃtātsuṃdarākṛtīn || 39 ||
cātuścaraṇikāṃstatra viprānāvāhya suṃdari || 4.147.40 ||
pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayettasya vedamantraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ ||
tasyā madhye nyasedviṣṇuṃ haimaṃ lakṣmyā samanvitam || 41 ||
netre ratnamaye kārye daśanā vajrabhūṣitāḥ ||
muktāphalamayaṃ tasya bhūṣaṇaṃ parikalpayet || 42 ||
aṃgaṃ svarṇamayaṃ kāryaṃ śaṃkhacakragadāyudham ||
pañcāmṛtena deveśaṃ snāpya nārāyaṇaṃ vibhum || 43 ||
śeṣā varṇāḥ purāṇoktaistāñchṛṇuṣva mama priye ||
vāsudevāya pādau tu gulphau saṃkarṣaṇāya ca || 45 ||
trailokyanāthāya guhye jñānamayāya vai kaṭim || 46 ||
dāmodarāyetyudaraṃ hṛdayaṃ viśvarūpiṇe ||
nityaṃ hi pūjayeddevi uraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe || 47 ||
kaṇṭhaṃ kaustubhanāthāya āsyaṃ yajñamukhāya ca ||
daityāṃtakāriṇe bāhū svairnāmairāyudhāni ca || 48 ||
śriyaṃ prapūjayeddevīṃ devyā maṃtraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 49 ||
indrādilokapālānāṃ pūjā kāryā yathākramam ||
navagrahāṇāṃ homaśca kartavyo vighnanāśanaḥ ||4.147.50||
pūjā gaṇapateḥ kāryā tathā homo vidhānataḥ ||
pāyasaṃ ghṛtapūrāṃśca modakānpūrikāstathā ||
sohālikādinaivedyaṃ pheṇikāḥ śarkarāstathā || 52 ||
dīpāndaśa diśo dadyātpārthivānraktavartikān||53||
etena tu viśālākṣi mūlamantreṇa dāpayet ||
puṣpamālānvitānkṛtvā caṃdanena vibhūṣitān ||54||
sahasraśīrṣādibhirmaṃtrairjapadbhirbrāhmaṇottamaiḥ || 55 ||
ṣoḍaśātha sapatnīkānpūjayecca yathāvidhi ||
bhūṣayecca śubhairvastraistathālaṃkāraṇādibhiḥ || 56 ||
viṣṇuṃ matvā dvijaḥ pūjyo lakṣmīṃ matvā ca brāhmaṇīm ||
chatraṃ copānahau caiva aṃgulyābharaṇaṃ tathā ||57||
dātavyaṃ ca sabhāryāya kṛṣṇo me prīyatāmiti || 58 ||
śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ caiva vastreṇācchādya yatnataḥ ||
purīṃ ghaṭāpayetpūrvaṃ vastreṇācchādyayastaḥ ||
yathā kuryātprayāsena yathā kartā na paśyati || 4.147.60 ||
dīpāṃstu dīpitāṃstatra ānayedyajñamaṇḍapam ||
śrutavāñchāstravitprājñaḥ kṛtasarvāghasaṃkṣayaḥ ||
ābadhya netre suprājña ācāryastamidaṃ vadet ||62||
sarvakāmapradāṃ paśya kāṃcanākhyāṃ purīmimām||
varavastrayutāṃ ramyāṃ duḥkhadaurbhāgyanāśinīm|| 63 ||
puṣpāñjaliṃ gurau kṣiptvā sa paśyettāṃ purīṃ śubhām||64||
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ nagarīṃ devi yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ ||
sauvarṇaṃ pātramādāya raupyaṃ tāmramathāpi vā || 65 ||
atha vā śaṃkhamādāya pātrālābhe tu sundari ||
pañcaratnaṃ kṣipetpātre jalaṃ gāṅgaṃ tathā phalam || 66 ||
siddhārthamakṣatāḥ pūrvaṃ rocanā dadhi vā punaḥ ||
tataścārdhyaṃ pradātavyaṃ kṛṣṇāya prabhaviṣṇave || 67 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau devau sarvakāmaphalapradau ||
rukmapuryāḥ pradānena yacchaitāṃ vāṃchitaṃ mama || 68 ||
nārāyaṇa hṛṣīkeśa jñānajñeya niraṃjana||
lakṣmīkāṃta jagannātha gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namostu te||69|| ( ityarghamaṃtraḥ) ||
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā maṃtrametamudīrayet ||
brahmaṇā pūjitā devī viṣṇunā śaṃkareṇa ca ||71||
pārvatyā pūjitā lakṣmīḥ skaṃdavaiśravaṇena ca||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādbhaktiyuktena cetasā ||74||
gītanṛtyavinodena upākhyānaiśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ||
unnidro jāgṛyādyastu śatayajñaphalaṃ labhet ||
prabhāte vimale snātvā saṃpūjya pitṛdevatāḥ ||76||
brāhmaṇāṃśca sapatnīkānparidhāpyānubhojayet ||
dakṣiṇāśca yathāśaktyā pradāya ca kṣamāpayet || 77 || dīnāṃdhabadhirānpaṃgūnsarvāṃstānparitoṣayet ||
paścātpāraṇakaṃ kāryamupavāsī bhavedyadi || 78 ||
madhuraṃ payasā yuktaṃ suhṛdbhirbāṃdhavaiḥ saha ||
evametadvrataṃ kāryamekādaśyāṃ śucismite || 79 ||
śuklāyāmatha kṛṣṇāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tathā tithau||
saṃkrāṃtivāsare vāpi vyatīpāte ca vaidhṛtau ||4.147.80||
yadā vā jāyate vittaṃ cittaṃ ca varavarṇini ||
gaurānīya pradātavyā kṛṣṇo me prīyatāmiti || 81 ||
evaṃ kṛte ca yatpuṇyaṃ tanna śakyaṃ niveditum ||
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca||
indrādilokapālānāṃ vratī lokamavāpnuyāt || 84 ||
tato bhuktvā śuciḥ śrīmānbhogāṃstrailokyasuṃdari ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ vācayamānaṃ samaṃtataḥ ||
tvayā kāṃcanapuryākhyaṃ vratametatkṛtaṃ purā ||
saptapūrvānbhaviṣyāṃśca svakule sapta mānavān||1||
lokānāpnoti ca tathā dakṣasyaiva prajāpateḥ||2||
prājāpatyena vidhinā ātmānaṃ ca samuddharet||
bhūgavāśvapradānāni gajadānaṃ tathaiva ca ||
bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi purīṣaṃ kākamaśnute||
śulkena dattvā kanyāṃ ca ghoraṃ narakamāpnuyāt ||5||
bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi tathā aśucibhuṅnaraḥ||
savarṇāṃ ca savarṇebhyo dadyātkanyāṃ yathāvidhi ||6||
anāthāṃ kanyakāṃ dattvā nākaloke mahīyate || 8 ||
kanyādānādavāpnoti dakṣalokaṃ narottama ||
viṣṇupūjāsamaṃ puṇyaṃ tatkanyāpūjayā bhavet || 4.148.10 ||
vimānamāhṛtya manobhirāmaṃ surāṅganāgītavilāsahṛdyam ||
prāpnoti lokaṃ tridaśottamānāṃ kanyāpradānānna vicāraṇeti || 11 || ||
brāhmaṇaśuśrūṣāvidhivarṇanam
brāhmaṇā daivataṃ bhūmau brāhmaṇā divi daivatam ||
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṃ nāsti nāsti bhūtaṃ jagattraye || 1 ||
brāhmaṇā hi mahābhāgāḥ pūjyaṃte satataṃ dvijāḥ ||2||
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samutpannā devāḥ pūrvamiti smṛtiḥ ||
brāhmaṇebhyo jagatsarvaṃ tasmātpūjyatamā dvijāḥ || 3 ||
yeṣāmaśnaṃti vaktreṇa devatāḥ pitarastathā ||
ṛṣayaśca tathā nāgāḥ kiṃ bhūtamadhikaṃ tataḥ || 4 ||
tālavṛṃtānilenaiva śrāṃtasaṃvāhanena ca ||
utsādanena gātrāṇāṃ tathā vyaṃjanakarmaṇā || 6 ||
aniṣṭvāpi samāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca śāśvatam ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā nākaloke mahīyate || 8 ||
yadbrāhmaṇāstuṣṭimanto vadaṃti pratyakṣadeveṣu parokṣadevāḥ ||
vṛṣadānavidhivarṇanam
yuṣmadvākyāmṛtamidaṃ hyahaṃ śṛṇvañjanārdana||
na tṛptimadhigacchāmi jātaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 1 ||
tasmādgovṛṣakalpasya vidhānaṃ kathayācyuta || 3 ||
vṛṣadānaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi te ||
pavitraṃ pāvanaṃ caiva sarvadānottamaṃ tathā || 4 ||
voḍhā ca cārupṛṣṭhāṃgo hyarogaḥ pāṃḍunaṃdana ||
yuvā bhadraḥ suśī laśca sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ || 6 ||
trātā bhavati saṃsārānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 7 ||
alaṃkṛtya vṛṣaṃ śāṃtaṃ puṇyehni samupasthite ||
raupyalāḍgūlasaṃyuktaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet || 8 ||
maṃtreṇānena rājendra taṃ śṛṇuṣva vadāmi te ||
dharmastvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa jaga dānaṃdakāraka || 9 ||
aṣṭamūrteradhiṣṭhānamataḥ pāhi sanātana ||
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vāṅmanaḥ kāyakarmajam ||
yānaṃ vṛṣabhasaṃyuktaṃ dīpyamānaṃ suśobhitam ||
yāvaṃti tasya romāṇi govṛṣasya mahīpate ||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi gavāṃ loke mahīyate || 13 ||
yajñayājī mahātejāḥ sarvabrāhmaṇapūjitaḥ || 14 ||
tavoktaṃ vai mahārāja kasya deyo vṛṣottamaḥ ||
tadapyahaṃ te vakṣyāmi pātraṃ trāṇapradaṃ nṛṇām || 15 ||
yeṣāṃ sadā vai śrutipūrṇakarṇā jitendriyāḥ prāṇivadhe nivṛttāḥ ||
pratigrahe saṃkucitā gṛhasthāste brāhmaṇāstārayituṃ samarthāḥ ||16 ||
gātre dṛḍhaṃ bhārasahaṃ supuṣṭaṃ suśṛṅgiṇaṃ sarvaguṇopapannam ||
śrutaḥ purāṇaviṣayastvatprasādānmayācyuta ||
saṃsārāsāratāṃ jñātvā śrutaśca vratavistaraḥ || 1 ||
bhūyaśca śrotumicchāmi dānamāhātmyamuttamam ||
kiṃ dīyate kadā kṛṣṇa kenopāyena śaṃsa me || 2 ||
dhanaṃ dhanavatāṃ kiñcidahāryaṃ rājataskaraiḥ || 3 ||
anītaṃ yāti cādhvānaṃ dhanaṃ viprakarārpitam || 4 ||
kiṃ kāyena supuṣṭena balinā cirajīvinā ||
yasya trivargaśūnyāni dinānyāyāṃti yāṃti ca ||
dīnā niraśanā rūkṣāḥ kapālāṅkitapāṇayaḥ ||
te dṛśyaṃte mahārāja jāyamānā punaḥ || 4.151.10 ||
āyāsaśatalabdhasya prāṇebhyopi garīyasaḥ ||
nopabhogaiḥ kṣayaṃ yāṃti na pradānaiḥ samṛddhayaḥ ||
pūrvārjitānāmanyatra sukṛtānāṃ parikṣayāt || 12 ||
yasmānmṛtasya tannāsti tasmātsāṃśayikaṃ varam || 13 ||
dānāni bahurūpāṇi kathayāmi tavānagha ||
vyāsavālmīkimanvādyaiḥ kathitāni purā mama || 14 ||
brāhmaṇaprīṇanārthāya keśavasya śivasya ca ||
yāni dānāni deyāni tānyācakṣya yadūttama ||16||
trīṇyāhuratidānāni gāvaḥ pṛthvī sarasvatī ||
godānamādau vakṣyāmi pratyakṣakramayogataḥ ||
deyāḥ kiṃlakṣaṇā gāvaḥ kāśca rājanvivarjitāḥ ||
kīdṛśāya pradātavyā na deyāḥ kīdṛśāya vai ||4.151.20||
taruṇī rūpasaṃpannā suśīlā ca payasvinī ||
nyāyārjitā savatsā ca pradeyā śrotriyāya gauḥ || 21 ||
vṛddhā sarogā hīnāṃgī vaṃdhyā duṣṭā mṛtaprajā ||
sā dattaiva haretpāpaṃ śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye ||
atithipriyāya dāṃtāya dhenuṃ dadyādguṇādhike ||23||
akulīnāya mūrkhāya lubdhāya piśunāya ca ||
puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya snātvātarpya pitṛrṃstathā ||
ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣekaṃ ca kṛtvā viṣṇoḥ śivasya ca || 25 ||
udaṅmukhīṃ prāṅmukhīṃ vā gṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā payasvinīm || 26 ||
savatsāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ sitayajñopavītinīm ||
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ kāṃsyadohanakānvitām || 27 ||
śaktito dakṣiṇāyuktāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
pucche kṛṣṇājinaṃ deyaṃ gāṃ pucche kariṇaṃ kare || 28 ||
aśvaṃ sadā sukarṇe vā dāsīṃ śirasi dāpayet ||
gāvo mamāgrataḥ saṃtu gāvo me saṃtu pṛṣṭhataḥ || 29 ||
gāvo me hṛdaye saṃtu gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham ||
pradakṣiṇāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhenuṃ dvijavarāya tām || 4.151.30 ||
imāṃ ca pratigṛhṇīṣva dhenurdattā mayā tava ||
sapta pūrvānsapta parānātmānaṃ caiva mānavaḥ ||33||
sarvakāmapradā sā syātsarvakāleṣu pārthiva ||35||
bhavatyasau pāpaharā yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa ||
sarveṣāmeva pāpānāṃ kṛtānāmapi jānatā ||36||
prāyaścittamidaṃ proktamanutāpopabṛṃhitam ||
sarveṣāmeva dānānāmekajanmānugaṃ phalam || 37 ||
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiścānyaiśca mānavaiḥ ||
lokāḥ kāmagamā prāptā dattvaitadvidhinā nṛpa || 38 ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dhenūnāṃ kalpanā nṛpa ||
viśeṣavidhinā yāśca deyāḥ kāmānabhīpsubhiḥ || 1 ||
kāmaṃ yaddīyate dānaṃ samagraṃ tatsukhāvaham ||
tasmānna dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ vidhānavikalaṃ tathā ||
deyaṃ dānaṃ mahārāja samagraphalakāmyayā || 3 ||
anyathā dīyamānaṃ tadahaṃkārāya kevalam ||
pratyakṣaṃ cārthahāniḥ syānna vā tatphaladaṃ bhavet || 4 ||
tiladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu pārthivasattama ||
vārāheṇa purā proktāṃ mahāpātakanāśinīm || 5 ||
yāṃ dattvā brahmahā goghnaḥ pitṛhā gurutalpagaḥ ||
agāradāhī garadaḥ sarvapāparatopi vā || 6 ||
mahāpātakayuktaśca saṃyuktaścopapātakaiḥ ||
anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe kṛṣṇājinasamāvṛte ||
dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ kṛtvā darbhānāstīrya sarvataḥ || 8 ||
tilāḥ śvetāstilāḥ kṛṣṇāstilā gomūtravarṇakāḥ ||
tilānāṃ ca vicitrāṇāṃ dhenuṃ sarvāṃ ca kārayet ||9 ||
droṇasya vatsakaṃ kuryāccaturāḍhakikāṃ ca gām ||
svarṇaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ gandhavarṇavatīṃ tathā || 4.152.10 ||
kāryā śarkarayā jihvā guḍenāsyaṃ ca kambalaḥ ||
ikṣupādāṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhīṃ śuktimuktāphalekṣaṇām || 11 ||

vṛṣabhadānavratavarṇanam

kapilādānamāhātmyavarṇanam

|| vinatāśva uvāca || ||

|| dharaṇyuvāca || ||

kṛṣṇājinadānavidhivarṇanam

na mūlyamādādveśyātaḥ sa bhavāniha sāṃpratam ||

gaurī lakṣmīśca sāvitrī śaktibhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 12 ||

chaṃdāṃsyenaṃ mṛtyukāle tyajaṃti nīḍaṃ śakuntā iva jātapakṣāḥ || 17 ||

ācārāddhi cyuto jaṃturna kulīno na dhārmikaḥ || 4.205.20||

hīnajātiprasūtopi śaucācārasamanvitaḥ ||

sarvalakṣaṇahīnopi yaḥ sadācāravānnaraḥ ||

nekṣetādityamudyantaṃ nāstaṃ yāṃtaṃ kadācana || 32 ||

sarvāṃstāndhārmiko rājā śūdrakarmaṇi yojayet ||

dāridranāśanaṃ dharmmaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ tathākṣayaṃ |0||
kauṇḍinya uvāca |
pūrṇo manoratho deva mama cādya viśeṣataḥ |
kaścūtaḥ ko vṛṣaḥ kā gauḥ kintat puṣkariṇīdvayaṃ |
kaḥ kharaḥ kuñjaraḥ ko vā ko vā vṛddhadvijottamaḥ |
kṛpayā kathayasvādya pathi dṛṣṭo mayā vibho |
śrīananta uvāca |
yaścāmravṛkṣo dṛṣṭo hi vipro vidyāsu garvvitaḥ |
upasthitāya śiṣyāya vidyāṃ yasmānna dattavān |
tena karmmavipākena vṛkṣatvaṃ prāpya tiṣṭhati |
vṛṣabho yastvayā dṛṣṭo lobhakarmmakṛtaḥ purā ||
dattaṃ paryyuṣitaṃ dravyaṃ svādu bhuktaṃ svayaṃ yataḥ |
vṛṣabhatvaṃ samāsādya tatastiṣṭhati nirjjane ||
viprāya vasudhāṃ dattvā niṣphalāṃ śasyavarjjitāṃ |
tenāsau gotvamāsādya tṛṇamadhye pradhāvati ||
dharmmādharmmau vijānīyādyattat puṣkariṇīdvayaṃ |
bhuktvā bhogāṃśca vipulān saṃprāpsyasi mahat padaṃ ||
anantākhyaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ varṣāṇāñca caturdaśaṃ |
śīlayā saha dharmmātmā sukhaṃ bhuktvā manorathān ||
viṣṇurokaṃ samāsādya rarāja śīlayā saha |
